例句.pinyin: zhè ge nián dài yòng diàn shì hé shōu yīn jī bào dào xīn wén yǐ shì shí fēn píng cháng de shì le 。
例句.en: The communication of news by TV and radio is very common now.

例句.zh: 关于这个问题，我觉得垃圾媒体只报道了很片面的信息。
例句.pinyin: guān yú zhè ge wèn tí ， wǒ jué de lā jī méi tǐ zhǐ bào dào le hěn piàn miàn de xìn xī 。
例句.en: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.

例句.zh: 他觉得必须报道这件事。
例句.pinyin: tā jué de bì xū bào dào zhè jiàn shì 。
例句.en: He felt compelled to report the incident.

释义: to inform / to report / to make known / report / speech / talk / lecture / CL:篇[pian1],份[fen4],個|个[ge4],通[tong4]

例句.zh: 在明天前完成报告几乎是不可能的。
例句.pinyin: zài míng tiān qián wán chéng bào gào jī hū shì bù kě néng de 。
例句.en: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.

例句.zh: 这个月底前，我们必须交报告。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge yuè dǐ qián ， wǒ men bì xū jiāo bào gào 。
例句.en: We have to turn in our reports by the end of this month.

例句.zh: 我们认为这份报告是假的。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men rèn wéi zhè fèn bào gào shì jiǎ de 。
例句.en: We considered the report as false.

释义: to sound an alarm / to report sth to the police

例句.zh: 最重要的是马上报警。
例句.pinyin: zuì zhòng yào de shì mǎ shàng bào jǐng 。
例句.en: The important thing is to call the police at once.

例句.zh: 我们该报警。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men gāi bào jǐng 。
例句.en: We should call the police.

例句.zh: 在紧急情况下，打电话报警。
例句.pinyin: zài jǐn jí qíng kuàng xià ， dǎ diàn huà bào jǐng 。
例句.en: In case of emergency, call the police.

释义: torrential rain / rainstorm / CL:場|场[chang2],陣|阵[zhen4]

例句.zh: 狂风暴雨造成她无法准时抵达。
例句.pinyin: kuáng fēng bào yǔ zào chéng tā wú fǎ zhǔn shí dǐ dá 。
例句.en: The storm prevented her from arriving on time.

例句.zh: 我很庆幸我们没有去那儿，因为当时那儿有局部大暴雨。
例句.pinyin: wǒ hěn qìng xìng wǒ men méi yǒu qù nà ér ， yīn wèi dāng shí nà ér yǒu jú bù dà bào yǔ 。
例句.en: I'm glad we didn't go there because there were some localized heavy rain showers.

例句.zh: 强风暗示著即将到来的暴雨。
例句.pinyin: qiáng fēng àn shì zhù jí jiāng dào lái de bào yǔ 。
例句.en: The strong wind indicates that a storm is coming.

释义: to complain / to grumble / to harbor a complaint / to feel dissatisfied

例句.zh: 他一直抱怨他的房间很小。
例句.pinyin: tā yì zhí bào yuàn tā de fáng jiān hěn xiǎo 。
例句.en: He is always complaining of his room being small.

例句.zh: 工人们抱怨他们的工作时间被延长了。
例句.pinyin: gōng rén men bào yuàn tā men de gōng zuò shí jiān bèi yán cháng le 。
例句.en: The workers are complaining that their hours have been increased.

例句.zh: 我不想再听你抱怨了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng zài tīng nǐ bào yuàn le 。
例句.en: I don't want to hear any more of your complaining.

释义: variant of 背[bei1] / to carry on one's back / (fig.) to bear; to shoulder (a burden, blame etc) / the back of a body or object / to turn one's back / to hide something from / to learn by heart / to recite from memory / (slang) unlucky / hard of hearing

例句.zh: 要解开谋杀背后潜藏之谜！
例句.pinyin: yào jiě kāi móu shā bèi hòu qián cáng zhī mí ！
例句.en: Solve the mystery lurking behind the murder!

例句.zh: 他背著一个袋子。
例句.pinyin: tā bèi zhù yí gè dài zi 。
例句.en: He carries a bag on his back.

例句.zh: 女孩总是跟随在母亲背后。
例句.pinyin: nǚ hái zǒng shì gēn suí zài mǔ qīn bèi hòu 。
例句.en: The girl was always following her mother.

释义: behind / at the back / in the rear / behind sb's back

例句.zh: 要解开谋杀背后潜藏之谜！
例句.pinyin: yào jiě kāi móu shā bèi hòu qián cáng zhī mí ！
例句.en: Solve the mystery lurking behind the murder!

例句.zh: 女孩总是跟随在母亲背后。
例句.pinyin: nǚ hái zǒng shì gēn suí zài mǔ qīn bèi hòu 。
例句.en: The girl was always following her mother.

例句.zh: 你不应该在背后说别人的坏话。
例句.pinyin: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài bèi hòu shuō bié rén de huài huà 。
例句.en: Don't speak ill of others behind their back.

释义: background; backdrop; context / (fig.) powerful backer

例句.zh: 如果你不明白一件事，那是因为你没有意识到它的背景。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ bù míng bái yī jiàn shì ， nà shì yīn wèi nǐ méi yǒu yì shí dào tā de bèi jǐng 。
例句.en: If you don't understand something, it's because you aren't aware of its context.

例句.zh: 图片的背景是一座城堡。
例句.pinyin: tú piàn de bèi jǐng shì yī zuò chéng bǎo 。
例句.en: There is a castle in the background of the picture.

例句.zh: Tom有兽医背景。
例句.pinyin: Tom yǒu shòu yī bèi jǐng 。
例句.en: Tom has a veterinary background.

释义: blanket; quilt / CL:條|条[tiao2],床[chuang2]

例句.zh: 冬天我总是需要多加条被子。
例句.pinyin: dōng tiān wǒ zǒng shì xū yào duō jiā tiáo bèi zi 。
例句.en: I always need an extra blanket in the wintertime.

例句.zh: 食物和被子被送到难民手中。
例句.pinyin: shí wù hé bèi zi bèi sòng dào nàn mín shǒu zhōng 。
例句.en: Food and quilts were delivered to the refugees.

例句.zh: 我能要一条被子吗?
例句.pinyin: wǒ néng yào yī tiáo bèi zi ma ?
例句.en: Can I have a quilt?

释义: (bound form) root; stem / (bound form) origin; source / (bound form) one's own; this / (bound form) this; the current (year etc) / (bound form) original / (bound form) inherent / originally; initially / capital; principal / classifier for books, periodicals, files etc

例句.zh: 这本书对你来说读起来太难了。
例句.pinyin: zhè běn shū duì nǐ lái shuō dú qǐ lái tài nán le 。
例句.en: This book is too difficult for you to read.

例句.zh: 这本书有精美的插图。
例句.pinyin: zhè běn shū yǒu jīng měi de chā tú 。
例句.en: This book is beautifully illustrated.

例句.zh: 我做完我的功课后，就读这本书。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zuò wán wǒ de gōng kè hòu ， jiù dú zhè běn shū 。
例句.en: I read the book after I had finished my homework.

释义: local / this locality

例句.zh: 本地人、外来人齐心共创上海新文明。
例句.pinyin: běn dì rén 、 wài lái rén qí xīn gòng chuàng shàng hǎi xīn wén míng 。
例句.en: Native Chinese people are working alongside foreigners to change the culture of Shanghai.

例句.zh: 我说世界语可以说得像个本地人。
例句.pinyin: wǒ shuō shì jiè yǔ kě yǐ shuō dé xiàng gè běn dì rén 。
例句.en: I can speak Esperanto like a native.

例句.zh: 当你想说"我保证", 如果你说"koko ni chikaimasu", 你听起来会更象一个本地人。
例句.pinyin: dāng nǐ xiǎng shuō " wǒ bǎo zhèng ",  rú guǒ nǐ shuō "koko ni chikaimasu",  nǐ tīng qǐ lái huì gèng xiàng yí gè běn dì rén 。
例句.en: When you want to say "I promise", if you say "koko ni chikaimasu" you'll sound more like a native.

释义: skill / ability / capability / CL:項|项[xiang4],個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 若老师要筹划一趟假期旅行或类似需要比价、核算费用的事，他便会借助学生的本领。有时，妻子想要一个新果盘，或丈夫想要一把新裁纸刀；许多人有儿子需要听睡前短故事，或有女儿的洋娃娃必须穿上最时髦的衣裳；凡此种种，老师一律让学生替他代劳。
例句.pinyin: ruò lǎo shī yào chóu huà yī tàng jià qī lǚ xíng huò lèi sì xū yào bǐ jià 、 hé suàn fèi yòng de shì ， tā biàn huì jiè zhù xué shēng de běn lǐng 。 yǒu shí ， qī zǐ xiǎng yào yí gè xīn guǒ pán ， huò zhàng fū xiǎng yào yī bǎ xīn cái zhǐ dāo ； xǔ duō rén yǒu ér zi xū yào tīng shuì qián duǎn gù shì ， huò yǒu nǚ ér de yáng wá wá bì xū chuān shàng zuì shí máo de yī shang ； fán cǐ zhǒng zhǒng ， lǎo shī yī lǜ ràng xué shēng tì tā dài láo 。
例句.en: If the teacher is to plan out a vacation or something similar requiring one to compare prices and figure out what it would cost, it is the pupils' skills he would exploit. Sometimes, the wife may be wishing for a new fruit bowl, or perhaps the husband is looking for a new letter opener. Many have sons that require a short bedside story or daughters with dolls that must be clad in clothing of utmost fashionability; all this, the teacher makes the pupils make for him.

释义: I; me; myself / oneself; yourself; himself; herself; the person concerned

例句.zh: 日本人放弃了战争。
例句.pinyin: rì běn rén fàng qì le zhàn zhēng 。
例句.en: The Japanese people have renounced war.

例句.zh: 你是中国人还是日本人？
例句.pinyin: nǐ shì zhōng guó rén hái shì rì běn rén ？
例句.en: Are you Chinese or Japanese?

例句.zh: 访客通常在进入一户日本人家之前会被要求脱鞋。
例句.pinyin: fǎng kè tōng cháng zài jìn rù yī hù rì běn rén jiā zhī qián huì bèi yāo qiú tuō xié 。
例句.en: Visitors are usually asked to remove their shoes before they enter a Japanese house.

释义: essence / nature / innate character / intrinsic quality

例句.zh: 自由的本质就是数学。
例句.pinyin: zì yóu de běn zhì jiù shì shù xué 。
例句.en: The essence of liberty is mathematics.

例句.zh: 它本质上是一个时间的问题。
例句.pinyin: tā běn zhì shàng shì yí gè shí jiān de wèn tí 。
例句.en: It is essentially a question of time.

例句.zh: 喏，这是我的秘密。很简单。只有用心才能看到本质的东西。精髓是眼睛看不见的。
例句.pinyin: nuò ， zhè shì wǒ de mì mì 。 hěn jiǎn dān 。 zhǐ yǒu yòng xīn cái néng kàn dào běn zhì dì dōng xī 。 jīng suǐ shì yǎn jīng kàn bú jiàn de 。
例句.en: And now here is my secret, a very simple secret: It is only with the heart that one can see rightly; what is essential is invisible to the eye.

释义: each other; one another

例句.zh: 21个月前在寒冬所开始的一切不应当在今天这个秋夜结束。今天的选举胜利并不是我们所寻求的改变--这只是我们进行改变的机会。如果我们仍然按照过去的方式行事，我们所寻求的改变将不会发生。没有你们，没有服务和牺牲的新精神，就不可能发生改变。因此，让我们发扬新的爱国和负责精神，所有的人都下定决心参与其中，更加努力地工作，不仅是为自己而是为彼此。
例句.pinyin: 21 gè yuè qián zài hán dōng suǒ kāi shǐ de yī qiè bù yīng dāng zài jīn tiān zhè ge qiū yè jié shù 。 jīn tiān de xuǎn jǔ shèng lì bìng bú shì wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn -- zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men jìn xíng gǎi biàn de jī huì 。 rú guǒ wǒ men réng rán àn zhào guò qù de fāng shì xíng shì ， wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn jiāng bú huì fā shēng 。 méi yǒu nǐ men ， méi yǒu fú wù hé xī shēng de xīn jīng shén ， jiù bù kě néng fā shēng gǎi biàn 。 yīn cǐ ， ràng wǒ men fā yáng xīn de ài guó hé fù zé jīng shén ， suǒ yǒu de rén dōu xià dìng jué xīn cān yù qí zhōng ， gèng jiā nǔ lì dì gōng zuò ， bù jǐn shì wèi zì jǐ ér shì wèi bǐ cǐ 。
例句.en: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.

例句.zh: 彼此必须一辈子努力,才能把感情维系好。
例句.pinyin: bǐ cǐ bì xū yī bèi zi nǔ lì , cái néng bǎ gǎn qíng wéi jì hǎo 。
例句.en: Each of you must work hard for a lifetime, and only then will you be able to maintain a relationship.

例句.zh: 约翰和安娜很高兴看到彼此。
例句.pinyin: yuē hàn hé ān nà hěn gāo xìng kàn dào bǐ cǐ 。
例句.en: John and Anna are very happy to see each other.

释义: score (of a game or competition)

例句.zh: 中场比分是多少？
例句.pinyin: zhōng chǎng bǐ fēn shì duō shǎo ？
例句.en: What was the score at halftime?

例句.zh: 比赛以平局结束，最后比分是二比二。
例句.pinyin: bǐ sài yǐ píng jú jié shù ， zuì hòu bǐ fēn shì èr bǐ èr 。
例句.en: The game ended in a draw, and the final score was 2-2.

例句.zh: 我觉得巴塞罗那和皇家马德里的最终比分将会是二比零。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jué de bā sāi luó nà hé huáng jiā mǎ dé lǐ de zuì zhōng bǐ fēn jiāng huì shì èr bǐ líng 。
例句.en: I think the final score between Barcelona and Real Madrid will be 2-0.

释义: proportion / scale

例句.zh: 1772 年，埃斯皮利先生计算出法国人口超过 2,200 万人；其中男性 10,562,631 人，女性 11,451,726 人；因此，女性与男性的比例约为 14 比 13。
例句.pinyin: 1772  nián ， āi sī pí lì xiān shēng jì suàn chū fǎ guó rén kǒu chāo guò  2,200  wàn rén ； qí zhōng nán xìng  10,562,631  rén ， nǚ xìng  11,451,726  rén ； yīn cǐ ， nǚ xìng yǔ nán xìng de bǐ lì yuē wèi  14  bǐ  13。
例句.en: Monsieur D'Espilly, in the year 1772, calculated the population of France at upwards of 22 millions; namely, 10,562,631 males, and 11,451,726 females; consequently the proportion of females to males was about 14 to 13.

释义: to compare / to liken to / metaphor / analogy / figure of speech / figuratively

例句.zh: 莎士比亚把世界比喻成一个舞台。
例句.pinyin: shā shì bǐ yà bǎ shì jiè bǐ yù chéng yí gè wǔ tái 。
例句.en: Shakespeare compared the world to a stage.

释义: certainly / must / will / necessarily

例句.zh: 选择什么是“对”或“错”是一项艰难的任务，我们却必须要完成它。
例句.pinyin: xuǎn zé shén me shì “ duì ” huò “ cuò ” shì yī xiàng jiān nán de rèn wù ， wǒ men què bì xū yào wán chéng tā 。
例句.en: It is a difficult task, choosing what is "right" or "wrong", but you have to do it.

例句.zh: 我们必须设法打破这个僵局。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men bì xū shè fǎ dǎ pò zhè ge jiāng jú 。
例句.en: We must try to break the deadlock.

例句.zh: 他的政权必定会崩溃。
例句.pinyin: tā de zhèng quán bì dìng huì bēng kuì 。
例句.en: His regime is bound to collapse.

释义: after all / all in all / when all is said and done / in the final analysis

例句.zh: 你毕竟是对的。
例句.pinyin: nǐ bì jìng shì duì de 。
例句.en: After all, you're right.

例句.zh: “爸爸，这是真的剑吗？”“当然，毕竟这是一场对决。”
例句.pinyin: “ bà bà ， zhè shì zhēn de jiàn ma ？”“ dāng rán ， bì jìng zhè shì yī cháng duì jué 。”
例句.en: "Dad, this a real sword?" "Of course, it is a duel after all."

例句.zh: 毕竟，即使是神也会偶尔出差错。
例句.pinyin: bì jìng ， jí shǐ shì shén yě huì ǒu ěr chū chā cuò 。
例句.en: After all, even the gods may err at times.

释义: to avert / to prevent / to avoid / to refrain from

例句.zh: 有一天我去法国是无可避免的，我只是不知道何时。
例句.pinyin: yǒu yī tiān wǒ qù fǎ guó shì wú kě bì miǎn de ， wǒ zhǐ shì bù zhī dào hé shí 。
例句.en: It is inevitable that I go to France someday, I just don't know when.

例句.zh: 战争并非不可避免。
例句.pinyin: zhàn zhēng bìng fēi bù kě bì miǎn 。
例句.en: War is not inevitable.

例句.zh: Jim抑制住了怒火，避免了一场斗争。
例句.pinyin: Jim yì zhì zhù le nù huǒ ， bì miǎn le yī cháng dòu zhēng 。
例句.en: Jim was able to hold back his anger and avoid a fight.

释义: closing ceremony

例句.zh: 闭幕式将在今晚举行。
例句.pinyin: Bì mù shì jiāng zài jīn wǎn jǔ xíng.
例句.en: The closing ceremony will be held tonight.

例句.zh: 我们一起观看了奥运会闭幕式。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ men yì qǐ guān kàn le Ào yùn huì bì mù shì.
例句.en: We watched the Olympic closing ceremony together.

例句.zh: 校长在闭幕式上发表了讲话。
例句.pinyin: Xiào zhǎng zài bì mù shì shàng fā biǎo le jiǎng huà.
例句.en: The principal gave a speech at the closing ceremony.

释义: inevitable / certain / necessity

例句.zh: 他们的相遇是必然的。
例句.pinyin: tā men de xiāng yù shì bì rán de 。
例句.en: Their meeting was inevitable.

例句.zh: 他的成功是必然的。
例句.pinyin: tā de chéng gōng shì bì rán de 。
例句.en: That he will succeed is certain.

释义: to need / to require / essential / indispensable

例句.zh: 摄像机对我而言是必需品。
例句.pinyin: shè xiàng jī duì wǒ ér yán shì bì xū pǐn 。
例句.en: The camera was essential for me.

例句.zh: 你必需马上去那儿。
例句.pinyin: nǐ bì xū mǎ shàng qù nà ér 。
例句.en: It is necessary for you to go there immediately.

例句.zh: 在美国，汽车并不是奢华的象征，而是生活的必需品。
例句.pinyin: zài měi guó ， qì chē bìng bú shì shē huá de xiàng zhēng ， ér shì shēng huó de bì xū pǐn 。
例句.en: In the United States the automobile is a necessity and not a luxury.

释义: necessary / essential / indispensable / required

例句.zh: 你其实没必要带伞。

例句.pinyin: 「 hēng ， jiù suàn shì zhè yàng ， wǒ de fēn shù hái shì bǐ nǐ gāo dé duō ya ！」「 nǐ shuō shén me ？！ rú guǒ wǒ yòng jìn quán lì ， nǐ hái huì shì wǒ de duì shǒu ma ？」
例句.en: "Well, even so my score is far above yours isn't it?" "What did you say!? If I was to go all out you'd be as nothing to me!"

释义: troops; army / ranks; contingent; force; staff; team / line; procession / (in video games or fantasy settings etc) party

例句.zh: 为了参加划船比赛，一支新的队伍组成了。
例句.pinyin: wèi le cān jiā huá chuán bǐ sài ， yī zhī xīn de duì wǔ zǔ chéng le 。
例句.en: A new team was formed in order to take part in the boat race.

例句.zh: 刘备和诸葛亮是一支无法战胜的队伍。
例句.pinyin: liú bèi hé zhū gě liàng shì yī zhī wú fǎ zhàn shèng de duì wǔ 。
例句.en: Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang are an unbeatable team.

例句.zh: 以前，想到城市，人们就会想到拥挤的街道、紧缺的车位、拥挤的交通、排得老长的队伍以及噪音和烟雾。
例句.pinyin: yǐ qián ， xiǎng dào chéng shì ， rén men jiù huì xiǎng dào yōng jǐ de jiē dào 、 jǐn quē de chē wèi 、 yōng jǐ de jiāo tōng 、 pái dé lǎo zhǎng de duì wǔ yǐ jí zào yīn hé yān wù 。
例句.en: Before now, when you thought of a city, you thought of crowded streets, parking problems, traffic jams, queues, noise and fumes.

释义: target; object / partner; boyfriend; girlfriend / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 这名采访者确认了他的采访对象。

例句.en: The interviewer identifies his interviewees.

例句.zh: 我想说的是，柴门霍夫不仅构建了一个语言学对象，而且在这之后还有一个理念——一个兄弟情谊的理念，一个和平主义的理念。这种理想的力量——世界语者甚至因此而受到纳粹主义和斯大林主义的迫害——至今仍为世界语者社区所保留。没有人能说这是失败的，但有一件事需要说明：任何语言之所以成功的原因总是难以定义的。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng shuō de shì ， chái mén huò fū bù jǐn gòu jiàn le yí gè yǔ yán xué duì xiàng ， ér qiě zài zhè zhī hòu hái yǒu yí gè lǐ niàn —— yí gè xiōng dì qíng yì de lǐ niàn ， yí gè hé píng zhǔ yì de lǐ niàn 。 zhè zhǒng lǐ xiǎng de lì liàng —— shì jiè yǔ zhě shèn zhì yīn cǐ ér shòu dào nà cuì zhǔ yì hé sī dà lín zhǔ yì de pò hài —— zhì jīn réng wèi shì jiè yǔ zhě shè qū suǒ bǎo liú 。 méi yǒu rén néng shuō zhè shì shī bài de ， dàn yǒu yī jiàn shì xū yào shuō míng ： rèn hé yǔ yán zhī suǒ yǐ chéng gōng de yuán yīn zǒng shì nán yǐ dìng yì de 。
例句.en: What I’m getting at is that Zamenhof not only built a linguistic object, but that behind that was an idea — an idea of brotherhood, a pacifist idea. That strength of an ideal — for which Esperantists were even persecuted under Nazism and Stalinism — is still conserved by the community of Esperantists. One cannot say that it has failed, but one thing needs to be said: the reason why any language is successful is always indefinable.

例句.pinyin: zhè ge èr wéi mǎ shuō shén me ？

释义: to issue / to publish

例句.zh: 林肯在向远比我们眼下分歧更大的国家发表讲话时说，我们不是敌人，而是朋友……虽然激情可能会褪去，但这不会割断我们感情上的联系。
例句.pinyin: lín kěn zài xiàng yuǎn bǐ wǒ men yǎn xià fēn qí gèng dà de guó jiā fā biǎo jiǎng huà shí shuō ， wǒ men bú shì dí rén ， ér shì péng yǒu …… suī rán jī qíng kě néng huì tùn qù ， dàn zhè bú huì gē duàn wǒ men gǎn qíng shàng de lián xì 。
例句.en: As Lincoln said to a nation far more divided than ours, we are not enemies but friends. Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.

例句.zh: 妇女当时没有投票权，她们的希望被挫败，但是安-尼克松-库波尔活着看到妇女们站了起来，看到她们站出来发表自己的见解，看到她们参加大选投票。是的，我们能做到。
例句.pinyin: fù nǚ dāng shí méi yǒu tóu piào quán ， tā men de xī wàng bèi cuò bài ， dàn shì ān - ní kè sōng - kù bō ěr huó zhe kàn dào fù nǚ men zhàn le qǐ lái ， kàn dào tā men zhàn chū lái fā biǎo zì jǐ de jiàn jiě ， kàn dào tā men cān jiā dà xuǎn tóu piào 。 shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào 。
例句.en: At a time when women's voices were silenced and their hopes dismissed, she lived to see them stand up and speak out and reach for the ballot. Yes, we can.

例句.zh: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。
例句.pinyin: tā gāng fā biǎo yī xì liè yǒu qù de wén zhāng 。

例句.zh: 25日，中国政府发布《钓鱼岛是中国的固有领土》白皮书。

释义: well-developed; flourishing / to develop; to promote; to expand / (literary) to achieve fame and fortune; to prosper

例句.zh: 马不但象征著刚健、高昂、昌盛、发达，还代表著奋斗不止、自强不息的民族精神。
例句.pinyin: mǎ bù dàn xiàng zhēng zhù gāng jiàn 、 gāo áng 、 chāng shèng 、 fā dá ， hái dài biǎo zhù fèn dòu bù zhǐ 、 zì qiáng bù xī de mín zú jīng shén 。

例句.zh: 许多词是根据拼写来发音的，不过有些不是。

例句.zh: 让我们记住这一点，如果说这场金融危机教会了我们什么东西的话，那就是我们不可能在金融以外的领域处于困境的同时拥有繁荣兴旺的华尔街。

This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. 例句.zh: 这次大选创造了多项第一，也诞生了很多将世代流传的故事。但是今天晚上令我难忘的却是在亚特兰大投票的一名妇女：安-尼克松-库波尔。她和其他数百万排队等待投票的选民没有什么差别，除了一点：她已是106岁的高龄。

例句.en: This election had many firsts and many stories that will be told for generations. But one that's on my mind tonight is about a woman who cast her ballot in Atlanta. She's a lot like the millions of others who stood in line to make their voice heard in this election, except for one thing: Ann Nixon Cooper is 106 years old.

例句.zh: 在伦敦，我住的饭店靠近巴比肯艺术中心。一次难忘的经验是用报纸包著，吃美味的炸鱼薯条，这在北美人家里是无法复制的。我最喜欢的英国人是奥拉夫斯塔普雷顿和 J.R.R. 托尔金，他们分别是科幻作家和奇幻作家。我曾经透过卫星图像勘察过不列颠群岛，英格兰西南部是一个非常有趣的地区，那里有古朴的城镇和小村庄。
例句.pinyin: zài lún dūn ， wǒ zhù de fàn diàn kào jìn bā bǐ kěn yì shù zhōng xīn 。 yī cì nán wàng de jīng yàn shì yòng bào zhǐ bāo zhù ， chī měi wèi de zhá yú shǔ tiáo ， zhè zài běi měi rén jiā lǐ shì wú fǎ fù zhì de 。 wǒ zuì xǐ huān de yīng guó rén shì ào lā fū sī tǎ pǔ léi dùn hé  J.R.R.  tuō ěr jīn ， tā men fēn bié shì kē huàn zuò jiā hé qí huàn zuò jiā 。 wǒ céng jīng tòu guò wèi xīng tú xiàng kān chá guò bù liè diān qún dǎo ， yīng gé lán xī nán bù shì yí gè fēi cháng yǒu qù de dì qū ， nà lǐ yǒu gǔ piáo de chéng zhèn hé xiǎo cūn zhuāng 。
例句.en: In London, my hotel was near the Barbican Centre. A memorable event was eating delicious fish and chips wrapped in newspaper, which back home, North Americans could not replicate. My favourite Brits are Olaf Stapledon and J.R.R. Tolkien, respectively a sci-fi writer and a fantasy writer. I have surveyed the British Isles via satellite imagery, and a really interesting area is southwestern England, where there are quaint towns and hamlets.

例句.zh: 让我们记住，是伊利诺伊州的一名男子首次将共和党的旗帜扛到了白宫。共和党是建立在自立、个人自由以及国家团结的价值观之上的。这也是我们所有人共同的价值观。虽然民主党今天晚上赢得了巨大的胜利，但我们是以谦卑的态度和弥合阻碍我们进步的分歧的决心赢得这场胜利的

例句.pinyin: ràng wǒ men jì zhù ， shì yī lì nuò yī zhōu de yī míng nán zi shǒu cì jiāng gòng hé dǎng de qí zhì káng dào le bái gōng 。 gòng hé dǎng shì jiàn lì zài zì lì 、 gè rén zì yóu yǐ jí guó jiā tuán jié de jià zhí guān zhī shàng de 。 zhè yě shì wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén gòng tóng de jià zhí guān 。 suī rán mín zhǔ dǎng jīn tiān wǎn shàng yíng dé le jù dà de shèng lì ， dàn wǒ men shì yǐ qiān bēi de tài dù hé mí hé zǔ ài wǒ men jìn bù de fēn qí de jué xīn yíng dé zhè chǎng shèng lì de

Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.

例句.zh: 2025 年 5 月 14 日，天空多云，间或有蓝色空间。我两次走到圣奥尔本斯路上的罗马天主教堂，一次在早上，一次在下午，这是我今年春天第 12 次和第 13 次。早上，穿著制服的小男孩和小女孩们在宽敞的礼拜堂里忏悔。他们来自不同的种族。神父在告解室和一个学生交谈。在崇拜小堂，我注意到左前方有一盆漂亮的兰花。下午，宽敞的礼拜堂几乎空无一人，我通常更喜欢这种状态。路边有个穿著白色背心的英俊肌肉男在慢跑。那棵开著紫色花朵的大树看起来像一棵皇后树，一棵泡桐，因为它有著大大的心形叶子。它让我想起开著紫色花朵的蓝花楹，让我对南美洲充满了怀念。在提姆霍顿斯咖啡馆，我早上享用了香肠马铃薯炒蛋和一杯燕麦奶伯爵茶，下午又喝了一杯经典冰柠檬水。这一天我都在散步。在家，我学习了一些逻辑语和世界语。我有很多世界语书籍。我的融合主义倾向是万物有灵论和佛教。
例句.pinyin: 2025  nián  5  yuè  14  rì ， tiān kōng duō yún ， jiàn huò yǒu lán sè kōng jiān 。 wǒ liǎng cì zǒu dào shèng ào ěr běn sī lù shàng de luó mǎ tiān zhǔ jiào táng ， yī cì zài zǎo shàng ， yī cì zài xià wǔ ， zhè shì wǒ jīn nián chūn tiān dì  12  cì hé dì  13  cì 。 zǎo shàng ， chuān zhù zhì fú de xiǎo nán hái hé xiǎo nǚ hái men zài kuān chǎng de lǐ bài táng lǐ chàn huǐ 。 tā men lái zì bù tóng de zhǒng zú 。 shén fù zài gào jiě shì hé yí gè xué shēng jiāo tán 。 zài chóng bài xiǎo táng ， wǒ zhù yì dào zuǒ qián fāng yǒu yī pén piào liàng de lán huā 。 xià wǔ ， kuān chǎng de lǐ bài táng jī hū kōng wú yì rén ， wǒ tōng cháng gèng xǐ huān zhè zhǒng zhuàng tài 。 lù biān yǒu gè chuān zhù bái sè bèi xīn de yīng jùn jī ròu nán zài màn pǎo 。 nà kē kāi zhù zǐ sè huā duǒ de dà shù kàn qǐ lái xiàng yī kē huáng hòu shù ， yī kē pāo tóng ， yīn wèi tā yǒu zhù dà dà de xīn xíng yè zi 。 tā ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ kāi zhù zǐ sè huā duǒ de lán huā yíng ， ràng wǒ duì nán měi zhōu chōng mǎn le huái niàn 。 zài tí mǔ huò dùn sī kā fēi guǎn ， wǒ zǎo shàng xiǎng yòng le xiāng cháng mǎ líng shǔ chǎo dàn hé yī bēi yàn mài nǎi bó jué chá ， xià wǔ yòu hē le yī bēi jīng diǎn bīng níng méng shuǐ 。 zhè yī tiān wǒ dōu zài sàn bù 。 zài jiā ， wǒ xué xí le yī xiē luó jí yǔ hé shì jiè yǔ 。 wǒ yǒu hěn duō shì jiè yǔ shū jí 。 wǒ de róng hé zhǔ yì qīng xiàng shì wàn wù yǒu líng lùn hé fó jiào 。
例句.en: This 14th of May of 2025 is cloudy skies interspersed with blue spaces. I walked to the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road twice, once in the morning and again in the afternoon, my 12th and 13th times this spring. In the morning was confession for the little boys and girls in uniform. They were of different races, in the big worship hall. The priest was in the confession booth talking to a student. At the Adoration Chapel, I noticed a nice pot of orchids on the front left. In the afternoon, the big worship hall was mostly empty, a condition which I usually prefer. At the road was a handsome muscle man in white tank top jogging. The big purple-bloom tree seems like an Empress Tree, a Paulownia, because of the big heart-shaped leaves. Reminiscent of Jacaranda with its purple blooming, it's saudade for me about South America. At Tim Hortons café, I enjoyed Scrambled Eggs with Sausage and Potatoes and an Earl Grey Tea with oat milk in the morning, and an Iced Classic Lemonade in the afternoon. The day was full of walking. At home, I study bits of Lojban and Esperanto. I have many books in Esperanto. I tend towards Animism-Buddhism in my Syncretism.

释义: spirit / mind / consciousness / thought / mental / psychological / essence / gist / CL:個|个[ge4] / vigor; vitality / spirited / good-looking

例句.zh: 人人生而自由，在尊严和权利上一律平等。他们赋有理性和良心，并应以兄弟关系的精神相对待。

例句.en: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights. They are endowed with reason and conscience and should act towards one another in a spirit of brotherhood.

例句.zh: 21个月前在寒冬所开始的一切不应当在今天这个秋夜结束。今天的选举胜利并不是我们所寻求的改变--这只是我们进行改变的机会。如果我们仍然按照过去的方式行事，我们所寻求的改变将不会发生。没有你们，没有服务和牺牲的新精神，就不可能发生改变。因此，让我们发扬新的爱国和负责精神，所有的人都下定决心参与其中，更加努力地工作，不仅是为自己而是为彼此。
例句.pinyin: 21 gè yuè qián zài hán dōng suǒ kāi shǐ de yī qiè bù yīng dāng zài jīn tiān zhè ge qiū yè jié shù 。 jīn tiān de xuǎn jǔ shèng lì bìng bú shì wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn -- zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men jìn xíng gǎi biàn de jī huì 。 rú guǒ wǒ men réng rán àn zhào guò qù de fāng shì xíng shì ， wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn jiāng bú huì fā shēng 。 méi yǒu nǐ men ， méi yǒu fú wù hé xī shēng de xīn jīng shén ， jiù bù kě néng fā shēng gǎi biàn 。 yīn cǐ ， ràng wǒ men fā yáng xīn de ài guó hé fù zé jīng shén ， suǒ yǒu de rén dōu xià dìng jué xīn cān yù qí zhōng ， gèng jiā nǔ lì dì gōng zuò ， bù jǐn shì wèi zì jǐ ér shì wèi bǐ cǐ 。
例句.en: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.

释义: to get a job / employment

例句.zh: 当30年代的沙尘暴和大萧条使人们感到绝望时，她看到一个国家用新政、新的就业机会以及对新目标的共同追求战胜恐慌。是的，我们能做到。
例句.pinyin: dāng 30 nián dài de shā chén bào hé dà xiāo tiáo shǐ rén men gǎn dào jué wàng shí ， tā kàn dào yí gè guó jiā yòng xīn zhèng 、 xīn de jiù yè jī huì yǐ jí duì xīn mù biāo de gòng tóng zhuī qiú zhàn shèng kǒng huāng 。 shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào 。
例句.en: When there was despair in the dust bowl and depression across the land, she saw a nation conquer fear itself with a New Deal, new jobs, a new sense of common purpose. Yes, we can.

例句.zh: 现在是我们回答这个问题的机会。这是我们的时刻这是我们的时代--让我们的人民重新就业，为我们的后代敞开机会之门，恢复繁荣，推进和平，重新确立“美国梦”，再次证明这样一个基本的真理：我们是一家人；只要一息尚存，我们就有希望；当我们遇到嘲讽和怀疑，当有人说我们办不到的时候，我们要以这个永恒的信条来回应他们。是的，我们能做到
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì wǒ men huí dá zhè ge wèn tí de jī huì 。 zhè shì wǒ men de shí kè zhè shì wǒ men de shí dài -- ràng wǒ men de rén mín chóng xīn jiù yè ， wèi wǒ men de hòu dài chǎng kāi jī huì zhī mén ， huī fù fán róng ， tuī jìn hé píng ， chóng xīn què lì “ měi guó mèng ”， zài cì zhèng míng zhè yàng yí gè jī běn de zhēn lǐ ： wǒ men shì yī jiā rén ； zhǐ yào yī xī shàng cún ， wǒ men jiù yǒu xī wàng ； dāng wǒ men yù dào cháo fěng hé huái yí ， dāng yǒu rén shuō wǒ men bàn bú dào de shí hòu ， wǒ men yào yǐ zhè ge yǒng héng de xìn tiáo lái huí yìng tā men 。 shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào
例句.en: This is our chance to answer that call. This is our moment. This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. And where we are met with cynicism and doubt and those who tell us that we can't, we will respond with that timeless creed that sums up the spirit of a people: Yes, we can.

例句.zh: 我在黑暗的巷子中绊倒，膝盖砸在柏油路上。一块木板盖著巷弄的房屋之间的电线。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼镜从眼睛上掉了下来。幸好有一位带著手电筒的广东工人帮忙。我的膝盖只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝盖摔伤是在菲律宾奎松市的唐荷西高地。那里有一大片火星般的红土地，遍地长满了「塔拉希布」草。有时工人会故意纵火烧草。我和哥哥当时还在外面玩。那时我们还未到青春期。在燃烧的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝盖著地。我的贝贝姥姥愤怒不已。家里的女佣在车库后面的大磁砖水槽里帮我清洗了双腿。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài hēi àn de xiàng zi zhōng bàn dǎo ， xī gài zá zài bǎi yóu lù shàng 。 yī kuài mù bǎn gài zhù xiàng nòng de fáng wū zhī jiān de diàn xiàn 。 shēn yè de xiàng nòng fēi cháng zhī àn 。 wǒ de yǎn jìng cóng yǎn jīng shàng diào le xià lái 。 xìng hǎo yǒu yī wèi dài zhù shǒu diàn tǒng de guǎng dōng gōng rén bāng máng 。 wǒ de xī gài zhǐ shì cā pò le pí 。 wǒ xiǎng qǐ lìng yī cì xī gài shuāi shāng shì zài fēi lǜ bīn kuí sōng shì de táng hé xī gāo dì 。 nà lǐ yǒu yī dà piàn huǒ xīng bān de hóng tǔ dì ， biàn dì zhǎng mǎn le 「 tǎ lā xī bù 」 cǎo 。 yǒu shí gōng rén huì gù yì zòng huǒ shāo cǎo 。 wǒ hé gē gē dāng shí hái zài wài miàn wán 。 nà shí wǒ men hái wèi dào qīng chūn qī 。 zài rán shāo de yě cǎo páng ， wǒ shuāi dǎo le ， xī gài zhù dì 。 wǒ de bèi bèi lǎo lao fèn nù bù yǐ 。 jiā lǐ de nǚ yōng zài chē kù hòu miàn de dà cí zhuān shuǐ cáo lǐ bāng wǒ qīng xǐ le shuāng tuǐ 。
例句.en: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

例句.en: Don't underestimate my power.

例句.pinyin: zhī shí jiù shì lì liàng ， dàn zhè lì liàng kě yǐ yòng lái zuò hǎo shì ， yě kě yǐ yòng lái zuò huài shì 。
例句.en: Knowledge is power, but it is power for evil just as much as for good.

例句.zh: 如果外头还有人怀疑，美国是否真的是任何事都可能发生的地方，怀疑我们开国先贤的梦想今天是否依然存在，怀疑我们民主的力量；今夜，就是你们要的答案。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ wài tou hái yǒu rén huái yí ， měi guó shì fǒu zhēn de shì rèn hé shì dōu kě néng fā shēng de dì fāng ， huái yí wǒ men kāi guó xiān xián de mèng xiǎng jīn tiān shì fǒu yī rán cún zài ， huái yí wǒ men mín zhǔ de lì liàng ； jīn yè ， jiù shì nǐ men yào de dá àn 。
例句.en: If there is anyone out there who still doubts that America is a place where all things are possible; who still wonders if the dream of our founders is alive in our time; who still questions the power of our democracy, tonight is your answer.

释义: profits

例句.zh: 旅行社的利润猛涨。
例句.pinyin: lǚ xíng shè de lì rùn měng zhǎng 。
例句.en: Travel agencies' profits soared.

例句.zh: 这不过是他在谈判最后时刻尽可能最大化利润的尝试。
例句.pinyin: zhè bù guò shì tā zài tán pàn zuì hòu shí kè jǐn kě néng zuì dà huà lì rùn de cháng shì 。
例句.en: It's just an attempt on his part to maximize profits, as much as possible, in the last moments of negotiations.

释义: benefit / (in sb's) interest / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 从国际的观点看，应该考虑推行人口政策来平衡两方的利益。
例句.pinyin: cóng guó jì de guān diǎn kàn ， yīng gāi kǎo lǜ tuī xíng rén kǒu zhèng cè lái píng héng liǎng fāng de lì yì 。
例句.en: A population policy should be considered on the international viewpoint so as to balance the interests of both sides.

例句.zh: 大使是为了本国的利益被派去外国撒谎的正直的人。
例句.pinyin: dà shǐ shì wèi le běn guó de lì yì bèi pài qù wài guó sā huǎng de zhèng zhí de rén 。
例句.en: An ambassador is an honest man sent to lie abroad for the good of his country.

例句.zh: 他只顾自己的利益。
例句.pinyin: tā zhǐ gù zì jǐ de lì yì 。
例句.en: All he thinks about is himself.

释义: to exploit / to make use of / to use / to take advantage of / to utilize

例句.zh: 你要更好地利用闲暇时间。
例句.pinyin: nǐ yào gèng hǎo dì lì yòng xián xiá shí jiān 。
例句.en: You should make better use of your free time.

例句.zh: 你应该好好利用这个机会。
例句.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi hǎo hǎo lì yòng zhè ge jī huì 。
例句.en: You had better make use of the opportunity.

例句.zh: 你应该好好利用一切的机会。
例句.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi hǎo hǎo lì yòng yī qiè de jī huì 。
例句.en: You should avail yourself of every opportunity.

释义: to combine / to join / unite / alliance

例句.zh: 爱丁堡的水边地工程只是许多重建联合王国城镇的工程之一。
例句.pinyin: ài dīng bǎo de shuǐ biān dì gōng chéng zhǐ shì xǔ duō chóng jiàn lián hé wáng guó chéng zhèn de gōng chéng zhī yī 。
例句.en: Edinburgh's Waterfront is just one of the many projects that are regenerating UK towns and cities.

例句.zh: UN代表联合国。
例句.pinyin: UN dài biǎo lián hé guó 。
例句.en: UN stands for the United Nations.

例句.zh: 联合航空公司办理登机手续的柜台在哪里？
例句.pinyin: lián hé háng kōng gōng sī bàn lǐ dēng jī shǒu xù de guì tái zài nǎ lǐ ？
例句.en: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?

释义: to link; to join; to connect
短释义: to link; to join; to connect

例句.zh: 海洋不是将世界分隔开来，而是将世界连接起来
例句.pinyin: hǎi yáng bú shì jiāng shì jiè fēn gé kāi lái ， ér shì jiāng shì jiè lián jiē qǐ lái
例句.en: Oceans do not so much divide the world as unite it.

例句.zh: 人类登上月球、柏林墙倒下，世界被我们的科学和想像被连接在一起。
例句.pinyin: rén lèi dēng shàng yuè qiú 、 bó lín qiáng dǎo xià ， shì jiè bèi wǒ men de kē xué hé xiǎng xiàng bèi lián jiē zài yì qǐ 。
例句.en: A man touched down on the moon. A wall came down in Berlin. A world was connected by our own science and imagination.

例句.zh: 我经常使用SSH来远程连接到我的电脑。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jīng cháng shǐ yòng SSH lái yuǎn chéng lián jiē dào wǒ de diàn nǎo 。
例句.en: I often use SSH to access my computers remotely.

释义: promptly; at once

例句.zh: 听到门铃响，他连忙去开门。
例句.pinyin: Tīngdào ménlíng xiǎng, tā liánmáng qù kāi mén.
例句.en: When he heard the doorbell ring, he promptly went to open the door.

例句.zh: 孩子摔倒了，妈妈连忙跑过去。
例句.pinyin: Háizi shuāidǎo le, māma liánmáng pǎo guòqu.
例句.en: The child fell down, and his mother immediately ran over.

例句.zh: 我发现拿错了书，连忙向他道歉。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ fāxiàn ná cuò le shū, liánmáng xiàng tā dàoqiàn.
例句.en: When I realized I had taken the wrong book, I apologized to him at once.

释义: continuous / in a row / serial / consecutive

例句.zh: 雨连续下了五天。
例句.pinyin: yǔ lián xù xià le wǔ tiān 。
例句.en: The rain lasted five days.

例句.zh: 比尔连续哭了几个小时。
例句.pinyin: bǐ ěr lián xù kū le jǐ gè xiǎo shí 。
例句.en: Bill kept on crying for hours.

例句.zh: 这个男人连续说了一个小时的话。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge nán rén lián xù shuō le yí gè xiǎo shí de huà 。
例句.en: The man kept talking for an hour.

释义: complexion / look

例句.zh: 凯特的脸色这么差，一定是生病了。
例句.pinyin: kǎi tè de liǎn sè zhè me chà ， yí dìng shì shēng bìng le 。
例句.en: Kate must be sick, for she looks pale.

例句.zh: 你的脸色这么差，还是赶快去睡觉吧。
例句.pinyin: nǐ de liǎn sè zhè me chà ， hái shì gǎn kuài qù shuì jiào ba 。
例句.en: You look pale. You had better lie down in bed at once.

例句.zh: 他的脸色变得十分苍白。
例句.pinyin: tā de liǎn sè biàn dé shí fēn cāng bái 。
例句.en: His face turned white.

释义: (romantic) love / CL:個|个[ge4],場|场[chang3] / in love / to have an affair

例句.zh: 最近我参加了一个中国朋友的婚礼，新郎和新娘是大学同学，都是中文系毕业的，他们已经恋爱五年了。
例句.pinyin: zuì jìn wǒ cān jiā le yí gè zhōng guó péng yǒu de hūn lǐ ， xīn láng hé xīn niáng shì dà xué tóng xué ， dōu shì zhōng wén xì bì yè de ， tā men yǐ jīng liàn ài wǔ nián le 。
例句.en: Recently I attended the wedding of a Chinese friend. The bride and groom had been classmates at university, and both graduated from the Chinese faculty. They've already been together for five years.

例句.zh: 不，她从没恋爱过。
例句.pinyin: bù ， tā cóng méi liàn ài guò 。
例句.en: No, she has never fallen in love.

例句.zh: 当两个女生都跟约翰宣称她们对他有感觉时，他不知道该跟哪个谈恋爱了。
例句.pinyin: dāng liǎng gè nǚ shēng dōu gēn yuē hàn xuān chēng tā men duì tā yǒu gǎn jué shí ， tā bù zhī dào gāi gēn nǎ ge tán liàn ài le 。
例句.en: When both girls told John they had feelings for him, he was in a quandary as to which girl he should be with.

释义: good / favorable / well / fine

例句.zh: 自从手术后，我父亲一直处于良好的状态。
例句.pinyin: zì cóng shǒu shù hòu ， wǒ fù qīn yì zhí chǔ yú liáng hǎo de zhuàng tài 。
例句.en: My father has been in good shape since his operation.

例句.zh: 你受过良好教育，这是你的优势。
例句.pinyin: nǐ shòu guò liáng hǎo jiào yù ， zhè shì nǐ de yōu shì 。
例句.en: You have the advantage of a good education.

例句.zh: 请给您所译的句子一个良好的翻译。请勿让其他语言的翻译影响到您所做的翻译。
例句.pinyin: qǐng gěi nín suǒ yì de jù zi yí gè liáng hǎo de fān yì 。 qǐng wù ràng qí tā yǔ yán de fān yì yǐng xiǎng dào nín suǒ zuò de fān yì 。
例句.en: Make a good translation of the sentence that you are translating. Don't let translations into other languages influence you.

释义: foodstuff / cereals / CL:種|种[zhong3]

例句.zh: 他们想栽培新品种的米来增加粮食生产。
例句.pinyin: tā men xiǎng zāi péi xīn pǐn zhǒng de mǐ lái zēng jiā liáng shí shēng chǎn 。
例句.en: They want to increase food production by growing new kinds of rice.

例句.zh: 粮食供应十分充足。
例句.pinyin: liáng shí gōng yìng shí fēn chōng zú 。
例句.en: There is an abundant supply of foodstuffs.

例句.zh: 我又转念，见日光之下，快跑的未必能赢，力战的未必得胜，智慧的未必得粮食，明哲的未必得资财，灵巧的未必得喜悦，所临到众人的，是在乎当时的机会。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yòu zhuǎn niàn ， jiàn rì guāng zhī xià ， kuài pǎo de wèi bì néng yíng ， lì zhàn de wèi bì děi shèng ， zhì huì de wèi bì děi liáng shí ， míng zhé de wèi bì děi zī cái ， líng qiǎo de wèi bì děi xǐ yuè ， suǒ lín dào zhòng rén de ， shì zài hū dāng shí de jī huì 。
例句.en: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happen to them all.

释义: to measure / capacity / quantity / amount / to estimate / abbr. for 量詞|量词[liang4 ci2], classifier (in Chinese grammar) / measure word

例句.zh: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。
例句.pinyin: wǒ huì jǐn liàng bù dǎ rǎo nǐ fù xí 。
例句.en: I'll do my best not to disturb your studying.

例句.zh: 我尽量留着胃吃甜点。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jǐn liàng liú zhe wèi chī tián diǎn 。
例句.en: I'm trying to save room for dessert.

例句.zh: 由于产量过剩，卷心菜的价格下降了。
例句.pinyin: yóu yú chǎn liàng guò shèng ， juǎn xīn cài de jià gé xià jiàng le 。
例句.en: The price of cabbage fell because of overproduction.

释义: amazing / terrific / extraordinary

例句.zh: 这个可怜的年轻人最后成为了一个了不起的艺术家。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge kě lián de nián qīng rén zuì hòu chéng wéi le yí gè liǎo bù qǐ de yì shù jiā 。
例句.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.

例句.zh: 这个穷小子最后成为了一个了不起的艺术家。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge qióng xiǎo zi zuì hòu chéng wéi le yí gè liǎo bù qǐ de yì shù jiā 。
例句.en: The poor young man finally became a great artist.

例句.zh: 他以为自己很了不起。
例句.pinyin: tā yǐ wéi zì jǐ hěn liǎo bù qǐ 。
例句.en: He thinks he's so great.

释义: (railway) train

例句.zh: 我们不知道他们会乘哪一班列车。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men bù zhī dào tā men huì chéng nǎ yī bān liè chē 。
例句.en: We didn't know what train they'd be on.

例句.zh: 他定已错过了他平常坐的那班列车。
例句.pinyin: tā dìng yǐ cuò guò le tā píng cháng zuò de nà bān liè chē 。
例句.en: He must have missed his usual train.

例句.zh: 但是，我建议你乘 JR 的成田特急（每三十分钟至一个小时就有一班列车从机场开出），不用转车这么麻烦。
例句.pinyin: dàn shì ， wǒ jiàn yì nǐ chéng  JR  de chéng tián tè jí （ měi sān shí fēn zhōng zhì yí gè xiǎo shí jiù yǒu yī bān liè chē cóng jī chǎng kāi chū ）， bù yòng zhuǎn chē zhè me má fán 。
例句.en: However, I recommend that you take the JR Narita Express (a train leaves every 30-60 minutes from the airport), to avoid the complexity of changing trains.

释义: as the time draws near / at the last moment / temporary / interim / ad hoc

例句.zh: 经济萧条是一段时间内，当这样的经济活动普遍增长而造成的一种临时性的经济活动衰退。
例句.pinyin: jīng jì xiāo tiáo shì yī duàn shí jiān nèi ， dāng zhè yàng de jīng jì huó dòng pǔ biàn zēng zhǎng ér zào chéng de yī zhǒng lín shí xìng de jīng jì huó dòng shuāi tuì 。
例句.en: Recession is a temporary falling off of business activity during a period when such activity is generally increasing.

例句.zh: 因为临时有事，我很抱歉在2月27日那天不能跟你们碰面了。
例句.pinyin: yīn wèi lín shí yǒu shì ， wǒ hěn bào qiàn zài 2 yuè 27 rì nà tiān bù néng gēn nǐ men pèng miàn le 。
例句.en: I regret that I will be unable to meet you on February 27 owing to an unexpected matter.

例句.zh: 夜幕降临时，孩子们回家了。
例句.pinyin: yè mù jiàng lín shí ， hái zi men huí jiā le 。
例句.en: The children returned home at dusk.

释义: (small) bell / CL:隻|只[zhi1]

例句.zh: 他进来的同时，铃响了。
例句.pinyin: tā jìn lái de tóng shí ， líng xiǎng le 。
例句.en: He came in, and at the same time the bell rang.

例句.zh: 铃响了。
例句.pinyin: líng xiǎng le 。
例句.en: The bell rang.

例句.zh: 门铃响的时候，我正准备出门。
例句.pinyin: mén líng xiǎng de shí hòu ， wǒ zhèng zhǔn bèi chū mén 。
例句.en: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.

释义: flexible / nimble / agile

例句.zh: 他是一个脑子灵活的人。
例句.pinyin: tā shì yí gè nǎo zi líng huó de rén 。
例句.en: He is a quick-witted man.

例句.zh: 汤姆缺乏灵活性。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ quē fá líng huó xìng 。
例句.en: Tom lacks flexibility.

例句.zh: 弹钢琴需要手指灵活。
例句.pinyin: tán gāng qín xū yào shǒu zhǐ líng huó 。
例句.en: Playing the piano requires manual dexterity.

释义: neck / collar / to lead / to receive / classifier for clothes, mats, screens etc

例句.zh: Kent生来就是个领导人。
例句.pinyin: Kent shēng lái jiù shì gè lǐng dǎo rén 。
例句.en: Kent is a born leader.

例句.zh: 很快，城市就被士兵占领了。
例句.pinyin: hěn kuài ， chéng shì jiù bèi shì bīng zhàn lǐng le 。
例句.en: The city was soon occupied by the soldiers.

例句.zh: 领主对他的臣民有绝对权力。
例句.pinyin: lǐng zhǔ duì tā de chén mín yǒu jué duì quán lì 。
例句.en: The lord held absolute power over his subjects.

释义: necktie / CL:條|条[tiao2]

例句.zh: 这条领带和那件上衣很配。
例句.pinyin: zhè tiáo lǐng dài hé nà jiàn shàng yī hěn pèi 。
例句.en: This tie and that jacket go well together.

例句.zh: 他的领带和西装很配。
例句.pinyin: tā de lǐng dài hé xī zhuāng hěn pèi 。
例句.en: His tie corresponds well with his suit.

例句.zh: 这条领带多少钱？
例句.pinyin: zhè tiáo lǐng dài duō shǎo qián ？
例句.en: How much is this tie?

释义: lead / leading / to lead / leadership / leader / CL:位[wei4],個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: Kent生来就是个领导人。
例句.pinyin: Kent shēng lái jiù shì gè lǐng dǎo rén 。
例句.en: Kent is a born leader.

例句.zh: 我是该队的领导者。
例句.pinyin: wǒ shì gāi duì de lǐng dǎo zhě 。
例句.en: I am the leader of this team.

例句.zh: 对于那些彻夜关注美国大选的海外人士，从国会到皇宫，以及在被遗忘的角落里挤在收音机旁的人们，我们的经历虽然各有不同，但是我们的命运是一样的，新的美国领导层已产生了。
例句.pinyin: duì yú nà xiē chè yè guān zhù měi guó dà xuǎn de hǎi wài rén shì ， cóng guó huì dào huáng gōng ， yǐ jí zài bèi yí wàng de jiǎo luò lǐ jǐ zài shōu yīn jī páng de rén men ， wǒ men de jīng lì suī rán gè yǒu bù tóng ， dàn shì wǒ men de mìng yùn shì yī yàng de ， xīn de měi guó lǐng dǎo céng yǐ chǎn shēng le 。
例句.en: And all those watching tonight from beyond our shores, from parliaments and palaces, to those who are huddled around radios in the forgotten corners of the world, our stories are singular, but our destiny is shared, and a new dawn of American leadership is at hand.

释义: to receive; to draw; to get
短释义: to receive; to draw; to get

例句.zh: 我能在机场领取机票吗？
例句.pinyin: wǒ néng zài jī chǎng lǐng qǔ jī piào ma ？
例句.en: Can I pick my ticket up at the airport?

例句.zh: 无人领取的物品被拍卖了。
例句.pinyin: wú rén lǐng qǔ de wù pǐn bèi pāi mài le 。
例句.en: The unclaimed items were sold off at auction.

释义: to lead / to be in front

例句.zh: 人生是一次长跑，暂时的落后和领先都不算什么。
例句.pinyin: rén shēng shì yī cì zhǎng pǎo ， zàn shí de luò hòu hé lǐng xiān dōu bù suàn shén me 。
例句.en: Life is like a marathon, where short-term gains and losses are not significant in and of themselves.

例句.zh: 皇家马德里在上半场处于领先，但切尔西最终赢得了比赛。
例句.pinyin: huáng jiā mǎ dé lǐ zài shàng bàn chǎng chǔ yú lǐng xiān ， dàn qiè ěr xī zuì zhōng yíng dé le bǐ sài 。
例句.en: At the end of the first half Real Madrid were in the lead, but Chelsea won in the end.

例句.zh: 你领先。
例句.pinyin: nǐ lǐng xiān 。

释义: fault / defect / shortcomings / ailment / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.pinyin: wǒ tiāo bù chū tā de máo bìng 。
例句.en: I cannot find fault with him.

例句.zh: 杰克很喜欢挑别人的毛病，所以没有人愿意和他交朋友。
例句.pinyin: jié kè hěn xǐ huān tiāo bié rén de máo bìng ， suǒ yǐ méi yǒu rén yuàn yì hé tā jiāo péng yǒu 。
例句.en: Jack always finds fault with others. That's why everybody avoids him.

例句.zh: 不过，有趣的是，有人因为玩电脑玩出毛病，但也有人因为玩电脑而治好疾病。
例句.pinyin: bù guò ， yǒu qù de shì ， yǒu rén yīn wèi wán diàn nǎo wán chū máo bìng ， dàn yě yǒu rén yīn wèi wán diàn nǎo ér zhì hǎo jí bìng 。

释义: contradiction / CL:個|个[ge4] / conflicting views / contradictory

例句.zh: 举例说，如果一个老师警告学生不要吸烟，但自己却每天吸个不停，那么这个警告就是自相矛盾的了。
例句.pinyin: jǔ lì shuō ， rú guǒ yí gè lǎo shī jǐng gào xué shēng bú yào xī yān ， dàn zì jǐ què měi tiān xī gè bù tíng ， nà me zhè ge jǐng gào jiù shì zì xiāng máo dùn de le 。
例句.en: For example, if a chain-smoking teacher cautions a pupil for smoking, that warning is self-contradictory.

例句.zh: 我不能禁止一个人娶好几个妻子，因为这与圣经不矛盾。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù néng jìn zhǐ yí gè rén qǔ hǎo jǐ gè qī zǐ ， yīn wèi zhè yǔ shèng jīng bù máo dùn 。
例句.en: I cannot forbid a person to marry several wives, for it does not contradict Scripture.

例句.zh: 他和老板有矛盾，这个我们知道就好。
例句.pinyin: tā hé lǎo bǎn yǒu máo dùn ， zhè ge wǒ men zhī dào jiù hǎo 。
例句.en: Between you and me, he's in trouble with the boss.

释义: (coll.) can't do anything about it / (coll.) there's no way that ...; it's simply not credible that ... / (coll.) couldn't be (better) (i.e. simply wonderful)

例句.pinyin: yīn wèi kāi guān huài le ， wǒ méi fǎ ér bǎ tā dǎ kāi 。
例句.en: I can't turn it on, because the switch is broken.

例句.zh: 我没法儿购买所有我需要的东西。
例句.pinyin: wǒ méi fǎ ér gòu mǎi suǒ yǒu wǒ xū yào de dōng xī 。

例句.zh: 我没法儿再忍了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ méi fǎ ér zài rěn le 。
例句.en: I can't bear it anymore.

释义: rugosa rose (shrub) (Rosa rugosa) (CL:棵[ke1]) / rose flower (CL:朵[duo3])

例句.zh: 我喜欢花，比如说，玫瑰。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān huā ， bǐ rú shuō ， méi guī 。
例句.en: I like flowers, such as roses.

释义: media, esp. news media

例句.zh: 我想用媒体播放器听音乐，却出现了错误讯息，不能播放。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yòng méi tǐ bō fàng qì tīng yīn yuè ， què chū xiàn le cuò wù xùn xī ， bù néng bō fàng 。
例句.en: When I try to listen to music with media player there's an error and I can't play the file.

例句.zh: 关于这个问题，我觉得垃圾媒体只报道了很片面的信息。
例句.pinyin: guān yú zhè ge wèn tí ， wǒ jué de lā jī méi tǐ zhǐ bào dào le hěn piàn miàn de xìn xī 。
例句.en: Concerning this issue, I feel that the trash media only report biased information.

例句.zh: 媒体对他所说的话断章取义并发展到无法控制的地步了。
例句.pinyin: méi tǐ duì tā suǒ shuō de huà duàn zhāng qǔ yì bìng fā zhǎn dào wú fǎ kòng zhì de dì bù le 。

释义: art / fine arts / painting / CL:種|种[zhong3]

例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù měi shù guǎn shèng guò qù diàn yǐng yuàn 。

例句.pinyin: rén rén duì yóu yú tā suǒ chuàng zuò de rèn hé kē xué 、 wén xué huò měi shù zuò pǐn ér chǎn shēng de jīng shén de hé wù zhì dì lì yì ， yǒu xiǎng shòu bǎo hù de quán lì 。

例句.zh: 好了孩子们！所以为了这个美术计划，你们所有人都将被分离并加入3-5人的小组
例句.pinyin: hǎo le hái zi men ！ suǒ yǐ wéi le zhè ge měi shù jì huà ， nǐ men suǒ yǒu rén dōu jiāng bèi fēn lí bìng jiā rù 3-5 rén de xiǎo zǔ
例句.en: Alrighty kids! So for this art project, all of you guys will split into groups of 3 - 5 people.

释义: delicious / delicious food / delicacy

例句.pinyin: shàng cì lái chī de shí hòu shì hěn měi wèi de 。

例句.pinyin: tā qǐng wǒ chī le dùn měi wèi de wǎn fàn 。
例句.en: I had a good dinner at his expense.

例句.zh: 您的蛋糕很美味。
例句.pinyin: nín de dàn gāo hěn měi wèi 。
例句.en: Your cake is delicious.

释义: charm / fascination / glamor / charisma

例句.zh: 她的魅力难以用笔墨形容。
例句.pinyin: tā de mèi lì nán yǐ yòng bǐ mò xíng róng 。
例句.en: Her charm is beyond description.

例句.zh: 魅力冲击视觉，美德征服心灵。
例句.pinyin: mèi lì chōng jī shì jué ， měi dé zhēng fú xīn líng 。
例句.en: Charms strike the sight, but merit wins the soul.

例句.zh: 她是个有魅力的女性。
例句.pinyin: tā shì gè yǒu mèi lì de nǚ xìng 。
例句.en: She is a charming woman.

例句.zh: 这家医院周末也有门诊。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn zhōumò yě yǒu ménzhěn.

例句.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān qù yīyuàn kàn ménzhěn.
例句.en: I’m going to the hospital for an outpatient appointment tomorrow.

释义: to bewilder / crazy about / fan / enthusiast / lost / confused

例句.zh: 他在森林中迷了路。
例句.pinyin: tā zài sēn lín zhōng mí le lù 。

例句.zh: 她迷路了，紧接着天开始下雨了。
例句.pinyin: tā mí lù le ， jǐn jiē zhe tiān kāi shǐ xià yǔ le 。
例句.en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.

释义: to lose the way / lost / labyrinth / labyrinthus vestibularis (of the inner ear)

例句.zh: 他可能迷路了。
例句.pinyin: tā kě néng mí lù le 。
例句.en: He may have lost his way.

例句.pinyin: tā mí lù le ， jǐn jiē zhe tiān kāi shǐ xià yǔ le 。
例句.en: She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.

释义: secret; private; confidential; clandestine / a secret

例句.pinyin: zhè zhǒng mì mì zǒng yǒu yī tiān huì bèi jiē lù de 。

例句.zh: 他说得好像知道这个秘密一样。
例句.pinyin: tā shuō dé hǎo xiàng zhī dào zhè ge mì mì yī yàng 。
例句.en: He talks as if he knew the secret.

例句.zh: 他透露了我的秘密。
例句.pinyin: tā tòu lù le wǒ de mì mì 。
例句.en: He disclosed my secret.

释义: close; intimate / to strengthen (ties, cooperation etc) / closely; intently; carefully / (math.) to osculate

例句.zh: 供应和需求之间的关系十分密切。

例句.zh: 他主张的是出生的先后次序和个性有很密切的关系。
例句.pinyin: tā zhǔ zhāng de shì chū shēng de xiān hòu cì xù hé gè xìng yǒu hěn mì qiè de guān xì 。

例句.zh: 以动物命名人的属相，是因为我们的先民与这些动物有密切关系。
例句.pinyin: yǐ dòng wù mìng míng rén de shǔ xiāng ， shì yīn wèi wǒ men de xiān mín yǔ zhè xiē dòng wù yǒu mì qiè guān xì 。

释义: secretary

例句.zh: 她在超市做秘书。
例句.pinyin: tā zài chāo shì zuò mì shū 。

例句.zh: 他把信交给了秘书。
例句.pinyin: tā bǎ xìn jiāo gěi le mì shū 。
例句.en: He handed the letter to the secretary.

例句.zh: 佐藤是社长的新秘书。
例句.pinyin: zuǒ téng shì shè zhǎng de xīn mì shū 。
例句.en: Sato is the new secretary of the company president.

释义: face / side / surface / aspect / top / classifier for objects with flat surfaces such as drums, mirrors, flags etc / variant of 麵|面[mian4] / flour / noodles / (of food) soft (not crunchy) / (slang) (of a person) ineffectual / spineless

例句.zh: 一块岩石从上面落下。
例句.pinyin: yī kuài yán shí cóng shàng miàn là xià 。
例句.en: A rock fell from above.

例句.zh: 他对日本的历史非常感兴趣。我们很惊讶他在这方面的丰富知识。
例句.pinyin: tā duì rì běn de lì shǐ fēi cháng gǎn xìng qù 。 wǒ men hěn jīng yà tā zài zhè fāng miàn de fēng fù zhī shí 。
例句.en: He is very much interested in Japanese history. We are surprised at his vast knowledge of the subject.

例句.zh: 这箱子是空的，里面什么也没有。
例句.pinyin: zhè xiāng zi shì kōng de ， lǐ miàn shén me yě méi yǒu 。
例句.en: This box is empty. It has nothing in it.

释义: area (of a floor, piece of land etc) / surface area / tract of land
短释义: area (of a floor, piece of land etc)

例句.zh: 这片小区的绿地面积有多少？
例句.pinyin: zhè piàn xiǎo qū de lǜ dì miàn jī yǒu duō shǎo ？

例句.pinyin: mù chǎng de miàn jī yǒu 10 yīng mǔ 。
例句.en: The pasture has an area of 10 acres.

例句.zh: 日本是由四个大岛和三千多个小岛组成的，面积和加州差不多。
例句.pinyin: rì běn shì yóu sì gè dà dǎo hé sān qiān duō gè xiǎo dǎo zǔ chéng de ， miàn jī hé jiā zhōu chà bu duō 。

释义: to face sth; to be confronted with
短释义: to face sth; to be confronted with

例句.zh: 我知道你们的所做的一切并不只是为了赢得选举，我也知道你们做这一切并不是为了我。你们这样做是因为你们明白前面的任务有多么艰巨。即便我们今晚欢呼庆祝，我们也知道明天将面临我们一生之中最艰难的挑战——两场战争、一个面临危险的星球，一个世纪以来最严重的金融危机。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ men de suǒ zuò de yī qiè bìng bù zhǐ shì wèi le yíng dé xuǎn jǔ ， wǒ yě zhī dào nǐ men zuò zhè yī qiè bìng bú shì wèi le wǒ 。 nǐ men zhè yàng zuò shì yīn wèi nǐ men míng bái qián miàn de rèn wù yǒu duō me jiān jù 。 jí biàn wǒ men jīn wǎn huān hū qìng zhù ， wǒ men yě zhī dào míng tiān jiāng miàn lín wǒ men yī shēng zhī zhōng zuì jiān nán de tiǎo zhàn —— liǎng chǎng zhàn zhēng 、 yí gè miàn lín wēi xiǎn de xīng qiú ， yí gè shì jì yǐ lái zuì yán zhòng de jīn róng wēi jī 。
例句.en: And I know you didn't do this just to win an election. And I know you didn't do it for me. You did it because you understand the enormity of the task that lies ahead. For even as we celebrate tonight, we know the challenges that tomorrow will bring are the greatest of our lifetime: two wars, a planet in peril, the worst financial crisis in a century.

例句.zh: 但我将总是会向你们坦陈我们所面临的挑战。我会听取你们的意见，尤其是存在不同意见的时候。最重要的是，我会请求你们参与重建这个国家，以美国221年来从未改变的唯一方式-一砖一瓦、同心协力。
例句.pinyin: dàn wǒ jiāng zǒng shì huì xiàng nǐ men tǎn chén wǒ men suǒ miàn lín de tiǎo zhàn 。 wǒ huì tīng qǔ nǐ men de yì jiàn ， yóu qí shì cún zài bù tóng yì jiàn de shí hòu 。 zuì zhòng yào de shì ， wǒ huì qǐng qiú nǐ men cān yù chóng jiàn zhè ge guó jiā ， yǐ měi guó 221 nián lái cóng wèi gǎi biàn de wéi yī fāng shì - yī zhuān yī wǎ 、 tóng xīn xié lì 。
例句.en: But I will always be honest with you about the challenges we face. I will listen to you, especially when we disagree. And above all, I will ask you to join in the work of remaking this nation, the only way it's been done in America for 221 years; block by block, brick by brick, calloused hand by calloused hand.

例句.zh: 俄罗斯面临着严重的财政困难。
例句.pinyin: é luó sī miàn lín zhe yán zhòng de cái zhèng kùn nán 。
例句.en: Russia is facing great financial difficulties.

释义: to face; to turn towards; geared towards; catering for; -oriented / (Tw) aspect; facet
短释义: to face; to turn towards; geared towards; catering for; -oriented

例句.zh: 我的房间面向花园。
例句.pinyin: wǒ de fáng jiān miàn xiàng huā yuán 。

例句.pinyin: wǒ de fáng jiān miàn xiàng dōng biān 。
例句.en: My room faces east.

例句.zh: 因为我的房间面向南边, 即使在冬天都不会那么冷。
例句.pinyin: yīn wèi wǒ de fáng jiān miàn xiàng nán biān ,  jí shǐ zài dōng tiān dōu bú huì nà me lěng 。
例句.en: As my room faces south, it's not too cold even in winter.

释义: to describe / description

例句.zh: 评论员对巫巫兹拉的声音作出了各种各样的描述：除了「烦人」、「像魔鬼一般」之外，还把它比作「一群嘈吵的大象」、「一群嗡嗡狂叫的蝗虫」、「一只准备给屠宰的山羊」、「一个装满发狂的蜜蜂的巨大蜂巢」、「一只吃了摇头丸的鸭子」等等。
例句.pinyin: píng lùn yuán duì wū wū zī lā de shēng yīn zuò chū le gè zhǒng gè yàng de miáo shù ： chú le 「 fán rén 」、「 xiàng mó guǐ yì bān 」 zhī wài ， hái bǎ tā bǐ zuò 「 yī qún cáo chǎo de dà xiàng 」、「 yī qún wēng wēng kuáng jiào de huáng chóng 」、「 yī zhī zhǔn bèi gěi tú zǎi de shān yáng 」、「 yí gè zhuāng mǎn fā kuáng de mì fēng de jù dà fēng cháo 」、「 yī zhī chī le yáo tóu wán de yā zi 」 děng děng 。
例句.en: Commentators have variously described the sound of vuvuzelas as "annoying" and "satanic" and compared it with "a stampede of noisy elephants", "a deafening swarm of locusts", "a goat on the way to slaughter", "a giant hive full of very angry bees", and "a duck on speed".

例句.zh: 该报文章中将被告人描述成一个罪魁祸首，尽管他已经被证明是无辜的了。
例句.pinyin: gāi bào wén zhāng zhōng jiàng bèi gào rén miáo shù chéng yí gè zuì kuí huò shǒu ， jǐn guǎn tā yǐ jīng bèi zhèng míng shì wú gū de le 。
例句.en: The news article painted the defendant as a guilty man, even though he had been proven innocent.

例句.zh: 你可以描述一下当时的处境吗？
例句.pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ miáo shù yī xià dāng shí de chǔ jìng ma ？

例句.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de míngchēng shì shénme?
例句.en: What is the name of this plant?

例句.zh: 这个名称很容易记。
例句.pinyin: Zhège míngchēng hěn róngyì jì.
例句.en: This name is easy to remember.

释义: famous brand / nameplate / name tag

例句.zh: 她喜欢买名牌包。
例句.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan mǎi míngpái bāo.
例句.en: She likes buying designer handbags.

例句.zh: 这家商场有很多名牌。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā shāngchǎng yǒu hěn duō míngpái.
例句.en: This shopping mall carries many famous brands.

例句.zh: 名牌通常比较贵。
例句.pinyin: Míngpái tōngcháng bǐjiào guì.
例句.en: Famous brands tend to be expensive.

释义: (business) card

例句.zh: 看，这是我的名片。
例句.pinyin: kàn ， zhè shì wǒ de míng piàn 。
例句.en: Look, this is my business card.

释义: clear-cut; definite; explicit / to clarify; to specify; to make definite

例句.zh: 他给我的工作作出了明确指示。
例句.pinyin: tā gěi wǒ de gōng zuò zuò chū le míng què zhǐ shì 。
例句.en: He gave me precise instructions to do the job.

例句.zh: 法律有很多不明确的地方。
例句.pinyin: fǎ lǜ yǒu hěn duō bù míng què de dì fāng 。
例句.en: The law is full of ambiguities.

例句.zh: 我发现有明确定义的词最容易记住。
例句.pinyin: wǒ fā xiàn yǒu míng què dìng yì de cí zuì róng yì jì zhù 。
例句.en: I find words with concise definitions to be the easiest to remember.

释义: clear / distinct / obvious

例句.zh: Kate 的声音明显和其它女孩不同。
例句.pinyin: Kate  de shēng yīn míng xiǎn hé qí tā nǚ hái bù tóng 。
例句.en: Kate's voice is clearly different from the other girls'.

例句.zh: 很明显的是他犯了错。
例句.pinyin: hěn míng xiǎn de shì tā fàn le cuò 。
例句.en: It is evident that he has made a mistake.

例句.zh: 很明显的是这两者之间有很强烈的分歧。
例句.pinyin: hěn míng xiǎn de shì zhè liǎng zhě zhī jiān yǒu hěn qiáng liè de fēn qí 。
例句.en: It's clear that there's a rather strong disagreement between the two.

释义: star; celebrity

例句.zh: 谁是你最喜爱的电视明星？
例句.pinyin: shuí shì nǐ zuì xǐ ài de diàn shì míng xīng ？
例句.en: Who is your favorite TV star?

释义: life / fate / order or command / to assign a name, title etc

例句.zh: 睡眠是最大的小偷，它偷了我们一半的生命。
例句.pinyin: shuì mián shì zuì dà de xiǎo tōu ， tā tōu le wǒ men yí bàn de shēng mìng 。
例句.en: Sleep is the greatest thief, for it steals half one's life.

例句.zh: 他的医生命令他休息。
例句.pinyin: tā de yī shēng mìng lìng tā xiū xī 。
例句.en: His doctor ordered him to rest.

例句.zh: 100万人在战争中失去了生命。
例句.pinyin: 100 wàn rén zài zhàn zhēng zhōng shī qù le shēng mìng 。
例句.en: One million people lost their lives in the war.

释义: fate; destiny

例句.zh: 对于那些彻夜关注美国大选的海外人士，从国会到皇宫，以及在被遗忘的角落里挤在收音机旁的人们，我们的经历虽然各有不同，但是我们的命运是一样的，新的美国领导层已产生了。
例句.pinyin: duì yú nà xiē chè yè guān zhù měi guó dà xuǎn de hǎi wài rén shì ， cóng guó huì dào huáng gōng ， yǐ jí zài bèi yí wàng de jiǎo luò lǐ jǐ zài shōu yīn jī páng de rén men ， wǒ men de jīng lì suī rán gè yǒu bù tóng ， dàn shì wǒ men de mìng yùn shì yī yàng de ， xīn de měi guó lǐng dǎo céng yǐ chǎn shēng le 。
例句.en: And all those watching tonight from beyond our shores, from parliaments and palaces, to those who are huddled around radios in the forgotten corners of the world, our stories are singular, but our destiny is shared, and a new dawn of American leadership is at hand.

例句.zh: 她该接受她的命运。
例句.pinyin: tā gāi jiē shòu tā de mìng yùn 。
例句.en: She had to accept her fate.

例句.zh: 与其向命运妥协，我宁可自杀。
例句.pinyin: yǔ qí xiàng mìng yùn tuǒ xié ， wǒ nìng kě zì shā 。
例句.en: I would rather kill myself than reconcile myself to my fate.

释义: to feel with the hand / to touch / to stroke / to grope / to steal / to abstract / variant of 摹[mo2]

例句.zh: 他在口袋里摸着找他的钱包。
例句.pinyin: tā zài kǒu dài lǐ mō zhe zhǎo tā de qián bāo 。
例句.en: He felt in his pocket for his wallet.

例句.zh: 今年，在这场选举中，她用手指触摸屏幕投下自己的选票，因为在美国生活了106年之后，经历了最好的时光和最黑暗的时刻之后，她知道美国如何能够发生变革。
例句.pinyin: jīn nián ， zài zhè chǎng xuǎn jǔ zhōng ， tā yòng shǒu zhǐ chù mō píng mù tóu xià zì jǐ de xuǎn piào ， yīn wèi zài měi guó shēng huó le 106 nián zhī hòu ， jīng lì le zuì hǎo de shí guāng hé zuì hēi àn de shí kè zhī hòu ， tā zhī dào měi guó rú hé néng gòu fā shēng biàn gé 。
例句.en: And this year, in this election, she touched her finger to a screen, and cast her vote; because after 106 years in America, through the best of times and the darkest of hours, she knows how America can change.

例句.zh: 这条围巾摸起来又软又滑。
例句.pinyin: zhè tiáo wéi jīn mō qǐ lái yòu ruǎn yòu huá 。
例句.en: This scarf feels soft and smooth.

释义: vague; indistinct; fuzzy / to blur; to obscure; to confuse; to mix up

例句.zh: 我对童年的记忆越来越模糊了.
例句.pinyin: wǒ duì tóng nián de jì yì yuè lái yuè mó hú le .
例句.en: I recall less and less of my childhood.

例句.zh: 可能会引起视力模糊、呼吸急促等副作用。
例句.pinyin: kě néng huì yǐn qǐ shì lì mó hú 、 hū xī jí cù děng fù zuò yòng 。
例句.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.

例句.zh: 这一个段落是模糊不清的。
例句.pinyin: zhè yí gè duàn luò shì mó hú bù qīng de 。
例句.en: This paragraph is vague.

释义: mode; pattern; model

例句.zh: 你很快就会习惯这个国家的生活模式了。
例句.pinyin: nǐ hěn kuài jiù huì xí guàn zhè ge guó jiā de shēng huó mó shì le 。
例句.en: You will soon get accustomed to living in this country.

例句.zh: 电视的发明为我们的生活模式带来了巨大的变化。
例句.pinyin: diàn shì de fā míng wèi wǒ men de shēng huó mó shì dài lái le jù dà de biàn huà 。
例句.en: The invention of TV caused a drastic change in our daily life.

例句.zh: 许多网路公司为求生存而需要新颖的商业模式。
例句.pinyin: xǔ duō wǎng lù gōng sī wèi qiú shēng cún ér xū yào xīn yǐng de shāng yè mó shì 。
例句.en: Many on-line companies need to have a new approach to business to survive.

释义: strange; unfamiliar

例句.zh: 在公车上，一个陌生人和我说了话。
例句.pinyin: zài gōng chē shàng ， yí gè mò shēng rén hé wǒ shuō le huà 。
例句.en: A stranger spoke to me on the bus.

例句.zh: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。
例句.pinyin: tā duì wǒ lái shuō shì yí gè wán quán mò shēng de rén 。
例句.en: As far as I'm concerned, she's a complete stranger.

例句.zh: 当一个陌生人来和玛丽说话时，她不知道该说什么了。
例句.pinyin: dāng yí gè mò shēng rén lái hé mǎ lì shuō huà shí ， tā bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me le 。
例句.en: When Mary was spoken to by a stranger, she was at a loss for words.

释义: some / a certain / sb or sth indefinite / such-and-such

例句.zh: 由医生来决定某人何时该死是对的吗？
例句.pinyin: yóu yī shēng lái jué dìng mǒu rén hé shí gāi sǐ shì duì de ma ？
例句.en: Is it right for a doctor to decide when someone should die?

例句.zh: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。
例句.pinyin: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shàng nǐ shì duì de ， dàn wǒ hái shì yǒu yí wèn 。
例句.en: In a way you are right, but I still have doubts.

例句.zh: 不是因为读者对某本书不感兴趣，这本书就肯定是有问题的了。
例句.pinyin: bú shì yīn wèi dú zhě duì mǒu běn shū bù gǎn xìng qù ， zhè běn shū jiù kěn dìng shì yǒu wèn tí de le 。
例句.en: Just because a certain book does not interest readers does not mean that the fault lies in the book.

释义: gaze; (fig.) attention / expression in one's eyes; look / (lit. and fig.) sight; vision

例句.zh: 他的目光十分困惑：「我甚么也没听过，所以甚么也说不出来。」
例句.pinyin: tā de mù guāng shí fēn kùn huò ：「 wǒ shén me yě méi tīng guò ， suǒ yǐ shén me yě shuō bù chū lái 。」
例句.en: He said with a perplexed expression, "I've heard nothing, so I can't say anything."

例句.zh: 你穿那条裙子，一定会惹来许多人的目光。
例句.pinyin: nǐ chuān nà tiáo qún zi ， yí dìng huì rě lái xǔ duō rén de mù guāng 。
例句.en: You're going to turn a lot of heads with that dress.

例句.zh: 汤姆用怀疑的目光盯着那个高个子男人。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ yòng huái yí de mù guāng dīng zhe nà ge gāo gè zi nán rén 。
例句.en: Tom looked at the tall man suspiciously.

释义: wood; log (CL:塊|块[kuai4],根[gen1]) / (fig.) blockhead; dolt

例句.zh: 木头能浮在水面上。
例句.pinyin: mù tou néng fú zài shuǐ miàn shàng 。
例句.en: Wood floats in water.

例句.zh: 木头容易着火。
例句.pinyin: mù tou róng yì zháo huǒ 。
例句.en: Wood burns easily.

例句.zh: 这玩具是用木头做的。
例句.pinyin: zhè wán jù shì yòng mù tou zuò de 。
例句.en: This toy is made of wood.

释义: even / even if / even though / no matter how

例句.zh: 哪怕没有人陪我，我也要去看这部电影。
例句.pinyin: nǎ pà méi yǒu rén péi wǒ ， wǒ yě yào qù kàn zhè bù diàn yǐng 。
例句.en: Even if no one goes with me, I still want to see this movie.

释义: seldom / rare / hard to come by

例句.zh: 我生平难得做了一件好事...却是没用的。
例句.pinyin: wǒ shēng píng nán dé zuò le yī jiàn hǎo shì ... què shì méi yòng de 。
例句.en: For once in my life I'm doing a good deed... And it is useless.

例句.zh: 警方很能明白有人偷了我的信用卡，并提了好多钱。让他们相信”有人偷了我的魔剑“要难得多。
例句.pinyin: jǐng fāng hěn néng míng bái yǒu rén tōu le wǒ de xìn yòng kǎ ， bìng tí le hǎo duō qián 。 ràng tā men xiāng xìn ” yǒu rén tōu le wǒ de mó jiàn “ yào nán dé duō 。
例句.en: The police are really good at understanding "Someone stole my credit card and ran up a lot of charges." It's a lot harder to get them to buy into "Someone stole my magic sword."

例句.zh: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ bú huì shuō yīng yǔ ， nǐ jiù hěn nán dé dào yí gè hǎo de zhí wèi 。
例句.en: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.

释义: degree of difficulty

例句.zh: 均分蛋糕有些难度。
例句.pinyin: jūn fēn dàn gāo yǒu xiē nán dù 。
例句.en: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.

释义: hard to (predict, imagine etc)

例句.zh: 我难以用言语表达我的感情。
例句.pinyin: wǒ nán yǐ yòng yán yǔ biǎo dá wǒ de gǎn qíng 。
例句.en: I find it hard to express my feelings in words.

例句.zh: 你会发现难以满足她。
例句.pinyin: nǐ huì fā xiàn nán yǐ mǎn zú tā 。
例句.en: You'll find it difficult to meet her requirements.

例句.zh: 疼痛令人难以忍受。
例句.pinyin: téng tòng lìng rén nán yǐ rěn shòu 。
例句.en: The pain is unbearable.

释义: a man; a male

例句.zh: 我会使你成为一个男子汉。
例句.pinyin: wǒ huì shǐ nǐ chéng wéi yí gè nán zi hàn 。
例句.en: I will make a man of you.

例句.zh: 让我们记住，是伊利诺伊州的一名男子首次将共和党的旗帜扛到了白宫。共和党是建立在自立、个人自由以及国家团结的价值观之上的。这也是我们所有人共同的价值观。虽然民主党今天晚上赢得了巨大的胜利，但我们是以谦卑的态度和弥合阻碍我们进步的分歧的决心赢得这场胜利的
例句.pinyin: ràng wǒ men jì zhù ， shì yī lì nuò yī zhōu de yī míng nán zi shǒu cì jiāng gòng hé dǎng de qí zhì káng dào le bái gōng 。 gòng hé dǎng shì jiàn lì zài zì lì 、 gè rén zì yóu yǐ jí guó jiā tuán jié de jià zhí guān zhī shàng de 。 zhè yě shì wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén gòng tóng de jià zhí guān 。 suī rán mín zhǔ dǎng jīn tiān wǎn shàng yíng dé le jù dà de shèng lì ， dàn wǒ men shì yǐ qiān bēi de tài dù hé mí hé zǔ ài wǒ men jìn bù de fēn qí de jué xīn yíng dé zhè chǎng shèng lì de
例句.en: Let's remember that it was a man from this state who first carried the banner of the Republican Party to the White House, a party founded on the values of self-reliance and individual liberty and national unity. Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.

例句.zh: 贝克小姐知道那个年轻男子很快就要离开了，所以决定请求他将车稍微移开，如此一来她就能在夜间入睡前将她的车停到正确的位置。
例句.pinyin: bèi kè xiǎo jiě zhī dào nà ge nián qīng nán zi hěn kuài jiù yào lí kāi le ， suǒ yǐ jué dìng qǐng qiú tā jiāng chē shāo wēi yí kāi ， rú cǐ yī lái tā jiù néng zài yè jiān rù shuì qián jiāng tā de chē tíng dào zhèng què de wèi zhì 。
例句.en: Miss Baker knew that the young man would have to leave very soon, so she decided to ask him to move his car a bit, so that she could park hers in the proper place for the night before going to bed.

释义: variant of 鬧|闹[nao4] / noisy / cacophonous / to make noise / to disturb / to vent (feelings) / to fall ill / to have an attack (of sickness) / to go in (for some activity) / to joke

例句.zh: 昨天闹钟没响，Kurt也就没醒过来。
例句.pinyin: zuó tiān nào zhōng méi xiǎng ，Kurt yě jiù méi xǐng guò lái 。

例句.zh: 父亲把闹钟调到六时。
例句.pinyin: fù qīn bǎ nào zhōng diào dào liù shí 。
例句.en: Father set the alarm for six o'clock.

例句.zh: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。
例句.pinyin: bèi nào zhōng huàn xǐng méi yǒu bèi niǎo huàn xǐng de hǎo 。
例句.en: Much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.

释义: alarm clock

例句.zh: 昨天闹钟没响，Kurt也就没醒过来。
例句.pinyin: zuó tiān nào zhōng méi xiǎng ，Kurt yě jiù méi xǐng guò lái 。
例句.en: Yesterday the alarm clock didn't go off and Kurt didn't wake up.

例句.zh: 父亲把闹钟调到六时。
例句.pinyin: fù qīn bǎ nào zhōng diào dào liù shí 。
例句.en: Father set the alarm for six o'clock.

例句.zh: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。
例句.pinyin: bèi nào zhōng huàn xǐng méi yǒu bèi niǎo huàn xǐng de hǎo 。
例句.en: Much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.

释义: interior / inside (part, section) / internal

例句.zh: 我们还应该看下这个房子的内部。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men hái yīng gāi kàn xià zhè ge fáng zi de nèi bù 。
例句.en: We should look inside this house as well.

例句.zh: 电脑内部计时器内的纽扣电池没电了。
例句.pinyin: diàn nǎo nèi bù jì shí qì nèi de niǔ kòu diàn chí méi diàn le 。
例句.en: The button battery in the PC's internal timer has gone flat.

例句.zh: 2015 年 4 月 14 日，我步行前往列治文公共市场，先是爬上了外面的阶梯。市场内部宽敞的中庭式建筑，让我感觉仿佛置身于丛林之中。我当时已经有点饿了，便小跑到小吃摊「瓦船长」那里，点了一份面和一杯热茶。面里有鱿鱼、鱼和豆腐。我吃著吃著，一位穿著紫色 T 恤的英俊原住民男子从我身边走过。接著，一位身材魁梧、相貌英俊的犹太人也走了过来。几分钟后，我开始觉得口渴，于是在「QQ 珍珠奶茶与咖啡」买了一杯冰镇薄荷珍珠绿茶。我坐在阶梯旁慢慢品尝。附近坐著一家三口吃东西，男人是黑人，女人是东亚人，小孩是混血儿。我喝珍珠奶茶上瘾，于是在「花生家」又买了一杯。这次是冰镇青苹果珍珠绿茶，味道好极了。我搭扶梯下楼。去洗手间的路上，我注意到一个大水族箱，里面养著大概是体型巨大的阿拉斯加红帝王蟹，蟹腿上长满了藤壶。不知怎的，牠们让我想起了外星生物。在书店里，我买了一本图文并茂的绿色植物学书籍，上面用的是汉字。一个月前我把它放在一个箱子上，现在还在那里。这本书 14 块钱。我搭扶梯上楼。我对珍珠奶茶还是有瘾，于是用剩下的零钱买了一杯冰荔枝珍珠绿茶。味道好极了，里面甚至还有白色的荔枝果肉。
例句.pinyin: 2015  nián  4  yuè  14  rì ， wǒ bù xíng qián wǎng liè zhì wén gōng gòng shì chǎng ， xiān shì pá shàng le wài miàn de jiē tī 。 shì chǎng nèi bù kuān chǎng de zhōng tíng shì jiàn zhù ， ràng wǒ gǎn jué fǎng fú zhì shēn yú cóng lín zhī zhōng 。 wǒ dāng shí yǐ jīng yǒu diǎn è le ， biàn xiǎo pǎo dào xiǎo chī tān 「 wǎ chuán zhǎng 」 nà lǐ ， diǎn le yī fèn miàn hé yī bēi rè chá 。 miàn lǐ yǒu yóu yú 、 yú hé dòu fǔ 。 wǒ chī zhù chī zhù ， yī wèi chuān zhù zǐ sè  T  xù de yīng jùn yuán zhù mín nán zi cóng wǒ shēn biān zǒu guò 。 jiē zhù ， yī wèi shēn cái kuí wú 、 xiàng mào yīng jùn de yóu tài rén yě zǒu le guò lái 。 jǐ fēn zhōng hòu ， wǒ kāi shǐ jué de kǒu kě ， yú shì zài 「QQ  zhēn zhū nǎi chá yǔ kā fēi 」 mǎi le yī bēi bīng zhèn bò hé zhēn zhū lǜ chá 。 wǒ zuò zài jiē tī páng màn màn pǐn cháng 。 fù jìn zuò zhù yī jiā sān kǒu chī dōng xī ， nán rén shì hēi rén ， nǚ rén shì dōng yà rén ， xiǎo hái shì hùn xuè ér 。 wǒ hē zhēn zhū nǎi chá shàng yǐn ， yú shì zài 「 huā shēng jiā 」 yòu mǎi le yī bēi 。 zhè cì shì bīng zhèn qīng píng guǒ zhēn zhū lǜ chá ， wèi dào hǎo jí le 。 wǒ dā fú tī xià lóu 。 qù xǐ shǒu jiān de lù shàng ， wǒ zhù yì dào yí gè dà shuǐ zú xiāng ， lǐ miàn yǎng zhù dà gài shì tǐ xíng jù dà de ā lā sī jiā hóng dì wáng xiè ， xiè tuǐ shàng zhǎng mǎn le téng hú 。 bù zhī zěn de ， tā men ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ le wài xīng shēng wù 。 zài shū diàn lǐ ， wǒ mǎi le yī běn tú wén bìng mào de lǜ sè zhí wù xué shū jí ， shàng miàn yòng de shì hàn zì 。 yí gè yuè qián wǒ bǎ tā fàng zài yí gè xiāng zi shàng ， xiàn zài hái zài nà lǐ 。 zhè běn shū  14  kuài qián 。 wǒ dā fú tī shàng lóu 。 wǒ duì zhēn zhū nǎi chá hái shì yǒu yǐn ， yú shì yòng shèng xià de líng qián mǎi le yī bēi bīng lì zhī zhēn zhū lǜ chá 。 wèi dào hǎo jí le ， lǐ miàn shèn zhì hái yǒu bái sè de lì zhī guǒ ròu 。
例句.en: On the 14th of April of 2015, I walk to the Richmond Public Market, I first climbing the stairs outside. Inside, the wide atrium-like building is like a garden in a jungle surrounding, I imagine. Already quite hungry, I trot to Captain Wa, the food vendor, to get noodles with squid, fish, and tofu, as well as hot tea. As I eat, a handsome First Nations man in a purple T-shirt walks by. Then a handsome, stocky Jewish fellow walks by. A few minutes later, I begin to thirst, so I get a cold Mint Bubble Green Tea at the vendor QQ Bubble Tea and Coffee. I sit by the stairs to sip. A threesome family sits eating nearby, the man being black, the woman being Oriental, and the child being a hybrid. Addicted to Bubble Tea, I get another one, this time at Peanut's. It is a cold Green Apple Bubble Green Tea. It is delicious. I take the escalator down. On my way to the washroom, I notice a big aquarium full of probably giant red Alaskan king crabs with barnacles on their legs. They remind me of extraterrestrials, somehow. At the bookstore, I buy a heavily illustrated green botany book in sinograms. I left it on top of a box a month ago and it is still there. It is $14. I take the escalator up. Addicted to Bubble Tea, I spend my remaining coins on a cold Lychee Bubble Green Tea. It is delicious with even bits of white lychee flesh.

例句.zh: 从国际的观点看，应该考虑推行人口政策来平衡两方的利益。
例句.pinyin: cóng guó jì de guān diǎn kàn ， yīng gāi kǎo lǜ tuī xíng rén kǒu zhèng cè lái píng héng liǎng fāng de lì yì 。

例句.en: He got where he wanted to be in life by just using his raw mental strength and willpower.

例句.en: It is time not only to equalize men's and women's wages, but also to equalize responsibility for housework.

释义: screen (TV, computer or movie)

例句.pinyin: jīn nián ， zài zhè chǎng xuǎn jǔ zhōng ， tā yòng shǒu zhǐ chù mō píng mù tóu xià zì jǐ de xuǎn piào ， yīn wèi zài měi guó shēng huó le 106 nián zhī hòu ， jīng lì le zuì hǎo de shí guāng hé zuì hēi àn de shí kè zhī hòu ， tā zhī dào měi guó rú hé néng gòu fā shēng biàn gé 。

例句.zh: 我父母说，YouTube 和串流平台让电影的魔力大打折扣。
例句.pinyin: wǒ fù mǔ shuō ，YouTube  hé chuàn liú píng tái ràng diàn yǐng de mó lì dà dǎ zhé kòu 。
例句.en: My parents say that YouTube and streaming services cheapen the magic of film.

例句.zh: 虽然视频平台没有明确禁止此类内容，但这种类型的作品的流量会被限制。

例句.pinyin: xiàn jīn shǒu jī fēi cháng pǔ jí 。
例句.en: Nowadays mobile phones are very popular.

例句.pinyin: wǒ qī dài tīng dào nǐ zài zhè jiàn shì shàng de xiǎng fǎ  。

例句.pinyin: xué xiào yǔ qǐ yè jiàn miàn huì yú 12 yuè 26 rì àn qī jǔ xíng 。

例句.pinyin: zhè kē qì qiú bèi shù bàn zhù le 。

例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ zài chuī qì qiú 。
例句.en: Tom is inflating a balloon.

例句.en: What began in 1972 with a modest launch of 13 balloons has evolved into the largest ballooning event in the world — and the world’s most photographed event.

释义: gasoline

例句.zh: 越来越多的环保者开始宣传和使用以环保的无铅汽油为燃料的汽车。
例句.pinyin: yuè lái yuè duō de huán bǎo zhě kāi shǐ xuān chuán hé shǐ yòng yǐ huán bǎo de wú qiān qì yóu wèi rán liào de qì chē 。

例句.pinyin: wǒ hěn què dìng wǒ men yǒu zú gòu hǎo de qì yóu huí jiā 。
例句.en: I'm pretty sure we have enough gas to get home.

短释义: to agree to and sign (a treaty etc)

例句.pinyin: nǐ néng zài zhè lǐ qiān míng ma ?

例句.pinyin: qǐng nǐ zài zhè lǐ qiān míng hǎo ma ？
