例句.en: At what age will I be able to withstand what now hurts me so easily, makes me disheartened and anxious?

例句.zh: 但是，如果你动错了，你别放弃。因为你不知道接下来会发生什么。记得，不要轻易放弃。
例句.pinyin: dàn shì ， rú guǒ nǐ dòng cuò le ， nǐ bié fàng qì 。 yīn wèi nǐ bù zhī dào jiē xià lái huì fā shēng shén me 。 jì de ， bú yào qīng yì fàng qì 。
例句.en: But if you're wrong, don't give up. Because you don't know what's going to happen next. Remember, don't give up easily.

释义: severity (of the case) / degree of seriousness / whether sth is slight or serious

例句.zh: 医生会根据病情轻重安排治疗。
例句.pinyin: Yīshēng huì gēnjù bìngqíng qīngzhòng ānpái zhìliáo.
例句.en: The doctor will arrange treatment according to the severity of the illness.

例句.zh: 处罚要根据情节轻重来决定。
例句.pinyin: Chǔfá yào gēnjù qíngjié qīngzhòng lái juédìng.
例句.en: The punishment should be determined based on the severity of the case.

例句.zh: 这些伤员不分轻重，都得到了及时救治。
例句.pinyin: Zhèxiē shāngyuán bù fēn qīngzhòng, dōu dédào le jíshí jiùzhì.
例句.en: All the injured received timely treatment, regardless of the severity of their injuries.

释义: feeling / emotion / to move (emotionally)

例句.zh: 他把情感藏进了心底，装出热心的样子。
例句.pinyin: tā bǎ qíng gǎn cáng jìn le xīn dǐ ， zhuāng chū rè xīn de yàng zi 。
例句.en: He hid his emotions and pretended to be enthusiastic.

例句.zh: 书页翻动之间，我们可以对书中的人物不予理会而不伤及他们的情感。
例句.pinyin: shū yè fān dòng zhī jiān ， wǒ men kě yǐ duì shū zhōng de rén wù bù yǔ lǐ huì ér bù shāng jí tā men de qíng gǎn 。
例句.en: By turning the page, we can dismiss the characters in a book without fear of hurting their feelings.

例句.zh: 我对昨天晚上发生的事情感到非常的抱歉。
例句.pinyin: wǒ duì zuó tiān wǎn shàng fā shēng de shì qíng gǎn dào fēi cháng de bào qiàn 。
例句.en: I'm really sorry about what happened last night.

释义: scene; spectacle / circumstances; situation

例句.zh: 咖啡师们该创造一个情景喜剧。
例句.pinyin: kā fēi shī men gāi chuàng zào yí gè qíng jǐng xǐ jù 。
例句.en: Baristas need to make a sitcom.

例句.zh: 我决不会忘记去年与总统握手的情景。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jué bù huì wàng jì qù nián yǔ zǒng tǒng wò shǒu de qíng jǐng 。
例句.en: I'll never forget shaking the President's hand last year.

例句.zh: 我被这情景吓到了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bèi zhè qíng jǐng xià dào le 。
例句.en: I was frightened by the sight.

释义: mood / state of mind / moodiness / CL:種|种[zhong3]

例句.zh: 雨天让我情绪低落。
例句.pinyin: yǔ tiān ràng wǒ qíng xù dī luò 。
例句.en: Rainy days make me depressed.

例句.zh: 你应该学习控制自己的情绪。
例句.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi xué xí kòng zhì zì jǐ de qíng xù 。
例句.en: You should learn to restrain yourself.

例句.zh: 我们上班时的情绪，就像坐过山车一样 ﹣ 老板脸上一现出不悦的神色，我们就要吃苦头；老板脸上有了笑容，我们才能松一口气。这样的工作，我不想再干下去了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men shàng bān shí de qíng xù ， jiù xiàng zuò guò shān chē yī yàng  ﹣  lǎo bǎn liǎn shàng yī xiàn chū bú yuè de shén sè ， wǒ men jiù yào chī kǔ tóu ； lǎo bǎn liǎn shàng yǒu le xiào róng ， wǒ men cái néng sōng yì kǒu qì 。 zhè yàng de gōng zuò ， wǒ bù xiǎng zài gàn xià qù le 。
例句.en: I can't keep this up. It's an emotional roller coaster around here and all we have to do is look at the boss's face to know whether everybody is going to be happy or sad.

释义: to ask for guidance / to consult

例句.zh: 您最好请教一下医生。
例句.pinyin: nín zuì hǎo qǐng jiào yī xià yī shēng 。
例句.en: You'd better consult the doctor.

例句.zh: 你最好请教一下医生。
例句.pinyin: nǐ zuì hǎo qǐng jiào yī xià yī shēng 。
例句.en: You'd better consult the doctor.

例句.zh: 你最好请教你的医生。
例句.pinyin: nǐ zuì hǎo qǐng jiào nǐ de yī shēng 。
例句.en: You'd better consult your doctor.

释义: to request; to ask / request (CL:個|个[ge4])

例句.zh: 他请求她给予优待。
例句.pinyin: tā qǐng qiú tā jǐ yǔ yōu dài 。
例句.en: He asked her to give him preferential treatment.

例句.zh: 她请求他们脱掉鞋子。
例句.pinyin: tā qǐng qiú tā men tuō diào xié zi 。
例句.en: She asked them to take their shoes off.

例句.zh: 但我将总是会向你们坦陈我们所面临的挑战。我会听取你们的意见，尤其是存在不同意见的时候。最重要的是，我会请求你们参与重建这个国家，以美国221年来从未改变的唯一方式-一砖一瓦、同心协力。
例句.pinyin: dàn wǒ jiāng zǒng shì huì xiàng nǐ men tǎn chén wǒ men suǒ miàn lín de tiǎo zhàn 。 wǒ huì tīng qǔ nǐ men de yì jiàn ， yóu qí shì cún zài bù tóng yì jiàn de shí hòu 。 zuì zhòng yào de shì ， wǒ huì qǐng qiú nǐ men cān yù chóng jiàn zhè ge guó jiā ， yǐ měi guó 221 nián lái cóng wèi gǎi biàn de wéi yī fāng shì - yī zhuān yī wǎ 、 tóng xīn xié lì 。
例句.en: But I will always be honest with you about the challenges we face. I will listen to you, especially when we disagree. And above all, I will ask you to join in the work of remaking this nation, the only way it's been done in America for 221 years; block by block, brick by brick, calloused hand by calloused hand.

释义: poor / destitute / to use up / to exhaust / thoroughly / extremely / (coll.) persistently and pointlessly

例句.zh: 他年轻的时候穷困潦倒。
例句.pinyin: tā nián qīng de shí hòu qióng kùn liáo dǎo 。
例句.en: He was terribly poor when he was young.

例句.zh: 贫穷的不是拥有太少的人，而是想要太多的人。
例句.pinyin: pín qióng de bú shì yōng yǒu tài shǎo de rén ， ér shì xiǎng yào tài duō de rén 。
例句.en: Poor is not the one who has too little, but the one who wants too much.

例句.zh: 玛丽不穷，相反，她相当富裕。
例句.pinyin: mǎ lì bù qióng ， xiāng fǎn ， tā xiāng dāng fù yù 。
例句.en: Mary is not poor. On the contrary, she is quite rich.

释义: trend; tendency

例句.zh: 世界人口有上升的趋势。
例句.pinyin: shì jiè rén kǒu yǒu shàng shēng de qū shì 。
例句.en: The world's population tends to increase.

例句.zh: 她很了解最新的时尚趋势。
例句.pinyin: tā hěn liǎo jiě zuì xīn de shí shàng qū shì 。
例句.en: She knows a lot about the latest fashions.

释义: area / region / district

例句.zh: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。
例句.pinyin: yuán jiù rén yuán wèi le zhǎo dào hái zi ， zǐ xì sōu suǒ le nà ge qū yù 。
例句.en: The rescue worker searched the area, looking for the child.

例句.zh: 据说这个区域埋着财宝。
例句.pinyin: jù shuō zhè ge qū yù mái zhe cái bǎo 。
例句.en: It is said that treasure is buried in this area.

例句.zh: 位处赤道附近一个狭窄区域的热带雨林，正在不断地遭受人类的破坏，预计在二零零零年之前，该区域将会有五分之四的热带雨林从地球上消失。
例句.pinyin: wèi chù chì dào fù jìn yí gè xiá zhǎi qū yù de rè dài yǔ lín ， zhèng zài bù duàn dì zāo shòu rén lèi de pò huài ， yù jì zài èr líng líng líng nián zhī qián ， gāi qū yù jiāng huì yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rè dài yǔ lín cóng dì qiú shàng xiāo shī 。
例句.en: The tropical rainforests, located in a narrow region near the equator, are disappearing so fast that by the year 2000 eighty percent of them may be gone.

释义: to pass away / to die

例句.zh: 据说他爸爸在外国去世了。
例句.pinyin: jù shuō tā bà bà zài wài guó qù shì le 。
例句.en: It is said that his father died in a foreign country.

例句.zh: 我爸爸去世有10年了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bà bà qù shì yǒu 10 nián le 。
例句.en: My father has been dead for ten years.

例句.zh: 她在睡眠中安详地去世了。
例句.pinyin: tā zài shuì mián zhōng ān xiáng dì qù shì le 。
例句.en: She passed away peacefully in her sleep.

释义: surname Quan / authority / power / right / (literary) to weigh / expedient / temporary

例句.zh: 他向权力屈服。
例句.pinyin: tā xiàng quán lì qū fú 。
例句.en: He succumbed to authority.

例句.zh: 他的政权必定会崩溃。
例句.pinyin: tā de zhèng quán bì dìng huì bēng kuì 。
例句.en: His regime is bound to collapse.

例句.zh: 接受对方的准则就是给予他权力。
例句.pinyin: jiē shòu duì fāng de zhǔn zé jiù shì jǐ yǔ tā quán lì 。
例句.en: Accepting the other's norms is submitting to the other's power.

释义: right (i.e. an entitlement to sth) / (classical) power and wealth

例句.zh: 人人生而自由，在尊严和权利上一律平等。他们赋有理性和良心，并应以兄弟关系的精神相对待。
例句.pinyin: rén rén shēng ér zì yóu ， zài zūn yán hé quán lì shàng yī lǜ píng děng 。 tā men fù yǒu lǐ xìng hé liáng xīn ， bìng yīng yǐ xiōng dì guān xì de jīng shén xiāng duì dài 。
例句.en: All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights. They are endowed with reason and conscience and should act towards one another in a spirit of brotherhood.

例句.zh: 人有选择的权利，但是奴隶却只有服从的份儿。
例句.pinyin: rén yǒu xuǎn zé de quán lì ， dàn shì nú lì què zhǐ yǒu fú cóng de fèn ér 。
例句.en: A man chooses; a slave obeys.

例句.zh: 我以为他没有任何权利这么做。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi tā méi yǒu rèn hé quán lì zhè me zuò 。
例句.en: He had, I thought, no right to do that.

释义: with all one's strength / full strength / all-out (effort) / fully (support)

例句.zh: 你做任何事都要尽全力。
例句.pinyin: nǐ zuò rèn hé shì dōu yào jìn quán lì 。
例句.en: Do your best in anything you do.

例句.zh: 他用尽了全力, 还是没有成功.
例句.pinyin: tā yòng jǐn le quán lì ,  hái shì méi yǒu chéng gōng .
例句.en: With all his efforts, he couldn't succeed.

例句.zh: 她会尽全力及时赶到这儿的。
例句.pinyin: tā huì jìn quán lì jí shí gǎn dào zhè ér de 。
例句.en: She will do her best to be here on time.

释义: all-around / comprehensive / total / overall

例句.zh: 我想去医院做一个全面的检查。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng qù yī yuàn zuò yí gè quán miàn de jiǎn chá 。
例句.en: I want to go to the hospital to get a complete check-up.

例句.zh: 全面罢工瘫痪了整个国家。
例句.pinyin: quán miàn bà gōng tān huàn le zhěng gè guó jiā 。
例句.en: The general strike paralyzed the whole country.

例句.zh: 这艘货运飞船将为太空站工作人员运送超过四吨的补给品、水、备件和实验硬件，其中包括完成太空站电力系统全面升级所需的六块新的锂离子电池。
例句.pinyin: zhè sōu huò yùn fēi chuán jiāng wèi tài kōng zhàn gōng zuò rén yuán yùn sòng chāo guò sì dūn de bǔ jǐ pǐn 、 shuǐ 、 bèi jiàn hé shí yàn yìng jiàn ， qí zhōng bāo kuò wán chéng tài kōng zhàn diàn lì xì tǒng quán miàn shēng jí suǒ xū de liù kuài xīn de lǐ lí zi diàn chí 。
例句.en: The cargo craft will carry more than four tons of supplies, water, spare parts and experiment hardware for the station crew, including six new lithium-ion batteries needed to complete an overall update of the station’s electrical system.

释义: all / entire

例句.zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。
例句.pinyin: quán tǐ xiāo shòu rén yuán tōng xiāo dá dàn dì gōng zuò le yī zhōu 。
例句.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.

例句.zh: 在全体职员回家后，火事爆发了。
例句.pinyin: zài quán tǐ zhí yuán huí jiā hòu ， huǒ shì bào fā le 。
例句.en: The fire broke out after the staff went home.

例句.zh: 我们全体为日本祈祷。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men quán tǐ wèi rì běn qí dǎo 。
例句.en: We are all praying for Japan.

释义: all new; completely new

例句.zh: 这是全新的。
例句.pinyin: zhè shì quán xīn de 。
例句.en: It's brand new.

例句.zh: 望远镜为我们的文明开启了一种全新的视角来观察宇宙。
例句.pinyin: wàng yuǎn jìng wèi wǒ men de wén míng kāi qǐ le yī zhǒng quán xīn de shì jiǎo lái guān chá yǔ zhòu 。
例句.en: The telescope has opened a new eye onto the cosmos that has been transformative for our civilization.

例句.zh: 您买了辆全新的车子？
例句.pinyin: nín mǎi le liàng quán xīn de chē zi ？
例句.en: Did you buy a new car?

释义: to advise / to urge / to try to persuade / to exhort / to console / to soothe

例句.zh: 我劝了他戒烟。
例句.pinyin: wǒ quàn le tā jiè yān 。
例句.en: I advised him to give up smoking.

例句.zh: 医生劝我戒烟。
例句.pinyin: yī shēng quàn wǒ jiè yān 。
例句.en: The doctor advised me to stop smoking.

例句.zh: 我们试着劝了他。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men shì zhe quàn le tā 。
例句.en: We tried to persuade him.

释义: to lack; to be short of
短释义: to lack; to be short of

例句.zh: 考虑到他缺乏经验，他做得[已经]非常好了。
例句.pinyin: kǎo lǜ dào tā quē fá jīng yàn ， tā zuò dé [ yǐ jīng ] fēi cháng hǎo le 。
例句.en: He is doing very well considering he lacks experience.

例句.zh: 日本缺乏原材料。
例句.pinyin: rì běn quē fá yuán cái liào 。
例句.en: Japan is lacking in raw materials.

例句.zh: 他有我所缺乏的东西: 信心。
例句.pinyin: tā yǒu wǒ suǒ quē fá de dōng xī :  xìn xīn 。
例句.en: He has what I lack; confidence.

释义: to ensure; to guarantee

例句.zh: 我将确保你们在第一年后有一个增长。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jiāng què bǎo nǐ men zài dì yī nián hòu yǒu yí gè zēng zhǎng 。
例句.en: I'll see to it that you have a raise after the first year.

例句.zh: 确保亲自填写注册表格。
例句.pinyin: què bǎo qīn zì tián xiě zhù cè biǎo gé 。
例句.en: Be sure to fill out the registration form in person.

例句.zh: 确保这个孩子不生病。
例句.pinyin: què bǎo zhè ge hái zi bù shēng bìng 。
例句.en: Make sure that the child is not sick.

释义: definite / certain / fixed / to fix (on sth) / to determine / to be sure / to ensure / to make certain / to ascertain / to clinch / to recognize / to confirm / OK (on computer dialog box)

例句.zh: 你确定吗？
例句.pinyin: nǐ què dìng ma ？
例句.en: Are you sure?

例句.zh: 我不太确定这个单词的发音。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù tài què dìng zhè ge dān cí de fā yīn 。
例句.en: I'm not sure how to pronounce the word.

例句.zh: 我发现有明确定义的词最容易记住。
例句.pinyin: wǒ fā xiàn yǒu míng què dìng yì de cí zuì róng yì jì zhù 。
例句.en: I find words with concise definitions to be the easiest to remember.

释义: to confirm / to verify / confirmation

例句.zh: 您的订单确认如下。
例句.pinyin: nín de dìng dān què rèn rú xià 。
例句.en: We will confirm your order as follows.

例句.zh: 请把发给你的那张单子看一下，再确认一下所有的句子都很通顺。
例句.pinyin: qǐng bǎ fā gěi nǐ de nà zhāng dān zi kàn yī xià ， zài què rèn yī xià suǒ yǒu de jù zi dōu hěn tōng shùn 。
例句.en: Read the list we sent you and check that all the sentences sound natural to you.

例句.zh: 你可以删除「需要母语者确认」的标签。
例句.pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ shān chú 「 xū yào mǔ yǔ zhě què rèn 」 de biāo qiān 。
例句.en: You can remove the NNC.

释义: variant of 群[qun2] / group / crowd / flock, herd, pack etc

例句.zh: 小偷迅速地窜入了人群。
例句.pinyin: xiǎo tōu xùn sù dì cuàn rù le rén qún 。
例句.en: The thief whipped out into the crowd.

例句.zh: 他太不合群。
例句.pinyin: tā tài bù hé qún 。
例句.en: He is unsociable.

例句.zh: 鸟儿成群飞着。
例句.pinyin: niǎo ér chéng qún fēi zhe 。
例句.en: The birds were flying in a group.

释义: community / colony

例句.zh: 但我敢说解决这些少数群体的利益问题—虽然这些利益很大，但总比以后面对社会的愤怒好。
例句.pinyin: dàn wǒ gǎn shuō jiě jué zhè xiē shǎo shù qún tǐ de lì yì wèn tí — suī rán zhè xiē lì yì hěn dà ， dàn zǒng bǐ yǐ hòu miàn duì shè huì de fèn nù hǎo 。
例句.en: But I dare to say that it is better to face those few but powerful interests, rather than eventually facing the fury of society.

例句.zh: 汤姆是LGBTQ+群体中的一员。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ shì LGBTQ+ qún tǐ zhōng de yī yuán 。
例句.en: Tom is part of the LGBTQ+ community.

例句.zh: 印度一家全女性新闻编辑室今年引起了国际社会的关注，该编辑室的员工由本国边缘群体构成，其中包括达利特人。

例句.zh: 现代交通使我们能在几天内环绕地球。

例句.zh: 这是个用这个国家前所未见的，环绕学校、教堂的无数人龙，所说出的答案。这些人苦等三、四个小时投票，许多人还是生平头一次，因为他们相信，这次一定要不一样，他们的声音就是明证。
例句.pinyin: zhè shì gè yòng zhè ge guó jiā qián suǒ wèi jiàn de ， huán rào xué xiào 、 jiào táng de wú shù rén lóng ， suǒ shuō chū de dá àn 。 zhè xiē rén kǔ děng sān 、 sì gè xiǎo shí tóu piào ， xǔ duō rén hái shì shēng píng tóu yī cì ， yīn wèi tā men xiāng xìn ， zhè cì yí dìng yào bù yī yàng ， tā men de shēng yīn jiù shì míng zhèng 。
例句.en: It's the answer told by lines that stretched around schools and churches, in numbers this nation has never seen. By people who waited three hours and four hours, many for the first time in their lives, because they believed that this time must be different, that their voices could be that difference.

例句.zh: 假设 A 和 B 之间有一座高山，那就要考虑一下，路线应该越过高山、穿过高山，还是直接从山旁绕过呢？
例句.pinyin: jiǎ shè  A  hé  B  zhī jiān yǒu yī zuò gāo shān ， nà jiù yào kǎo lǜ yī xià ， lù xiàn yīng gāi yuè guò gāo shān 、 chuān guò gāo shān ， hái shì zhí jiē cóng shān páng rào guò ne ？
例句.en: If a high hill stood between A and B, it was important to decide whether the line should climb over it, pierce it with a tunnel, or make a detour to avoid it.

例句.en: They are a peace-loving people.

例句.zh: 今晚稍早，我接到马侃参议员打来，态度非常恳切的电话。马侃参议员已打完一场漫长艰苦的选战。他为这个他所热爱的国家所打的仗更久，更艰苦。他为美国的奉献牺牲，是我们多数同胞难以想像的。因为有他这位勇敢无私的领袖的奉献，我们才能过比较好的日子。
例句.pinyin: jīn wǎn shāo zǎo ， wǒ jiē dào mǎ kǎn cān yì yuán dǎ lái ， tài dù fēi cháng kěn qiè de diàn huà 。 mǎ kǎn cān yì yuán yǐ dǎ wán yī cháng màn cháng jiān kǔ de xuǎn zhàn 。 tā wèi zhè ge tā suǒ rè ài de guó jiā suǒ dǎ dī zhàng gèng jiǔ ， gèng jiān kǔ 。 tā wèi měi guó de fèng xiàn xī shēng ， shì wǒ men duō shù tóng bāo nán yǐ xiǎng xiàng de 。 yīn wèi yǒu tā zhè wèi yǒng gǎn wú sī de lǐng xiù de fèng xiàn ， wǒ men cái néng guò bǐ jiào hǎo de rì zi 。
例句.en: A little bit earlier this evening, I received an extraordinarily gracious call from Senator McCain. Senator McCain fought long and hard in this campaign. And he's fought even longer and harder for the country that he loves. He has endured sacrifices for America that most of us cannot begin to imagine. We are better off for the service rendered by this brave and selfless leader.

例句.zh: 我仍然热爱着网球运动。

例句.zh: 史丹佛大学电机工程教授范善辉表示：这些面板包含一层材料，类似沙子中的物质。它就像一种高科技镜子，既能将热量从建筑物中排出，又能反射太阳光线，并将热量和阳光都送入 100 公里高的寒冷太空。
例句.pinyin: shǐ dān fú dà xué diàn jī gōng chéng jiào shòu fàn shàn huī biǎo shì ： zhè xiē miàn bǎn bāo hán yī céng cái liào ， lèi sì shā zi zhōng de wù zhì 。 tā jiù xiàng yī zhǒng gāo kē jì jìng zi ， jì néng jiāng rè liàng cóng jiàn zhù wù zhōng pái chū ， yòu néng fǎn shè tài yáng guāng xiàn ， bìng jiāng rè liàng hé yáng guāng dōu sòng rù  100  gōng lǐ gāo de hán lěng tài kōng 。
例句.en: Stanford University electrical engineering professor Shanhui Fan said the panels—which include a layer of material similar to what is found in sand—act like a kind of high-tech mirror, both siphoning heat out of the buildings and reflecting the sun's rays, sending both 100 kilometers up into the coldness of space.

例句.zh: 现在是我们回答这个问题的机会。这是我们的时刻这是我们的时代--让我们的人民重新就业，为我们的后代敞开机会之门，恢复繁荣，推进和平，重新确立“美国梦”，再次证明这样一个基本的真理：我们是一家人；只要一息尚存，我们就有希望；当我们遇到嘲讽和怀疑，当有人说我们办不到的时候，我们要以这个永恒的信条来回应他们。是的，我们能做到
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì wǒ men huí dá zhè ge wèn tí de jī huì 。 zhè shì wǒ men de shí kè zhè shì wǒ men de shí dài -- ràng wǒ men de rén mín chóng xīn jiù yè ， wèi wǒ men de hòu dài chǎng kāi jī huì zhī mén ， huī fù fán róng ， tuī jìn hé píng ， chóng xīn què lì “ měi guó mèng ”， zài cì zhèng míng zhè yàng yí gè jī běn de zhēn lǐ ： wǒ men shì yī jiā rén ； zhǐ yào yī xī shàng cún ， wǒ men jiù yǒu xī wàng ； dāng wǒ men yù dào cháo fěng hé huái yí ， dāng yǒu rén shuō wǒ men bàn bú dào de shí hòu ， wǒ men yào yǐ zhè ge yǒng héng de xìn tiáo lái huí yìng tā men 。 shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào
例句.en: This is our chance to answer that call. This is our moment. This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. And where we are met with cynicism and doubt and those who tell us that we can't, we will respond with that timeless creed that sums up the spirit of a people: Yes, we can.

例句.en: But above all, I will never forget who this victory truly belongs to. It belongs to you. It belongs to you.

例句.zh: 竞选活动的声势也来自那些已不再年轻的人们，他们冒着严寒酷暑，敲开陌生人的家门进行竞选宣传；竞选声势也源自数百万的美国民众，他们充当志愿者和组织者，他们证明了在两百多年以后，民有、民治、民享的政府并未从地球上消失。这是你们的胜利。

例句.en: It drew strength from the not-so-young people who braved the bitter cold and scorching heat to knock on doors of perfect strangers, and from the millions of Americans who volunteered and organized and proved that more than two centuries later a government of the people, by the people, and for the people has not perished from the Earth.

例句.en: Even as we stand here tonight, we know there are brave Americans waking up in the deserts of Iraq and the mountains of Afghanistan, to risk their lives for us.

例句.zh: 今年，在这场选举中，她用手指触摸屏幕投下自己的选票，因为在美国生活了106年之后，经历了最好的时光和最黑暗的时刻之后，她知道美国如何能够发生变革。
例句.pinyin: jīn nián ， zài zhè chǎng xuǎn jǔ zhōng ， tā yòng shǒu zhǐ chù mō píng mù tóu xià zì jǐ de xuǎn piào ， yīn wèi zài měi guó shēng huó le 106 nián zhī hòu ， jīng lì le zuì hǎo de shí guāng hé zuì hēi àn de shí kè zhī hòu ， tā zhī dào měi guó rú hé néng gòu fā shēng biàn gé 。
例句.en: And this year, in this election, she touched her finger to a screen, and cast her vote; because after 106 years in America, through the best of times and the darkest of hours, she knows how America can change.

例句.zh: 现在是我们回答这个问题的机会。这是我们的时刻这是我们的时代--让我们的人民重新就业，为我们的后代敞开机会之门，恢复繁荣，推进和平，重新确立“美国梦”，再次证明这样一个基本的真理：我们是一家人；只要一息尚存，我们就有希望；当我们遇到嘲讽和怀疑，当有人说我们办不到的时候，我们要以这个永恒的信条来回应他们。是的，我们能做到
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì wǒ men huí dá zhè ge wèn tí de jī huì 。 zhè shì wǒ men de shí kè zhè shì wǒ men de shí dài -- ràng wǒ men de rén mín chóng xīn jiù yè ， wèi wǒ men de hòu dài chǎng kāi jī huì zhī mén ， huī fù fán róng ， tuī jìn hé píng ， chóng xīn què lì “ měi guó mèng ”， zài cì zhèng míng zhè yàng yí gè jī běn de zhēn lǐ ： wǒ men shì yī jiā rén ； zhǐ yào yī xī shàng cún ， wǒ men jiù yǒu xī wàng ； dāng wǒ men yù dào cháo fěng hé huái yí ， dāng yǒu rén shuō wǒ men bàn bú dào de shí hòu ， wǒ men yào yǐ zhè ge yǒng héng de xìn tiáo lái huí yìng tā men 。 shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào
例句.en: This is our chance to answer that call. This is our moment. This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. And where we are met with cynicism and doubt and those who tell us that we can't, we will respond with that timeless creed that sums up the spirit of a people: Yes, we can.

例句.pinyin: wǒ mā mā de bà bà shì wǒ de wài gōng 。
例句.en: My mother's father is my maternal grandfather.

释义: outward appearance

例句.zh: 这座大楼的外观很奇怪，不知道设计师是怎么想的。
例句.pinyin: zhè zuò dà lóu de wài guān hěn qí guài ， bù zhī dào shè jì shī shì zěn me xiǎng de 。
例句.en: The façade of this building is bizarre. What the architect was thinking I don't know.

释义: (coll.) mother's mother / maternal grandmother

例句.zh: 有时候外婆比克格勃还危险。
例句.pinyin: yǒu shí hòu wài pó bǐ kè gé bó hái wēi xiǎn 。
例句.en: Sometimes, Grandma is more dangerous than the KGB.

例句.zh: 我们担心着外公和外婆。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men dān xīn zhe wài gōng hé wài pó 。
例句.en: We're worried about Grandma and Grandpa.

例句.zh: 我外婆患有骨质疏松症。
例句.pinyin: wǒ wài pó huàn yǒu gǔ zhì shū sōng zhèng 。
例句.en: My grandmother suffers from osteoporosis.

释义: figure / shape / external form / contour

例句.zh: 地球的外形和橙子相似。
例句.pinyin: dì qiú de wài xíng hé chéng zi xiāng sì 。
例句.en: The earth is similar to an orange in shape.

例句.zh: 这座山有一个美丽的外形。
例句.pinyin: zhè zuò shān yǒu yí gè měi lì de wài xíng 。
例句.en: The mountain has a beautiful shape.

例句.zh: 她身材高挑，外形出众，身穿黑金刺绣衬衫，头戴闪亮的棕色软帽，轻松地融入了时髦的下班人潮之中。
例句.pinyin: tā shēn cái gāo tiǎo ， wài xíng chū zhòng ， shēn chuān hēi jīn cì xiù chèn shān ， tóu dài shǎn liàng de zōng sè ruǎn mào ， qīng sōng dì róng rù le shí máo de xià bān rén cháo zhī zhōng 。
例句.en: Tall and striking, with a black and gold embroidered shirt and a glittering brown bonnet, she blends in easily with the trendy, after-work crowd.

释义: to bend / bent / a bend; a turn (in a road etc) / CL:道[dao4]

例句.zh: 当您开车的时候，应该在转弯处减速。
例句.pinyin: dāng nín kāi chē de shí hòu ， yīng gāi zài zhuǎn wān chù jiǎn sù 。
例句.en: When you are driving, you should slow down on corners.

例句.zh: 就是这个答案，让那些长久以来被灌输要嘲讽、害怕和怀疑自身能力的人们 把他们的手放在历史的弧线上，将它弯向一个更美好的一天的希望。
例句.pinyin: jiù shì zhè ge dá àn ， ràng nà xiē cháng jiǔ yǐ lái bèi guàn shū yào cháo fěng 、 hài pà hé huái yí zì shēn néng lì de rén men   bǎ tā men de shǒu fàng zài lì shǐ de hú xiàn shàng ， jiāng tā wān xiàng yí gè gèng měi hǎo de yī tiān de xī wàng 。
例句.en: It's the answer that led those who've been told for so long, by so many, to be cynical and fearful and doubtful about what we can achieve, to put their hands on the arc of history and bend it once more toward the hope of a better day.

例句.zh: 往北拐弯走到第二条弄堂就是。
例句.pinyin: wǎng běi guǎi wān zǒu dào dì èr tiáo lòng táng jiù shì 。
例句.en: Turn north, walk to the second alley, and you're there.

释义: plaything / toy

例句.zh: 我想要个能装这些玩具的盒子。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yào gè néng zhuāng zhè xiē wán jù de hé zi 。
例句.en: I want a box in which to keep these toys.

例句.zh: 他收起了他的玩具。
例句.pinyin: tā shōu qǐ le tā de wán jù 。
例句.en: He gathered his toys together.

例句.zh: 他给了孩子一个玩具。
例句.pinyin: tā gěi le hái zi yí gè wán jù 。
例句.en: He gave the child a toy.

释义: perfect

例句.zh: 要变得完美，她就是少了一个缺点。
例句.pinyin: yào biàn dé wán měi ， tā jiù shì shǎo le yí gè quē diǎn 。
例句.en: To be perfect she lacked just one defect.

例句.zh: 他的文章写得完美无瑕。
例句.pinyin: tā de wén zhāng xiě dé wán měi wú xiá 。
例句.en: His composition leaves nothing to be desired.

例句.zh: 这才是美国真正的精华——美国能够改变。我们的联邦会日渐完美。我们现在已取得的成就为我们将来能够取得和必须取得的成就增添了希望。
例句.pinyin: zhè cái shì měi guó zhēn zhèng de jīng huá —— měi guó néng gòu gǎi biàn 。 wǒ men de lián bāng huì rì jiàn wán měi 。 wǒ men xiàn zài yǐ qǔ dé de chéng jiù wèi wǒ men jiāng lái néng gòu qǔ dé hé bì xū qǔ dé de chéng jiù zēng tiān le xī wàng 。
例句.en: That's the true genius of America; that America can change. Our Union can be perfected. What we've already achieved gives us hope for what we can and must achieve tomorrow.

释义: (of systems, facilities etc) comprehensive / well-developed / excellent / to refine / to improve

例句.zh: 这个系统存在着许多缺陷和不尽完善的地方。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge xì tǒng cún zài zhe xǔ duō quē xiàn hé bù jìn wán shàn de dì fāng 。
例句.en: This system is bristling with defects and drawbacks.

例句.zh: 一些大学生在假期去非洲做志愿者 ，帮助当地完善野生生物管理。
例句.pinyin: yī xiē dà xué shēng zài jià qī qù fēi zhōu zuò zhì yuàn zhě  ， bāng zhù dāng dì wán shàn yě shēng shēng wù guǎn lǐ 。
例句.en: During the holidays, some university students go to Africa as volunteers and help to perfect local wildlife conservation.

释义: complete / intact

例句.zh: 你有没有看完整本书？
例句.pinyin: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu kàn wán zhěng běn shū ？
例句.en: Did you read the whole book?

例句.zh: 我们想要完整的句子。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men xiǎng yào wán zhěng de jù zi 。
例句.en: We want complete sentences.

例句.zh: 在怀念旧日时光的时刻，我们可能往往想起童年像是有著几乎完整幸福的一段时期。
例句.pinyin: zài huái niàn jiù rì shí guāng de shí kè ， wǒ men kě néng wǎng wǎng xiǎng qǐ tóng nián xiàng shì yǒu zhù jī hū wán zhěng xìng fú de yī duàn shí qī 。
例句.en: In nostalgic moments we may tend to think of childhood as a time of almost unbroken happiness.

释义: just in case / if by any chance / contingency

例句.zh: 万一你生病了，吃这个药。
例句.pinyin: wàn yī nǐ shēng bìng le ， chī zhè ge yào 。
例句.en: Take this medicine in case you get sick.

例句.zh: 万一发生火灾，打碎玻璃并按下红色按钮。
例句.pinyin: wàn yī fā shēng huǒ zāi ， dǎ suì bō lí bìng àn xià hóng sè àn niǔ 。
例句.en: In case of fire, break the glass and push the red button.

例句.zh: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
例句.pinyin: wàn yī yǒu jǐn jí qíng kuàng ， lián xì wǒ de dài lǐ rén 。
例句.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.

释义: to go back and forth; to go to and fro; to do a round trip
短释义: to go back and forth; to go to and fro; to do a round trip

例句.zh: 往返吗？是单程。
例句.pinyin: wǎng fǎn ma ？ shì dān chéng 。
例句.en: Round trip? Only one-way.

例句.zh: 往返还是单程？
例句.pinyin: wǎng fǎn huán shì dān chéng ？
例句.en: Round trip or one-way?

例句.zh: 往返各地的收费如下。
例句.pinyin: wǎng fǎn gè dì de shōu fèi rú xià 。
例句.en: Round-trip fares to each destination are as follows.

释义: network / Internet

例句.zh: 中国政府控制了网络，以免让人民知道六四事件的真相。
例句.pinyin: zhōng guó zhèng fǔ kòng zhì le wǎng luò ， yǐ miǎn ràng rén mín zhī dào liù sì shì jiàn de zhēn xiàng 。
例句.en: The Chinese government controlled the internet to prevent the people from knowing the truth of the Tiananmen Square Massacre.

例句.zh: 青年农民和外出务工农民是农村网民的主力军，在对诸如网络音乐、网络游戏、网络影视等互联网娱乐功能的使用上，农村网民和城镇网民相当。
例句.pinyin: qīng nián nóng mín hé wài chū wù gōng nóng mín shì nóng cūn wǎng mín de zhǔ lì jūn ， zài duì zhū rú wǎng luò yīn yuè 、 wǎng luò yóu xì 、 wǎng luò yǐng shì děng hù lián wǎng yú lè gōng néng de shǐ yòng shàng ， nóng cūn wǎng mín hé chéng zhèn wǎng mín xiāng dāng 。
例句.en: Young people and migrant workers are the bulk of rural Internet users; in terms of online music, online games, online film and television, and the Internet's capacity for entertainment, rural Internet users are equivalent to urban ones.

例句.zh: 但是，相对于城镇网民，农村网民对网络新闻、搜索引擎、网络购物、网上银行和网上炒股等应用程度要低很多。
例句.pinyin: dàn shì ， xiāng duì yú chéng zhèn wǎng mín ， nóng cūn wǎng mín duì wǎng luò xīn wén 、 sōu suǒ yǐn qíng 、 wǎng luò gòu wù 、 wǎng shàng yín háng hé wǎng shàng chǎo gǔ děng yìng yòng chéng dù yào dī hěn duō 。
例句.en: However, compared to that in cities, rural use of online news, search engines, online shopping, online banking, online stocks and so on is much lower.

释义: to harm; to jeopardize; to endanger / harmful effect; damage
短释义: to harm; to jeopardize; to endanger

例句.zh: 有些药品会对身体产生危害。
例句.pinyin: yǒu xiē yào pǐn huì duì shēn tǐ chǎn shēng wēi hài 。
例句.en: Some medicines can be harmful to the body.

例句.zh: 奴役制是一种危害人类罪。
例句.pinyin: nú yì zhì shì yī zhǒng wēi hài rén lèi zuì 。
例句.en: Slavery is a crime against humanity.

例句.zh: 吸烟真是又恶心又低俗！点根烟然后吸，把这些危害健康的气体吸进肺里，然后呼出肮脏的气味。
例句.pinyin: xī yān zhēn shì yòu ě xīn yòu dī sú ！ diǎn gēn yān rán hòu xī ， bǎ zhè xiē wēi hài jiàn kāng de qì tǐ xī jìn fèi lǐ ， rán hòu hū chū āng zāng de qì wèi 。
例句.en: What a disgusting and stupid vice smoking is! Lighting a cigarette and sucking in the smoke. Breathing a dangerous threat to your health into your lungs. Exhaling a foul odor.

释义: smile / CL:個|个[ge4],絲|丝[si1] / to smile

例句.zh: 但是他不常微笑。
例句.pinyin: dàn shì tā bù cháng wēi xiào 。
例句.en: But he did not often smile.

例句.zh: 教授微微笑了一下。
例句.pinyin: jiào shòu wēi wēi xiào le yī xià 。
例句.en: The professor grinned.

例句.zh: 教授微微笑了笑。
例句.pinyin: jiào shòu wēi wēi xiào le xiào 。
例句.en: The professor smiled slightly.

释义: to threaten; to menace

例句.zh: 我们觉得他的威胁只是一个玩笑。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men jué de tā de wēi xié zhǐ shì yí gè wán xiào 。
例句.en: We thought his threat was only a joke.

例句.zh: 威胁我也没用，我什么都不会说的。
例句.pinyin: wēi xié wǒ yě méi yòng ， wǒ shén me dōu bú huì shuō de 。
例句.en: No point in threatening me. I'll still tell you nothing.

例句.zh: 我们需要开发新的能源、创造新的工作岗位，我们需要修建新学校，应对众多威胁、修复与许多国家的盟友关系。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men xū yào kāi fā xīn de néng yuán 、 chuàng zào xīn de gōng zuò gǎng wèi ， wǒ men xū yào xiū jiàn xīn xué xiào ， yìng duì zhòng duō wēi xié 、 xiū fù yǔ xǔ duō guó jiā de méng yǒu guān xì 。
例句.en: There's new energy to harness, new jobs to be created, new schools to build, and threats to meet, alliances to repair.

释义: to encircle / to surround / all around / to wear by wrapping around (scarf, shawl)

例句.zh: 花园被木栅栏围了起来。
例句.pinyin: huā yuán bèi mù shān lán wéi le qǐ lái 。
例句.en: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.

例句.zh: 他被很多人围着，自然变得有点紧张。
例句.pinyin: tā bèi hěn duō rén wéi zhe ， zì rán biàn dé yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng 。
例句.en: With so many people around he naturally became a bit nervous.

例句.zh: 他住在公园周围的某个地方。
例句.pinyin: tā zhù zài gōng yuán zhōu wéi de mǒu gè dì fāng 。
例句.en: He lives somewhere around the park.

释义: as (in the capacity of) / to take sth as / to act as / to serve as / to behave as / to become / to be / to do / by (in the passive voice) / because of / for / to / variant of 為|为[wei2] / variant of 為|为[wei4]

例句.zh: 刚才我的麦克风没起作用，不知道为什么。
例句.pinyin: gāng cái wǒ de mài kè fēng méi qǐ zuò yòng ， bù zhī dào wèi shén me 。
例句.en: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.

例句.zh: 那是因为妳是女生。
例句.pinyin: nà shì yīn wèi nǐ shì nǚ shēng 。
例句.en: That's because you're a girl.

例句.zh: 很少人这么认为。
例句.pinyin: hěn shǎo rén zhè me rèn wéi 。
例句.en: Few people think so.

释义: to keep; to maintain; to preserve
短释义: to keep; to maintain; to preserve

例句.zh: 和一个只说"是"与"否"的人维持一段对话是很难的。
例句.pinyin: hé yí gè zhǐ shuō " shì " yǔ " fǒu " de rén wéi chí yī duàn duì huà shì hěn nán de 。
例句.en: It is difficult to keep up a conversation with someone who only says "yes" and "no".

例句.zh: 你在东京如何维持生计？
例句.pinyin: nǐ zài dōng jīng rú hé wéi chí shēng jì ？
例句.en: How did you make a living in Tokyo?

例句.zh: 维持一个人的声誉是很难的。
例句.pinyin: wéi chí yí gè rén de shēng yù shì hěn nán de 。
例句.en: It is hard to maintain one's reputation.

释义: illegal / to break the law

例句.zh: 严禁卖淫嫖娼，赌博，吸毒，酗酒滋事等违法犯罪活动！
例句.pinyin: yán jìn mài yín piáo chāng ， dǔ bó ， xī dú ， xù jiǔ zī shì děng wéi fǎ fàn zuì huó dòng ！
例句.en: Prostitution, gambling, the use of narcotic substances, drunkenness, disorder, and all other illegal activities are STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.

例句.zh: 携带武器是违法的。
例句.pinyin: xié dài wǔ qì shì wéi fǎ de 。
例句.en: It's against the law to carry weapons.

例句.zh: 在我的城市的所有花园里，践踏花坛是违法的。
例句.pinyin: zài wǒ de chéng shì de suǒ yǒu huā yuán lǐ ， jiàn tà huā tán shì wéi fǎ de 。
例句.en: In all of the gardens in my city it is illegal to trample the flower beds.

释义: to violate (a law)

例句.zh: 如果你违反了法律, 你将受到惩罚。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ wéi fǎn le fǎ lǜ ,  nǐ jiāng shòu dào chéng fá 。
例句.en: You'll be punished if you break the law.

例句.zh: 被判严重违反新的行为准则的青少年将失去免费乘坐公交车的权利，如果想重新取得必须做无报酬的社区工作。
例句.pinyin: bèi pàn yán zhòng wéi fǎn xīn de xíng wéi zhǔn zé de qīng shào nián jiāng shī qù miǎn fèi chéng zuò gōng jiāo chē de quán lì ， rú guǒ xiǎng chóng xīn qǔ dé bì xū zuò wú bào chóu de shè qū gōng zuò 。
例句.en: Youths who are caught violating the new rules on behaviour will lose their right to free travel, and will have to complete unpaid community work to earn it back.

例句.zh: 为了惩处累犯，约翰逊先生也创造了“二振出局”的政策，再次严重违反准则将永久失去免费旅行权利。
例句.pinyin: wèi le chéng chǔ lèi fàn ， yuē hàn xùn xiān shēng yě chuàng zào le “ èr zhèn chū jú ” de zhèng cè ， zài cì yán zhòng wéi fǎn zhǔn zé jiāng yǒng jiǔ shī qù miǎn fèi lǚ xíng quán lì 。
例句.en: In order to deal with repeat offenders, Mr Johnson is also establishing a "two strikes and you're out" policy - serious breaches of the rules will result in permanent removal of free travel rights.

释义: scarf / shawl / CL:條|条[tiao2]

例句.zh: 这条围巾摸起来又软又滑。
例句.pinyin: zhè tiáo wéi jīn mō qǐ lái yòu ruǎn yòu huá 。
例句.en: This scarf feels soft and smooth.

例句.zh: 女孩的脖子上围著一条长长的围巾。
例句.pinyin: nǚ hái de bó zi shàng wéi zhù yī tiáo cháng cháng de wéi jīn 。
例句.en: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.

例句.zh: 我想给妻子买一件礼物。我打算买一条围巾。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gěi qī zǐ mǎi yī jiàn lǐ wù 。 wǒ dǎ suàn mǎi yī tiáo wéi jīn 。
例句.en: I would like to buy a present for my wife. I thought about a scarf.

释义: to revolve around / to center on (an issue)

例句.zh: 地球大约每三百六十五天就会围绕太阳旋转一周。
例句.pinyin: dì qiú dà yuē měi sān bǎi liù shí wǔ tiān jiù huì wéi rào tài yáng xuán zhuǎn yī zhōu 。
例句.en: The earth makes one revolution around the sun in about 365 days.

例句.zh: 我被各国语言及文字的爱好者所围绕。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bèi gè guó yǔ yán jí wén zì de ài hào zhě suǒ wéi rào 。
例句.en: I'm surrounded by linguaphiles!

例句.zh: 那里有许多雏菊围绕着钢铁大厦。
例句.pinyin: nà lǐ yǒu xǔ duō chú jú wéi rào zhe gāng tiě dà shà 。
例句.en: There are daisies around the steel building.

释义: maintenance (of equipment) / to protect and maintain

例句.zh: 这间房子要维修了。
例句.pinyin: zhè jiān fáng zi yào wéi xiū le 。
例句.en: This house must be done up.

例句.zh: 真的凑巧，这两样现在还在维修。
例句.pinyin: zhēn de còu qiǎo ， zhè liǎng yàng xiàn zài hái zài wéi xiū 。
例句.en: Completely coincidentally, these two are still being repaired.

例句.zh: 我的磁带录音机需要维修。
例句.pinyin: wǒ de cí dài lù yīn jī xū yào wéi xiū 。

例句.en: It drew strength from the not-so-young people who braved the bitter cold and scorching heat to knock on doors of perfect strangers, and from the millions of Americans who volunteered and organized and proved that more than two centuries later a government of the people, by the people, and for the people has not perished from the Earth.

例句.en: His leg was bitten by a crocodile.

释义: otherwise / or else / how about...? / either... (or...)

例句.zh: 这个工作需要不低于300美金。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge gōng zuò xū yào bù dī yú 300 měi jīn 。
例句.en: No less than three hundred dollars was needed for the work.

例句.zh: 要不要再来一些沙拉？
例句.pinyin: yào bù yào zài lái yī xiē shā lā ？
例句.en: Would you like some more salad?

例句.zh: 这是个用这个国家前所未见的，环绕学校、教堂的无数人龙，所说出的答案。这些人苦等三、四个小时投票，许多人还是生平头一次，因为他们相信，这次一定要不一样，他们的声音就是明证。
例句.pinyin: zhè shì gè yòng zhè ge guó jiā qián suǒ wèi jiàn de ， huán rào xué xiào 、 jiào táng de wú shù rén lóng ， suǒ shuō chū de dá àn 。 zhè xiē rén kǔ děng sān 、 sì gè xiǎo shí tóu piào ， xǔ duō rén hái shì shēng píng tóu yī cì ， yīn wèi tā men xiāng xìn ， zhè cì yí dìng yào bù yī yàng ， tā men de shēng yīn jiù shì míng zhèng 。
例句.en: It's the answer told by lines that stretched around schools and churches, in numbers this nation has never seen. By people who waited three hours and four hours, many for the first time in their lives, because they believed that this time must be different, that their voices could be that difference.

释义: if it were not for / but for

例句.zh: 只要不是致命性的错误，失败也没关系。
例句.pinyin: zhǐ yào bú shì zhì mìng xìng de cuò wù ， shī bài yě méi guān xì 。
例句.en: As long as it's not a fatal mistake, it is ok to fail.

例句.zh: 要不是他这么磨磨蹭蹭，现在早做完了。
例句.pinyin: yào bú shì tā zhè me mó mó cèng cèng ， xiàn zài zǎo zuò wán le 。
例句.en: If he hadn't wasted time, he'd be finished by now.

例句.zh: 要不是当初有内战，他们现在应该挺富裕了。
例句.pinyin: yào bú shì dāng chū yǒu nèi zhàn ， tā men xiàn zài yīng gāi tǐng fù yù le 。
例句.en: If it had not been for civil war, they would be wealthy now.

释义: medicaments / medicine / drug

例句.zh: 这个药品会提高病人的存活率。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge yào pǐn huì tí gāo bìng rén de cún huó lǜ 。
例句.en: This medicine will increase the survival rate of the patients.

例句.zh: 有些药品会对身体产生危害。
例句.pinyin: yǒu xiē yào pǐn huì duì shēn tǐ chǎn shēng wēi hài 。
例句.en: Some medicines can be harmful to the body.

例句.zh: 从2009年开始，超市和便利店就可以出售药品了。
例句.pinyin: cóng 2009 nián kāi shǐ ， chāo shì hé biàn lì diàn jiù kě yǐ chū shòu yào pǐn le 。
例句.en: Starting from 2009, supermarkets and convenience stores have been allowed to sell medicines.

释义: medicaments / pharmaceuticals / medication / medicine / drug

例句.zh: 没有药物能够治疗这种疾病。
例句.pinyin: méi yǒu yào wù néng gòu zhì liáo zhè zhǒng jí bìng 。
例句.en: No medicine can cure this disease.

例句.zh: 一个成长中的孩子如果没有充足的能量，可能需要药物治疗。
例句.pinyin: yí gè chéng zhǎng zhōng de hái zi rú guǒ méi yǒu chōng zú de néng liàng ， kě néng xū yào yào wù zhì liáo 。
例句.en: A growing child who doesn't seem to have much energy perhaps needs medical attention.

例句.zh: 优胜者不使用药物。
例句.pinyin: yōu shèng zhě bù shǐ yòng yào wù 。
例句.en: Winners don't use drugs.

释义: nighttime / evening or night (e.g. classes)

例句.zh: 贝克小姐知道那个年轻男子很快就要离开了，所以决定请求他将车稍微移开，如此一来她就能在夜间入睡前将她的车停到正确的位置。
例句.pinyin: bèi kè xiǎo jiě zhī dào nà ge nián qīng nán zi hěn kuài jiù yào lí kāi le ， suǒ yǐ jué dìng qǐng qiú tā jiāng chē shāo wēi yí kāi ， rú cǐ yī lái tā jiù néng zài yè jiān rù shuì qián jiāng tā de chē tíng dào zhèng què de wèi zhì 。
例句.en: Miss Baker knew that the young man would have to leave very soon, so she decided to ask him to move his car a bit, so that she could park hers in the proper place for the night before going to bed.

例句.zh: 在夜间发生了火灾。
例句.pinyin: zài yè jiān fā shēng le huǒ zāi 。
例句.en: A fire broke out during the night.

例句.zh: 敌人在夜间攻击了我们。
例句.pinyin: dí rén zài yè jiān gōng jī le wǒ men 。
例句.en: The enemy attacked us at night.

释义: night market

例句.zh: 台湾的夜市很热闹。
例句.pinyin: tái wān de yè shì hěn rè nào 。
例句.en: Taiwan's night market is bustling.

例句.zh: 柏霖昨天在夜市遇到前女友，尴尬到不行。
例句.pinyin: bǎi lín zuó tiān zài yè shì yù dào qián nǚ yǒu ， gān gà dào bù xíng 。
例句.en: Po-lin ran into his ex at the night market yesterday. It was super awkward.

例句.zh: 他计划周末去新竹小旅行，顺便逛城隍庙夜市。
例句.pinyin: tā jì huà zhōu mò qù xīn zhú xiǎo lǚ xíng ， shùn biàn guàng chéng huáng miào yè shì 。
例句.en: He plans to take a short trip to Hsinchu this weekend and visit the Chenghuang Temple Night Market along the way.

释义: business / professional work / service / CL:項|项[xiang4]

例句.zh: 不是的，他是我们的业务主管。
例句.pinyin: bú shì de ， tā shì wǒ men de yè wù zhǔ guǎn 。
例句.en: No, he's our business manager.

例句.zh: 因为你们公司的业务能够发挥我的特长。
例句.pinyin: yīn wèi nǐ men gōng sī de yè wù néng gòu fā huī wǒ de tè cháng 。
例句.en: Because your business can play to my strengths.

例句.zh: 有可能将电脑工作扩展到银行业务, 会计业务等等。
例句.pinyin: yǒu kě néng jiāng diàn nǎo gōng zuò kuò zhǎn dào yín háng yè wù ,  kuài jì yè wù děng děng 。
例句.en: It's possible to branch out from computing to jobs in banking, accountancy and so on.

释义: in one's spare time / outside working hours / amateur (historian etc)

例句.zh: 观察鸟类是个很好的业余爱好。
例句.pinyin: guān chá niǎo lèi shì gè hěn hǎo de yè yú ài hào 。
例句.en: Bird watching is a nice hobby.

例句.zh: 我的业余爱好是拍野花的照片。
例句.pinyin: wǒ de yè yú ài hào shì pāi yě huā de zhào piān 。
例句.en: My hobby is taking pictures of wild flowers.

例句.zh: 我们必须阐明这个观点，在运动项目上，业余选手和专业选手的界限开始消失了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men bì xū chǎn míng zhè ge guān diǎn ， zài yùn dòng xiàng mù shàng ， yè yú xuǎn shǒu hé zhuān yè xuǎn shǒu de jiè xiàn kāi shǐ xiāo shī le 。
例句.en: The point we must clarify here is that the lines between amateur and professional in sport are beginning to disappear.

释义: according to / basis / foundation

例句.zh: 我的演讲稿就是依据这个理论写的。
例句.pinyin: wǒ de yǎn jiǎng gǎo jiù shì yī jù zhè ge lǐ lùn xiě de 。
例句.en: This is the ideology to which my speech is written.

例句.zh: 每一个人对事情的看法不同是依据他们是富有还是贫穷。
例句.pinyin: měi yí gè rén duì shì qíng de kàn fǎ bù tóng shì yī jù tā men shì fù yǒu hái shì pín qióng 。
例句.en: A person views things differently according to whether they are rich or poor.

释义: to rely on; to depend on
短释义: to rely on; to depend on

例句.zh: 我没什么可依靠的了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ méi shén me kě yī kào de le 。
例句.en: I have nothing to fall back on.

例句.zh: 他经济上依靠他的太太。
例句.pinyin: tā jīng jì shàng yī kào tā de tài tài 。
例句.en: He relies on his wife financially.

例句.pinyin: rì běn de shí yóu yī kào jìn kǒu 。
例句.en: Japan depends on other countries for oil.

释义: medical treatment

例句.zh: 美国的医疗费很高。
例句.pinyin: měi guó de yī liáo fèi hěn gāo 。
例句.en: American medical fees are very high.

例句.zh: 公司的医疗保险覆盖了全部的医疗费用。
例句.pinyin: gōng sī de yī liáo bǎo xiǎn fù gài le quán bù de yī liáo fèi yòng 。
例句.en: The company medical treatment insurance covered all the medical treatment costs.

例句.zh: 四月是全国弱势团体医疗月。
例句.pinyin: sì yuè shì quán guó ruò shì tuán tǐ yī liáo yuè 。
例句.en: April is the national minority health month.

释义: still; as before

例句.zh: 如果外头还有人怀疑，美国是否真的是任何事都可能发生的地方，怀疑我们开国先贤的梦想今天是否依然存在，怀疑我们民主的力量；今夜，就是你们要的答案。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ wài tou hái yǒu rén huái yí ， měi guó shì fǒu zhēn de shì rèn hé shì dōu kě néng fā shēng de dì fāng ， huái yí wǒ men kāi guó xiān xián de mèng xiǎng jīn tiān shì fǒu yī rán cún zài ， huái yí wǒ men mín zhǔ de lì liàng ； jīn yè ， jiù shì nǐ men yào de dá àn 。
例句.en: If there is anyone out there who still doubts that America is a place where all things are possible; who still wonders if the dream of our founders is alive in our time; who still questions the power of our democracy, tonight is your answer.

例句.zh: 你说尽他的坏话，但我依然喜欢他。
例句.pinyin: nǐ shuō jǐn tā de huài huà ， dàn wǒ yī rán xǐ huān tā 。
例句.en: For all you say about him, I still like him.

例句.zh: 她现在依然依靠父母生活。
例句.pinyin: tā xiàn zài yī rán yī kào fù mǔ shēng huó 。
例句.en: She's still dependent on her parents.

释义: medicine / medical science / study of medicine

例句.zh: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。
例句.pinyin: tā zài yī xué jiè yǒu hěn dà de yǐng xiǎng lì 。
例句.en: He's very influential in the world of medicine.

例句.zh: 被选上的将会面临大量的医学和精神测试。
例句.pinyin: bèi xuǎn shàng de jiāng huì miàn lín dà liàng de yī xué hé jīng shén cè shì 。
例句.en: Those selected will have to face extensive medical and psychological tests.

例句.zh: 她提出了一连串的医学发现。
例句.pinyin: tā tí chū le yī lián chuàn de yī xué fā xiàn 。
例句.en: She made a series of medical discoveries.

释义: to move / to shift / to change / to alter / to remove

例句.zh: 随着时间的推移，比赛增加了规则以使之更安全。
例句.pinyin: suí zhe shí jiān de tuī yí ， bǐ sài zēng jiā le guī zé yǐ shǐ zhī gèng ān quán 。

例句.pinyin: tā bǎ tā de shǒu cóng zhuō shàng yí kāi le 。

例句.en: It drew strength from the young people who rejected the myth of their generation's apathy, who left their homes and their families for jobs that offered little pay and less sleep.

例句.pinyin: zhè xiē gǔ lǎo xí sú dōu shì yí dài yí dài xiāng chuán xià lái de 。
例句.en: These old customs have been handed down from generation to generation.

例句.zh: 互联网的广泛应用使新一代的年轻人诞生了。
例句.pinyin: hù lián wǎng de guǎng fàn yìng yòng shǐ xīn yí dài de nián qīng rén dàn shēng le 。

例句.zh: 一旦养成了坏习惯，就很难改回来了。
例句.pinyin: yí dàn yǎng chéng le huài xí guàn ， jiù hěn nán gǎi huí lái le 。

例句.zh: 一旦捡到一颗你喜欢的石头，尽快将它带回家并好好对待它，因为那是妳唯一得到的石头。
例句.pinyin: yí dàn jiǎn dào yī kē nǐ xǐ huān de shí tou ， jǐn kuài jiāng tā dài huí jiā bìng hǎo hǎo duì dài tā ， yīn wèi nà shì nǐ wéi yī de dào de shí tou 。
例句.en: Once you've picked up a stone that you like, take it home as soon as you can and treat it well, because that's the only stone you've got.

例句.zh: 一旦过了河, 你就安全了。
例句.pinyin: yí dàn guò le hé ,  nǐ jiù ān quán le 。
例句.en: Once across the river, you are safe.

释义: to move / movement / migration / mobile / portable

例句.zh: 牛群在郁郁葱葱的草地上缓缓移动著。
例句.pinyin: niú qún zài yù yù cōng cōng de cǎo dì shàng huǎn huǎn yí dòng zhù 。
例句.en: The cows were moving very slowly through the long green grass.

例句.zh: 手指在键盘上快速的移动。
例句.pinyin: shǒu zhǐ zài jiàn pán shàng kuài sù de yí dòng 。
例句.en: The fingers move fast on the keyboard.

例句.zh: 如果你移动笔的距离太小, 速度太慢, 它就无法辨识出你的手势, 那么你便无法用你想要的方式操作它。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ yí dòng bǐ de jù lí tài xiǎo ,  sù dù tài màn ,  tā jiù wú fǎ biàn shí chū nǐ de shǒu shì ,  nà me nǐ biàn wú fǎ yòng nǐ xiǎng yào de fāng shì cāo zuò tā 。
例句.en: If the distance you move the pen is too small, the speed too slow, it can't recognize the gestures well and you can't operate it in the way you thought.

释义: regret / to regret / to be sorry that

例句.zh: 有人死了的时候真是遗憾。
例句.pinyin: yǒu rén sǐ le de shí hòu zhēn shì yí hàn 。
例句.en: It's a pity when somebody dies.

例句.zh: 我很遗憾您没有和我们一起来。

例句.en: I'm sorry for your not having come with us.

例句.zh: 我们对他的死亡表示遗憾。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men duì tā de sǐ wáng biǎo shì yí hàn 。
例句.en: We regret his death.

例句.zh: 一路顺风！

例句.zh: 祝你一路上玩得愉快。
例句.pinyin: zhù nǐ yī lù shàng wán dé yú kuài 。

例句.pinyin: yī lù shùn fēng ！
例句.en: Bon voyage!

例句.zh: 祝您一路顺风。
例句.pinyin: zhù nín yī lù shùn fēng 。
例句.en: I hope you have a good trip.

例句.zh: 祝你一路顺风。
例句.pinyin: zhù nǐ yī lù shùn fēng 。
例句.en: I hope you have a good trip.

释义: question / interrogation / doubt

例句.zh: 宇宙毫无疑问是无限的。
例句.pinyin: yǔ zhòu háo wú yí wèn shì wú xiàn de 。
例句.en: There's no doubt that the universe is infinite.

例句.zh: 在某种程度上你是对的，但我还是有疑问。
例句.pinyin: zài mǒu zhǒng chéng dù shàng nǐ shì duì de ， dàn wǒ hái shì yǒu yí wèn 。

例句.zh: 毫无疑问。
例句.pinyin: háo wú yí wèn 。
例句.en: There's no doubt.

例句.zh: 你的言行必须一致。
例句.pinyin: nǐ de yán xíng bì xū yí zhì 。
例句.en: Your words must correspond with your actions.

例句.zh: 911事件让世人震惊，全球所有的政治家都一致谴责恐怖分子的这一应受人斥责的行径。
例句.pinyin: 911 shì jiàn ràng shì rén zhèn jīng ， quán qiú suǒ yǒu de zhèng zhì jiā dōu yí zhì qiǎn zé kǒng bù fèn zi de zhè yī yīng shòu rén chì zé de xíng jìng 。
例句.en: Shocked by the events of September 11th, politicians all over the world condemned the terrorists for their reprehensible deed.

例句.zh: 当我问人家高中时代他们最后悔的是什么时，他们几乎所有人都回答一致：他们浪费了那么多时间。
例句.pinyin: dāng wǒ wèn rén jiā gāo zhōng shí dài tā men zuì hòu huǐ de shì shén me shí ， tā men jī hū suǒ yǒu rén dōu huí dá yí zhì ： tā men làng fèi le nà me duō shí jiān 。
例句.en: When I ask people what they regret most about high school, they nearly all say the same thing: that they wasted so much time.

释义: second of the ten Heavenly Stems 十天干[shi2 tian1 gan1] / second in order / letter "B" or Roman "II" in list "A, B, C", or "I, II, III" etc / second party (in legal contract, usually 乙方[yi3 fang1], as opposed to 甲方[jia3 fang1]) / ethyl / bent / winding / radical in Chinese characters (Kangxi radical 5) / ancient Chinese compass point: 105° / turning stroke (in Chinese characters), aka 折[zhe2]
短释义: second of the ten Heavenly Stems 十天干[shi2 tian1 gan1]

例句.zh: 甲之蜜糖，乙之砒霜。
例句.pinyin: jiǎ zhī mì táng ， yǐ zhī pī shuāng 。
例句.en: One man's meat is another man's poison.

例句.zh: 雷吉娜安扬戈是奈洛比一家小吃摊的老板，她用乙醇燃料为顾客准备餐点。她的厨房没有木炭产生的烟雾与废气。
例句.pinyin: léi jí nà ān yáng gē shì nài luò bǐ yī jiā xiǎo chī tān de lǎo bǎn ， tā yòng yǐ chún rán liào wèi gù kè zhǔn bèi cān diǎn 。 tā de chú fáng méi yǒu mù tàn chǎn shēng de yān wù yǔ fèi qì 。
例句.en: Regina Anyango, owner of small food kiosk in Nairobi, uses ethanol fuel to prepare meals for customers. Her kitchen is free of fumes and smoke from charcoal use.

例句.zh: 对乙酰氨基酚是一种退烧药。
例句.pinyin: duì yǐ xiān ān jī fēn shì yī zhǒng tuì shāo yào 。
例句.en: Acetaminophen is an antipyretic.

释义: old variant of 以[yi3] / old variant of 以[yi3] / abbr. for Israel 以色列[Yi3 se4 lie4] / to use / by means of / according to / in order to / because of / at (a certain date or place)

例句.zh: 我以前在山里。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yǐ qián zài shān lǐ 。
例句.en: I was in the mountains.

例句.zh: 如果我可以像那样的话...
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ wǒ kě yǐ xiàng nà yàng de huà ...
例句.en: If I could be like that...

例句.zh: 以前读高中的时候﹐我每天早上六点起床。
例句.pinyin: yǐ qián dú gāo zhōng de shí hòu ﹐ wǒ měi tiān zǎo shàng liù diǎn qǐ chuáng 。
例句.en: Back in high school, I got up at 6 a.m. every morning.

释义: and; as well as

例句.zh: 让我们记住，是伊利诺伊州的一名男子首次将共和党的旗帜扛到了白宫。共和党是建立在自立、个人自由以及国家团结的价值观之上的。这也是我们所有人共同的价值观。虽然民主党今天晚上赢得了巨大的胜利，但我们是以谦卑的态度和弥合阻碍我们进步的分歧的决心赢得这场胜利的
例句.pinyin: ràng wǒ men jì zhù ， shì yī lì nuò yī zhōu de yī míng nán zi shǒu cì jiāng gòng hé dǎng de qí zhì káng dào le bái gōng 。 gòng hé dǎng shì jiàn lì zài zì lì 、 gè rén zì yóu yǐ jí guó jiā tuán jié de jià zhí guān zhī shàng de 。 zhè yě shì wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén gòng tóng de jià zhí guān 。 suī rán mín zhǔ dǎng jīn tiān wǎn shàng yíng dé le jù dà de shèng lì ， dàn wǒ men shì yǐ qiān bēi de tài dù hé mí hé zǔ ài wǒ men jìn bù de fēn qí de jué xīn yíng dé zhè chǎng shèng lì de
例句.en: Let's remember that it was a man from this state who first carried the banner of the Republican Party to the White House, a party founded on the values of self-reliance and individual liberty and national unity. Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.

例句.zh: 对于那些彻夜关注美国大选的海外人士，从国会到皇宫，以及在被遗忘的角落里挤在收音机旁的人们，我们的经历虽然各有不同，但是我们的命运是一样的，新的美国领导层已产生了。
例句.pinyin: duì yú nà xiē chè yè guān zhù měi guó dà xuǎn de hǎi wài rén shì ， cóng guó huì dào huáng gōng ， yǐ jí zài bèi yí wàng de jiǎo luò lǐ jǐ zài shōu yīn jī páng de rén men ， wǒ men de jīng lì suī rán gè yǒu bù tóng ， dàn shì wǒ men de mìng yùn shì yī yàng de ， xīn de měi guó lǐng dǎo céng yǐ chǎn shēng le 。
例句.en: And all those watching tonight from beyond our shores, from parliaments and palaces, to those who are huddled around radios in the forgotten corners of the world, our stories are singular, but our destiny is shared, and a new dawn of American leadership is at hand.

例句.zh: 当30年代的沙尘暴和大萧条使人们感到绝望时，她看到一个国家用新政、新的就业机会以及对新目标的共同追求战胜恐慌。是的，我们能做到。
例句.pinyin: dāng 30 nián dài de shā chén bào hé dà xiāo tiáo shǐ rén men gǎn dào jué wàng shí ， tā kàn dào yí gè guó jiā yòng xīn zhèng 、 xīn de jiù yè jī huì yǐ jí duì xīn mù biāo de gòng tóng zhuī qiú zhàn shèng kǒng huāng 。 shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào 。
例句.en: When there was despair in the dust bowl and depression across the land, she saw a nation conquer fear itself with a New Deal, new jobs, a new sense of common purpose. Yes, we can.

释义: since (used after a specified time or event)
短释义: since (used after a specified time or event)

例句.zh: 就是这个答案，让那些长久以来被灌输要嘲讽、害怕和怀疑自身能力的人们 把他们的手放在历史的弧线上，将它弯向一个更美好的一天的希望。
例句.pinyin: jiù shì zhè ge dá àn ， ràng nà xiē cháng jiǔ yǐ lái bèi guàn shū yào cháo fěng 、 hài pà hé huái yí zì shēn néng lì de rén men   bǎ tā men de shǒu fàng zài lì shǐ de hú xiàn shàng ， jiāng tā wān xiàng yí gè gèng měi hǎo de yī tiān de xī wàng 。
例句.en: It's the answer that led those who've been told for so long, by so many, to be cynical and fearful and doubtful about what we can achieve, to put their hands on the arc of history and bend it once more toward the hope of a better day.

例句.zh: 我知道你们的所做的一切并不只是为了赢得选举，我也知道你们做这一切并不是为了我。你们这样做是因为你们明白前面的任务有多么艰巨。即便我们今晚欢呼庆祝，我们也知道明天将面临我们一生之中最艰难的挑战——两场战争、一个面临危险的星球，一个世纪以来最严重的金融危机。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ men de suǒ zuò de yī qiè bìng bù zhǐ shì wèi le yíng dé xuǎn jǔ ， wǒ yě zhī dào nǐ men zuò zhè yī qiè bìng bú shì wèi le wǒ 。 nǐ men zhè yàng zuò shì yīn wèi nǐ men míng bái qián miàn de rèn wù yǒu duō me jiān jù 。 jí biàn wǒ men jīn wǎn huān hū qìng zhù ， wǒ men yě zhī dào míng tiān jiāng miàn lín wǒ men yī shēng zhī zhōng zuì jiān nán de tiǎo zhàn —— liǎng chǎng zhàn zhēng 、 yí gè miàn lín wēi xiǎn de xīng qiú ， yí gè shì jì yǐ lái zuì yán zhòng de jīn róng wēi jī 。
例句.en: And I know you didn't do this just to win an election. And I know you didn't do it for me. You did it because you understand the enormity of the task that lies ahead. For even as we celebrate tonight, we know the challenges that tomorrow will bring are the greatest of our lifetime: two wars, a planet in peril, the worst financial crisis in a century.

例句.zh: 你随时可以来。
例句.pinyin: nǐ suí shí kě yǐ lái 。
例句.en: You can come at any time.

释义: 100 million

例句.zh: 计划的总开支为一亿円。
例句.pinyin: jì huà de zǒng kāi zhī wèi yī yì yuán 。
例句.en: The total expense for the project amounts to one hundred million yen.

例句.zh: 一项估计显示，今年的钢鉄产量将会达到一亿吨。
例句.pinyin: yī xiàng gū jì xiǎn shì ， jīn nián de gāng zhí chǎn liàng jiāng huì dá dào yī yì dūn 。
例句.en: According to an estimate, steel production will reach 100 million tons this year.

例句.zh: 中国的人口已经超过了十三亿。
例句.pinyin: zhōng guó de rén kǒu yǐ jīng chāo guò le shí sān yì 。
例句.en: The population of China has already exceeded 1.3 billion.

释义: consciousness; awareness / (usu. followed by 到[dao4]) to be aware of; to realize

例句.zh: 我们看东西不是看其实质，而是以我们的主观意识看它们的。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men kàn dōng xī bú shì kàn qí shí zhì ， ér shì yǐ wǒ men de zhǔ guān yì shí kàn tā men de 。
例句.en: We don't see things as they are, but as we are.

例句.zh: 直到那时，他才意识到他已经上当受骗。
例句.pinyin: zhí dào nà shí ， tā cái yì shí dào tā yǐ jīng shàng dàng shòu piàn 。
例句.en: Only then did he realize he had been deceived.

例句.zh: 他们粗心大意，还没意识到危险。
例句.pinyin: tā men cū xīn dà yì ， hái méi yì shí dào wēi xiǎn 。
例句.en: They were carelessly unaware of the danger.

释义: unexpected / accident / mishap / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 这真是很意外。
例句.pinyin: zhè zhēn shì hěn yì wài 。
例句.en: That is rather unexpected.

例句.zh: 这意外是何时发生的？
例句.pinyin: zhè yì wài shì hé shí fā shēng de ？
例句.en: When did the accident take place?

例句.zh: 发生意外是因为司机的驾驶技术差。
例句.pinyin: fā shēng yì wài shì yīn wèi sī jī de jià shǐ jì shù chà 。
例句.en: The accident was due to bad driving.

释义: to signify / to mean / to imply

例句.zh: 这意味着其他人只能从听你说的话来了解你和喜欢你。
例句.pinyin: zhè yì wèi zhe qí tā rén zhǐ néng cóng tīng nǐ shuō de huà lái liǎo jiě nǐ hé xǐ huān nǐ 。
例句.en: This means that others can only come to know you and like you by listening to what you say.

例句.zh: 这是不是意味着你不会来了？
例句.pinyin: zhè shì bú shì yì wèi zhe nǐ bú huì lái le ？
例句.en: Does that mean you won't come?

例句.zh: 这很可能意味着战争。
例句.pinyin: zhè hěn kě néng yì wèi zhe zhàn zhēng 。
例句.en: This probably means war.

释义: duty; obligation (CL:項|项[xiang4]) / volunteer (work etc)

例句.zh: 你有义务还债。
例句.pinyin: nǐ yǒu yì wù huán zhài 。
例句.en: You are liable for the debt.

例句.zh: 每一位选手都有义务遵守规则。
例句.pinyin: měi yī wèi xuǎn shǒu dōu yǒu yì wù zūn shǒu guī zé 。
例句.en: Every player is under obligation to keep the rules.

例句.zh: 英国期望每个人都会尽义务。
例句.pinyin: yīng guó qī wàng měi gè rén dū huì jìn yì wù 。
例句.en: England expects that every man will do his duty.

释义: sense / meaning / significance / importance / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 如果你没有其它可说的，那对我说“嗨，你怎么样？”就毫无意义。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ méi yǒu qí tā kě shuō de ， nà duì wǒ shuō “ hāi ， nǐ zěn me yàng ？” jiù háo wú yì yì 。
例句.en: There's no point saying "Hi, how are you?" to me if you have nothing else to say.

例句.zh: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。
例句.pinyin: méi yǒu ài qíng de shēng huó háo wú yì yì 。
例句.en: Life without love is just totally pointless.

例句.zh: 他说的话根本毫无意义。
例句.pinyin: tā shuō de huà gēn běn háo wú yì yì 。
例句.en: What he says makes no sense at all.

释义: therefore / as a result / thus / and as a result, ...

例句.zh: 在中文里面，饺子和“交子”谐音，因而具有丰富的文化涵义。
例句.pinyin: zài zhōng wén lǐ miàn ， jiǎo zi hé “ jiāo zi ” xié yīn ， yīn ér jù yǒu fēng fù de wén huà hán yì 。
例句.en: In Chinese, 'dumpling' and 'first exchange' are homophones, so they have a rich cultural association.

例句.zh: 中国幅员辽阔,因而茶的品种繁多。
例句.pinyin: zhōng guó fú yuán liáo kuò , yīn ér chá de pǐn zhǒng fán duō 。
例句.en: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.

释义: loudness / volume

例句.zh: 麻烦你把音量调低一点。
例句.pinyin: má fán nǐ bǎ yīn liàng diào dī yì diǎn 。
例句.en: Turn down the volume, please.

例句.zh: 可以把收音机的音量调低一点吗？
例句.pinyin: kě yǐ bǎ shōu yīn jī de yīn liàng diào dī yì diǎn ma ？
例句.en: Could you turn down the radio?

例句.zh: 收音机太响了。你不能把音量调低一点吗？
例句.pinyin: shōu yīn jī tài xiǎng le 。 nǐ bù néng bǎ yīn liàng diào dī yì diǎn ma ？
例句.en: The radio is too loud. Can't you turn it down a little?

释义: element / factor / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 由于诸多不幸因素，单亲家庭在增长中。
例句.pinyin: yóu yú zhū duō bù xìng yīn sù ， dān qìng jia tíng zài zēng zhǎng zhōng 。
例句.en: Due to a number of unfortunate causes, one-parent families are on the increase.

例句.zh: 诚实是他成功最重要的因素。
例句.pinyin: chéng shí shì tā chéng gōng zuì zhòng yào de yīn sù 。
例句.en: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.

例句.zh: 物价上涨是多方因素造成的。
例句.pinyin: wù jià shàng zhǎng shì duō fāng yīn sù zào chéng de 。
例句.en: Several factors operated to help prices go up.

释义: to recommend / to introduce (from outside)

例句.zh: 其中，道教是本国的，其他是从国外引进的。
例句.pinyin: qí zhōng ， dào jiào shì běn guó de ， qí tā shì cóng guó wài yǐn jìn de 。
例句.en: Of these, Taoism is a native religion, the others having been introduced from foreign lands.

释义: eating and drinking / food and drink; diet

例句.zh: 50年代，芬兰人被认为是世界上饮食最不健康的例子。
例句.pinyin: 50 nián dài ， fēn lán rén bèi rèn wéi shì shì jiè shàng yǐn shí zuì bù jiàn kāng de lì zi 。
例句.en: In the 1950's, the Finns were cited as having one of the least healthy diets in the world.

例句.zh: 我要改变我的饮食吗？
例句.pinyin: wǒ yào gǎi biàn wǒ de yǐn shí ma ？
例句.en: Do I have to change my diet?

例句.zh: 蔬果对平衡饮食必不可少。
例句.pinyin: shū guǒ duì píng héng yǐn shí bì bù kě shǎo 。
例句.en: Fruits and vegetables are essential to a balanced diet.

释义: to print / printing

例句.zh: 他为一份印刷量很大的报纸工作。
例句.pinyin: tā wèi yī fèn yìn shuā liàng hěn dà de bào zhǐ gōng zuò 。
例句.en: He works for a newspaper with a large circulation.

例句.zh: 虽然有一些印刷错误, 但大致上说来, 这是一本好书。
例句.pinyin: suī rán yǒu yī xiē yìn shuā cuò wù ,  dàn dà zhì shàng shuō lái ,  zhè shì yī běn hǎo shū 。
例句.en: There are some misprints, but all in all, it's a good book.

例句.zh: 这本书在英国印刷。
例句.pinyin: zhè běn shū zài yīng guó yìn shuā 。
例句.en: This book was printed in England.

释义: should; ought to

例句.zh: 21个月前在寒冬所开始的一切不应当在今天这个秋夜结束。今天的选举胜利并不是我们所寻求的改变--这只是我们进行改变的机会。如果我们仍然按照过去的方式行事，我们所寻求的改变将不会发生。没有你们，没有服务和牺牲的新精神，就不可能发生改变。因此，让我们发扬新的爱国和负责精神，所有的人都下定决心参与其中，更加努力地工作，不仅是为自己而是为彼此。
例句.pinyin: 21 gè yuè qián zài hán dōng suǒ kāi shǐ de yī qiè bù yīng dāng zài jīn tiān zhè ge qiū yè jié shù 。 jīn tiān de xuǎn jǔ shèng lì bìng bú shì wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn -- zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men jìn xíng gǎi biàn de jī huì 。 rú guǒ wǒ men réng rán àn zhào guò qù de fāng shì xíng shì ， wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn jiāng bú huì fā shēng 。 méi yǒu nǐ men ， méi yǒu fú wù hé xī shēng de xīn jīng shén ， jiù bù kě néng fā shēng gǎi biàn 。 yīn cǐ ， ràng wǒ men fā yáng xīn de ài guó hé fù zé jīng shén ， suǒ yǒu de rén dōu xià dìng jué xīn cān yù qí zhōng ， gèng jiā nǔ lì dì gōng zuò ， bù jǐn shì wèi zì jǐ ér shì wèi bǐ cǐ 。
例句.en: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.

例句.zh: 你应当多运动运动。
例句.pinyin: nǐ yīng dāng duō yùn dòng yùn dòng 。
例句.en: You should exercise more.

例句.zh: 我们应当把文化传承到下一代。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men yīng dāng bǎ wén huà chuán chéng dào xià yí dài 。
例句.en: We should pass on our culture to the next generation.

释义: to welcome; to meet / to forge ahead (esp. in the face of difficulties); to meet face to face

例句.zh: 欢迎回家。
例句.pinyin: huān yíng huí jiā 。
例句.en: Welcome home.

例句.zh: 在不久的将来这些问题都会迎刃而解。
例句.pinyin: zài bù jiǔ de jiāng lái zhè xiē wèn tí dū huì yíng rèn ér jiě 。
例句.en: These problems will be solved in the near future.

例句.zh: 欢迎再来。
例句.pinyin: huān yíng zài lái 。
例句.en: Do come again.

释义: to welcome; to greet

例句.zh: 我要去机场迎接我的家人。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yào qù jī chǎng yíng jiē wǒ de jiā rén 。
例句.en: I have to go to the airport to meet my family.

例句.zh: 她用一个微笑迎接了我。
例句.pinyin: tā yòng yí gè wēi xiào yíng jiē le wǒ 。
例句.en: She greeted me with a smile.

释义: to answer; to reply / to handle; to deal with / response

例句.zh: 我们需要开发新的能源、创造新的工作岗位，我们需要修建新学校，应对众多威胁、修复与许多国家的盟友关系。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men xū yào kāi fā xīn de néng yuán 、 chuàng zào xīn de gōng zuò gǎng wèi ， wǒ men xū yào xiū jiàn xīn xué xiào ， yìng duì zhòng duō wēi xié 、 xiū fù yǔ xǔ duō guó jiā de méng yǒu guān xì 。
例句.en: There's new energy to harness, new jobs to be created, new schools to build, and threats to meet, alliances to repair.

例句.zh: 知道吗？内科急救专家对于子宫下垂常用的应对方法是带上手套，把拳头深入阴道，然后用力将子宫向上推。但这个姿势在赶到医院前是改变不了了!
例句.pinyin: zhī dào ma ？ nèi kē jí jiù zhuān jiā duì yú zi gōng xià chuí cháng yòng de yìng duì fāng fǎ shì dài shàng shǒu tào ， bǎ quán tou shēn rù yīn dào ， rán hòu yòng lì jiāng zi gōng xiàng shàng tuī 。 dàn zhè ge zī shì zài gǎn dào yī yuàn qián shì gǎi biàn bù liǎo le !

例句.zh: 你不能应对压力。

例句.zh: 用户应该拥有硬件和软件的使用自由，操作系统应该是开放的，而不是封闭的。
例句.pinyin: yòng hù yīng gāi yōng yǒu yìng jiàn hé ruǎn jiàn de shǐ yòng zì yóu ， cāo zuò xì tǒng yīng gāi shì kāi fàng de ， ér bú shì fēng bì de 。

例句.zh: 这艘货运飞船将为太空站工作人员运送超过四吨的补给品、水、备件和实验硬件，其中包括完成太空站电力系统全面升级所需的六块新的锂离子电池。
例句.pinyin: zhè sōu huò yùn fēi chuán jiāng wèi tài kōng zhàn gōng zuò rén yuán yùn sòng chāo guò sì dūn de bǔ jǐ pǐn 、 shuǐ 、 bèi jiàn hé shí yàn yìng jiàn ， qí zhōng bāo kuò wán chéng tài kōng zhàn diàn lì xì tǒng quán miàn shēng jí suǒ xū de liù kuài xīn de lǐ lí zi diàn chí 。

例句.zh: 但是，相对于城镇网民，农村网民对网络新闻、搜索引擎、网络购物、网上银行和网上炒股等应用程度要低很多。

例句.en: "Honey, quick, quick. There's this website called Tatoeba that's auctioning its sentence collection for a cent each! They've even got special offers like buy 100 sentences and get 1 free!" "Ah great! now people collect sentences as a hobby?! What's the world coming to!"

例句.pinyin: zhè zhǒng kē jì de yōu shì shì shén me ？

例句.zh: 教导学生，不到他想了解而不得其解的时候，不去开导他；不到他想表达意见却说不出来的时候，不去启发他。教给他一个方面的东西，他却不能由此而推知其它三个方面的东西，那就不再教他了。
例句.pinyin: jiào dǎo xué shēng ， bú dào tā xiǎng liǎo jiě ér bù dé qí jiě de shí hòu ， bù qù kāi dǎo tā ； bú dào tā xiǎng biǎo dá yì jiàn què shuō bù chū lái de shí hòu ， bù qù qǐ fā tā 。 jiāo gěi tā yí gè fāng miàn de dōng xī ， tā què bù néng yóu cǐ ér tuī zhī qí tā sān gè fāng miàn de dōng xī ， nà jiù bù zài jiào tā le 。
例句.en: When teaching a student, do not enlighten him until he wishes to understand what he could not. Do not inspire him until he wishes to express but could not. When teaching him one side of a solution, if he could not discover the other three sides, then do not teach him again.

例句.zh: 她读了信，由此得知他的死讯。

例句.zh: 通过创造一个更像家乡并有许多绿色植物和社区建筑物的城市地区，住在城市里快要代表想到在爱丁堡水边地生活，工作也娱乐的两万个人会有更简单、没有压力生活方式。

例句.en: With the creation of a city area that's more like a town, with plenty of greenery and community buildings, living in the city will soon mean simpler, stress-free lifestyles for the 20,000 that are expected to live, work and play in Edinburgh's Waterfront.

例句.zh: 青年农民和外出务工农民是农村网民的主力军，在对诸如网络音乐、网络游戏、网络影视等互联网娱乐功能的使用上，农村网民和城镇网民相当。
例句.pinyin: qīng nián nóng mín hé wài chū wù gōng nóng mín shì nóng cūn wǎng mín de zhǔ lì jūn ， zài duì zhū rú wǎng luò yīn yuè 、 wǎng luò yóu xì 、 wǎng luò yǐng shì děng hù lián wǎng yú lè gōng néng de shǐ yòng shàng ， nóng cūn wǎng mín hé chéng zhèn wǎng mín xiāng dāng 。
例句.en: Young people and migrant workers are the bulk of rural Internet users; in terms of online music, online games, online film and television, and the Internet's capacity for entertainment, rural Internet users are equivalent to urban ones.

例句.zh: 人类食衣住行娱乐用的每一件东西都是全世界的人一起帮我们做出来的，而且参与的每个人都只知道怎么创造一小部分，没有例外。因此当我们决定帮自己一把来帮助全世界，只要全力关注创造，全世界的人都会帮我们。
例句.pinyin: rén lèi shí yī zhù xíng yú lè yòng de měi yī jiàn dōng xī dōu shì quán shì jiè de rén yì qǐ bāng wǒ men zuò chū lái de ， ér qiě cān yù de měi gè rén dōu zhǐ zhī dào zěn me chuàng zào yī xiǎo bù fèn ， méi yǒu lì wài 。 yīn cǐ dāng wǒ men jué dìng bāng zì jǐ yī bǎ lái bāng zhù quán shì jiè ， zhǐ yào quán lì guān zhù chuàng zào ， quán shì jiè de rén dū huì bāng wǒ men 。
例句.en: Humanity's food, cloth, place of living, transport, entertainment are all created together by people around the globe. Also, people who partake in these activities only know a fraction of how the parts are created, without exception. Therefore, when we decide to help ourselves to help the entire world, as long as we focus with our entire being to create, the entire world will help us.

例句.zh: 在韩语中，形容词通常充当描述性动词，这意味著它们可以像动词一样变位以表达不同的时态和语气。

例句.pinyin: suí zhe běi cháo xiān zài 26 hào xuān bù le àn zhào liù fāng tán huà shàng dá chéng de gòng shí suǒ zhì dìng de hé jì huà fā zhǎn ， měi guó jiāng qí cóng měi guó de kǒng bù zhǔ yì juān zhù guó de míng dān shàng qù chú 。 bèi bǎng jià zhě de jiā shǔ biǎo dá le bù ān ， yīn wèi zhè yǒu kě néng zào chéng duì bǎng jià wèn tí de fàng qì 。
例句.en: With North Korea's announcement on the 26th of its nuclear development plan based upon the agreement stemming from the Six Party Talks, and the United States' commencement of procedures to remove North Korea from its designation on the list of State Sponsors of Terrorism, the families of abductees have expressed growing unease that it may constitute an abandonment of the abductee issue.

例句.zh: 她出生的那个时代奴隶制度刚刚结束；那时路上没有汽车，天上也没有飞机。当时像她这样的人由于两个原因不能投票，首先她是女性，其次她是黑人。
例句.pinyin: tā chū shēng de nà ge shí dài nú lì zhì dù gāng gāng jié shù ； nà shí lù shàng méi yǒu qì chē ， tiān shàng yě méi yǒu fēi jī 。 dāng shí xiàng tā zhè yàng de rén yóu yú liǎng gè yuán yīn bù néng tóu piào ， shǒu xiān tā shì nǚ xìng ， qí cì tā shì hēi rén 。
例句.en: She was born just a generation past slavery. A time when there were no cars on the road or planes in the sky, when someone like her couldn't vote for two reasons: because she was a woman, and because of the color of her skin.

例句.en: It drew strength from the not-so-young people who braved the bitter cold and scorching heat to knock on doors of perfect strangers, and from the millions of Americans who volunteered and organized and proved that more than two centuries later a government of the people, by the people, and for the people has not perished from the Earth.

例句.zh: 2021 年 11 月 4 日，阴沉沉的一天。在披萨店，我没办法像平常一样坐在窗外的桌子吃披萨，因为那里挤满了皮肤黝黑的青少年。于是，我坐在了室内靠窗的位置。我可以看到外面桌子上一个棕色皮肤青少年毛茸茸的手臂。之后，我去了咖啡馆，点了杯我常喝的冰绿茶。在那里，我遇到了一个名叫阿尔玛的菲律宾老朋友，她以前在街角的便利商店工作，现在从事医疗保健行业。

例句.en: A grey day it is on the 4th of November of 2021. At the pizzeria, I could not sit eating my pizza at my regular table just outside the window, as a crowd of fresh brown teenagers were eating pizza there. So, I sat inside by the window. I could see the hairy arms of one brown teenager at the table outside. I went then to the cafe to have my usual iced green tea. I saw a longtime Filipino friend named Alma, who worked before at a corner convenience store, but now is in health care.

例句.zh: 老师肯定厌倦了一遍又一遍地纠正学生试卷中同样的错误。
例句.pinyin: lǎo shī kěn dìng yàn juàn le yī biàn yòu yī biàn dì jiū zhèng xué shēng shì juàn zhōng tóng yàng de cuò wù 。
例句.en: Teachers must get tired of rectifying the same mistakes over and over again in their students' papers.

例句.zh: 于是彼拉多把耶稣带去鞭打。兵丁用荆棘编作冠冕，戴在他头上，又给他穿上紫袍。他们上前一遍遍地打他，说道：「万岁，犹太人的王！」又打他的脸。
例句.pinyin: yú shì bǐ lā duō bǎ yē sū dài qù biān dǎ 。 bīng dīng yòng jīng jí biān zuò guān miǎn ， dài zài tā tóu shàng ， yòu gěi tā chuān shàng zǐ páo 。 tā men shàng qián yī biàn biàn dì dǎ tā ， shuō dào ：「 wàn suì ， yóu tài rén de wáng ！」 yòu dǎ tā de liǎn 。
例句.en: Then Pilate took Jesus and had Him flogged. The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns, put it on His head, and dressed Him in a purple robe. And they went up to Him again and again, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and slapping Him in the face.

例句.zh: 我在黑暗的巷子中绊倒，膝盖砸在柏油路上。一块木板盖著巷弄的房屋之间的电线。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼镜从眼睛上掉了下来。幸好有一位带著手电筒的广东工人帮忙。我的膝盖只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝盖摔伤是在菲律宾奎松市的唐荷西高地。那里有一大片火星般的红土地，遍地长满了「塔拉希布」草。有时工人会故意纵火烧草。我和哥哥当时还在外面玩。那时我们还未到青春期。在燃烧的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝盖著地。我的贝贝姥姥愤怒不已。家里的女佣在车库后面的大磁砖水槽里帮我清洗了双腿。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài hēi àn de xiàng zi zhōng bàn dǎo ， xī gài zá zài bǎi yóu lù shàng 。 yī kuài mù bǎn gài zhù xiàng nòng de fáng wū zhī jiān de diàn xiàn 。 shēn yè de xiàng nòng fēi cháng zhī àn 。 wǒ de yǎn jìng cóng yǎn jīng shàng diào le xià lái 。 xìng hǎo yǒu yī wèi dài zhù shǒu diàn tǒng de guǎng dōng gōng rén bāng máng 。 wǒ de xī gài zhǐ shì cā pò le pí 。 wǒ xiǎng qǐ lìng yī cì xī gài shuāi shāng shì zài fēi lǜ bīn kuí sōng shì de táng hé xī gāo dì 。 nà lǐ yǒu yī dà piàn huǒ xīng bān de hóng tǔ dì ， biàn dì zhǎng mǎn le 「 tǎ lā xī bù 」 cǎo 。 yǒu shí gōng rén huì gù yì zòng huǒ shāo cǎo 。 wǒ hé gē gē dāng shí hái zài wài miàn wán 。 nà shí wǒ men hái wèi dào qīng chūn qī 。 zài rán shāo de yě cǎo páng ， wǒ shuāi dǎo le ， xī gài zhù dì 。 wǒ de bèi bèi lǎo lao fèn nù bù yǐ 。 jiā lǐ de nǚ yōng zài chē kù hòu miàn de dà cí zhuān shuǐ cáo lǐ bāng wǒ qīng xǐ le shuāng tuǐ 。
例句.en: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.
