例句.zh: 罗杰斯先生和史密斯小姐昨天宣布订婚。
例句.pinyin: luó jié sī xiān shēng hé shǐ mì sī xiǎo jiě zuó tiān xuān bù dìng hūn 。
例句.en: The engagement of Mr Rogers and Miss Smith was announced yesterday.

释义: unpeaceful / unstable / uneasy / disturbed / restless / worried

例句.zh: 狗不安地看着他的主人。
例句.pinyin: gǒu bù ān dì kàn zhe tā de zhǔ rén 。
例句.en: The dog nervously looks at the master.

例句.zh: 保险使我们意识到我们生活在一个不安全的世界中，可能会生病、面临危险、出现意外等等，我们必须要面对。
例句.pinyin: bǎo xiǎn shǐ wǒ men yì shí dào wǒ men shēng huó zài yí gè bù ān quán de shì jiè zhōng ， kě néng huì shēng bìng 、 miàn lín wēi xiǎn 、 chū xiàn yì wài děng děng ， wǒ men bì xū yào miàn duì 。
例句.en: Insurance makes us remember that the world we live in isn't completely safe; we might fall ill, face danger or encounter the unexpected.

例句.zh: Sakura说话的方式令我不安。
例句.pinyin: Sakura shuō huà de fāng shì lìng wǒ bù ān 。
例句.en: The way Sakura talks makes me uncomfortable.

释义: hasn't yet; hasn't ever

例句.zh: 自从她在厨房里摔倒后，她不曾再到那里。
例句.pinyin: zì cóng tā zài chú fáng lǐ shuāi dǎo hòu ， tā bù céng zài dào nà lǐ 。
例句.en: Ever since she fell in the kitchen, she hasn't been all there.

释义: won't do / unable to / (at the end of a rhetorical question) can that be?

例句.zh: 听到这个悲伤的消息，她泣不成声。
例句.pinyin: tīng dào zhè ge bēi shāng de xiāo xī ， tā qì bù chéng shēng 。
例句.en: Hearing the sad news, she collapsed in tears.

例句.zh: 我们会遭遇挫折和不成功的起步。我作为总统所做的每项决定或政策，会有许多人持有异议，我们也知道，政府不能解决所有问题。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men huì zāo yù cuò zhé hé bù chéng gōng de qǐ bù 。 wǒ zuò wéi zǒng tǒng suǒ zuò de měi xiàng jué dìng huò zhèng cè ， huì yǒu xǔ duō rén chí yǒu yì yì ， wǒ men yě zhī dào ， zhèng fǔ bù néng jiě jué suǒ yǒu wèn tí 。
例句.en: There will be setbacks and false starts. There are many who won't agree with every decision or policy I make as president. And we know the government can't solve every problem.

例句.zh: 在这个国家，我们患难与共。让我们抵制重走老路的诱惑，避免重新回到令美国政治长期深受毒害的党派纷争、小题大作、不成熟的表现。
例句.pinyin: zài zhè ge guó jiā ， wǒ men huàn nàn yǔ gòng 。 ràng wǒ men dǐ zhì zhòng zǒu lǎo lù de yòu huò ， bì miǎn chóng xīn huí dào lìng měi guó zhèng zhì cháng qī shēn shòu dú hài de dǎng pài fēn zhēng 、 xiǎo tí dà zuò 、 bù chéng shú de biǎo xiàn 。
例句.en: In this country, we rise or fall as one nation, as one people. Let's resist the temptation to fall back on the same partisanship and pettiness and immaturity that has poisoned our politics for so long.

释义: must not / may not / not to be allowed / cannot

例句.zh: 你不得不制造一些借口。
例句.pinyin: nǐ bù dé bù zhì zào yī xiē jiè kǒu 。
例句.en: You'll have to manufacture some kind of excuse.

例句.zh: 我的电视机出故障了，所以我不得不拿去修。
例句.pinyin: wǒ de diàn shì jī chū gù zhàng le ， suǒ yǐ wǒ bù dé bù ná qù xiū 。
例句.en: My television was broken down, so I had to get it repaired.

例句.zh: 我不得不向她道歉。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù dé bù xiàng tā dào qiàn 。
例句.en: I must make an apology to her.

释义: army / armed forces / troops / force / unit / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 地面高低不平，给部队前进带来了困难。
例句.pinyin: dì miàn gāo dī bù píng ， gěi bù duì qián jìn dài lái le kùn nán 。
例句.en: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.

例句.zh: 特种部队包围了建筑物。
例句.pinyin: tè zhǒng bù duì bāo wéi le jiàn zhù wù 。
例句.en: Special forces surrounded the building.

释义: can't help (doing sth) / can't refrain from

例句.zh: 她目睹爱犬在意外中离世，不禁泪如泉涌。
例句.pinyin: tā mù dǔ ài quǎn zài yì wài zhōng lí shì ， bù jīn lèi rú quán yǒng 。
例句.en: She shed plentiful tears when her beloved dog was killed in an accident.

例句.zh: 这首歌太感人了，使我不禁流下了眼泪。
例句.pinyin: zhè shǒu gē tài gǎn rén le ， shǐ wǒ bù jīn liú xià le yǎn lèi 。
例句.en: This song is so moving that it brings tears to my eyes.

例句.zh: 她得知父亲突然离世，不禁心如刀割。
例句.pinyin: tā dé zhī fù qīn tū rán lí shì ， bù jīn xīn rú dāo gē 。
例句.en: She was filled with deep grief to hear of her father's sudden death.

释义: from time to time / now and then / occasionally / frequently

例句.zh: 他时不时地因为工作去东京。
例句.pinyin: tā shí bù shí dì yīn wèi gōng zuò qù dōng jīng 。
例句.en: He sometimes goes to Tokyo on business.

例句.zh: 他仍然时不时来看我。
例句.pinyin: tā réng rán shí bù shí lái kàn wǒ 。
例句.en: He still comes to see me now and then.

例句.zh: 我们时不时地去钓鱼。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men shí bù shí dì qù diào yú 。
例句.en: We go fishing from time to time.

释义: part (esp. of the body, but also of a vegetable, e.g. the root, or a garment, e.g. the sleeve, etc)
短释义: part (esp. of the body, but also of a vegetable, e.g. the root, or a garment, e.g. the sleeve, etc)

例句.zh: 我们的新总部位于东京。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men de xīn zǒng bù wèi yú dōng jīng 。
例句.en: Our new head office is in Tokyo.

释义: not to allow / must not / can't

例句.zh: 你不许犯法。
例句.pinyin: nǐ bù xǔ fàn fǎ 。
例句.en: You are not to break the law.

例句.zh: 这条规定不许例外。
例句.pinyin: zhè tiáo guī dìng bù xǔ lì wài 。
例句.en: This rule allows no exception.

例句.zh: 不许逐字逐句地翻译这个句子。
例句.pinyin: bù xǔ zhú zì zhú jù dì fān yì zhè ge jù zi 。
例句.en: You cannot translate the sentence word-for-word.

释义: not suitable / inadvisable / inappropriate

例句.zh: 这里不宜停车。
例句.pinyin: Zhè lǐ bù yí tíngchē.
例句.en: This is not a suitable place to park.

例句.zh: 病人不宜吃辛辣食物。
例句.pinyin: Bìngrén bù yí chī xīnlà shíwù.
例句.en: Patients should not eat spicy food.

例句.zh: 这种天气不宜出门。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng tiānqì bù yí chūmén.
例句.en: It is not advisable to go out in this weather.

释义: (used after a verb) endlessly; incessantly

例句.zh: 汤姆兴奋不已。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ xīng fèn bù yǐ 。
例句.en: Tom's thrilled.

例句.zh: 麦格激动不已。
例句.pinyin: mài gé jī dòng bù yǐ 。
例句.en: Meg is filled with excitement.

例句.zh: 我激动不已。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jī dòng bù yǐ 。
例句.en: I'm thrilled.

释义: to arrange; to set up; to lay out / to assign (tasks, homework etc)
短释义: to arrange; to set up; to lay out

例句.zh: 老师给我们布置了家庭作业。
例句.pinyin: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men bù zhì le jiā tíng zuò yè 。
例句.en: The teacher gave us homework.

例句.zh: 说因为学生不够努力，老师应该布置更多回家作业的傻瓜是谁？
例句.pinyin: shuō yīn wèi xué shēng bù gòu nǔ lì ， lǎo shī yīng gāi bù zhì gèng duō huí jiā zuò yè de shǎ guā shì shuí ？
例句.en: Who are the idiots who said that teachers should push for larger amounts of homework, seeing as the students don't work enough?

例句.zh: 那对夫妇花了很多钱来布置他们的房子。
例句.pinyin: nà duì fū fù huā le hěn duō qián lái bù zhì tā men de fáng zi 。
例句.en: The couple spent a lot of money on furnishing their house.

释义: incessantly / without end / more than / not limited to

例句.zh: 现在不止要男女薪金平等，而且还要平均分配家务。
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài bù zhǐ yào nán nǚ xīn jīn píng děng ， ér qiě hái yào píng jūn fēn pèi jiā wù 。
例句.en: It is time not only to equalize men's and women's wages, but also to equalize responsibility for housework.

例句.zh: 如果有朋友对你作出善意批评，你不止应该欣然接受，还要好好的感谢他。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ yǒu péng yǒu duì nǐ zuò chū shàn yì pī píng ， nǐ bù zhǐ yīng gāi xīn rán jiē shòu ， hái yào hǎo hǎo de gǎn xiè tā 。
例句.en: If your friend reminds you kindly of your faults, take what he says not only pleasantly, but thankfully.

例句.zh: 马不但象征著刚健、高昂、昌盛、发达，还代表著奋斗不止、自强不息的民族精神。
例句.pinyin: mǎ bù dàn xiàng zhēng zhù gāng jiàn 、 gāo áng 、 chāng shèng 、 fā dá ， hái dài biǎo zhù fèn dòu bù zhǐ 、 zì qiáng bù xī de mín zú jīng shén 。
例句.en: The horse does not just represent energy, high spirits, prosperity, development, but also stands for a national spirit of struggling on without stopping, and of striving on without giving up.

释义: procedure / step

例句.zh: 安装软件需要三个步骤。
例句.pinyin: Ānzhuāng ruǎnjiàn xūyào sān ge bùzhòu.
例句.en: Installing the software requires three steps.

例句.zh: 请按照说明书上的步骤操作。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng ànzhào shuōmíngshū shàng de bùzhòu cāozuò.
例句.en: Please follow the steps in the instruction manual.

例句.zh: 这个步骤很容易被忽略。
例句.pinyin: Zhège bùzhòu hěn róngyì bèi hūlüè.
例句.en: This step is easily overlooked.

释义: to guess / to conjecture / to surmise

例句.zh: 这是建立在猜测的基础上。
例句.pinyin: zhè shì jiàn lì zài cāi cè de jī chǔ shàng 。
例句.en: It is founded on supposition.

释义: property / assets / estate / CL:筆|笔[bi3]

例句.zh: 他留给他女儿一大笔财产。
例句.pinyin: tā liú gěi tā nǚ ér yī dà bǐ cái chǎn 。
例句.en: He left his daughter a great fortune.

例句.zh: John 继承了一大笔财产。
例句.pinyin: John  jì chéng le yī dà bǐ cái chǎn 。
例句.en: John inherited a large fortune.

例句.zh: 他继承了他父亲的财产。
例句.pinyin: tā jì chéng le tā fù qīn de cái chǎn 。
例句.en: He succeeded to his father's property.

释义: wealth / riches

例句.zh: 健康比财富重要。
例句.pinyin: jiàn kāng bǐ cái fù zhòng yào 。
例句.en: Health is above wealth.

例句.zh: 那些追求和平和安全的人们，我们支持你们。那些所有怀疑美国的灯塔能否能像以前一样明亮的人们，今天晚上我们再次证明，我们国家真正的力量并非来自我们武器的威力或财富的规模，而是来自我们理想的持久力量：民主、 自由、机会、不屈服的希望。
例句.pinyin: nà xiē zhuī qiú hé píng hé ān quán de rén men ， wǒ men zhī chí nǐ men 。 nà xiē suǒ yǒu huái yí měi guó de dēng tǎ néng fǒu néng xiàng yǐ qián yī yàng míng liàng de rén men ， jīn tiān wǎn shàng wǒ men zài cì zhèng míng ， wǒ men guó jiā zhēn zhèng de lì liàng bìng fēi lái zì wǒ men wǔ qì de wēi lì huò cái fù de guī mó ， ér shì lái zì wǒ men lǐ xiǎng de chí jiǔ lì liàng ： mín zhǔ 、  zì yóu 、 jī huì 、 bù qū fú de xī wàng 。
例句.en: To those who seek peace and security. We support you. And to all those who have wondered if America's beacon still burns as bright, tonight we proved once more that the true strength of our nation comes not from the might of our arms or the scale of our wealth, but from the enduring power of our ideals: democracy, liberty, opportunity and unyielding hope.

例句.zh: 不用说，健康比财富重要。
例句.pinyin: bú yòng shuō ， jiàn kāng bǐ cái fù zhòng yào 。
例句.en: Needless to say, health is above wealth.

释义: talent / CL:份[fen4]

例句.zh: 我不禁欣赏他的才华。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù jīn xīn shǎng tā de cái huá 。
例句.en: I can't help admiring his talent.

例句.zh: 我们需要有才华的人。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men xū yào yǒu cái huá de rén 。
例句.en: We need talented people.

例句.zh: 汤姆是个很有才华的作家。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ shì gè hěn yǒu cái huá de zuò jiā 。
例句.en: Tom is a very talented writer.

释义: talent / ability / capacity

例句.zh: 她对自己的才能很自豪。
例句.pinyin: tā duì zì jǐ de cái néng hěn zì háo 。
例句.en: She is very proud of her talent.

例句.zh: 只有学习才能获得知识。
例句.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu xué xí cái néng huò dé zhī shí 。
例句.en: Knowledge can only be obtained by study.

例句.zh: 今晚稍早，我接到马侃参议员打来，态度非常恳切的电话。马侃参议员已打完一场漫长艰苦的选战。他为这个他所热爱的国家所打的仗更久，更艰苦。他为美国的奉献牺牲，是我们多数同胞难以想像的。因为有他这位勇敢无私的领袖的奉献，我们才能过比较好的日子。
例句.pinyin: jīn wǎn shāo zǎo ， wǒ jiē dào mǎ kǎn cān yì yuán dǎ lái ， tài dù fēi cháng kěn qiè de diàn huà 。 mǎ kǎn cān yì yuán yǐ dǎ wán yī cháng màn cháng jiān kǔ de xuǎn zhàn 。 tā wèi zhè ge tā suǒ rè ài de guó jiā suǒ dǎ dī zhàng gèng jiǔ ， gèng jiān kǔ 。 tā wèi měi guó de fèng xiàn xī shēng ， shì wǒ men duō shù tóng bāo nán yǐ xiǎng xiàng de 。 yīn wèi yǒu tā zhè wèi yǒng gǎn wú sī de lǐng xiù de fèng xiàn ， wǒ men cái néng guò bǐ jiào hǎo de rì zi 。
例句.en: A little bit earlier this evening, I received an extraordinarily gracious call from Senator McCain. Senator McCain fought long and hard in this campaign. And he's fought even longer and harder for the country that he loves. He has endured sacrifices for America that most of us cannot begin to imagine. We are better off for the service rendered by this brave and selfless leader.

释义: financial affairs; finance

例句.zh: 关于财务方面的事项，公司里没有人比琼斯先生更了解。
例句.pinyin: guān yú cái wù fāng miàn de shì xiàng ， gōng sī lǐ méi yǒu rén bǐ qióng sī xiān shēng gèng liǎo jiě 。
例句.en: With respect to financial matters, Mr Jones knows more than anyone else in the company.

释义: property / belongings

例句.zh: 因为他们的财物过多，不能同居共处：他们寄居的地方也容不下他们，因为他们的牲畜甚多。
例句.pinyin: yīn wèi tā men de cái wù guò duō ， bù néng tóng jū gòng chǔ ： tā men jì jū de dì fāng yě róng bù xià tā men ， yīn wèi tā men de shēng chù shèn duō 。
例句.en: For they were exceeding rich, and could not dwell together: neither was the land in which they sojourned able to bear them, for the multitude of their flocks.

释义: texture of timber / quality of material / material (that sth is made of)

例句.zh: 纸张、玻璃和塑胶都是可回收的材质。
例句.pinyin: zhǐ zhāng 、 bō lí hé sù jiāo dōu shì kě huí shōu de cái zhì 。
例句.en: Paper, glass and plastic are recyclable materials.

例句.zh: 每个3D模型的顶点都有大量数据与之相关，并影响颜色，材质和光照的行为。
例句.pinyin: měi gè 3D mó xíng de dǐng diǎn dōu yǒu dà liàng shù jù yǔ zhī xiāng guān ， bìng yǐng xiǎng yán sè ， cái zhì hé guāng zhào de xíng wéi 。
例句.en: Every vertex of a 3D model has a huge amount of data associated with it, influencing the behavior of colors, textures, and lighting.

释义: variant of 踩[cai3] / to step on / to tread / to stamp / to press a pedal / to pedal (a bike) / (online) to downvote

例句.zh: 我昨晚差点踩到一只臭鼬。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zuó wǎn chà diǎn cǎi dào yī zhī chòu yòu 。
例句.en: I almost stepped on a skunk last night.

例句.zh: 不要踩在碎玻璃上。
例句.pinyin: bú yào cǎi zài suì bō lí shàng 。
例句.en: Don't step on the broken glass.

例句.zh: 他故意踩我的脚。
例句.pinyin: tā gù yì cǎi wǒ de jiǎo 。
例句.en: He stepped on my foot on purpose.

释义: to procure (for an enterprise etc) / to purchase

例句.zh: 公司计划采购一批新设备。
例句.pinyin: Gōngsī jìhuà cǎigòu yì pī xīn shèbèi.
例句.en: The company plans to procure a batch of new equipment.

例句.zh: 她负责办公室用品的采购。
例句.pinyin: Tā fùzé bàngōngshì yòngpǐn de cǎigòu.
例句.en: She is responsible for the procurement of office supplies.

例句.zh: 这些原料需要从国外采购。
例句.pinyin: Zhèxiē yuánliào xūyào cóng guówài cǎigòu.
例句.en: These raw materials need to be procured from abroad.

释义: rainbow / CL:道[dao4]

例句.zh: 彩虹是自然界最美的现象之一。
例句.pinyin: cǎi hóng shì zì rán jiè zuì měi de xiàn xiàng zhī yī 。
例句.en: A rainbow is one of the most beautiful phenomena of nature.

例句.zh: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
例句.pinyin: cǎi hóng shì yī zhǒng zì rán xiàn xiàng 。
例句.en: A rainbow is a natural phenomenon.

例句.zh: 彩虹有七种颜色。
例句.pinyin: cǎi hóng yǒu qī zhǒng yán sè 。
例句.en: A rainbow has seven colors.

释义: to gather / to collect / to harvest

例句.zh: 汤姆和玛丽亚到树林里采集蘑菇去了。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì yà dào shù lín lǐ cǎi jí mó gū qù le 。

例句.zh: 当我们濒临死亡，我们应该独处。我们将摒离所有身外之物。世间的朋友们-跟我们的地位，财富和社会层次息息相关的朋友，都将离我们而去，只因我们即将步入黑暗的山谷。那些与陌生人紧紧相连的关系网-我们的亲属、我们的爱人、孩子、兄弟姐妹，还有那些不太亲却有共同朋友的人们，我们也必须要分开。现在，他们并没用离开我们。有一个比兄弟更亲的人-爱他自己也爱世间直到尽头。
例句.pinyin: dāng wǒ men bīn lín sǐ wáng ， wǒ men yīng gāi dú chǔ 。 wǒ men jiāng bǐng lí suǒ yǒu shēn wài zhī wù 。 shì jiān de péng yǒu men - gēn wǒ men de dì wèi ， cái fù hé shè huì céng cì xī xī xiāng guān de péng yǒu ， dōu jiāng lí wǒ men ér qù ， zhǐ yīn wǒ men jí jiāng bù rù hēi àn de shān gǔ 。 nà xiē yǔ mò shēng rén jǐn jǐn xiāng lián de guān xì wǎng - wǒ men de qīn shǔ 、 wǒ men de ài rén 、 hái zi 、 xiōng dì jiě mèi ， hái yǒu nà xiē bù tài qīn què yǒu gòng tóng péng yǒu de rén men ， wǒ men yě bì xū yào fēn kāi 。 xiàn zài ， tā men bìng méi yòng lí kāi wǒ men 。 yǒu yí gè bǐ xiōng dì gèng qīn de rén - ài tā zì jǐ yě ài shì jiān zhí dào jìn tóu 。
例句.en: When we come to die, we shall be alone. From all our worldly possessions we shall be about to part. Worldly friends — the friends drawn to us by our position, our wealth, or our social qualities, — will leave us as we enter the dark valley. From those bound to us by stronger ties — our kindred, our loved ones, children, brothers, sisters, and from those not less dear to us who have been made our friends because they and we are the friends of the same Saviour, — from them also we must part. Yet not all will leave us. There is One who "sticketh closer than a brother" — One who having loved His own which are in the world loves them to the end.

例句.zh: 今天是 2013 年 6 月 27 日。蓝色梦想不只有一种，而是有很多种。国际语并非唯一。几十年来，一直存在著其他拉丁语系的人工语言，分别属于不同的专案。未来，有些人寄望于其他语言。但世界语，这个绿色梦想，却成功传承了一个多世纪。几十年来，推行世界语的革命尝试都以失败告终，因为真正的世界语拥有一种无法篡改的艺术平衡。世界语依然历久不衰。在蓝色阵营中，我仍然选择国际语。应该有更多的人给它一个机会。世界语的重音赋予了这种语言一种魅力，或许正是这种魅力推动了它多年来的生存。但世界上也有其他替代方案。
例句.pinyin: jīn tiān shì  2013  nián  6  yuè  27  rì 。 lán sè mèng xiǎng bù zhǐ yǒu yī zhǒng ， ér shì yǒu hěn duō zhǒng 。 guó jì yǔ bìng fēi wéi yī 。 jǐ shí nián lái ， yì zhí cún zài zhù qí tā lā dīng yǔ xì de rén gōng yǔ yán ， fēn bié shǔ yú bù tóng de zhuān àn 。 wèi lái ， yǒu xiē rén jì wàng yú qí tā yǔ yán 。 dàn shì jiè yǔ ， zhè ge lǜ sè mèng xiǎng ， què chéng gōng chuán chéng le yí gè duō shì jì 。 jǐ shí nián lái ， tuī xíng shì jiè yǔ de gé mìng cháng shì dōu yǐ shī bài gào zhōng ， yīn wèi zhēn zhèng de shì jiè yǔ yōng yǒu yī zhǒng wú fǎ cuàn gǎi de yì shù píng héng 。 shì jiè yǔ yī rán lì jiǔ bù shuāi 。 zài lán sè zhèn yíng zhōng ， wǒ réng rán xuǎn zé guó jì yǔ 。 yīng gāi yǒu gèng duō de rén gěi tā yí gè jī huì 。 shì jiè yǔ de zhòng yīn fù yǔ le zhè zhǒng yǔ yán yī zhǒng mèi lì ， huò xǔ zhèng shì zhè zhǒng mèi lì tuī dòng le tā duō nián lái de shēng cún 。 dàn shì jiè shàng yě yǒu qí tā tì dài fāng àn 。
例句.en: It is the 27th of June of 2013. The Blue Dreams are plural. The Blue Dreams are many. Interlingua is not the only one. For decades now, there have existed other Latinate conlangs, different projects. And in the future, some hope for others. But it has been the Green Dream, Esperanto, that has succeeded for more than a century. Reforms attempted upon Esperanto have met with failure over the decades because genuine Esperanto has an artistic balance with which one cannot tamper. Esperanto remains enduring. Amongst the Blues, my vote is still Interlingua. More people should give it a chance. Esperanto's accents give a charm to the language that perhaps boosted its survival over the years. There are substitute systems.

She's a lot like the millions of others who stood in line to make their voice heard in this election, except for one thing: Ann Nixon Cooper is 106 years old.

例句.zh: 在香港北部石篱公共屋邨的一个社区中心里，一堆堆月饼盒正等著在隔天的中秋节当天分发出去。月饼盒里装的，是本地慈善机构「惜食堂」在佳节时分收集到的 76,000 个月饼的其中一部分，将被重新分配给低收入家庭和个人。
例句.pinyin: zài xiāng gǎng běi bù shí lí gōng gòng wū cūn de yí gè shè qū zhōng xīn lǐ ， yī duī duī yuè bǐng hé zhèng děng zhù zài gé tiān de zhōng qiū jié dàng tiān fēn fā chū qù 。 yuè bǐng hé lǐ zhuāng de ， shì běn dì cí shàn jī gòu 「 xī shí táng 」 zài jiā jié shí fēn shōu jí dào de  76,000  gè yuè bǐng de qí zhōng yī bù fèn ， jiāng bèi chóng xīn fēn pèi gěi dī shōu rù jiā tíng hé gè rén 。
例句.en: At a community center on Shek Lei public housing estate in northern Hong Kong, stacks of mooncake boxes are waiting to be distributed on Mid-Autumn Festival the following day. Inside they contain some of the 76,000 mooncakes that have been collected by Food Grace, a local charity, this holiday season to be redistributed to low-income families and individuals.

释义: variant of 島|岛[dao3] / island / CL:個|个[ge4],座[zuo4]

例句.zh: 乘飞机去该岛，将花费你100美元。
例句.pinyin: chéng fēi jī qù gāi dǎo ， jiāng huā fèi nǐ 100 měi yuán 。
例句.en: It will cost you $100 to fly to the island.

例句.zh: 这个岛在日本的南面。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge dǎo zài rì běn de nán miàn 。
例句.en: This island is in the south of Japan.

例句.zh: 恶魔摧毁了广岛和长崎。
例句.pinyin: è mó cuī huǐ le guǎng dǎo hé cháng qí 。
例句.en: The devil destroyed Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

释义: to go bankrupt / to close down

例句.zh: 公司很快就要倒闭了。
例句.pinyin: gōng sī hěn kuài jiù yào dǎo bì le 。
例句.en: The company will soon go bankrupt.

例句.zh: 许多小公司倒闭了。
例句.pinyin: xǔ duō xiǎo gōng sī dǎo bì le 。
例句.en: Many small companies went bankrupt.

例句.zh: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。
例句.pinyin: gōng sī yóu yú quē fá zī běn dǎo bì le 。
例句.en: The firm went under due to lack of capital.

释义: to change buses, trains etc / to reverse (a vehicle) / to drive backwards

例句.zh: 「你鼻子怎么了？」「我刚才倒车的时候，想探头出窗看清楚后面有没有人。我以为车窗是开著的，谁知原来是关上了，于是就一头撞到车窗上了。」
例句.pinyin: 「 nǐ bí zi zěn me le ？」「 wǒ gāng cái dào chē de shí hòu ， xiǎng tàn tóu chū chuāng kàn qīng chǔ hòu miàn yǒu méi yǒu rén 。 wǒ yǐ wéi chē chuāng shì kāi zhù de ， shuí zhī yuán lái shì guān shàng le ， yú shì jiù yī tóu zhuàng dào chē chuāng shàng le 。」
例句.en: "What happened to your nose?" "When I was backing my car up I went to check behind me, convinced that the car window was open, and bashed my face into it!"

例句.zh: 他倒车入车库。
例句.pinyin: tā dào chē rù chē kù 。
例句.en: He backed his car into the garage.

例句.zh: 她倒车进车库。
例句.pinyin: tā dào chē jìn chē kù 。
例句.en: She backed her car into the garage.

释义: tutor / teacher / academic advisor

例句.zh: 我的驾驶导师说我应该耐心一点。
例句.pinyin: wǒ de jià shǐ dǎo shī shuō wǒ yīng gāi nài xīn yì diǎn 。
例句.en: My driving instructor says I should be more patient.

例句.zh: 她很尊重她的导师。
例句.pinyin: tā hěn zūn zhòng tā de dǎo shī 。
例句.en: She respects her homeroom teacher a lot.

例句.zh: 他是数学系的导师。
例句.pinyin: tā shì shù xué xì de dǎo shī 。
例句.en: He is a tutor for the math department.

释义: virtue / morality / ethics / CL:種|种[zhong3]

例句.zh: 一个人就算不吃肉，也可以健健康康的生活。所以人杀生、吃肉，只不过是为了满足自己的口腹之欲而已。这种行为是不道德的。
例句.pinyin: yí gè rén jiù suàn bù chī ròu ， yě kě yǐ jiàn jiàn kāng kāng de shēng huó 。 suǒ yǐ rén shā shēng 、 chī ròu ， zhǐ bù guò shì wèi le mǎn zú zì jǐ de kǒu fù zhī yù ér yǐ 。 zhè zhǒng xíng wéi shì bù dào dé de 。
例句.en: A man can live and be healthy without killing animals for food; therefore, if he eats meat, he participates in taking animal life merely for the sake of his appetite. And to act so is immoral.

例句.zh: 小说家说谎并不是不道德的事。其实，谎话说得愈离谱、愈有技巧，就愈会受到公众和批评家的表扬。
例句.pinyin: xiǎo shuō jiā shuō huǎng bìng bú shì bù dào dé de shì 。 qí shí ， huǎng huà shuō dé yù lí pǔ 、 yù yǒu jì qiǎo ， jiù yù huì shòu dào gōng zhòng hé pī píng jiā de biǎo yáng 。
例句.en: It's not immoral for a novelist to tell lies. In fact, the bigger the lies, the better lies, and the more the common folks and critics will praise you.

例句.zh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。
例句.pinyin: yì yuán shòu dào le yì huì dào dé wěi yuán huì de qiǎn zé 。
例句.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.

释义: contrary to what one might expect / actually / contrariwise / why don't you
短释义: contrary to what one might expect

例句.zh: 这件衣服样式倒是挺好，就是贵了点儿。
例句.pinyin: zhè jiàn yī fú yàng shì dǎo shì tǐng hǎo ， jiù shì guì le diǎn ér 。
例句.en: The style of this item of clothing is good; it's just a bit expensive.

例句.zh: 我倒是很想去看这场比赛，可是不知道有没有时间。
例句.pinyin: wǒ dǎo shì hěn xiǎng qù kàn zhè chǎng bǐ sài ， kě shì bù zhī dào yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān 。
例句.en: I'd certainly like to go and watch the match; it's just that I'm not sure if I have time.

例句.zh: 我倒是很想去看电影，可是不确定有没有时间。
例句.pinyin: wǒ dǎo shì hěn xiǎng qù kàn diàn yǐng ， kě shì bù què dìng yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān 。
例句.en: I’d certainly like to go and watch a film, but I’m not sure if I have time.

释义: all right! / that's enough! / (emphatically, in rhetorical questions) possible

例句.zh: 这部电影为她赢得了人气。
例句.pinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng wèi tā yíng dé le rén qì 。
例句.en: The movie gained her great popularity.

例句.zh: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bà bà cān jiā le liào lǐ jìng sài bìng dé le dì yì míng 。
例句.en: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.

例句.zh: 得了！你弄得她不自在了！
例句.pinyin: dé le ！ nǐ nòng dé tā bù zì zài le ！
例句.en: Stop it! You're making her feel uncomfortable!

释义: able to / so that sb can / enabling / in order to / finally in a position to / with sth in view

例句.zh: 这本书里错误多得以至于老师把它叫作“醉鬼版”。
例句.pinyin: zhè běn shū lǐ cuò wù duō dé yǐ zhì yú lǎo shī bǎ tā jiào zuò “ zuì guǐ bǎn ”。
例句.en: There are so many mistakes in this book that the teacher has dubbed it "The Drunkard's Edition".

例句.zh: 我记得以前见到你。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jì de yǐ qián jiàn dào nǐ 。
例句.en: I remember meeting you before.

例句.zh: 勇气是非常重要的。比如肌肉，经常使用才得以加强。
例句.pinyin: yǒng qì shì fēi cháng zhòng yào de 。 bǐ rú jī ròu ， jīng cháng shǐ yòng cái dé yǐ jiā qiáng 。
例句.en: Courage is very important. Like a muscle, it is strengthened by use.

释义: to find out / to learn of

例句.zh: 只有学习才能获得知识。
例句.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu xué xí cái néng huò dé zhī shí 。
例句.en: Knowledge can only be obtained by study.

例句.zh: 她得知父亲突然离世，不禁心如刀割。
例句.pinyin: tā dé zhī fù qīn tū rán lí shì ， bù jīn xīn rú dāo gē 。
例句.en: She was filled with deep grief to hear of her father's sudden death.

例句.zh: 当这位女士得知她已经赢得了百万美元, 她真的乐疯了。
例句.pinyin: dāng zhè wèi nǚ shì dé zhī tā yǐ jīng yíng dé le bǎi wàn měi yuán ,  tā zhēn de lè fēng le 。
例句.en: The lady really flipped out when she learned she had won a million dollars.

释义: lantern

例句.zh: 灯笼在树枝上吊着。
例句.pinyin: dēng lóng zài shù zhī shàng diào zhe 。
例句.en: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.

例句.zh: 美国自然历史博物馆的「光之生物」展览展出了发绿色光的水母、额头上提著灯笼的琵琶鱼，以及在洞穴顶棚上悬挂粘液状细丝，用来诱捕猎物的萤火虫。
例句.pinyin: měi guó zì rán lì shǐ bó wù guǎn de 「 guāng zhī shēng wù 」 zhǎn lǎn zhǎn chū le fā lǜ sè guāng de shuǐ mǔ 、 é tóu shàng tí zhù dēng lóng de pí pá yú ， yǐ jí zài dòng xué dǐng péng shàng xuán guà nián yè zhuàng xì sī ， yòng lái yòu bǔ liè wù de yíng huǒ chóng 。
例句.en: The American Museum of Natural History’s “Creatures of Light” exhibit features jellyfish that glow green, anglerfish whose lantern-like bulbs dangle from their foreheads and luminous glowworms that hang mucus-like strands from cave ceilings to attract and ensnare their prey.

释义: grade / rank / status

例句.zh: 根据国土安全部的规定，目前的安全水准是橙色等级。
例句.pinyin: gēn jù guó tǔ ān quán bù de guī dìng ， mù qián de ān quán shuǐ zhǔn shì chéng sè děng jí 。
例句.en: The security level, as established by the Department of Homeland Security, is orange.

例句.zh: 在过去一个相当长的时期里，社会都是等级制度森严并且极度不公的，做为社会阶级中最大一部分的贫农常常被赋税，战争，饥荒压得喘不过气来，痛苦不堪。
例句.pinyin: zài guò qù yí gè xiāng dāng zhǎng de shí qī lǐ ， shè huì dōu shì děng jí zhì dù sēn yán bìng qiě jí dù bù gōng de ， zuò wèi shè huì jiē jí zhōng zuì dà yī bù fèn de pín nóng cháng cháng bèi fù shuì ， zhàn zhēng ， jī huāng yā dé chuǎn bù guò qì lái ， tòng kǔ bù kān 。
例句.en: For a long time, society was strongly hierarchical and unequal, primarily composed of peasants. The most backward, impoverished segment of the population, they were crushed by the weight of taxes, wars, and famines.

例句.zh: 形式是暂时的，等级才是永恒的。
例句.pinyin: xíng shì shì zàn shí de ， děng jí cái shì yǒng héng de 。
例句.en: Form is temporary, class is permanent.

释义: to drip / to let drip; to apply (eye drops etc) / (bound form) a drop (of liquid) / classifier for drops of liquid

例句.zh: 屋檐上正滴下雨水。
例句.pinyin: wū yán shàng zhèng dī xià yǔ shuǐ 。
例句.en: The eaves are dripping.

例句.zh: 这两个礼拜一滴雨也没下过。
例句.pinyin: zhè liǎng gè lǐ bài yī dī yǔ yě méi xià guò 。
例句.en: We have not had a single drop of rain for two weeks.

例句.zh: 一滴滴水能聚成湖泊。
例句.pinyin: yī dī dī shuǐ néng jù chéng hú pō 。
例句.en: Drop by drop, the water can conglomerate into a lake.

释义: (attributive) low-carbon; low-carb (diet)

例句.zh: 我们应该选择低碳的出行方式。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi xuǎnzé dītàn de chūxíng fāngshì.
例句.en: We should choose low-carbon ways of traveling.

例句.zh: 这座城市正在推广低碳生活。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì zhèngzài tuīguǎng dītàn shēnghuó.
例句.en: The city is promoting a low-carbon lifestyle.

例句.zh: 医生建议他尝试低碳饮食。
例句.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā chángshì dītàn yǐnshí.
例句.en: The doctor advised him to try a low-carb diet.

释义: to arrive / to reach (a destination)

例句.zh: 他们就快从香港抵达了。
例句.pinyin: tā men jiù kuài cóng xiāng gǎng dǐ dá le 。
例句.en: They are arriving here soon from Hong Kong.

例句.zh: 狂风暴雨造成她无法准时抵达。
例句.pinyin: kuáng fēng bào yǔ zào chéng tā wú fǎ zhǔn shí dǐ dá 。
例句.en: The storm prevented her from arriving on time.

例句.zh: 他们在四时抵达了酒店。
例句.pinyin: tā men zài sì shí dǐ dá le jiǔ diàn 。
例句.en: At four o'clock, they arrived at the hotel.

释义: to resist / resistance

例句.zh: 当移居者的村庄被野蛮人征服后，他们的希望和生活到了痛苦的尽头，数年对灾祸的抵抗结束了。
例句.pinyin: dāng yí jū zhě de cūn zhuāng bèi yě mán rén zhēng fú hòu ， tā men de xī wàng hé shēng huó dào le tòng kǔ de jìn tóu ， shù nián duì zāi huò de dǐ kàng jié shù le 。
例句.en: Years of resistance to misfortune ended when the settlers' village was overcome by the savages and their hopes and lives came to the bitter end.

例句.zh: 停止抵抗！
例句.pinyin: tíng zhǐ dǐ kàng ！
例句.en: Stop resisting!

例句.zh: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。
例句.pinyin: wǒ dǐ kàng bù liǎo tián shí de yòu huò 。
例句.en: I can't resist sweet things.

释义: tunnel / causeway / authentic / genuine / proper

例句.zh: 她大方地道歉。
例句.pinyin: tā dà fāng dì dào qiàn 。
例句.en: She had the decency to apologize.

例句.zh: 我很希望可以说一口地道的中文。
例句.pinyin: wǒ hěn xī wàng kě yǐ shuō yī kǒu dì dào de zhōng wén 。
例句.en: I really hope that I can speak authentic Chinese.

例句.zh: 我不会原谅你，除非你真诚地道歉。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bú huì yuán liàng nǐ ， chú fēi nǐ zhēn chéng dì dào qiàn 。
例句.en: I won’t forgive you unless you apologise sincerely.

释义: region / regional (away from the central administration) / local / place; location; area; space; territory / aspect; part / CL:處|处[chu4]

例句.zh: 沿着这条路直走，到第三个红绿灯的地方右转。
例句.pinyin: yán zhe zhè tiáo lù zhí zǒu ， dào dì sān gè hóng lǜ dēng de dì fāng yòu zhuǎn 。
例句.en: Go straight down this street and turn right at the third light.

例句.zh: 我总是在离手不远的地方放一本字典。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zǒng shì zài lí shǒu bù yuǎn de dì fāng fàng yī běn zì diǎn 。
例句.en: I always keep a dictionary close at hand.

例句.zh: 我爸爸坚持要我去那地方看看。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bà bà jiān chí yào wǒ qù nà dì fāng kàn kàn 。
例句.en: My father insisted that I should go to see the place.

释义: topography / terrain / landform

例句.zh: 这里的地形十分复杂。
例句.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de dìxíng shífēn fùzá.
例句.en: The terrain here is very complex.

例句.zh: 山区的地形不适合建机场。
例句.pinyin: Shānqū de dìxíng bù shìhé jiàn jīchǎng.
例句.en: The mountainous terrain is not suitable for building an airport.

例句.zh: 我们先研究一下当地的地形。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān yánjiū yíxià dāngdì de dìxíng.
例句.en: Let's first study the local topography.

释义: area / district / region

例句.zh: 不同地域有不同的饮食习惯。
例句.pinyin: Bùtóng dìyù yǒu bùtóng de yǐnshí xíguàn.
例句.en: Different regions have different eating habits.

例句.zh: 这种植物只生长在温暖的地域。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù zhǐ shēngzhǎng zài wēnnuǎn de dìyù.
例句.en: This plant grows only in warm areas.

例句.zh: 地域差异影响了当地的建筑风格。
例句.pinyin: Dìyù chāyì yǐngxiǎng le dāngdì de jiànzhù fēnggé.
例句.en: Regional differences have influenced the local architectural style.

释义: geology

例句.zh: 该探测器会归纳火星的地质和过去的气候，并成为第一个收集和储存火星岩石和风化层的探测器，为人类探索这颗红色星球铺平道路。
例句.pinyin: gāi tàn cè qì huì guī nà huǒ xīng de dì zhì hé guò qù de qì hòu ， bìng chéng wéi dì yí gè shōu jí hé chǔ cún huǒ xīng yán shí hé fēng huà céng de tàn cè qì ， wéi rén lèi tàn suǒ zhè kē hóng sè xīng qiú pū píng dào lù 。
例句.en: The rover will characterize the planet’s geology and past climate and be the first mission to collect and cache Martian rock and regolith, paving the way for human exploration of the Red Planet.

释义: to hit / to press / to strike (on the keyboard) / to click (a web page button)

例句.zh: 请不要回复这封诈骗电邮，当然也不要点击电邮里的超连结。
例句.pinyin: qǐng bú yào huí fù zhè fēng zhà piàn diàn yóu ， dāng rán yě bú yào diǎn jī diàn yóu lǐ de chāo lián jié 。
例句.en: Please do not answer this fraudulent e-mail and certainly do not click on the links in the e-mail.

例句.zh: 点击图片进入下一页!
例句.pinyin: diǎn jī tú piàn jìn rù xià yī yè !
例句.en: Click the picture to go to the next page!

例句.zh: 您已添加了评论，而不是一个翻译。要添加一个翻译，点击这句话上面的«あ→а»图标。
例句.pinyin: nín yǐ tiān jiā le píng lùn ， ér bú shì yí gè fān yì 。 yào tiān jiā yí gè fān yì ， diǎn jī zhè jù huà shàng miàn de «あ→а» tú biāo 。
例句.en: You have added a comment, not a translation. To add a translation, click on the "あ→а" icon above the sentence.

释义: ceremony; celebration

例句.zh: 这个典礼有多正式?
例句.pinyin: zhè ge diǎn lǐ yǒu duō zhèng shì ?
例句.en: How formal is this ceremony?

例句.zh: 我不想参加典礼。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng cān jiā diǎn lǐ 。

例句.zh: 萨沙和马莉娅，我爱你们，我对你们的爱超出了你们的想象。你们已赢得了新的宠物狗，它将和我们一起前往新的白宫。

例句.zh: 让我们记住，是伊利诺伊州的一名男子首次将共和党的旗帜扛到了白宫。共和党是建立在自立、个人自由以及国家团结的价值观之上的。这也是我们所有人共同的价值观。虽然民主党今天晚上赢得了巨大的胜利，但我们是以谦卑的态度和弥合阻碍我们进步的分歧的决心赢得这场胜利的
例句.pinyin: ràng wǒ men jì zhù ， shì yī lì nuò yī zhōu de yī míng nán zi shǒu cì jiāng gòng hé dǎng de qí zhì káng dào le bái gōng 。 gòng hé dǎng shì jiàn lì zài zì lì 、 gè rén zì yóu yǐ jí guó jiā tuán jié de jià zhí guān zhī shàng de 。 zhè yě shì wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén gòng tóng de jià zhí guān 。 suī rán mín zhǔ dǎng jīn tiān wǎn shàng yíng dé le jù dà de shèng lì ， dàn wǒ men shì yǐ qiān bēi de tài dù hé mí hé zǔ ài wǒ men jìn bù de fēn qí de jué xīn yíng dé zhè chǎng shèng lì de
例句.en: Let's remember that it was a man from this state who first carried the banner of the Republican Party to the White House, a party founded on the values of self-reliance and individual liberty and national unity. Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.

释义: cold winter

例句.zh: 21个月前在寒冬所开始的一切不应当在今天这个秋夜结束。今天的选举胜利并不是我们所寻求的改变--这只是我们进行改变的机会。如果我们仍然按照过去的方式行事，我们所寻求的改变将不会发生。没有你们，没有服务和牺牲的新精神，就不可能发生改变。因此，让我们发扬新的爱国和负责精神，所有的人都下定决心参与其中，更加努力地工作，不仅是为自己而是为彼此。
例句.pinyin: 21 gè yuè qián zài hán dōng suǒ kāi shǐ de yī qiè bù yīng dāng zài jīn tiān zhè ge qiū yè jié shù 。 jīn tiān de xuǎn jǔ shèng lì bìng bú shì wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn -- zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men jìn xíng gǎi biàn de jī huì 。 rú guǒ wǒ men réng rán àn zhào guò qù de fāng shì xíng shì ， wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn jiāng bú huì fā shēng 。 méi yǒu nǐ men ， méi yǒu fú wù hé xī shēng de xīn jīng shén ， jiù bù kě néng fā shēng gǎi biàn 。 yīn cǐ ， ràng wǒ men fā yáng xīn de ài guó hé fù zé jīng shén ， suǒ yǒu de rén dōu xià dìng jué xīn cān yù qí zhōng ， gèng jiā nǔ lì dì gōng zuò ， bù jǐn shì wèi zì jǐ ér shì wèi bǐ cǐ 。
例句.en: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.

例句.zh: 今年，在这场选举中，她用手指触摸屏幕投下自己的选票，因为在美国生活了106年之后，经历了最好的时光和最黑暗的时刻之后，她知道美国如何能够发生变革。
例句.pinyin: jīn nián ， zài zhè chǎng xuǎn jǔ zhōng ， tā yòng shǒu zhǐ chù mō píng mù tóu xià zì jǐ de xuǎn piào ， yīn wèi zài měi guó shēng huó le 106 nián zhī hòu ， jīng lì le zuì hǎo de shí guāng hé zuì hēi àn de shí kè zhī hòu ， tā zhī dào měi guó rú hé néng gòu fā shēng biàn gé 。
例句.en: And this year, in this election, she touched her finger to a screen, and cast her vote; because after 106 years in America, through the best of times and the darkest of hours, she knows how America can change.

例句.zh: 现在是 2025 年 8 月 3 日，露露岛。晚餐后，阳光下嫩绿的无花果，昨天腌制的甜醋，还有重新加热的阿尔弗雷多义面，我坐在阳台上，望著那棵针叶树。楼下静谧无声，街道空无一车，一片悠闲。我的冰镇青柠水在阳光下闪闪发光。最近，我常和那位法丹混血的 UFO 研究专家麦可聊天。我们谈论内心深处的事情：智慧型装置的迷醉，以及思维的衰退。他说，咖啡馆已经不再是咖啡馆了。人们忘记如何观察、如何驻足停留。我跟他讲起在日本的亚瑟，他会像僧侣凝视虚空一样，对著空白的墙壁发呆。最近，我让机器像诗人一样说话，它们真的做到了。它们模仿伊莉莎白时代的诗歌，以及塔加洛语民谣中那古老而忧伤的韵律。我沿著通往蒂姆霍顿咖啡店的小路采摘黑莓。我像个孩子似的喊道：「莫拉！」我的朋友莫拉，她血液里流著安地斯山脉的薄雾，她会笑的。今天，我买了黄柠檬。我本来想买青柠，但黄柠檬也可以。/ 黑莓的清晨 / 指尖残留无花果的痕迹 / 街道依然沉睡
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì  2025  nián  8  yuè  3  rì ， lù lù dǎo 。 wǎn cān hòu ， yáng guāng xià nèn lǜ de wú huā guǒ ， zuó tiān yān zhì de tián cù ， hái yǒu chóng xīn jiā rè de ā ěr fú léi duō yì miàn ， wǒ zuò zài yáng tái shàng ， wàng zhù nà kē zhēn yè shù 。 lóu xià jìng mì wú shēng ， jiē dào kōng wú yī chē ， yī piàn yōu xián 。 wǒ de bīng zhèn qīng níng shuǐ zài yáng guāng xià shǎn shǎn fā guāng 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ cháng hé nà wèi fǎ dān hùn xuè de  UFO  yán jiū zhuān jiā mài kě liáo tiān 。 wǒ men tán lùn nèi xīn shēn chù de shì qíng ： zhì huì xíng zhuāng zhì de mí zuì ， yǐ jí sī wéi de shuāi tuì 。 tā shuō ， kā fēi guǎn yǐ jīng bù zài shì kā fēi guǎn le 。 rén men wàng jì rú hé guān chá 、 rú hé zhù zú tíng liú 。 wǒ gēn tā jiǎng qǐ zài rì běn de yà sè ， tā huì xiàng sēng lǚ níng shì xū kōng yī yàng ， duì zhù kòng bái de qiáng bì fā dāi 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ ràng jī qì xiàng shī rén yī yàng shuō huà ， tā men zhēn de zuò dào le 。 tā men mó fǎng yī lì shā bái shí dài de shī gē ， yǐ jí tǎ jiā luò yǔ mín yáo zhōng nà gǔ lǎo ér yōu shāng de yùn lǜ 。 wǒ yán zhù tōng wǎng dì mǔ huò dùn kā fēi diàn de xiǎo lù cǎi zhāi hēi méi 。 wǒ xiàng gè hái zi shì de hǎn dào ：「 mò lā ！」 wǒ de péng yǒu mò lā ， tā xuè yè lǐ liú zhù ān dì sī shān mài de bó wù ， tā huì xiào de 。 jīn tiān ， wǒ mǎi le huáng níng méng 。 wǒ běn lái xiǎng mǎi qīng níng ， dàn huáng níng méng yě kě yǐ 。/  hēi méi de qīng chén  /  zhǐ jiān cán liú wú huā guǒ de hén jì  /  jiē dào yī rán chén shuì
例句.en: It's Lulu Island, 3 August 2025. After supper—green figs tender with sunlight, sweet vinegar from yesterday’s pickled jar, and reheated Alfredo—I sat on the balcony and watched the conifer. Stillness below, a street without cars, without haste. My lime water, iced, caught the light. Michael, the Franco-Danish ufologist, has been in my conversations lately. We speak of inner things: the trance of smart devices, the mind’s eye dwindling. He says cafés aren’t cafés anymore. People forget how to look, how to linger. I tell him of Arthur in Japan—how he'd stare into blank walls like a monk gazing at emptiness. Lately I ask machines to speak like poets, and they do. They mimic Elizabethan verses and the old wistful lilt of Tagalog ballads. I pick blackberries along the path to Tim Hortons. "¡Moras!" I shout like a child. My friend Mora, whose blood flows with Andes mist, would smile. Today, I bought lemons. I meant limes, but lemons are all right. / blackberry morning— / a fig's ghost on my fingers / and the street still sleeps

例句.zh: 现在是我们回答这个问题的机会。这是我们的时刻这是我们的时代--让我们的人民重新就业，为我们的后代敞开机会之门，恢复繁荣，推进和平，重新确立“美国梦”，再次证明这样一个基本的真理：我们是一家人；只要一息尚存，我们就有希望；当我们遇到嘲讽和怀疑，当有人说我们办不到的时候，我们要以这个永恒的信条来回应他们。是的，我们能做到
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì wǒ men huí dá zhè ge wèn tí de jī huì 。 zhè shì wǒ men de shí kè zhè shì wǒ men de shí dài -- ràng wǒ men de rén mín chóng xīn jiù yè ， wèi wǒ men de hòu dài chǎng kāi jī huì zhī mén ， huī fù fán róng ， tuī jìn hé píng ， chóng xīn què lì “ měi guó mèng ”， zài cì zhèng míng zhè yàng yí gè jī běn de zhēn lǐ ： wǒ men shì yī jiā rén ； zhǐ yào yī xī shàng cún ， wǒ men jiù yǒu xī wàng ； dāng wǒ men yù dào cháo fěng hé huái yí ， dāng yǒu rén shuō wǒ men bàn bú dào de shí hòu ， wǒ men yào yǐ zhè ge yǒng héng de xìn tiáo lái huí yìng tā men 。 shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào
例句.en: This is our chance to answer that call. This is our moment. This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. And where we are met with cynicism and doubt and those who tell us that we can't, we will respond with that timeless creed that sums up the spirit of a people: Yes, we can.

例句.zh: 如果人类的物质生活一年比一年富足，蛋糕的推出越来越精致，科技越来越便利，同时没有前人种树就不可能有后人乘凉，那么我便可以肯定“富有”的人生，肯定是由热爱吃苦的前辈，那群带有苦味的食客开创出来的。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ rén lèi de wù zhì shēng huó yī nián bǐ yī nián fù zú ， dàn gāo de tuī chū yuè lái yuè jīng zhì ， kē jì yuè lái yuè biàn lì ， tóng shí méi yǒu qián rén zhǒng shù jiù bù kě néng yǒu hòu rén chéng liáng ， nà me wǒ biàn kě yǐ kěn dìng “ fù yǒu ” de rén shēng ， kěn dìng shì yóu rè ài chī kǔ de qián bèi ， nà qún dài yǒu kǔ wèi de shí kè kāi chuàng chū lái de 。
例句.en: If humanity's material life becomes richer year by year, cakes become more and more elaborate, technology becomes more and more convenient, and at the same time, without earlier generations planting trees, later generations would not be able to enjoy their shade, then I am sure that the "rich" life must've been brought about by our industrious forefathers, those who were unafraid to taste the bitterness of hardship.

例句.en: The Lockheed scandal is a worldwide corruption scandal involving the major American plane manufacturer Lockheed. It came to light in February 1976 and revolved mainly around the acceptance of passenger plane contracts.

例句.en: And I know you didn't do this just to win an election. And I know you didn't do it for me. You did it because you understand the enormity of the task that lies ahead. For even as we celebrate tonight, we know the challenges that tomorrow will bring are the greatest of our lifetime: two wars, a planet in peril, the worst financial crisis in a century.

例句.zh: 2025 年 5 月 14 日，天空多云，间或有蓝色空间。我两次走到圣奥尔本斯路上的罗马天主教堂，一次在早上，一次在下午，这是我今年春天第 12 次和第 13 次。早上，穿著制服的小男孩和小女孩们在宽敞的礼拜堂里忏悔。他们来自不同的种族。神父在告解室和一个学生交谈。在崇拜小堂，我注意到左前方有一盆漂亮的兰花。下午，宽敞的礼拜堂几乎空无一人，我通常更喜欢这种状态。路边有个穿著白色背心的英俊肌肉男在慢跑。那棵开著紫色花朵的大树看起来像一棵皇后树，一棵泡桐，因为它有著大大的心形叶子。它让我想起开著紫色花朵的蓝花楹，让我对南美洲充满了怀念。在提姆霍顿斯咖啡馆，我早上享用了香肠马铃薯炒蛋和一杯燕麦奶伯爵茶，下午又喝了一杯经典冰柠檬水。这一天我都在散步。在家，我学习了一些逻辑语和世界语。我有很多世界语书籍。我的融合主义倾向是万物有灵论和佛教。
例句.pinyin: 2025  nián  5  yuè  14  rì ， tiān kōng duō yún ， jiàn huò yǒu lán sè kōng jiān 。 wǒ liǎng cì zǒu dào shèng ào ěr běn sī lù shàng de luó mǎ tiān zhǔ jiào táng ， yī cì zài zǎo shàng ， yī cì zài xià wǔ ， zhè shì wǒ jīn nián chūn tiān dì  12  cì hé dì  13  cì 。 zǎo shàng ， chuān zhù zhì fú de xiǎo nán hái hé xiǎo nǚ hái men zài kuān chǎng de lǐ bài táng lǐ chàn huǐ 。 tā men lái zì bù tóng de zhǒng zú 。 shén fù zài gào jiě shì hé yí gè xué shēng jiāo tán 。 zài chóng bài xiǎo táng ， wǒ zhù yì dào zuǒ qián fāng yǒu yī pén piào liàng de lán huā 。 xià wǔ ， kuān chǎng de lǐ bài táng jī hū kōng wú yì rén ， wǒ tōng cháng gèng xǐ huān zhè zhǒng zhuàng tài 。 lù biān yǒu gè chuān zhù bái sè bèi xīn de yīng jùn jī ròu nán zài màn pǎo 。 nà kē kāi zhù zǐ sè huā duǒ de dà shù kàn qǐ lái xiàng yī kē huáng hòu shù ， yī kē pāo tóng ， yīn wèi tā yǒu zhù dà dà de xīn xíng yè zi 。 tā ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ kāi zhù zǐ sè huā duǒ de lán huā yíng ， ràng wǒ duì nán měi zhōu chōng mǎn le huái niàn 。 zài tí mǔ huò dùn sī kā fēi guǎn ， wǒ zǎo shàng xiǎng yòng le xiāng cháng mǎ líng shǔ chǎo dàn hé yī bēi yàn mài nǎi bó jué chá ， xià wǔ yòu hē le yī bēi jīng diǎn bīng níng méng shuǐ 。 zhè yī tiān wǒ dōu zài sàn bù 。 zài jiā ， wǒ xué xí le yī xiē luó jí yǔ hé shì jiè yǔ 。 wǒ yǒu hěn duō shì jiè yǔ shū jí 。 wǒ de róng hé zhǔ yì qīng xiàng shì wàn wù yǒu líng lùn hé fó jiào 。
例句.en: This 14th of May of 2025 is cloudy skies interspersed with blue spaces. I walked to the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road twice, once in the morning and again in the afternoon, my 12th and 13th times this spring. In the morning was confession for the little boys and girls in uniform. They were of different races, in the big worship hall. The priest was in the confession booth talking to a student. At the Adoration Chapel, I noticed a nice pot of orchids on the front left. In the afternoon, the big worship hall was mostly empty, a condition which I usually prefer. At the road was a handsome muscle man in white tank top jogging. The big purple-bloom tree seems like an Empress Tree, a Paulownia, because of the big heart-shaped leaves. Reminiscent of Jacaranda with its purple blooming, it's saudade for me about South America. At Tim Hortons café, I enjoyed Scrambled Eggs with Sausage and Potatoes and an Earl Grey Tea with oat milk in the morning, and an Iced Classic Lemonade in the afternoon. The day was full of walking. At home, I study bits of Lojban and Esperanto. I have many books in Esperanto. I tend towards Animism-Buddhism in my Syncretism.

例句.zh: 今天是 2025 年 7 月 3 日，阳光明媚。7 月 7日是日本的七夕。今天早上，在露露岛上，我两次去了提姆霍顿斯咖啡馆，先是点了燕麦奶冰咖啡，然后又点了草莓西瓜气泡饮配香肠卷。我还去了「蛤蜊寺」。路上，我瞥了一眼迷人的竹林。一位老人在竹林旁挖了几个坑，用吃剩的芒果和樱桃堆肥。在咖啡馆里，我和格雷格聊了起来。格雷格是个白人，他梦想著和他的日本妻子在北海道钏路开一家民宿。那里的特色是当地的阿伊努族人和沼泽地。今天，剃著光头的格雷格穿著米色 T 恤和米色短裤，也许带著一丝恰巴卡诺酒的韵味？
例句.pinyin: jīn tiān shì  2025  nián  7  yuè  3  rì ， yáng guāng míng mèi 。7  yuè  7 rì shì rì běn de qī xī 。 jīn tiān zǎo shàng ， zài lù lù dǎo shàng ， wǒ liǎng cì qù le tí mǔ huò dùn sī kā fēi guǎn ， xiān shì diǎn le yàn mài nǎi bīng kā fēi ， rán hòu yòu diǎn le cǎo méi xī guā qì pào yǐn pèi xiāng cháng juǎn 。 wǒ hái qù le 「 gé lí sì 」。 lù shàng ， wǒ piē le yī yǎn mí rén de zhú lín 。 yī wèi lǎo rén zài zhú lín páng wā le jǐ gè kēng ， yòng chī shèng de máng guǒ hé yīng táo duī féi 。 zài kā fēi guǎn lǐ ， wǒ hé gé léi gé liáo le qǐ lái 。 gé léi gé shì gè bái rén ， tā mèng xiǎng zhù hé tā de rì běn qī zǐ zài běi hǎi dào chuàn lù kāi yī jiā mín sù 。 nà lǐ de tè sè shì dāng dì de ā yī nǔ zú rén hé zhǎo zé dì 。 jīn tiān ， tì zhù guāng tóu de gé léi gé chuān zhù mǐ sè  T  xù hé mǐ sè duǎn kù ， yě xǔ dài zhù yī sī qià bā kǎ nuò jiǔ de yùn wèi ？
例句.en: It's a sunny 3rd of July of 2025. On the 7th will be the Star Festival—Tanabata—in Japan. This morning, here on Lulu Island, I strolled to Tim Hortons café twice—Iced Coffee with oat milk, then Strawberry Watermelon Sparkling Quencher with a Sausage Farmer's Wrap. I went to the "Clam Temple." On the way, I glanced at the charming bamboo grove. An old man had dug holes beside it to put compost—eaten mangoes and cherries. At the café, I spoke to Greg, the white man who eventually wants to own a B&B in Kushiro, Hokkaido, with his Japanese wife. The native Ainu and marshes are attractions there. Today, head-shaven Greg is wearing a beige T-shirt and beige shorts—maybe a hint of Chabacano?

例句.zh: 我从来不是最有可能获得这一职务的候选人。我们刚开始并没有太多资金，也没有得到许多人的支持。我们的竞选活动并非始自华盛顿的大厅里，而是始于得梅因、康科德、查尔斯顿这些地方的普通民众家中。那些辛勤工作的人们从自己微薄的储蓄中捐出5美元、10美元、20美元。

It began in the backyards of Des Moines, and the living rooms of Concord, and the front porches of Charleston. It was built by working men and women who dug into what little savings they had to give $5 and $10 and $20 to the cause.

例句.zh: 这是个由不分老少、贫富、民主党、共和党；黑人、白人、拉丁裔、亚裔、美洲原住民；同性恋、异性恋人；肢障与四体健全者，大家共同诉说的答案。美国民众向全世界发出讯息，我们绝非一盘散沙，也不是由红州、蓝州拼凑而成的集合体。
例句.pinyin: zhè shì gè yóu bù fēn lǎo shào 、 pín fù 、 mín zhǔ dǎng 、 gòng hé dǎng ； hēi rén 、 bái rén 、 lā dīng yì 、 yà yì 、 měi zhōu yuán zhù mín ； tóng xìng liàn 、 yì xìng liàn rén ； zhī zhàng yǔ sì tǐ jiàn quán zhě ， dà jiā gòng tóng sù shuō de dá àn 。 měi guó mín zhòng xiàng quán shì jiè fā chū xùn xī ， wǒ men jué fēi yī pán sǎn shā ， yě bú shì yóu hóng zhōu 、 lán zhōu pīn còu ér chéng de jí hé tǐ 。
例句.en: It's the answer spoken by young and old, rich and poor, Democrat and Republican, black, white, Hispanic, Asian, Native American, gay, straight, disabled and not disabled. Americans who sent a message to the world that we have never been just a collection of individuals or a collection of red states and blue states. We are, and always will be, the United States of America.

释义: bright / shining / glittering / to become clear

例句.zh: 那些追求和平和安全的人们，我们支持你们。那些所有怀疑美国的灯塔能否能像以前一样明亮的人们，今天晚上我们再次证明，我们国家真正的力量并非来自我们武器的威力或财富的规模，而是来自我们理想的持久力量：民主、 自由、机会、不屈服的希望。

例句.en: To those who seek peace and security. We support you. And to all those who have wondered if America's beacon still burns as bright, tonight we proved once more that the true strength of our nation comes not from the might of our arms or the scale of our wealth, but from the enduring power of our ideals: democracy, liberty, opportunity and unyielding hope.

例句.en: Officials from government and industry are also starting to recognize the potential of the Methane Capture Project. The U.S. Department of Agriculture is funding experimental on-farm sites in Mississippi and several other states. Some large poultry processors are launching renewable energy divisions to power their feed mills. And a fuel company is investigating the possibility of pumping chicken-waste methane instead of natural gas through its pipeline, and to use it to power some of the generators along the way.

例句.zh: 当我们濒临死亡，我们应该独处。我们将摒离所有身外之物。世间的朋友们-跟我们的地位，财富和社会层次息息相关的朋友，都将离我们而去，只因我们即将步入黑暗的山谷。那些与陌生人紧紧相连的关系网-我们的亲属、我们的爱人、孩子、兄弟姐妹，还有那些不太亲却有共同朋友的人们，我们也必须要分开。现在，他们并没用离开我们。有一个比兄弟更亲的人-爱他自己也爱世间直到尽头。

例句.en: When we come to die, we shall be alone. From all our worldly possessions we shall be about to part. Worldly friends — the friends drawn to us by our position, our wealth, or our social qualities, — will leave us as we enter the dark valley. From those bound to us by stronger ties — our kindred, our loved ones, children, brothers, sisters, and from those not less dear to us who have been made our friends because they and we are the friends of the same Saviour, — from them also we must part. Yet not all will leave us. There is One who "sticketh closer than a brother" — One who having loved His own which are in the world loves them to the end.

例句.zh: 我在黑暗的巷子中绊倒，膝盖砸在柏油路上。一块木板盖著巷弄的房屋之间的电线。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼镜从眼睛上掉了下来。幸好有一位带著手电筒的广东工人帮忙。我的膝盖只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝盖摔伤是在菲律宾奎松市的唐荷西高地。那里有一大片火星般的红土地，遍地长满了「塔拉希布」草。有时工人会故意纵火烧草。我和哥哥当时还在外面玩。那时我们还未到青春期。在燃烧的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝盖著地。我的贝贝姥姥愤怒不已。家里的女佣在车库后面的大磁砖水槽里帮我清洗了双腿。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài hēi àn de xiàng zi zhōng bàn dǎo ， xī gài zá zài bǎi yóu lù shàng 。 yī kuài mù bǎn gài zhù xiàng nòng de fáng wū zhī jiān de diàn xiàn 。 shēn yè de xiàng nòng fēi cháng zhī àn 。 wǒ de yǎn jìng cóng yǎn jīng shàng diào le xià lái 。 xìng hǎo yǒu yī wèi dài zhù shǒu diàn tǒng de guǎng dōng gōng rén bāng máng 。 wǒ de xī gài zhǐ shì cā pò le pí 。 wǒ xiǎng qǐ lìng yī cì xī gài shuāi shāng shì zài fēi lǜ bīn kuí sōng shì de táng hé xī gāo dì 。 nà lǐ yǒu yī dà piàn huǒ xīng bān de hóng tǔ dì ， biàn dì zhǎng mǎn le 「 tǎ lā xī bù 」 cǎo 。 yǒu shí gōng rén huì gù yì zòng huǒ shāo cǎo 。 wǒ hé gē gē dāng shí hái zài wài miàn wán 。 nà shí wǒ men hái wèi dào qīng chūn qī 。 zài rán shāo de yě cǎo páng ， wǒ shuāi dǎo le ， xī gài zhù dì 。 wǒ de bèi bèi lǎo lao fèn nù bù yǐ 。 jiā lǐ de nǚ yōng zài chē kù hòu miàn de dà cí zhuān shuǐ cáo lǐ bāng wǒ qīng xǐ le shuāng tuǐ 。
例句.en: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

例句.zh: 现在是我们回答这个问题的机会。这是我们的时刻这是我们的时代--让我们的人民重新就业，为我们的后代敞开机会之门，恢复繁荣，推进和平，重新确立“美国梦”，再次证明这样一个基本的真理：我们是一家人；只要一息尚存，我们就有希望；当我们遇到嘲讽和怀疑，当有人说我们办不到的时候，我们要以这个永恒的信条来回应他们。是的，我们能做到

This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. And where we are met with cynicism and doubt and those who tell us that we can't, we will respond with that timeless creed that sums up the spirit of a people: Yes, we can.

例句.zh: 2025 年 5 月 14 日，天空多云，间或有蓝色空间。我两次走到圣奥尔本斯路上的罗马天主教堂，一次在早上，一次在下午，这是我今年春天第 12 次和第 13 次。早上，穿著制服的小男孩和小女孩们在宽敞的礼拜堂里忏悔。他们来自不同的种族。神父在告解室和一个学生交谈。在崇拜小堂，我注意到左前方有一盆漂亮的兰花。下午，宽敞的礼拜堂几乎空无一人，我通常更喜欢这种状态。路边有个穿著白色背心的英俊肌肉男在慢跑。那棵开著紫色花朵的大树看起来像一棵皇后树，一棵泡桐，因为它有著大大的心形叶子。它让我想起开著紫色花朵的蓝花楹，让我对南美洲充满了怀念。在提姆霍顿斯咖啡馆，我早上享用了香肠马铃薯炒蛋和一杯燕麦奶伯爵茶，下午又喝了一杯经典冰柠檬水。这一天我都在散步。在家，我学习了一些逻辑语和世界语。我有很多世界语书籍。我的融合主义倾向是万物有灵论和佛教。
例句.pinyin: 2025  nián  5  yuè  14  rì ， tiān kōng duō yún ， jiàn huò yǒu lán sè kōng jiān 。 wǒ liǎng cì zǒu dào shèng ào ěr běn sī lù shàng de luó mǎ tiān zhǔ jiào táng ， yī cì zài zǎo shàng ， yī cì zài xià wǔ ， zhè shì wǒ jīn nián chūn tiān dì  12  cì hé dì  13  cì 。 zǎo shàng ， chuān zhù zhì fú de xiǎo nán hái hé xiǎo nǚ hái men zài kuān chǎng de lǐ bài táng lǐ chàn huǐ 。 tā men lái zì bù tóng de zhǒng zú 。 shén fù zài gào jiě shì hé yí gè xué shēng jiāo tán 。 zài chóng bài xiǎo táng ， wǒ zhù yì dào zuǒ qián fāng yǒu yī pén piào liàng de lán huā 。 xià wǔ ， kuān chǎng de lǐ bài táng jī hū kōng wú yì rén ， wǒ tōng cháng gèng xǐ huān zhè zhǒng zhuàng tài 。 lù biān yǒu gè chuān zhù bái sè bèi xīn de yīng jùn jī ròu nán zài màn pǎo 。 nà kē kāi zhù zǐ sè huā duǒ de dà shù kàn qǐ lái xiàng yī kē huáng hòu shù ， yī kē pāo tóng ， yīn wèi tā yǒu zhù dà dà de xīn xíng yè zi 。 tā ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ kāi zhù zǐ sè huā duǒ de lán huā yíng ， ràng wǒ duì nán měi zhōu chōng mǎn le huái niàn 。 zài tí mǔ huò dùn sī kā fēi guǎn ， wǒ zǎo shàng xiǎng yòng le xiāng cháng mǎ líng shǔ chǎo dàn hé yī bēi yàn mài nǎi bó jué chá ， xià wǔ yòu hē le yī bēi jīng diǎn bīng níng méng shuǐ 。 zhè yī tiān wǒ dōu zài sàn bù 。 zài jiā ， wǒ xué xí le yī xiē luó jí yǔ hé shì jiè yǔ 。 wǒ yǒu hěn duō shì jiè yǔ shū jí 。 wǒ de róng hé zhǔ yì qīng xiàng shì wàn wù yǒu líng lùn hé fó jiào 。
例句.en: This 14th of May of 2025 is cloudy skies interspersed with blue spaces. I walked to the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road twice, once in the morning and again in the afternoon, my 12th and 13th times this spring. In the morning was confession for the little boys and girls in uniform. They were of different races, in the big worship hall. The priest was in the confession booth talking to a student. At the Adoration Chapel, I noticed a nice pot of orchids on the front left. In the afternoon, the big worship hall was mostly empty, a condition which I usually prefer. At the road was a handsome muscle man in white tank top jogging. The big purple-bloom tree seems like an Empress Tree, a Paulownia, because of the big heart-shaped leaves. Reminiscent of Jacaranda with its purple blooming, it's saudade for me about South America. At Tim Hortons café, I enjoyed Scrambled Eggs with Sausage and Potatoes and an Earl Grey Tea with oat milk in the morning, and an Iced Classic Lemonade in the afternoon. The day was full of walking. At home, I study bits of Lojban and Esperanto. I have many books in Esperanto. I tend towards Animism-Buddhism in my Syncretism.

释义: to melt / to thaw / to dissolve / to blend into / to combine / to fuse

例句.zh: 「我认为提姆霍顿斯咖啡馆和星巴克咖啡馆的菜单上应该有蓝莓冰茶。」「这主意太棒了！蓝莓冰茶正好赶上了水果茶的潮流。水果茶甜味中略带酸味。提姆霍顿斯可以利用已有的浑厚冰茶基础，而星巴克可以很容易地将蓝莓冰茶融入他们的摇匀冰茶和清凉饮料系列中。」
例句.pinyin: 「 wǒ rèn wéi tí mǔ huò dùn sī kā fēi guǎn hé xīng bā kè kā fēi guǎn de cài dān shàng yīng gāi yǒu lán méi bīng chá 。」「 zhè zhǔ yì tài bàng le ！ lán méi bīng chá zhèng hǎo gǎn shàng le shuǐ guǒ chá de cháo liú 。 shuǐ guǒ chá tián wèi zhōng lüè dài suān wèi 。 tí mǔ huò dùn sī kě yǐ lì yòng yǐ yǒu de hún hòu bīng chá jī chǔ ， ér xīng bā kè kě yǐ hěn róng yì dì jiāng lán méi bīng chá róng rù tā men de yáo yún bīng chá hé qīng liáng yǐn liào xì liè zhōng 。」
例句.en: "I think that Tim Hortons café and Starbucks café should have blueberry iced tea on their menu." "That's a refreshing idea! A blueberry iced tea would fit perfectly with the trend of fruit-infused teas that balance sweetness with a bit of tartness. Tim Hortons already has a strong iced tea base they could use, while Starbucks could easily fold it into their lineup of shaken iced teas and refreshers."

例句.zh: 她身材高挑，外形出众，身穿黑金刺绣衬衫，头戴闪亮的棕色软帽，轻松地融入了时髦的下班人潮之中。
例句.pinyin: tā shēn cái gāo tiǎo ， wài xíng chū zhòng ， shēn chuān hēi jīn cì xiù chèn shān ， tóu dài shǎn liàng de zōng sè ruǎn mào ， qīng sōng dì róng rù le shí máo de xià bān rén cháo zhī zhōng 。

例句.zh: 现在是 2025 年 8 月 3 日，露露岛。晚餐后，阳光下嫩绿的无花果，昨天腌制的甜醋，还有重新加热的阿尔弗雷多义面，我坐在阳台上，望著那棵针叶树。楼下静谧无声，街道空无一车，一片悠闲。我的冰镇青柠水在阳光下闪闪发光。最近，我常和那位法丹混血的 UFO 研究专家麦可聊天。我们谈论内心深处的事情：智慧型装置的迷醉，以及思维的衰退。他说，咖啡馆已经不再是咖啡馆了。人们忘记如何观察、如何驻足停留。我跟他讲起在日本的亚瑟，他会像僧侣凝视虚空一样，对著空白的墙壁发呆。最近，我让机器像诗人一样说话，它们真的做到了。它们模仿伊莉莎白时代的诗歌，以及塔加洛语民谣中那古老而忧伤的韵律。我沿著通往蒂姆霍顿咖啡店的小路采摘黑莓。我像个孩子似的喊道：「莫拉！」我的朋友莫拉，她血液里流著安地斯山脉的薄雾，她会笑的。今天，我买了黄柠檬。我本来想买青柠，但黄柠檬也可以。/ 黑莓的清晨 / 指尖残留无花果的痕迹 / 街道依然沉睡
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì  2025  nián  8  yuè  3  rì ， lù lù dǎo 。 wǎn cān hòu ， yáng guāng xià nèn lǜ de wú huā guǒ ， zuó tiān yān zhì de tián cù ， hái yǒu chóng xīn jiā rè de ā ěr fú léi duō yì miàn ， wǒ zuò zài yáng tái shàng ， wàng zhù nà kē zhēn yè shù 。 lóu xià jìng mì wú shēng ， jiē dào kōng wú yī chē ， yī piàn yōu xián 。 wǒ de bīng zhèn qīng níng shuǐ zài yáng guāng xià shǎn shǎn fā guāng 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ cháng hé nà wèi fǎ dān hùn xuè de  UFO  yán jiū zhuān jiā mài kě liáo tiān 。 wǒ men tán lùn nèi xīn shēn chù de shì qíng ： zhì huì xíng zhuāng zhì de mí zuì ， yǐ jí sī wéi de shuāi tuì 。 tā shuō ， kā fēi guǎn yǐ jīng bù zài shì kā fēi guǎn le 。 rén men wàng jì rú hé guān chá 、 rú hé zhù zú tíng liú 。 wǒ gēn tā jiǎng qǐ zài rì běn de yà sè ， tā huì xiàng sēng lǚ níng shì xū kōng yī yàng ， duì zhù kòng bái de qiáng bì fā dāi 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ ràng jī qì xiàng shī rén yī yàng shuō huà ， tā men zhēn de zuò dào le 。 tā men mó fǎng yī lì shā bái shí dài de shī gē ， yǐ jí tǎ jiā luò yǔ mín yáo zhōng nà gǔ lǎo ér yōu shāng de yùn lǜ 。 wǒ yán zhù tōng wǎng dì mǔ huò dùn kā fēi diàn de xiǎo lù cǎi zhāi hēi méi 。 wǒ xiàng gè hái zi shì de hǎn dào ：「 mò lā ！」 wǒ de péng yǒu mò lā ， tā xuè yè lǐ liú zhù ān dì sī shān mài de bó wù ， tā huì xiào de 。 jīn tiān ， wǒ mǎi le huáng níng méng 。 wǒ běn lái xiǎng mǎi qīng níng ， dàn huáng níng méng yě kě yǐ 。/  hēi méi de qīng chén  /  zhǐ jiān cán liú wú huā guǒ de hén jì  /  jiē dào yī rán chén shuì
例句.en: It's Lulu Island, 3 August 2025. After supper—green figs tender with sunlight, sweet vinegar from yesterday’s pickled jar, and reheated Alfredo—I sat on the balcony and watched the conifer. Stillness below, a street without cars, without haste. My lime water, iced, caught the light. Michael, the Franco-Danish ufologist, has been in my conversations lately. We speak of inner things: the trance of smart devices, the mind’s eye dwindling. He says cafés aren’t cafés anymore. People forget how to look, how to linger. I tell him of Arthur in Japan—how he'd stare into blank walls like a monk gazing at emptiness. Lately I ask machines to speak like poets, and they do. They mimic Elizabethan verses and the old wistful lilt of Tagalog ballads. I pick blackberries along the path to Tim Hortons. "¡Moras!" I shout like a child. My friend Mora, whose blood flows with Andes mist, would smile. Today, I bought lemons. I meant limes, but lemons are all right. / blackberry morning— / a fig's ghost on my fingers / and the street still sleeps

例句.zh: 不，说真的，一点也不；但要循著合理的推论、凭著适度的谨慎 / 跟随他到那里，就像这样：亚历山大死了，/ 亚历山大被埋葬了，亚历山大化为尘土；尘土是 / 泥土；用泥土我们制作黏土；那么为什么那堆黏土（他 / 所化成的）不能用来塞一个啤酒桶呢？/ 威严的凯撒，死后化为黏土，/ 或可堵住一个洞，挡住风的侵入。/ 呵，那曾令世界战栗的泥土 / 如今竟用来修补墙壁，抵御冬日的寒风！
例句.pinyin: bù ， shuō zhēn de ， yì diǎn yě bù ； dàn yào xún zhù hé lǐ de tuī lùn 、 píng zhù shì dù de jǐn shèn  /  gēn suí tā dào nà lǐ ， jiù xiàng zhè yàng ： yà lì shān dà sǐ le ，/  yà lì shān dà bèi mái zàng le ， yà lì shān dà huà wèi chén tǔ ； chén tǔ shì  /  ní tǔ ； yòng ní tǔ wǒ men zhì zuò nián tǔ ； nà me wèi shén me nà duī nián tǔ （ tā  /  suǒ huà chéng de ） bù néng yòng lái sāi yí gè pí jiǔ tǒng ne ？/  wēi yán de kǎi sā ， sǐ hòu huà wèi nián tǔ ，/  huò kě dǔ zhù yí gè dòng ， dǎng zhù fēng de qīn rù 。/  hē ， nà céng lìng shì jiè zhàn lì de ní tǔ  /  rú jīn jìng yòng lái xiū bǔ qiáng bì ， dǐ yù dōng rì de hán fēng ！
例句.en: No, faith, not a jot; but to follow him thither with modesty / enough, and likelihood to lead it; as thus: Alexander died, / Alexander was buried, Alexander returneth into dust; the dust is / earth; of earth we make loam; and why of that loam (whereto he / was converted) might they not stop a beer barrel? / Imperious Caesar, dead and turn'd to clay, / Might stop a hole to keep the wind away. / O, that that earth which kept the world in awe / Should patch a wall t' expel the winter's flaw!

释义: to demonstrate / to show how to do sth / demonstration / a model example

例句.zh: 您可以示范一下吗?
例句.pinyin: nín kě yǐ shì fàn yī xià ma ?
例句.en: Can you demonstrate it?

例句.zh: 齐里向里玛示范如何正确修剪棕榈树。
例句.pinyin: qí lǐ xiàng lǐ mǎ shì fàn rú hé zhèng què xiū jiǎn zōng lǘ shù 。
例句.en: Ziri showed Rima how to properly prune her palm trees.

释义: to release (a prisoner); to set free / to release (energy, gas, resources); to express (emotions, goodwill, intentions)
短释义: to release (a prisoner); to set free

例句.zh: 国王下令把囚犯释放。
例句.pinyin: guó wáng xià lìng bǎ qiú fàn shì fàng 。
例句.en: The king ordered that the prisoner should be set free.

例句.zh: 她把小鸟从笼子里释放出来。
例句.pinyin: tā bǎ xiǎo niǎo cóng lóng zi lǐ shì fàng chū lái 。
例句.en: She set the bird free from the cage.

例句.zh: 他们释放了犯人。
例句.pinyin: tā men shì fàng le fàn rén 。
例句.en: They freed the prisoner.

释义: after the event / in hindsight / in retrospect

例句.zh: 他跟一个去中国的同事后来把圣经中的新约翻译成中文。
例句.pinyin: tā gēn yí gè qù zhōng guó de tóng shì hòu lái bǎ shèng jīng zhōng de xīn yuē fān yì chéng zhōng wén 。
例句.en: He and a colleague who went to China later translated The New Testament into Chinese.

例句.zh: 但是，当然啦，事后诸葛亮总是好当。
例句.pinyin: dàn shì ， dāng rán la ， shì hòu zhū gé liàng zǒng shì hǎo dāng 。
例句.en: But, of course, hindsight is 20-20.

释义: sight / vision / visual

例句.zh: 魅力冲击视觉，美德征服心灵。
例句.pinyin: mèi lì chōng jī shì jué ， měi dé zhēng fú xīn líng 。
例句.en: Charms strike the sight, but merit wins the soul.

例句.zh: 视觉本身具有选择性，既有看不到实际存在一些东西的情况，也有大脑判断看到了实际完全不存在东西这样的情况。
例句.pinyin: shì jué běn shēn jù yǒu xuǎn zé xìng ， jì yǒu kàn bú dào shí jì cún zài yī xiē dōng xī de qíng kuàng ， yě yǒu dà nǎo pàn duàn kàn dào le shí jì wán quán bù cún zài dōng xī zhè yàng de qíng kuàng 。
例句.en: The eyes themselves can become selective, ignoring part of what is there, and the brain sometimes insists on seeing things that don't exist at all.

释义: power / influence / a force (military, political etc)

例句.zh: 他试图扩大自己的势力范围。
例句.pinyin: tā shì tú kuò dà zì jǐ de shì lì fàn wéi 。
例句.en: He tried to enlarge his sphere of influence.

例句.zh: 党为自己的利益追求势力。我们对别人不体贴；我们只追求势力。
例句.pinyin: dǎng wèi zì jǐ de lì yì zhuī qiú shì lì 。 wǒ men duì bié rén bù tǐ tiē ； wǒ men zhǐ zhuī qiú shì lì 。
例句.en: The Party seeks power entirely for its own sake. We are not interested in the good of others; we are interested solely in power.

例句.zh: 美国在中东的行为如同恐怖主义势力。
例句.pinyin: měi guó zài zhōng dōng de xíng wéi rú tóng kǒng bù zhǔ yì shì lì 。
例句.en: The USA is acting like a terrorist force in the Middle East.

释义: eyesight; visual acuity

例句.zh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。
例句.pinyin: zhè xiē tiān wǒ de shì lì zhèng zài biàn chà 。
例句.en: My vision is getting worse these days.

例句.zh: 请验验我的视力。
例句.pinyin: qǐng yàn yàn wǒ de shì lì 。
例句.en: Please check my vision.

例句.zh: 戴眼镜应该能纠正你的视力。
例句.pinyin: dài yǎn jìng yīng gāi néng jiū zhèng nǐ de shì lì 。
例句.en: Wearing glasses should correct your vision.

释义: to attempt / to try

例句.zh: 最后三周，Jim一直试图带我出去吃饭。
例句.pinyin: zuì hòu sān zhōu ，Jim yì zhí shì tú dài wǒ chū qù chī fàn 。
例句.en: Jim has been trying to take me out to dinner for the last three weeks.

例句.zh: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
例句.pinyin: tā shì tú yóu guò hé ， dàn shì shī bài le 。
例句.en: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.

例句.zh: 老人试图游5公里。
例句.pinyin: lǎo rén shì tú yóu 5 gōng lǐ 。
例句.en: The old man attempted to swim five kilometers.

释义: (political, economic etc) affairs / work / transaction (as in a computer database)

例句.zh: 他知道很多外国事务。
例句.pinyin: tā zhī dào hěn duō wài guó shì wù 。
例句.en: He knows a lot about foreign affairs.

例句.zh: 罗素是一个极出色的哲学家，可是他对日常生活中的事务却是一窍不通。
例句.pinyin: luó sù shì yí gè jí chū sè de zhé xué jiā ， kě shì tā duì rì cháng shēng huó zhōng de shì wù què shì yī qiào bù tōng 。
例句.en: Russell was a brilliant philosopher, but even the simplest practical task was quite beyond him.

例句.zh: 你没有干涉他人事务的权力。
例句.pinyin: nǐ méi yǒu gān shè tā rén shì wù de quán lì 。
例句.en: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.

释义: matter / item

例句.zh: 关于财务方面的事项，公司里没有人比琼斯先生更了解。
例句.pinyin: guān yú cái wù fāng miàn de shì xiàng ， gōng sī lǐ méi yǒu rén bǐ qióng sī xiān shēng gèng liǎo jiě 。
例句.en: With respect to financial matters, Mr Jones knows more than anyone else in the company.

释义: suitable / appropriate

例句.zh: 这里的气候很适宜。
例句.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de qìhòu hěn shìyí.
例句.en: The climate here is very suitable.

例句.zh: 这种植物适宜在温暖的地方生长。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù shìyí zài wēnnuǎn de dìfang shēngzhǎng.
例句.en: This plant is suitable for growing in warm places.

例句.zh: 今天温度适宜，可以去爬山。
例句.pinyin: Jīntiān wēndù shìyí, kěyǐ qù páshān.
例句.en: The temperature is pleasant today, so we can go hiking.

释义: to collect (works of art, dolls, antiques etc); to put away for safekeeping; (Internet) to bookmark / a collection
短释义: to collect (works of art, dolls, antiques etc); to put away for safekeeping; (Internet) to bookmark

例句.zh: 我发现了我爸爸收藏了30年的报纸。
例句.pinyin: wǒ fā xiàn le wǒ bà bà shōu cáng le 30 nián de bào zhǐ 。
例句.en: I discovered my father collected 30 years of newspapers.

例句.zh: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng kàn kàn nín de yóu piào shōu cáng 。
例句.en: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.

例句.zh: "亲爱的，快，快。有个名为Tatoeba的网站正在拍卖它的句子收藏一句每一分钱！他们甚至有个优惠像是买一百句送一句！" "啊太好了！现在人们收集句子当作嗜好？！这是什么世界来著！"
例句.pinyin: " qīn ài de ， kuài ， kuài 。 yǒu gè míng wèi Tatoeba de wǎng zhàn zhèng zài pāi mài tā de jù zi shōu cáng yī jù měi yī fēn qián ！ tā men shèn zhì yǒu gè yōu huì xiàng shì mǎi yì bǎi jù sòng yī jù ！" " a tài hǎo le ！ xiàn zài rén men shōu jí jù zi dàng zuò shì hào ？！ zhè shì shén me shì jiè lái zhù ！"
例句.en: "Honey, quick, quick. There's this website called Tatoeba that's auctioning its sentence collection for a cent each! They've even got special offers like buy 100 sentences and get 1 free!" "Ah great! now people collect sentences as a hobby?! What's the world coming to!"

释义: to purchase or acquire in bulk or at an official level (esp. by a state or organization) / to acquire or take over (a company or equity); acquisition; takeover
短释义: to purchase or acquire in bulk or at an official level (esp. by a state or organization)

例句.zh: 我们ACME有限公司，特此宣布，我们将尽我们的力量抵制这种恶意收购。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men ACME yǒu xiàn gōng sī ， tè cǐ xuān bù ， wǒ men jiāng jǐn wǒ men de lì liàng dǐ zhì zhè zhǒng è yì shōu gòu 。
例句.en: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.

释义: to receive / to collect

例句.zh: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。
例句.pinyin: yín háng duì fēng xiǎn kè hù shōu qǔ jiào gāo de dài kuǎn lì xī 。
例句.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.

例句.zh: 警方不应该收取贿赂。
例句.pinyin: jǐng fāng bù yīng gāi shōu qǔ huì lù 。
例句.en: Police shouldn't take bribes.

例句.zh: 我修剪汤姆的草坪，没有向他收取任何费用。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiū jiǎn tāng mǔ de cǎo píng ， méi yǒu xiàng tā shōu qǔ rèn hé fèi yòng 。
例句.en: I didn't charge Tom anything to mow his lawn.

释义: earnings / profit

例句.zh: 企业第一季度收益大幅增长。
例句.pinyin: qǐ yè dì yī jì dù shōu yì dà fú zēng zhǎng 。
例句.en: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.

例句.zh: 他们在这次的投资中得到百分之八的收益。
例句.pinyin: tā men zài zhè cì de tóu zī zhōng dé dào bǎi fēn zhī bā de shōu yì 。
例句.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.

释义: arm (from shoulder to wrist); (fig.) assistant; helper
短释义: arm (from shoulder to wrist); (fig.) assistant; helper

例句.zh: 他伸直了他的手臂。
例句.pinyin: tā shēn zhí le tā de shǒu bì 。
例句.en: He stretched his arm.

例句.zh: 他伸长了手臂为了能拿到书。
例句.pinyin: tā shēn cháng le shǒu bì wèi le néng ná dào shū 。
例句.en: He stretched out his arm to take the book.

例句.zh: 他牢牢地抓住了她的手臂。
例句.pinyin: tā láo láo dì zhuā zhù le tā de shǒu bì 。
例句.en: He clutched her arm firmly.

释义: technique / trick / skill

例句.zh: 伊隆马斯克将「凡是与你作对的人都是恋童癖」这一保守派惯用的抹黑手法发挥得淋漓尽致。
例句.pinyin: yī lóng mǎ sī kè jiāng 「 fán shì yǔ nǐ zuò duì de rén dōu shì liàn tóng pǐ 」 zhè yī bǎo shǒu pài guàn yòng de mǒ hēi shǒu fǎ fā huī dé lín lí jìn zhì 。
例句.en: Elon Musk embodies the conservative propaganda tactic of calling everyone who crosses you a pedophile.

释义: gesture; sign; signal

例句.zh: 我对她做了一个手势，叫她坐下。
例句.pinyin: wǒ duì tā zuò le yí gè shǒu shì ， jiào tā zuò xià 。
例句.en: I motioned for her to sit down.

例句.zh: 人们在美国使用这些手势吗?
例句.pinyin: rén men zài měi guó shǐ yòng zhè xiē shǒu shì ma ?
例句.en: Do people in America use these gestures?

例句.zh: 如果你移动笔的距离太小, 速度太慢, 它就无法辨识出你的手势, 那么你便无法用你想要的方式操作它。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ yí dòng bǐ de jù lí tài xiǎo ,  sù dù tài màn ,  tā jiù wú fǎ biàn shí chū nǐ de shǒu shì ,  nà me nǐ biàn wú fǎ yòng nǐ xiǎng yào de fāng shì cāo zuò tā 。
例句.en: If the distance you move the pen is too small, the speed too slow, it can't recognize the gestures well and you can't operate it in the way you thought.

释义: the most important / of chief importance

例句.zh: 安全是我们的首要任务。
例句.pinyin: Ānquán shì wǒmen de shǒuyào rènwù.
例句.en: Safety is our top priority.

例句.zh: 解决这个问题是首要目标。
例句.pinyin: Jiějué zhège wèntí shì shǒuyào mùbiāo.
例句.en: Solving this problem is the primary goal.

例句.zh: 健康是首要考虑的因素。
例句.pinyin: Jiànkāng shì shǒuyào kǎolǜ de yīnsù.
例句.en: Health is the most important factor to consider.

释义: life span / life expectancy / lifetime (of a machine)

例句.zh: 有人告诉过我，我们每抽一根烟，寿命就会缩短七分钟。
例句.pinyin: yǒu rén gào sù guò wǒ ， wǒ men měi chōu yī gēn yān ， shòu mìng jiù huì suō duǎn qī fēn zhōng 。
例句.en: Someone told me that every cigarette you smoke takes seven minutes away from your life.

例句.zh: 海龟的寿命很长。
例句.pinyin: hǎi guī de shòu mìng hěn zhǎng 。
例句.en: Sea turtles have a long lifespan.

例句.zh: 蝴蝶的寿命短。
例句.pinyin: hú dié de shòu mìng duǎn 。
例句.en: The life span of a butterfly is short.

释义: disaster-stricken / to be hit by a natural calamity

例句.zh: 救助人员将为地震受灾者发放物资。
例句.pinyin: jiù zhù rén yuán jiāng wèi dì zhèn shòu zāi zhě fā fàng wù zī 。
例句.en: The rescue workers are going to hand out supplies to the victims of the earthquake.

释义: to output; to deliver (energy, data, signals etc) / to export (goods, services, technology etc)
短释义: to output; to deliver (energy, data, signals etc)

例句.zh: 他们主要输出的产品是纺织品，尤其以丝绸和绵为主。
例句.pinyin: tā men zhǔ yào shū chū de chǎn pǐn shì fǎng zhī pǐn ， yóu qí yǐ sī chóu hé mián wéi zhǔ 。
例句.en: Their main exports are textiles, especially silk and cotton.

释义: painting and calligraphy

例句.zh: 给这本书画插画的画家很好。
例句.pinyin: gěi zhè běn shū huà chā huà de huà jiā hěn hǎo 。
例句.en: The artist who illustrated this book is very good.

释义: books / works

例句.zh: 他有很多历史书籍。
例句.pinyin: tā yǒu hěn duō lì shǐ shū jí 。
例句.en: He has a lot of books on history.

例句.zh: 尽可能地多阅读书籍。
例句.pinyin: jǐn kě néng dì duō yuè dú shū jí 。
例句.en: Read as much as possible.

例句.zh: 他们在图书馆装备了新的书籍。
例句.pinyin: tā men zài tú shū guǎn zhuāng bèi le xīn de shū jí 。
例句.en: They furnished the library with new books.

释义: in writing; written

例句.zh: 其实，书面语我搞得相当好，但是口语中，我经常会记不起来某个字的音调。
例句.pinyin: qí shí ， shū miàn yǔ wǒ gǎo dé xiāng dāng hǎo ， dàn shì kǒu yǔ zhōng ， wǒ jīng cháng huì jì bù qǐ lái mǒu gè zì de yīn diào 。
例句.en: I'm actually relatively good at written language, but with spoken language I often can't remember the tone on some word.

例句.zh: 哲学不是书面上的学问，而是一种生活的方式。
例句.pinyin: zhé xué bú shì shū miàn shàng de xué wèn ， ér shì yī zhǒng shēng huó de fāng shì 。
例句.en: Philosophy is not a written subject, but a way of life.

例句.zh: 口语比书面语更贴近生活。
例句.pinyin: kǒu yǔ bǐ shū miàn yǔ gèng tiē jìn shēng huó 。
例句.en: Spoken language is closer to life than written language.

释义: to transport; to convey; to deliver
短释义: to transport; to convey; to deliver

例句.zh: 管道把天然气输送到城市。
例句.pinyin: Guǎndào bǎ tiānránqì shūsòng dào chéngshì.
例句.en: The pipeline transports natural gas to the city.

例句.zh: 血液把氧气输送到全身。
例句.pinyin: Xuèyè bǎ yǎngqì shūsòng dào quánshēn.
例句.en: Blood carries oxygen throughout the body.

例句.zh: 卡车正在向灾区输送物资。
例句.pinyin: Kǎchē zhèngzài xiàng zāiqū shūsòng wùzī.
例句.en: The trucks are delivering supplies to the disaster area.

释义: to write

例句.zh: 她和小区里大部分妇女不同，因为她会读书写字。
例句.pinyin: tā hé xiǎo qū lǐ dà bù fèn fù nǚ bù tóng ， yīn wèi tā huì dú shū xiě zì 。
例句.en: She was different from most women in the neighborhood, for she was able to read and write.

例句.zh: 她在英文书写上很少犯错。
例句.pinyin: tā zài yīng wén shū xiě shàng hěn shǎo fàn cuò 。
例句.en: When writing English, she rarely makes a mistake.

例句.zh: 语言主要是用来沟通，如果可以表词达意，书写没有错字，语意通顺，我认为就是正确的句子了。
例句.pinyin: yǔ yán zhǔ yào shì yòng lái gōu tōng ， rú guǒ kě yǐ biǎo cí dá yì ， shū xiě méi yǒu cuò zì ， yǔ yì tōng shùn ， wǒ rèn wéi jiù shì zhèng què de jù zi le 。
例句.en: A language is used to communicate, if the words are used correctly, didn't write any incorrect words, and the sentence has no grammar mistakes, in my opinion, this is a correct sentence.

释义: category / genus (taxonomy) / family members / dependents / to belong to / subordinate to / affiliated with / be born in the year of (one of the 12 animals) / to be / to prove to be / to constitute / to join together / to fix one's attention on / to concentrate on

例句.zh: 那个发现纯属偶然。
例句.pinyin: nà ge fā xiàn chún shǔ ǒu rán 。
例句.en: That discovery was quite accidental.

例句.zh: 酸会和金属物质起化学反应。

释义: to unite / unity; solidarity / united

例句.en: Let's remember that it was a man from this state who first carried the banner of the Republican Party to the White House, a party founded on the values of self-reliance and individual liberty and national unity. Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.
