例句.en: I can't bend my right arm.

例句.zh: 重庆是一座丘陵的城市，道路弯弯曲曲的。
例句.pinyin: chóng qìng shì yī zuò qiū líng de chéng shì ， dào lù wān wān qū qū de 。
例句.en: Chongqing is a hilly city with winding streets.

释义: tenacious / hard to defeat

例句.zh: 尽管受到暴君的迫害，英雄还顽强地斗争。
例句.pinyin: jǐn guǎn shòu dào bào jūn de pò hài ， yīng xióng hái wán qiáng dì dòu zhēng 。
例句.en: In spite of the tyrant’s persecution, the hero valiantly carried on the struggle.

释义: all things / all that exists

例句.zh: ​我们​来​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，说​不​同​的​语言。可是，我们​十分​团结，大家​都​有​同样​的​目标。最​重要​的​是，我们​都​渴望​尊荣​耶和华，耶和华​就是​圣经​所​说​的​上帝，他​是​万物​的​创造主。我们​尽力​效法​耶稣基督，以​身​为​基督徒​为​荣。我们​每​个​人​都​常常​花​时间​帮助​别人​认识​圣经​和​上帝​的​王国。由于​我们​为​耶和华​上帝​和​他​的​王国​作​见证，也​就是​向​别人​传讲​上帝​和​他​王国​的​真理，所以​我们​称​为​耶和华见证人。
例句.pinyin: ​ wǒ men ​ lái ​ zì ​ shì jiè ​ gè ​ dì ， yǒu ​ bù ​ tóng ​ de ​ wén huà ​ bèi jǐng ， shuō ​ bù ​ tóng ​ de ​ yǔ yán 。 kě shì ， wǒ men ​ shí fēn ​ tuán jié ， dà jiā ​ dōu ​ yǒu ​ tóng yàng ​ de ​ mù biāo 。 zuì ​ zhòng yào ​ de ​ shì ， wǒ men ​ dōu ​ kě wàng ​ zūn róng ​ yē hé huá ， yē hé huá ​ jiù shì ​ shèng jīng ​ suǒ ​ shuō ​ de ​ shàng dì ， tā ​ shì ​ wàn wù ​ de ​ chuàng zào zhǔ 。 wǒ men ​ jìn lì ​ xiào fǎ ​ yē sū jī dū ， yǐ ​ shēn ​ wèi ​ jī dū tú ​ wèi ​ róng 。 wǒ men ​ měi ​ gè ​ rén ​ dōu ​ cháng cháng ​ huā ​ shí jiān ​ bāng zhù ​ bié rén ​ rèn shí ​ shèng jīng ​ hé ​ shàng dì ​ de ​ wáng guó 。 yóu yú ​ wǒ men ​ wèi ​ yē hé huá ​ shàng dì ​ hé ​ tā ​ de ​ wáng guó ​ zuò ​ jiàn zhèng ， yě ​ jiù shì ​ xiàng ​ bié rén ​ chuán jiǎng ​ shàng dì ​ hé ​ tā ​ wáng guó ​ de ​ zhēn lǐ ， suǒ yǐ ​ wǒ men ​ chēng ​ wèi ​ yē hé huá jiàn zhèng rén 。
例句.en: We come from hundreds of ethnic and language backgrounds, yet we are united by common goals. Above all, we want to honor Jehovah, the God of the Bible and the Creator of all things. We do our best to imitate Jesus Christ and are proud to be called Christians. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and God’s Kingdom. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

例句.zh: 万事万物都在上帝掌握之中。
例句.pinyin: wàn shì wàn wù dōu zài shàng dì zhǎng wò zhī zhōng 。
例句.en: All things are in the hands of God.

例句.zh: 万物真美好。
例句.pinyin: wàn wù zhēn měi hǎo 。
例句.en: The world is beautiful.

释义: prince / son of a king

例句.zh: 王子在森林中迷了路。
例句.pinyin: wáng zǐ zài sēn lín zhōng mí le lù 。
例句.en: The prince was lost in the woods.

例句.zh: 其实我想做一个被关在高塔里的少女，然后有一天，就会有一个白马王子出现，把守卫著高塔的七条龙通通杀掉，救我出来。
例句.pinyin: qí shí wǒ xiǎng zuò yí gè bèi guān zài gāo tǎ lǐ de shào nǚ ， rán hòu yǒu yī tiān ， jiù huì yǒu yí gè bái mǎ wáng zǐ chū xiàn ， bǎ shǒu wèi zhù gāo tǎ de qī tiáo lóng tōng tōng shā diào ， jiù wǒ chū lái 。
例句.en: Actually I wanted to be a damsel in a tower guarded by seven dragons, and then a prince on a white horse would chop off the dragons' heads and liberate me.

例句.zh: 我再看一次《王子复仇记》，加起来一共就看过三次了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài kàn yī cì 《 wáng zǐ fù chóu jì 》， jiā qǐ lái yī gòng jiù kàn guò sān cì le 。
例句.en: I will have read Hamlet three times if I read it again.

释义: net; web / network / to net; to catch with a net

例句.zh: 我是网球俱乐部的会员。
例句.pinyin: wǒ shì wǎng qiú jù lè bù de huì yuán 。
例句.en: I belong to a tennis club.

例句.zh: 我觉得这个网站的概念非常好。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jué de zhè ge wǎng zhàn de gài niàn fēi cháng hǎo 。
例句.en: I really like the concept of this website.

例句.zh: 你昨天早上在打网球吗？
例句.pinyin: nǐ zuó tiān zǎo shàng zài dǎ wǎng qiú ma ？
例句.en: Were you playing tennis yesterday morning?

释义: from now on / in the future / time to come

例句.zh: 请往后退一退。
例句.pinyin: qǐng wǎng hòu tuì yī tuì 。
例句.en: Please move back.

例句.zh: 请往后退一点。
例句.pinyin: qǐng wǎng hòu tuì yì diǎn 。
例句.en: Stand back, please.

例句.zh: 他们往前走而我一直都在往后退。
例句.pinyin: tā men wǎng qián zǒu ér wǒ yì zhí dōu zài wǎng hòu tuì 。
例句.en: They are going forwards and I am always going backwards.

释义: dealings / contacts / to go back and forth

例句.zh: 随著东西方之间的贸易及文化往来日渐发展，越来越多的阿拉伯和波斯商人开始沿著丝路拜访中国。
例句.pinyin: suí zhù dōng xī fāng zhī jiān de mào yì jí wén huà wǎng lái rì jiàn fā zhǎn ， yuè lái yuè duō de ā lā bó hé bō sī shāng rén kāi shǐ yán zhù sī lù bài fǎng zhōng guó 。
例句.en: As commercial and cultural contacts between East and West developed, Arab and Persian traders began calling on China along the Silk Road in increasing numbers.

释义: in former years; in previous years
短释义: in former years; in previous years

例句.zh: 往年春节，这条街总是很热闹。
例句.pinyin: Wǎngnián Chūnjié, zhè tiáo jiē zǒngshì hěn rènao.
例句.en: In previous years, this street was always bustling during the Spring Festival.

例句.zh: 今年的雨水比往年多。
例句.pinyin: Jīnnián de yǔshuǐ bǐ wǎngnián duō.
例句.en: There is more rainfall this year than in previous years.

例句.zh: 往年这个时候，山上已经下雪了。
例句.pinyin: Wǎngnián zhège shíhou, shān shàng yǐjīng xià xuě le.
例句.en: By this time in previous years, it had already snowed in the mountains.

释义: full moon / to hope / to expect / to visit / to gaze (into the distance) / to look towards / towards / 15th day of month (lunar calendar) / old variant of 望[wang4]

例句.zh: 世界上的教育都让我失望。
例句.pinyin: shì jiè shàng de jiào yù dōu ràng wǒ shī wàng 。
例句.en: Education in this world disappoints me.

例句.zh: 没有欲望就等于拥有。
例句.pinyin: méi yǒu yù wàng jiù děng yú yōng yǒu 。
例句.en: Not wanting is the same as having.

例句.zh: 她没有辜负我们的期望。
例句.pinyin: tā méi yǒu gū fù wǒ men de qī wàng 。
例句.en: She lived up to our expectations.

释义: crisis

例句.zh: 我知道你们的所做的一切并不只是为了赢得选举，我也知道你们做这一切并不是为了我。你们这样做是因为你们明白前面的任务有多么艰巨。即便我们今晚欢呼庆祝，我们也知道明天将面临我们一生之中最艰难的挑战——两场战争、一个面临危险的星球，一个世纪以来最严重的金融危机。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ men de suǒ zuò de yī qiè bìng bù zhǐ shì wèi le yíng dé xuǎn jǔ ， wǒ yě zhī dào nǐ men zuò zhè yī qiè bìng bú shì wèi le wǒ 。 nǐ men zhè yàng zuò shì yīn wèi nǐ men míng bái qián miàn de rèn wù yǒu duō me jiān jù 。 jí biàn wǒ men jīn wǎn huān hū qìng zhù ， wǒ men yě zhī dào míng tiān jiāng miàn lín wǒ men yī shēng zhī zhōng zuì jiān nán de tiǎo zhàn —— liǎng chǎng zhàn zhēng 、 yí gè miàn lín wēi xiǎn de xīng qiú ， yí gè shì jì yǐ lái zuì yán zhòng de jīn róng wēi jī 。
例句.en: And I know you didn't do this just to win an election. And I know you didn't do it for me. You did it because you understand the enormity of the task that lies ahead. For even as we celebrate tonight, we know the challenges that tomorrow will bring are the greatest of our lifetime: two wars, a planet in peril, the worst financial crisis in a century.

例句.zh: 让我们记住这一点，如果说这场金融危机教会了我们什么东西的话，那就是我们不可能在金融以外的领域处于困境的同时拥有繁荣兴旺的华尔街。
例句.pinyin: ràng wǒ men jì zhù zhè yì diǎn ， rú guǒ shuō zhè chǎng jīn róng wēi jī jiào huì le wǒ men shén me dōng xī de huà ， nà jiù shì wǒ men bù kě néng zài jīn róng yǐ wài de lǐng yù chǔ yú kùn jìng de tóng shí yōng yǒu fán róng xīng wàng de huá ěr jiē 。
例句.en: Let us remember that if this financial crisis taught us anything, it's that we cannot have a thriving Wall Street while Main Street suffers.

例句.zh: 这部有关环境危机的纪录片真是令人大开眼界。
例句.pinyin: zhè bù yǒu guān huán jìng wēi jī de jì lù piàn zhēn shì lìng rén dà kāi yǎn jiè 。
例句.en: That documentary about the environmental crisis was a real eye-opener.

释义: minute (i.e. extremely small) / infinitesimal

例句.zh: 细菌微小到无法用肉眼看到。
例句.pinyin: xì jūn wēi xiǎo dào wú fǎ yòng ròu yǎn kàn dào 。
例句.en: Bacteria are so small that they cannot be seen with the naked eye.

例句.zh: 宇航服保护宇航员们不会因和微小宇宙尘埃碰撞而受伤。
例句.pinyin: yǔ háng fú bǎo hù yǔ háng yuán men bú huì yīn hé wēi xiǎo yǔ zhòu chén āi pèng zhuàng ér shòu shāng 。
例句.en: Spacesuits protect astronauts from being injured from impacts of small bits of space dust.

例句.zh: 每一天都是一生；每一次起床醒来都是次微小的新生，每个清新的早晨都带着点青春，每次歇息和睡眠都是次小小的死亡。
例句.pinyin: měi yī tiān dōu shì yī shēng ； měi yī cì qǐ chuáng xǐng lái dōu shì cì wēi xiǎo de xīn shēng ， měi gè qīng xīn de zǎo chén dōu dài zhe diǎn qīng chūn ， měi cì xiē xī hé shuì mián dōu shì cì xiǎo xiǎo de sǐ wáng 。
例句.en: Each day is a little life; every waking and rising a little birth; every fresh morning a little youth; every going to rest and sleep a little death.

释义: to violate the rules

例句.zh: 他因违规停车被罚款了。
例句.pinyin: Tā yīn wéiguī tíngchē bèi fákuǎn le.
例句.en: He was fined for parking illegally.

例句.zh: 请勿违规操作机器。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng wù wéiguī cāozuò jīqì.
例句.en: Please do not operate the machine against the rules.

例句.zh: 这家公司多次违规排放污水。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī duō cì wéiguī páifàng wūshuǐ.
例句.en: This company has repeatedly violated regulations by discharging wastewater.

释义: to defend / to safeguard / to protect / to uphold / to maintain

例句.zh: 台湾将维护自由。
例句.pinyin: tái wān jiāng wéi hù zì yóu 。
例句.en: Taiwan will remain free!

例句.zh: 当您滔滔不绝地谈论著维护中产阶级的生活水准时，我们的父母正死于体温过低。
例句.pinyin: dāng nín tāo tāo bù jué dì tán lùn zhù wéi hù zhōng chǎn jiē jí de shēng huó shuǐ zhǔn shí ， wǒ men de fù mǔ zhèng sǐ yú tǐ wēn guò dī 。
例句.en: While you drone on about preserving the standard of living for the middle class, our parents are dying of hypothermia.

释义: to feel embarrassed or awkward / to make things difficult (for someone) / to find things difficult (to do or manage)

例句.zh: 我觉得您说的很有道理，但是依照您出的条件处理的话，我们也很为难。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jué de nín shuō de hěn yǒu dào lǐ ， dàn shì yī zhào nín chū de tiáo jiàn chǔ lǐ de huà ， wǒ men yě hěn wéi nán 。
例句.en: I think what you said makes sense, but I would rather not just follow your conditions.

例句.zh: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。
例句.pinyin: nà ge tuán tǐ wéi nán mín men tí gōng shí pǐn gōng jǐ 。
例句.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.

释义: the game of Go

例句.zh: 我不喜欢出去玩，常常在家泡壶咖啡，跟朋友下围棋象棋。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huān chū qù wán ， cháng cháng zài jiā pào hú kā fēi ， gēn péng yǒu xià wéi qí xiàng qí 。
例句.en: I don't like going out to have fun. Usually, I make my own coffee at home, and have a game of chess with a friend.

例句.zh: 我想学围棋。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng xué wéi qí 。
例句.en: I want to learn how to play "Go".

例句.zh: 孩子们下围棋，会使用5x5或者7x7的棋盘。
例句.pinyin: hái zi men xià wéi qí ， huì shǐ yòng 5x5 huò zhě 7x7 de qí pán 。
例句.en: When children play Go, they use a 5-by-5 or 7-by-7 board.

释义: (to be done) by (a certain date) / lasting (a certain time)

例句.zh: 大多数学生都在为期末考试复习。
例句.pinyin: dà duō shù xué shēng dōu zài wéi qī mò kǎo shì fù xí 。
例句.en: Most students are preparing for the final exams.

释义: vitamin

例句.zh: 胡萝卜中含有大量的维生素A。
例句.pinyin: hú luó bo zhōng hán yǒu dà liàng de wéi shēng sù A。
例句.en: Carrots contain a lot of vitamin A.

例句.zh: 柳丁含有大量的维生素 C。
例句.pinyin: liǔ dīng hán yǒu dà liàng de wéi shēng sù  C。
例句.en: Oranges contain a lot of vitamin C.

例句.zh: 橙子含有大量的维生素 C。
例句.pinyin: chéng zi hán yǒu dà liàng de wéi shēng sù  C。
例句.en: Oranges contain a lot of vitamin C.

释义: until / (used in combination with words like 到[dao4] or 至[zhi4] in constructs of the form 到...為止|到...为止)

例句.zh: 我们的任务到目前为止很轻松，但从现在开始将会变得很难。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men de rèn wù dào mù qián wéi zhǐ hěn qīng sōng ， dàn cóng xiàn zài kāi shǐ jiāng huì biàn dé hěn nán 。
例句.en: Our task has been easy so far, but it will be difficult from now on.

例句.zh: 有效期到1997年3月31日为止。
例句.pinyin: yǒu xiào qī dào 1997 nián 3 yuè 31 rì wéi zhǐ 。
例句.en: It's valid until March thirty-first, nineteen-ninety-seven.

例句.zh: 在这儿等到他回来为止。
例句.pinyin: zài zhè ér děng dào tā huí lái wéi zhǐ 。
例句.en: Wait here till he comes back.

释义: wronged; aggrieved / to inconvenience; to put (sb) at a disadvantage; to do sb wrong / sense of being wronged

例句.zh: 我没做错什么，心里很委屈。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ méi zuò cuò shénme, xīnlǐ hěn wěiqu.
例句.en: I didn't do anything wrong, so I feel very aggrieved.

例句.zh: 他受了委屈，却什么也没说。
例句.pinyin: Tā shòu le wěiqu, què shénme yě méi shuō.
例句.en: He was wronged, but he didn't say anything.

例句.zh: 为了大家，只能先委屈你了。
例句.pinyin: Wèile dàjiā, zhǐ néng xiān wěiqu nǐ le.
例句.en: For everyone's sake, we'll have to inconvenience you for now.

释义: to entrust / to trust / to commission

例句.zh: 我是个委托人。
例句.pinyin: wǒ shì gè wěi tuō rén 。
例句.en: I'm a client.

释义: not yet / did not / have not / not / 8th earthly branch: 1-3 p.m., 6th solar month (7th July-6th August), year of the Sheep / ancient Chinese compass point: 210°

例句.zh: 你不能未经允许就看别人的私人信件。
例句.pinyin: nǐ bù néng wèi jīng yǔn xǔ jiù kàn bié rén de sī rén xìn jiàn 。
例句.en: You shouldn't read other people's private letters without permission.

例句.zh: 虽然Luciano可能已经是出类拔萃，但他还是乳臭未干。
例句.pinyin: suī rán Luciano kě néng yǐ jīng shì chū lèi bá cuì ， dàn tā hái shì rǔ xiù wèi gān 。
例句.en: Luciano might have the crowd behind him, but he's still wet behind the ears.

例句.zh: 这个问题仍然未解决。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge wèn tí réng rán wèi jiě jué 。
例句.en: The problem remains unsolved.

释义: not necessarily / maybe not

例句.zh: 这些资料未必可靠。
例句.pinyin: zhè xiē zī liào wèi bì kě kào 。
例句.en: It is questionable whether this data can be relied on.

例句.zh: 这项工作未必容易。
例句.pinyin: zhè xiàng gōng zuò wèi bì róng yì 。
例句.en: This work is not necessarily easy.

例句.zh: 发光的未必都是金子。
例句.pinyin: fā guāng de wèi bì dōu shì jīn zi 。
例句.en: All that glitters is not gold.

释义: minor (i.e. person under 18)

例句.zh: 禁止向未成年人出售香烟。
例句.pinyin: Jìnzhǐ xiàng wèichéngniánrén chūshòu xiāngyān.
例句.en: Selling cigarettes to minors is prohibited.

例句.zh: 未成年人需要得到更多保护。
例句.pinyin: Wèichéngniánrén xūyào dédào gèng duō bǎohù.
例句.en: Minors need more protection.

例句.zh: 这款游戏不适合未成年人。
例句.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn yóuxì bù shìhé wèichéngniánrén.
例句.en: This game is not suitable for minors.

释义: for this reason / with regards to this / in this respect / in order to do this / to this end

例句.zh: 我的首席策略师大卫-艾克斯罗德，他一直是追随我的伙伴。你们组建了政治史上最好的竞选团队，是你们成就了今天，我永远感谢你们为此所作出的牺牲。

例句.en: Things that modify nouns (adjective, or adjectival equivalent).

释义: to link / to join / link / connection

例句.zh: 实验构造是怎样的？它们是如何相连接的？
例句.pinyin: shí yàn gòu zào shì zěn yàng de ？ tā men shì rú hé xiāng lián jiē de ？
例句.en: What did the experimental set-up look like? What was connected to what and how?

例句.zh: 当我们濒临死亡，我们应该独处。我们将摒离所有身外之物。世间的朋友们-跟我们的地位，财富和社会层次息息相关的朋友，都将离我们而去，只因我们即将步入黑暗的山谷。那些与陌生人紧紧相连的关系网-我们的亲属、我们的爱人、孩子、兄弟姐妹，还有那些不太亲却有共同朋友的人们，我们也必须要分开。现在，他们并没用离开我们。有一个比兄弟更亲的人-爱他自己也爱世间直到尽头。
例句.pinyin: dāng wǒ men bīn lín sǐ wáng ， wǒ men yīng gāi dú chǔ 。 wǒ men jiāng bǐng lí suǒ yǒu shēn wài zhī wù 。 shì jiān de péng yǒu men - gēn wǒ men de dì wèi ， cái fù hé shè huì céng cì xī xī xiāng guān de péng yǒu ， dōu jiāng lí wǒ men ér qù ， zhǐ yīn wǒ men jí jiāng bù rù hēi àn de shān gǔ 。 nà xiē yǔ mò shēng rén jǐn jǐn xiāng lián de guān xì wǎng - wǒ men de qīn shǔ 、 wǒ men de ài rén 、 hái zi 、 xiōng dì jiě mèi ， hái yǒu nà xiē bù tài qīn què yǒu gòng tóng péng yǒu de rén men ， wǒ men yě bì xū yào fēn kāi 。 xiàn zài ， tā men bìng méi yòng lí kāi wǒ men 。 yǒu yí gè bǐ xiōng dì gèng qīn de rén - ài tā zì jǐ yě ài shì jiān zhí dào jìn tóu 。
例句.en: When we come to die, we shall be alone. From all our worldly possessions we shall be about to part. Worldly friends — the friends drawn to us by our position, our wealth, or our social qualities, — will leave us as we enter the dark valley. From those bound to us by stronger ties — our kindred, our loved ones, children, brothers, sisters, and from those not less dear to us who have been made our friends because they and we are the friends of the same Saviour, — from them also we must part. Yet not all will leave us. There is One who "sticketh closer than a brother" — One who having loved His own which are in the world loves them to the end.

例句.zh: 现在，Ghouate 的村庄与世界上最大的功能雾收集项目相连，减轻了主要落在妇女身上的收集水的需要。
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài ，Ghouate  de cūn zhuāng yǔ shì jiè shàng zuì dà de gōng néng wù shōu jí xiàng mù xiāng lián ， jiǎn qīng le zhǔ yào luò zài fù nǚ shēn shàng de shōu jí shuǐ de xū yào 。
例句.en: Now Ghouate's village is connected to the world's largest functioning fog collection project, alleviating the need to collect water that fell mainly on women.

释义: perfume / cologne

例句.zh: 你知道男孩子送女孩子香水代表什么吗？
例句.pinyin: nǐ zhī dào nán hái zi sòng nǚ hái zi xiāng shuǐ dài biǎo shén me ma ？
例句.en: Do you know what it means for a man to give a woman perfume?

释义: to correspond / answering (one another) / to agree (among the part) / corresponding / relevant / appropriate / (modify) accordingly

例句.zh: 虽然我们大多数人比我们的父母、祖父母还要富裕得多，但是与之相应的快乐程度却没有多大的改变。
例句.pinyin: suī rán wǒ men dà duō shù rén bǐ wǒ men de fù mǔ 、 zǔ fù mǔ hái yào fù yù dé duō ， dàn shì yǔ zhī xiāng yìng de kuài lè chéng dù què méi yǒu duō dà de gǎi biàn 。
例句.en: While most of us are significantly better off financially than our parents and grandparents, happiness levels haven't changed to reflect that.

例句.zh: 我们会根据您提出的要求对不足之处作出相应的改正。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men huì gēn jù nín tí chū de yāo qiú duì bù zú zhī chù zuò chū xiāng yìng de gǎi zhèng 。
例句.en: We will follow your demands and make the necessary corrections to those parts that need them.

例句.zh: 我们应该了解相应的规则。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men yīng gāi liǎo jiě xiāng yìng de guī zé 。
例句.en: We are supposed to know the rules.

释义: necklace / CL:條|条[tiao2]

例句.zh: 小姐已经有一个戒指，要不要配一条铂金项链？
例句.pinyin: xiǎo jiě yǐ jīng yǒu yí gè jiè zhǐ ， yào bù yào pèi yī tiáo bó jīn xiàng liàn ？
例句.en: Mademoiselle, would you like a platinum necklace to accompany your ring?

例句.zh: 这条项链是我奶奶送给我的。
例句.pinyin: zhè tiáo xiàng liàn shì wǒ nǎi nǎi sòng gěi wǒ de 。
例句.en: My grandma gave me this necklace.

例句.zh: 在沙发下，汤姆找到了玛丽的项链。
例句.pinyin: zài shā fā xià ， tāng mǔ zhǎo dào le mǎ lì de xiàng liàn 。
例句.en: Tom found Mary's necklace under the sofa.

释义: Chinese chess / CL:副[fu4]

例句.zh: 您能教我下国际象棋吗？
例句.pinyin: nín néng jiào wǒ xià guó jì xiàng qí ma ？
例句.en: Can you teach me to play chess?

例句.zh: 他在国际象棋比赛中取得了冠军。
例句.pinyin: tā zài guó jì xiàng qí bǐ sài zhōng qǔ dé le guàn jūn 。
例句.en: He carried off the first prize at the chess tournament.

例句.zh: 我不喜欢出去玩，常常在家泡壶咖啡，跟朋友下围棋象棋。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huān chū qù wán ， cháng cháng zài jiā pào hú kā fēi ， gēn péng yǒu xià wéi qí xiàng qí 。
例句.en: I don't like going out to have fun. Usually, I make my own coffee at home, and have a game of chess with a friend.

释义: comic dialogue / sketch / crosstalk

例句.zh: 我爷爷喜欢听相声。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ yéye xǐhuan tīng xiàngsheng.
例句.en: My grandfather enjoys listening to comic dialogues.

例句.zh: 这段相声很有意思。
例句.pinyin: Zhè duàn xiàngsheng hěn yǒu yìsi.
例句.en: This comic dialogue is very interesting.

例句.zh: 他在晚会上表演了相声。
例句.pinyin: Tā zài wǎnhuì shàng biǎoyǎn le xiàngsheng.
例句.en: He performed a comic dialogue at the evening gala.

释义: to yearn for / to look forward to

例句.zh: 我向往着和她一起看那部电影.
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiàng wǎng zhe hé tā yì qǐ kàn nà bù diàn yǐng .
例句.en: I'm looking forward to seeing the film with her.

例句.zh: 没有什么可以阻挡，我对自由的向往。
例句.pinyin: méi yǒu shén me kě yǐ zǔ dǎng ， wǒ duì zì yóu de xiàng wǎng 。
例句.en: Nothing can keep me from yearning for freedom.

例句.zh: 每个人都向往幸福。
例句.pinyin: měi gè rén dōu xiàng wǎng xìng fú 。
例句.en: Everybody desires happiness.

释义: to eliminate / to remove

例句.zh: 虽然冷战已经过了这么多年，俄罗斯人和德国人之间的仇恨还是没有消除，在苏联曾经侵占过的地区，这种仇恨就更深了。
例句.pinyin: suī rán lěng zhàn yǐ jīng guò le zhè me duō nián ， é luó sī rén hé dé guó rén zhī jiān de chóu hèn hái shì méi yǒu xiāo chú ， zài sū lián céng jīng qīn zhàn guò de dì qū ， zhè zhǒng chóu hèn jiù gēng shēn le 。
例句.en: Even now, many years after the Cold War, there is still much rancor between the Russians and the Germans, especially in areas once occupied by the Soviet Union.

例句.zh: 能付出爱心就是福，能消除烦恼就是慧。
例句.pinyin: néng fù chū ài xīn jiù shì fú ， néng xiāo chú fán nǎo jiù shì huì 。
例句.en: Knowing how to love is success; knowing how to relax is wisdom.

例句.zh: 证实她顺利地过渡入皇室组织，有帮于消除这些焦虑。
例句.pinyin: zhèng shí tā shùn lì dì guò dù rù huáng shì zǔ zhī ， yǒu bāng yú xiāo chú zhè xiē jiāo lǜ 。
例句.en: Her smooth entry into the ranks of the royal family will help to dispel these fears.

释义: to disinfect; to sterilize

例句.zh: 雅尼刚刚对他的挤奶桶进行了消毒。
例句.pinyin: yǎ ní gāng gāng duì tā de jǐ nǎi tǒng jìn xíng le xiāo dú 。
例句.en: Yanni has just sterilized his milking bucket.

释义: firefighting / fire control

例句.zh: 消防车到达之前，房子就全烧了。
例句.pinyin: xiāo fáng chē dào dá zhī qián ， fáng zi jiù quán shāo le 。
例句.en: Before the fire engine arrived, the whole house had burnt down.

例句.zh: 消防员还没有赶到，那两幢大厦就已经烧成灰烬了。
例句.pinyin: xiāo fáng yuán hái méi yǒu gǎn dào ， nà liǎng chuáng dà shà jiù yǐ jīng shāo chéng huī jìn le 。
例句.en: Before the firemen were able to arrive, both buildings burned down.

例句.zh: 消防队很快就把大火扑熄。
例句.pinyin: xiāo fáng duì hěn kuài jiù bǎ dà huǒ pū xī 。
例句.en: The firemen quickly extinguished the blaze.

释义: to consume; to use up / to deplete; to expend / (old) news; mail; message

例句.zh: 美国人快餐食物的消耗量在一九七七至一九九五年间大幅增长了三倍。
例句.pinyin: měi guó rén kuài cān shí wù de xiāo hào liàng zài yī jiǔ qī qī zhì yī jiǔ jiǔ wǔ nián jiān dà fú zēng zhǎng le sān bèi 。
例句.en: In America, the consumption of fast-food has tripled between 1977 and 1995.

例句.zh: 我们消耗了所有的自然资源。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men xiāo hào le suǒ yǒu de zì rán zī yuán 。
例句.en: We have consumed all the natural resources.

例句.zh: 瑞士人消耗不少啤酒。
例句.pinyin: ruì shì rén xiāo hào bù shǎo pí jiǔ 。
例句.en: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.

释义: to put an end to / to annihilate / to cause to perish / to perish / annihilation (in quantum field theory)

例句.zh: 他们奋斗的目标是消灭天花。
例句.pinyin: tā men fèn dòu de mù biāo shì xiāo miè tiān huā 。
例句.en: They are struggling with the goal of wiping out smallpox.

例句.zh: 奥陶纪—志留纪灭绝事件消灭了近 85% 的海洋物种。
例句.pinyin: ào táo jì — zhì liú jì miè jué shì jiàn xiāo miè le jìn  85%  de hǎi yáng wù zhǒng 。
例句.en: The Ordovician-Silurian Extinction Event wiped out nearly 85% of marine species.

释义: wheat / CL:粒[li4]

例句.zh: 面粉是小麦制成的。
例句.pinyin: miàn fěn shì xiǎo mài zhì chéng de 。
例句.en: Flour is made from wheat.

例句.zh: 极目远望，除了一大片小麦田以外，就甚么也看不见了。
例句.pinyin: jí mù yuǎn wàng ， chú le yī dà piàn xiǎo mài tián yǐ wài ， jiù shén me yě kàn bú jiàn le 。
例句.en: As far as the eye could see, nothing could be seen except cornfields.

例句.zh: 面包是用小麦做成的。
例句.pinyin: miàn bāo shì yòng xiǎo mài zuò chéng de 。
例句.en: Bread is made from wheat.

释义: stingy / miserly / narrow-minded / petty

例句.zh: 不过，我从来没有在一个小气的英国家庭做过客。
例句.pinyin: bù guò ， wǒ cóng lái méi yǒu zài yí gè xiǎo qì de yīng guó jiā tíng zuò guò kè 。
例句.en: However, I've never been a guest in an English household that wasn't generous.

例句.zh: 那个人那么小气，连谷壳都不让老鼠吃。
例句.pinyin: nà ge rén nà me xiǎo qì ， lián gǔ ké dōu bù ràng lǎo shǔ chī 。
例句.en: That person's so stingy that he won't even let the mouse have the chaff.

例句.zh: 他勤俭节约，甚至是小气的。
例句.pinyin: tā qín jiǎn jié yuē ， shèn zhì shì xiǎo qì de 。
例句.en: He is thrifty, not to say stingy.

释义: erhua form of 小偷[xiao3 tou1]
短释义: erhua form of 小偷[xiao3 tou1]

例句.zh: 那个小偷儿被警察抓住了。
例句.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōur bèi jǐngchá zhuāzhù le.
例句.en: That thief was caught by the police.

例句.zh: 小偷儿偷走了我的钱包。
例句.pinyin: Xiǎotōur tōuzǒu le wǒ de qiánbāo.
例句.en: The thief stole my wallet.

例句.zh: 我看见一个小偷儿跑出了商店。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ kànjiàn yí ge xiǎotōur pǎo chū le shāngdiàn.
例句.en: I saw a thief run out of the store.

释义: smile / smiling expression / CL:副[fu4]

例句.zh: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。
例句.pinyin: zhǐ yào tīng dào zhè shǒu gē ， wǒ jiù huì xiǎng qǐ tā men de xiào róng 。
例句.en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.

例句.zh: 她说再见的时候，脸上挂著笑容，但其实心中是十分难受的。
例句.pinyin: tā shuō zài jiàn de shí hòu ， liǎn shàng guà zhù xiào róng ， dàn qí shí xīn zhōng shì shí fēn nán shòu de 。
例句.en: She said good-bye with a smile, but there was a good deal of bitterness in her heart.

例句.zh: 我们上班时的情绪，就像坐过山车一样 ﹣ 老板脸上一现出不悦的神色，我们就要吃苦头；老板脸上有了笑容，我们才能松一口气。这样的工作，我不想再干下去了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men shàng bān shí de qíng xù ， jiù xiàng zuò guò shān chē yī yàng  ﹣  lǎo bǎn liǎn shàng yī xiàn chū bú yuè de shén sè ， wǒ men jiù yào chī kǔ tóu ； lǎo bǎn liǎn shàng yǒu le xiào róng ， wǒ men cái néng sōng yì kǒu qì 。 zhè yàng de gōng zuò ， wǒ bù xiǎng zài gàn xià qù le 。
例句.en: I can't keep this up. It's an emotional roller coaster around here and all we have to do is look at the boss's face to know whether everybody is going to be happy or sad.

释义: effect (scientific phenomenon)

例句.zh: 人们谈到全球气候变化的时候，常常用到“温室效应”这个词。
例句.pinyin: rén men tán dào quán qiú qì hòu biàn huà de shí hòu ， cháng cháng yòng dào “ wēn shì xiào yìng ” zhè ge cí 。
例句.en: The term 'greenhouse effect' is often used when people talk about global changes of climate nowadays.

例句.zh: 有的科学家认为温室效应是虚构的。
例句.pinyin: yǒu de kē xué jiā rèn wéi wēn shì xiào yìng shì xū gòu de 。
例句.en: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.

释义: to rest / to take a break / to stop / to halt / (dialect) to sleep / a moment / a short while

例句.zh: 如果没有我过去16年最好的朋友、我们家庭的中坚、我生命中的挚爱，我今天晚上不可能站在这里，美国下一位第一夫人米歇尔-奥巴马。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ méi yǒu wǒ guò qù 16 nián zuì hǎo de péng yǒu 、 wǒ men jiā tíng de zhōng jiān 、 wǒ shēng mìng zhòng de zhì ài ， wǒ jīn tiān wǎn shàng bù kě néng zhàn zài zhè lǐ ， měi guó xià yī wèi dì yī fū rén mǐ xiē ěr - ào bā mǎ 。
例句.en: And I would not be standing here tonight without the unyielding support of my best friend for the last 16 years, the rock of our family, the love of my life, the nation's next first lady, Michelle Obama.

例句.zh: “迈克尔”是一个男名，但是“米歇尔”是一个女名。
例句.pinyin: “ mài kè ěr ” shì yí gè nán míng ， dàn shì “ mǐ xiē ěr ” shì yí gè nǚ míng 。
例句.en: "Michael" is a man's name, but "Michelle" is a woman's name.

例句.zh: 因为天气很热，所以我就走到阴凉的地方歇了一会儿。
例句.pinyin: yīn wèi tiān qì hěn rè ， suǒ yǐ wǒ jiù zǒu dào yīn liáng de dì fāng xiē le yī huì er 。
例句.en: It was so hot that I got into the shade and took a rest.

释义: to carry (on one's person) / to support (old) / Taiwan pr. [xi1 dai4]

例句.zh: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。
例句.pinyin: zhè jià fēi jī yī cì kě yǐ xié dài 40 míng chéng kè 。
例句.en: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.

例句.zh: 这电子辞典的好处就是便于携带。
例句.pinyin: zhè diàn zi cí diǎn de hǎo chù jiù shì biàn yú xié dài 。
例句.en: The good thing about this electronic dictionary is that it's easy to carry.

例句.zh: 携带武器是违法的。
例句.pinyin: xié dài wǔ qì shì wéi fǎ de 。
例句.en: It's against the law to carry weapons.

释义: an association / a society / CL:個|个[ge4],家[jia1]

例句.zh: 在澳大利亚的快乐协会，两百块钱可能达到效果。
例句.pinyin: zài ào dà lì yà de kuài lè xié huì ， liǎng bǎi kuài qián kě néng dá dào xiào guǒ 。
例句.en: At The Happiness Institute in Australia, a couple of hundred dollars may do the trick.

例句.zh: 这个协会有三十个会员。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge xié huì yǒu sān shí gè huì yuán 。
例句.en: The association counts thirty members.

例句.zh: 我申请成为协会会员。
例句.pinyin: wǒ shēn qǐng chéng wéi xié huì huì yuán 。
例句.en: I applied for membership in the association.

释义: to coordinate / to harmonize / to fit together / to match (colors etc) / harmonious / concerted

例句.zh: 他的第三点说明的是，埃米特试图协调现实与他的理论设计。
例句.pinyin: tā de dì sān diǎn shuō míng de shì ， āi mǐ tè shì tú xié tiáo xiàn shí yǔ tā de lǐ lùn shè jì 。
例句.en: The third point to make is that Emmet attempted to harmonize his theory with the reality of designing.

例句.zh: 斯蒂芬·奥布莱恩，联合国负责人道主义事务副秘书长兼紧急救济协调员，声称在也门、索马里、南苏丹和尼日利亚，超过2000万人面临饥荒的威胁。
例句.pinyin: sī dì fēn · ào bù lái ēn ， lián hé guó fù zé rén dào zhǔ yì shì wù fù mì shū zhǎng jiān jǐn jí jiù jì xié tiáo yuán ， shēng chēng zài yě mén 、 suǒ mǎ lǐ 、 nán sū dān hé ní rì lì yà ， chāo guò 2000 wàn rén miàn lín jī huāng de wēi xié 。

例句.zh: 现在是 2025 年 8 月 3 日，露露岛。晚餐后，阳光下嫩绿的无花果，昨天腌制的甜醋，还有重新加热的阿尔弗雷多义面，我坐在阳台上，望著那棵针叶树。楼下静谧无声，街道空无一车，一片悠闲。我的冰镇青柠水在阳光下闪闪发光。最近，我常和那位法丹混血的 UFO 研究专家麦可聊天。我们谈论内心深处的事情：智慧型装置的迷醉，以及思维的衰退。他说，咖啡馆已经不再是咖啡馆了。人们忘记如何观察、如何驻足停留。我跟他讲起在日本的亚瑟，他会像僧侣凝视虚空一样，对著空白的墙壁发呆。最近，我让机器像诗人一样说话，它们真的做到了。它们模仿伊莉莎白时代的诗歌，以及塔加洛语民谣中那古老而忧伤的韵律。我沿著通往蒂姆霍顿咖啡店的小路采摘黑莓。我像个孩子似的喊道：「莫拉！」我的朋友莫拉，她血液里流著安地斯山脉的薄雾，她会笑的。今天，我买了黄柠檬。我本来想买青柠，但黄柠檬也可以。/ 黑莓的清晨 / 指尖残留无花果的痕迹 / 街道依然沉睡
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì  2025  nián  8  yuè  3  rì ， lù lù dǎo 。 wǎn cān hòu ， yáng guāng xià nèn lǜ de wú huā guǒ ， zuó tiān yān zhì de tián cù ， hái yǒu chóng xīn jiā rè de ā ěr fú léi duō yì miàn ， wǒ zuò zài yáng tái shàng ， wàng zhù nà kē zhēn yè shù 。 lóu xià jìng mì wú shēng ， jiē dào kōng wú yī chē ， yī piàn yōu xián 。 wǒ de bīng zhèn qīng níng shuǐ zài yáng guāng xià shǎn shǎn fā guāng 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ cháng hé nà wèi fǎ dān hùn xuè de  UFO  yán jiū zhuān jiā mài kě liáo tiān 。 wǒ men tán lùn nèi xīn shēn chù de shì qíng ： zhì huì xíng zhuāng zhì de mí zuì ， yǐ jí sī wéi de shuāi tuì 。 tā shuō ， kā fēi guǎn yǐ jīng bù zài shì kā fēi guǎn le 。 rén men wàng jì rú hé guān chá 、 rú hé zhù zú tíng liú 。 wǒ gēn tā jiǎng qǐ zài rì běn de yà sè ， tā huì xiàng sēng lǚ níng shì xū kōng yī yàng ， duì zhù kòng bái de qiáng bì fā dāi 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ ràng jī qì xiàng shī rén yī yàng shuō huà ， tā men zhēn de zuò dào le 。 tā men mó fǎng yī lì shā bái shí dài de shī gē ， yǐ jí tǎ jiā luò yǔ mín yáo zhōng nà gǔ lǎo ér yōu shāng de yùn lǜ 。 wǒ yán zhù tōng wǎng dì mǔ huò dùn kā fēi diàn de xiǎo lù cǎi zhāi hēi méi 。 wǒ xiàng gè hái zi shì de hǎn dào ：「 mò lā ！」 wǒ de péng yǒu mò lā ， tā xuè yè lǐ liú zhù ān dì sī shān mài de bó wù ， tā huì xiào de 。 jīn tiān ， wǒ mǎi le huáng níng méng 。 wǒ běn lái xiǎng mǎi qīng níng ， dàn huáng níng méng yě kě yǐ 。/  hēi méi de qīng chén  /  zhǐ jiān cán liú wú huā guǒ de hén jì  /  jiē dào yī rán chén shuì
例句.en: It's Lulu Island, 3 August 2025. After supper—green figs tender with sunlight, sweet vinegar from yesterday’s pickled jar, and reheated Alfredo—I sat on the balcony and watched the conifer. Stillness below, a street without cars, without haste. My lime water, iced, caught the light. Michael, the Franco-Danish ufologist, has been in my conversations lately. We speak of inner things: the trance of smart devices, the mind’s eye dwindling. He says cafés aren’t cafés anymore. People forget how to look, how to linger. I tell him of Arthur in Japan—how he'd stare into blank walls like a monk gazing at emptiness. Lately I ask machines to speak like poets, and they do. They mimic Elizabethan verses and the old wistful lilt of Tagalog ballads. I pick blackberries along the path to Tim Hortons. "¡Moras!" I shout like a child. My friend Mora, whose blood flows with Andes mist, would smile. Today, I bought lemons. I meant limes, but lemons are all right. / blackberry morning— / a fig's ghost on my fingers / and the street still sleeps

例句.zh: 我们中的许多人多多少少都经历过这样的循环：面对着浏览器，习惯性地Ctrl-T打开一个新的标签页，敲下常去网址的首字母然后回车，只为了看看有没有啥新鲜事发生。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men zhōng de xǔ duō rén duō duō shǎo shǎo dōu jīng lì guò zhè yàng de xún huán ： miàn duì zhe liú lǎn qì ， xí guàn xìng dì Ctrl-T dǎ kāi yí gè xīn de biāo qiān yè ， qiāo xià cháng qù wǎng zhǐ de shǒu zì mǔ rán hòu huí chē ， zhǐ wèi le kàn kàn yǒu méi yǒu shá xīn xiān shì fā shēng 。
例句.en: Most of us have, to some extent, experienced being caught in a cycle like this one: Facing the browser, you hit, like you always do, Ctrl-T to open a new tab, type in the first letter of the website you always visit, and hit "enter"... just to see if anything new has happened.

释义: to seek; to look for

例句.zh: 21个月前在寒冬所开始的一切不应当在今天这个秋夜结束。今天的选举胜利并不是我们所寻求的改变--这只是我们进行改变的机会。如果我们仍然按照过去的方式行事，我们所寻求的改变将不会发生。没有你们，没有服务和牺牲的新精神，就不可能发生改变。因此，让我们发扬新的爱国和负责精神，所有的人都下定决心参与其中，更加努力地工作，不仅是为自己而是为彼此。
例句.pinyin: 21 gè yuè qián zài hán dōng suǒ kāi shǐ de yī qiè bù yīng dāng zài jīn tiān zhè ge qiū yè jié shù 。 jīn tiān de xuǎn jǔ shèng lì bìng bú shì wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn -- zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men jìn xíng gǎi biàn de jī huì 。 rú guǒ wǒ men réng rán àn zhào guò qù de fāng shì xíng shì ， wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn jiāng bú huì fā shēng 。 méi yǒu nǐ men ， méi yǒu fú wù hé xī shēng de xīn jīng shén ， jiù bù kě néng fā shēng gǎi biàn 。 yīn cǐ ， ràng wǒ men fā yáng xīn de ài guó hé fù zé jīng shén ， suǒ yǒu de rén dōu xià dìng jué xīn cān yù qí zhōng ， gèng jiā nǔ lì dì gōng zuò ， bù jǐn shì wèi zì jǐ ér shì wèi bǐ cǐ 。
例句.en: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.

例句.zh: 竞选活动的声势也来自那些已不再年轻的人们，他们冒着严寒酷暑，敲开陌生人的家门进行竞选宣传；竞选声势也源自数百万的美国民众，他们充当志愿者和组织者，他们证明了在两百多年以后，民有、民治、民享的政府并未从地球上消失。这是你们的胜利。

例句.en: It drew strength from the not-so-young people who braved the bitter cold and scorching heat to knock on doors of perfect strangers, and from the millions of Americans who volunteered and organized and proved that more than two centuries later a government of the people, by the people, and for the people has not perished from the Earth.

例句.zh: 21个月前在寒冬所开始的一切不应当在今天这个秋夜结束。今天的选举胜利并不是我们所寻求的改变--这只是我们进行改变的机会。如果我们仍然按照过去的方式行事，我们所寻求的改变将不会发生。没有你们，没有服务和牺牲的新精神，就不可能发生改变。因此，让我们发扬新的爱国和负责精神，所有的人都下定决心参与其中，更加努力地工作，不仅是为自己而是为彼此。
例句.pinyin: 21 gè yuè qián zài hán dōng suǒ kāi shǐ de yī qiè bù yīng dāng zài jīn tiān zhè ge qiū yè jié shù 。 jīn tiān de xuǎn jǔ shèng lì bìng bú shì wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn -- zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men jìn xíng gǎi biàn de jī huì 。 rú guǒ wǒ men réng rán àn zhào guò qù de fāng shì xíng shì ， wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn jiāng bú huì fā shēng 。 méi yǒu nǐ men ， méi yǒu fú wù hé xī shēng de xīn jīng shén ， jiù bù kě néng fā shēng gǎi biàn 。 yīn cǐ ， ràng wǒ men fā yáng xīn de ài guó hé fù zé jīng shén ， suǒ yǒu de rén dōu xià dìng jué xīn cān yù qí zhōng ， gèng jiā nǔ lì dì gōng zuò ， bù jǐn shì wèi zì jǐ ér shì wèi bǐ cǐ 。
例句.en: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.

例句.zh: 政府官员与业界人士也开始意识到「甲烷捕捉计划」的潜力。美国农业部正在密西西比州及其他数个州资助农场内的实验场址。部分大型禽肉加工业者正在成立再生能源部门，以供应饲料厂所需电力。此外，一家燃料公司正在评估是否可以用鸡只排放的甲烷取代天然气，并注入管线，用来为部分沿线发电机提供动力。
例句.pinyin: zhèng fǔ guān yuán yǔ yè jiè rén shì yě kāi shǐ yì shí dào 「 jiǎ wán bǔ zhuō jì huà 」 de qián lì 。 měi guó nóng yè bù zhèng zài mì xī xī bǐ zhōu jí qí tā shù gè zhōu zī zhù nóng chǎng nèi de shí yàn chǎng zhǐ 。 bù fèn dà xíng qín ròu jiā gōng yè zhě zhèng zài chéng lì zài shēng néng yuán bù mén ， yǐ gōng yìng sì liào chǎng suǒ xū diàn lì 。 cǐ wài ， yī jiā rán liào gōng sī zhèng zài píng gū shì fǒu kě yǐ yòng jī zhǐ pái fàng de jiǎ wán qǔ dài tiān rán qì ， bìng zhù rù guǎn xiàn ， yòng lái wèi bù fèn yán xiàn fā diàn jī tí gōng dòng lì 。
例句.en: Officials from government and industry are also starting to recognize the potential of the Methane Capture Project. The U.S. Department of Agriculture is funding experimental on-farm sites in Mississippi and several other states. Some large poultry processors are launching renewable energy divisions to power their feed mills. And a fuel company is investigating the possibility of pumping chicken-waste methane instead of natural gas through its pipeline, and to use it to power some of the generators along the way.

It began in the backyards of Des Moines, and the living rooms of Concord, and the front porches of Charleston. 释义: to wish

例句.pinyin: Wǒ zhùyuàn nǐ měitiān dōu kāixīn.

例句.zh: 我们祝愿世界和平。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen zhùyuàn shìjiè hépíng.
例句.en: We wish for world peace.

释义: residence; dwelling; abode

例句.zh: 今年，爱丁堡城市为了改变它的水边地并给它增加中的人口供应一种新型的住宅区而开始十五年的重建工作。
例句.pinyin: jīn nián ， ài dīng bǎo chéng shì wèi le gǎi biàn tā de shuǐ biān dì bìng gěi tā zēng jiā zhōng de rén kǒu gòng yīng yī zhǒng xīn xíng de zhù zhái qū ér kāi shǐ shí wǔ nián de chóng jiàn gōng zuò 。
例句.en: This year, Edinburgh began work on its fifteen-year regeneration project to transform its waterfront and provide its growing population with a new kind of living area.

例句.zh: 汤姆的住宅有一个不错的花园。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ de zhù zhái yǒu yí gè bù cuò de huā yuán 。

例句.zh: 住宅围栏应该多高？
例句.pinyin: zhù zhái wéi lán yīng gāi duō gāo ？
例句.en: How high should a home fence be?

释义: to write / literary work / book / article / writings / CL:部[bu4]

例句.zh: 作为一个良好的交谈者，并不只意味著作一个英语说得好的说话者。
例句.pinyin: zuò wéi yí gè liáng hǎo de jiāo tán zhě ， bìng bù zhǐ yì wèi zhù zuò yí gè yīng yǔ shuō dé hǎo de shuō huà zhě 。
例句.en: Being a good conversationalist does not just mean being a good speaker of English.

例句.zh: 我希望所有那些想要修订现行著作权法的人一个从容不迫的夜晚，但实际上所有其他的人也一样。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xī wàng suǒ yǒu nà xiē xiǎng yào xiū dìng xiàn xíng zhù zuò quán fǎ de rén yí gè cóng róng bù pò de yè wǎn ， dàn shí jì shàng suǒ yǒu qí tā de rén yě yī yàng 。
例句.en: I wish all those an unhurried night who want a revision of the existing copyright laws, but actually all the others too.

例句.zh: 那位是一个著作等身的教授。
例句.pinyin: nà wèi shì yí gè zhù zuò děng shēn de jiào shòu 。
例句.en: She's a professor whose works you could stack up to head height.

释义: variant of 甎|砖[zhuan1] / variant of 磚|砖[zhuan1] / brick / tile (floor or wall, not roof) / CL:塊|块[kuai4]

例句.zh: 但我将总是会向你们坦陈我们所面临的挑战。我会听取你们的意见，尤其是存在不同意见的时候。最重要的是，我会请求你们参与重建这个国家，以美国221年来从未改变的唯一方式-一砖一瓦、同心协力。
例句.pinyin: dàn wǒ jiāng zǒng shì huì xiàng nǐ men tǎn chén wǒ men suǒ miàn lín de tiǎo zhàn 。 wǒ huì tīng qǔ nǐ men de yì jiàn ， yóu qí shì cún zài bù tóng yì jiàn de shí hòu 。 zuì zhòng yào de shì ， wǒ huì qǐng qiú nǐ men cān yù chóng jiàn zhè ge guó jiā ， yǐ měi guó 221 nián lái cóng wèi gǎi biàn de wéi yī fāng shì - yī zhuān yī wǎ 、 tóng xīn xié lì 。
例句.en: But I will always be honest with you about the challenges we face. I will listen to you, especially when we disagree. And above all, I will ask you to join in the work of remaking this nation, the only way it's been done in America for 221 years; block by block, brick by brick, calloused hand by calloused hand.

例句.zh: 你需要多少块儿磁砖？
例句.pinyin: nǐ xū yào duō shǎo kuài ér cí zhuān ？

例句.zh: 一阵寒意像砖头一样击中了我。
例句.pinyin: yī zhèn hán yì xiàng zhuān tóu yī yàng jī zhòng le wǒ 。
例句.en: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.

释义: specialized subject / branch (of medicine) / specialized training school

短释义: to focus; to concentrate; to give one's full attention

例句.zh: 我爸爸现在非常专注于股市。

释义: to change / to switch / to convert / to transform

例句.zh: 中国的汉字数量繁多，推行汉字简化的目的，是把结构复杂的繁体字转换成易学易记的简体字，从而提高国民的识字水平。

例句.en: In China, there is a large number of characters, so the goal of the character simplification was to replace the complex traditional characters with easy to remember simplified characters and increase the literacy rate.

例句.zh: 我天生是犹太人，但当我年纪大了的时候，我把它转换成了自恋。

例句.zh: 请告诉我我应该在哪里转换火车。

例句.zh: 我见了罗伊，他叫我把这个转交给你。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jiàn le luó yī ， tā jiào wǒ bǎ zhè ge zhuǎn jiāo gěi nǐ 。

释义: (of a person) to turn round / to face about / (of a widow) to remarry (archaic)

例句.zh: 我建议你转身回家。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jiàn yì nǐ zhuǎn shēn huí jiā 。
例句.en: I suggest you turn around and go back home.

例句.zh: 汤姆转身开始跑。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ zhuǎn shēn kāi shǐ pǎo 。
例句.en: Tom turned around and started to run.

例句.zh: 叶公子名叫高，十分喜爱龙，衣带钩上雕着龙，酒器上刻着龙，居室内的花纹图案也全都画着龙。天上的真龙听说这件事，便降临到人间，头探进窗户里，尾巴拖在厅堂中。叶公看见真龙，转身惊慌逃开，吓得魂飞魄散，脸色大变。由此可见，叶公并不是真的喜爱龙，他喜爱的只是那些像龙却并非真龙的东西。
例句.pinyin: yè gōng zi míng jiào gāo ， shí fēn xǐ ài lóng ， yī dài gōu shàng diāo zhe lóng ， jiǔ qì shàng kè zhe lóng ， jū shì nèi de huā wén tú àn yě quán dōu huà zhe lóng 。 tiān shàng de zhēn lóng tīng shuō zhè jiàn shì ， biàn jiàng lín dào rén jiān ， tóu tàn jìn chuāng hù lǐ ， wěi ba tuō zài tīng táng zhōng 。 yè gōng kàn jiàn zhēn lóng ， zhuǎn shēn jīng huāng táo kāi ， xià dé hún fēi pò sàn ， liǎn sè dà biàn 。 yóu cǐ kě jiàn ， yè gōng bìng bú shì zhēn de xǐ ài lóng ， tā xǐ ài de zhǐ shì nà xiē xiàng lóng què bìng fēi zhēn lóng de dōng xī 。
例句.en: Lord Ye, whose given name was Gao, was extremely fond of dragons. Dragons were carved on his belt hooks and wine vessels, and all the patterns in his dwelling were painted with dragons. When the real dragon in heaven heard of this, it descended to the mortal world. It poked its head through the window and trailed its tail across the hall. At the sight of the creature, Lord Ye spun around and fled in terror. He was utterly panic-stricken and turned pale with fright. This shows that Lord Ye did not truly love dragons. What he adored was merely things that looked like dragons, not real ones.

释义: to shift; to relocate; to transfer / (fig.) to shift (attention); to change (the subject etc) / (medicine) to metastasize

例句.zh: 沿着这条路直走，到第三个红绿灯的地方右转。

例句.pinyin: é luó sī zhèng xiàng xù lì yà pài qiǎn zhàn jiàn 、 hǎi jūn lù zhàn duì hé dēng lù tǐng tǎn kè ， bìng xiàng yī lǎng pài qiǎn qián jiàn zhuāng bèi 。
例句.en: Russia is sending battleships, marines, and landing craft tanks against Syria, and submarine equiment against Iran.

释义: self-discipline / self-regulation / autonomy (ethics) / autonomic (physiology)

例句.zh: 他每天早起锻炼，非常自律。

She's no refined, well-bred lady, but she's brisk and capable, sharp and competent, the kind of hardworking woman who can hold up half the sky.

例句.zh: 他杀了他，以为他父亲的死报仇。
例句.pinyin: tā shā le tā ， yǐ wéi tā fù qīn de sǐ bào chóu 。
例句.en: He killed him to avenge his dead father.

释义: to repay / to requite

例句.zh: 我该怎么报答你的恩情？
例句.pinyin: Wǒ gāi zěnme bàodá nǐ de ēnqíng?
例句.en: How can I repay you for your kindness?

例句.zh: 他努力学习，希望将来报答父母。
例句.pinyin: Tā nǔlì xuéxí, xīwàng jiānglái bàodá fùmǔ.
例句.en: He studies hard, hoping to repay his parents in the future.

例句.zh: 她想用实际行动报答老师。
例句.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yòng shíjì xíngdòng bàodá lǎoshī.
例句.en: She wants to repay her teacher through her actions.

释义: to scrap; to dispose of (sth worn-out or damaged)
短释义: to scrap; to dispose of (sth worn-out or damaged)

例句.zh: 我们抵达目的地的时候，我还以为那辆车快要报废了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men dǐ dá mù dì dì de shí hòu ， wǒ hái yǐ wéi nà liàng chē kuài yào bào fèi le 。
例句.en: We reached our destination just as I thought the car was going to give up the ghost.

释义: violent wind and rainstorm / hurricane / tempest

例句.zh: 暴风骤雨突然袭来，船只纷纷返航。
例句.pinyin: Bàofēng zhòuyǔ tūrán xílái, chuánzhī fēnfēn fǎnháng.
例句.en: A violent wind and rainstorm suddenly struck, and the boats returned to port one after another.

例句.zh: 窗外的暴风骤雨吵得我睡不着。
例句.pinyin: Chuāngwài de bàofēng zhòuyǔ chǎo de wǒ shuìbuzháo.
例句.en: The violent wind and rainstorm outside kept me from sleeping.

例句.zh: 他的批评如暴风骤雨般袭来。
例句.pinyin: Tā de pīpíng rú bàofēng zhòuyǔ bān xílái.
例句.en: His criticism came down like a violent storm.

释义: to make reprisals; to retaliate / revenge; retaliation

例句.zh: 他对杀父凶手进行了报复。
例句.pinyin: tā duì shā fù xiōng shǒu jìn xíng le bào fù 。
例句.en: He avenged the murder of his father.

例句.zh: 燕大侠发现自己被骗了他飞到了江枫的旁边，他抱走江枫的儿子。燕大侠誓言报复，他把男孩给了一个香料商人。
例句.pinyin: yàn dà xiá fā xiàn zì jǐ bèi piàn le tā fēi dào le jiāng fēng de páng biān ， tā bào zǒu jiāng fēng de ér zi 。 yàn dà xiá shì yán bào fù ， tā bǎ nán hái gěi le yí gè xiāng liào shāng rén 。
例句.en: Yan Daxia realised he had been lied to and flew to Jiang Feng's side. He took Jiang Feng's son and left. Yan Daxia vowed revenge and left the boy with a spice merchant.

例句.zh: 中国采取的报复性关税措施降低了大豆等农作物的需求和整体价格，最终影响了农民的收入，迫使许多农民一时无法购买大型、昂贵的设备。
例句.pinyin: zhōng guó cǎi qǔ de bào fù xìng guān shuì cuò shī jiàng dī le dà dòu děng nóng zuò wù de xū qiú hé zhěng tǐ jià gé ， zuì zhōng yǐng xiǎng le nóng mín de shōu rù ， pò shǐ xǔ duō nóng mín yī shí wú fǎ gòu mǎi dà xíng 、 áng guì de shè bèi 。
例句.en: Retaliatory tariffs by China have decreased demand and overall prices for crops like soybeans, ultimately affecting a farmer’s bottom line, forcing many to hold off purchasing large, expensive equipment.

释义: aspiration / ambition

例句.zh: 他有抱负，所以他很努力工作。
例句.pinyin: tā yǒu bào fù ， suǒ yǐ tā hěn nǔ lì gōng zuò 。
例句.en: He has ambition, so he works hard.

例句.zh: 一些美国人的抱负因学校教育不完美、隐性的偏见和出生环境而受到限制。
例句.pinyin: yī xiē měi guó rén de bào fù yīn xué xiào jiào yù bù wán měi 、 yǐn xìng de piān jiàn hé chū shēng huán jìng ér shòu dào xiàn zhì 。
例句.en: The ambitions of some Americans are limited by failing schools and hidden prejudice and the circumstances of their birth.

释义: to expose (photography) / (fig.) to expose (a scandal) / (advertising) exposure / Taiwan pr. [pu4 guang1]

例句.zh: 汤姆和我之间的秘密被曝光了。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ hé wǒ zhī jiān de mì mì bèi bào guāng le 。
例句.en: Tom and my secret came to light.

释义: sudden huge profits

例句.zh: 他靠倒卖口罩牟取暴利。
例句.pinyin: Tā kào dǎomài kǒuzhào móuqǔ bàolì.
例句.en: He made enormous profits by reselling masks.

例句.zh: 这家公司因牟取暴利而受到调查。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yīn móuqǔ bàolì ér shòudào diàochá.
例句.en: The company was investigated for making excessive profits.

例句.zh: 高价转卖门票能带来暴利。
例句.pinyin: Gāojià zhuǎnmài ménpiào néng dàilái bàolì.
例句.en: Reselling tickets at high prices can generate huge profits.

释义: filled to capacity (of theater, stadium, gymnasium etc)
短释义: filled to capacity (of theater, stadium, gymnasium etc)

例句.zh: 周末的演唱会场场爆满。
例句.pinyin: Zhōumò de yǎnchànghuì chǎng chǎng bàomǎn.
例句.en: The concerts are filled to capacity every weekend.

例句.zh: 这家餐厅今晚已经爆满了。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng jīnwǎn yǐjīng bàomǎn le.
例句.en: This restaurant is already fully booked tonight.

例句.zh: 节日期间，电影院几乎天天爆满。
例句.pinyin: Jiérì qījiān, diànyǐngyuàn jīhū tiāntiān bàomǎn.
例句.en: During the holiday, the movie theater is filled to capacity almost every day.

释义: to submit an expense account / to apply for reimbursement / to write off / to wipe out

例句.zh: 你们学校真好，还帮你们报销来回的机票。
例句.pinyin: nǐ men xué xiào zhēn hǎo ， hái bāng nǐ men bào xiāo lái huí de jī piào 。
例句.en: Your school is so kind to reimburse you for the return airfare.

例句.zh: 这张火车票能报销吗？
例句.pinyin: zhè zhāng huǒ chē piào néng bào xiāo ma ？
例句.en: Can I get a refund for this train ticket?

释义: irascible; irritable

例句.zh: 他早上总是有点脾气暴躁。
例句.pinyin: tā zǎo shàng zǒng shì yǒu diǎn pí qì bào zào 。
例句.en: He is always a little irritable in the morning.

例句.zh: 汤姆是个脾气暴躁的老人。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ shì gè pí qì bào zào de lǎo rén 。
例句.en: Tom is a grumpy old man.

释义: firecracker

例句.zh: 爷爷买了一串爆竹。
例句.pinyin: Yéye mǎi le yí chuàn bàozhú.
例句.en: Grandpa bought a string of firecrackers.

例句.zh: 过年时，孩子们喜欢放爆竹。
例句.pinyin: Guònián shí, háizimen xǐhuan fàng bàozhú.
例句.en: Children like to set off firecrackers during the Chinese New Year.

例句.zh: 这座城市禁止在市区燃放爆竹。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì jìnzhǐ zài shìqū ránfàng bàozhú.
例句.en: This city prohibits setting off firecrackers in urban areas.

释义: a monument / an upright stone tablet / stele / CL:塊|块[kuai4],面[mian4]

例句.zh: 登月是一项里程碑式的成就。
例句.pinyin: dēng yuè shì yī xiàng lǐ chéng bēi shì de chéng jiù 。
例句.en: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.

例句.zh: 这次任务充满了里程碑：这将是韩国女性首次进入太空轨道，也是代表韩国的蒜味辣白菜——「泡菜」，第一次出现在零重力餐桌上。
例句.pinyin: zhè cì rèn wù chōng mǎn le lǐ chéng bēi ： zhè jiāng shì hán guó nǚ xìng shǒu cì jìn rù tài kōng guǐ dào ， yě shì dài biǎo hán guó de suàn wèi là bái cài ——「 pào cài 」， dì yī cì chū xiàn zài líng zhòng lì cān zhuō shàng 。
例句.en: The mission is full of landmarks: it will be the first time a South Korean woman has headed into orbit, and it will also be the first time that "kimchi"—that spicy, garlicky cabbage dish that epitomizes South Korea—will be served at the zero-gravity dinner table.

释义: grieved / sorrowful

例句.zh: 她的眼神里充满了悲哀。
例句.pinyin: tā de yǎn shén lǐ chōng mǎn le bēi āi 。
例句.en: Her eyes were full of sadness.

释义: base / mean / contemptible / despicable

例句.zh: 我为你的卑鄙行径感到羞耻。
例句.pinyin: wǒ wèi nǐ de bēi bǐ xíng jìng gǎn dào xiū chǐ 。
例句.en: I am ashamed of your despicable deed.

例句.zh: 在你面前有一百万美金。你可以自己留下或帮一个你不认识的快全身瘫痪的人做手术。他不认识你，你也不认识他。当然，无论你慷慨地把所有的钱都捐给了一个素不相识的人去做手术，还是卑鄙地拿走这笔钱，让那个人今生都只能卧床不起，都不会有人知道。你会怎么做呢？这笔钱不可割分。
例句.pinyin: zài nǐ miàn qián yǒu yì bǎi wàn měi jīn 。 nǐ kě yǐ zì jǐ liú xià huò bāng yí gè nǐ bù rèn shí de kuài quán shēn tān huàn de rén zuò shǒu shù 。 tā bù rèn shí nǐ ， nǐ yě bù rèn shí tā 。 dāng rán ， wú lùn nǐ kāng kǎi dì bǎ suǒ yǒu de qián dōu juān gěi le yí gè sù bù xiāng shí de rén qù zuò shǒu shù ， hái shì bēi bǐ dì ná zǒu zhè bǐ qián ， ràng nà ge rén jīn shēng dōu zhǐ néng wò chuáng bù qǐ ， dōu bú huì yǒu rén zhī dào 。 nǐ huì zěn me zuò ne ？ zhè bǐ qián bù kě gē fēn 。
例句.en: You've got a million dollars in front of you. You can either spend it for yourself or spend it on a surgery for someone you don't know who is in danger of quadriplegia. You don't know each other. And no one will ever know what a noble deed you've done sacrificing all the money for the surgery for a person you don't know, or how mean you were to take the money confining that person to a wheelchair for the rest of their life. So what would you do? You can't share the money.

例句.zh: 他是个卑鄙小人。
例句.pinyin: tā shì gè bēi bǐ xiǎo rén 。
例句.en: He is a despicable person.

释义: miserable / tragic

例句.zh: 幸福家庭的幸福原因全都大同小异，但悲惨的家庭却往往各自有各自的惨法。
例句.pinyin: xìng fú jiā tíng de xìng fú yuán yīn quán dōu dà tóng xiǎo yì ， dàn bēi cǎn de jiā tíng què wǎng wǎng gè zì yǒu gè zì de cǎn fǎ 。
例句.en: All happy families resemble each other, each unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.

例句.zh: 这个故事有一个悲惨的结局。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge gù shì yǒu yí gè bēi cǎn de jié jú 。
例句.en: This story has a sad ending.

释义: to bear / to carry on one's back / to shoulder

例句.zh: 他背负着沉重的债务。
例句.pinyin: Tā bēifùzhe chénzhòng de zhàiwù.
例句.en: He bears a heavy debt.

例句.zh: 她背负着全家的希望。
例句.pinyin: Tā bēifùzhe quánjiā de xīwàng.
例句.en: She carries the hopes of her whole family.

例句.zh: 士兵背负着行囊继续前进。
例句.pinyin: Shìbīng bēifùzhe xíngnáng jìxù qiánjìn.
例句.en: The soldier continued forward carrying his pack.

释义: joys and sorrows / partings and reunions / the vicissitudes of life

例句.zh: 人生总有悲欢离合。
例句.pinyin: Rénshēng zǒng yǒu bēi huān lí hé.
例句.en: Life is always filled with joys and sorrows.

例句.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个家庭的悲欢离合。
例句.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎngshù le yí ge jiātíng de bēi huān lí hé.
例句.en: This film depicts the joys and sorrows of a family.

例句.zh: 经历了许多悲欢离合后，他更珍惜现在的生活。
例句.pinyin: Jīnglì le xǔduō bēi huān lí hé hòu, tā gèng zhēnxī xiànzài de shēnghuó.
例句.en: After experiencing many joys and sorrows, he cherishes his present life even more.

释义: grieved / sorrowful

例句.zh: 我一想到那些在战争中死去的人，心里就感到一阵阵的悲痛。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yī xiǎng dào nà xiē zài zhàn zhēng zhōng sǐ qù de rén ， xīn lǐ jiù gǎn dào yī zhèn zhèn de bēi tòng 。
例句.en: I feel sad when I think about all the people who die in wars.

例句.zh: 这表明幸福和悲痛之间只隔着看法。
例句.pinyin: zhè biǎo míng xìng fú hé bēi tòng zhī jiān zhǐ gé zhe kàn fǎ 。
例句.en: This shows that happiness and sadness are only separated by attitude.

例句.zh: 语言不能减轻她的悲痛。
例句.pinyin: yǔ yán bù néng jiǎn qīng tā de bēi tòng 。
例句.en: No words can relieve her deep sorrow.

释义: lowly / humble

例句.zh: 于是那欢快的小男孩们四处游荡，/ 如此喜悦地穿越山丘与山谷，/ 蔷薇的芬芳穿过荆棘丛 / 将随温柔的夏风飘散：/ 每个清晨，大自然含笑赐予，/ 那贫苦卑微的农夫也得一份，/ 云雀从草丛中振翅而上，/ 将悠扬的音符送向天际。
例句.pinyin: yú shì nà huān kuài de xiǎo nán hái men sì chù yóu dàng ，/  rú cǐ xǐ yuè dì chuān yuè shān qiū yǔ shān gǔ ，/  qiáng wēi de fēn fāng chuān guò jīng jí cóng  /  jiāng suí wēn róu de xià fēng piāo sàn ：/  měi gè qīng chén ， dà zì rán hán xiào cì yǔ ，/  nà pín kǔ bēi wēi de nóng fū yě dé yī fèn ，/  yún què cóng cǎo cóng zhōng zhèn chì ér shàng ，/  jiāng yōu yáng de yīn fú sòng xiàng tiān jì 。
例句.en: Then the merry little boys they will ramble, / So gleesome, o’er mountain and dale, / Where the sweets of the rose through the bramble / Will be blown by the mild summer gale: / Then a share of Nature’s smiles each morning / To the poor humble peasant will be given. / While the lark from his covert he is soaring, / His musical notes to the heaven.

释义: variant of 備|备[bei4] / (bound form) to prepare; to equip / (literary) fully; completely

例句.zh: 今天糟糕透了，所以我准备去喝一杯就直接上床。
例句.pinyin: jīn tiān zāo gāo tòu le ， suǒ yǐ wǒ zhǔn bèi qù hē yī bēi jiù zhí jiē shàng chuáng 。
例句.en: I had an awful experience today, so I'm going to have a beer and go straight to bed.

例句.zh: 男孩们窃窃私语，我知道他们准备做些什么。
例句.pinyin: nán hái men qiè qiè sī yǔ ， wǒ zhī dào tā men zhǔn bèi zuò xiē shén me 。
例句.en: The boys were whispering; I knew they were up to something.

例句.zh: 妈妈为我准备了午饭。
例句.pinyin: mā mā wèi wǒ zhǔn bèi le wǔ fàn 。
例句.en: Mother prepared lunch for me.

释义: backup

例句.zh: 我每周都会备份电脑里的文件。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ měi zhōu dōu huì bèifèn diànnǎo lǐ de wénjiàn.
例句.en: I back up the files on my computer every week.

例句.zh: 请把重要资料备份到云端。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhòngyào zīliào bèifèn dào yúnduān.
例句.en: Please back up the important data to the cloud.

例句.zh: 这个备份已经过期了。
例句.pinyin: Zhège bèifèn yǐjīng guòqī le.
例句.en: This backup is already out of date.

释义: (law) the defendant; the accused

例句.zh: 被告周五将会出现在法庭上。
例句.pinyin: bèi gào zhōu wǔ jiāng huì chū xiàn zài fǎ tíng shàng 。
例句.en: The accused is to appear before the court on Friday.

例句.zh: 「被告人」一词是法律用语。
例句.pinyin: 「 bèi gào rén 」 yī cí shì fǎ lǜ yòng yǔ 。
例句.en: "The accused" is a legal term.

例句.zh: 今天晚上，我想到了她在美国过去一百年间所经历的种种：心痛和希望；斗争和进步；在那里时代，我们被告知我们办不到，一些人继续坚信着美国的信念——是的，我们能做到。
例句.pinyin: jīn tiān wǎn shàng ， wǒ xiǎng dào le tā zài měi guó guò qù yì bǎi nián jiān suǒ jīng lì de zhǒng zhǒng ： xīn tòng hé xī wàng ； dòu zhēng hé jìn bù ； zài nà lǐ shí dài ， wǒ men bèi gào zhī wǒ men bàn bú dào ， yī xiē rén jì xù jiān xìn zhe měi guó de xìn niàn —— shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào 。
例句.en: And tonight, I think about all that she's seen throughout her century in America. The heartache and the hope, the struggle and the progress. The times we were told that we can't, and the people who pressed on with that American creed: Yes, we can.

释义: shell (of a mollusk)

例句.zh: 在我手里的是一个贝壳化石。
例句.pinyin: zài wǒ shǒu lǐ de shì yí gè bèi ké huà shí 。
例句.en: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.

例句.zh: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài hǎi tān shàng fā xiàn le yí gè piào liàng de bèi ké 。
例句.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.

例句.zh: 她在海边卖贝壳。
例句.pinyin: tā zài hǎi biān mài bèi ké 。
例句.en: She sells seashells by the seashore.

释义: (of a teacher) to do one's lesson preparation
短释义: (of a teacher) to do one's lesson preparation

例句.zh: 老师每天晚上备课。
例句.pinyin: Lǎoshī měitiān wǎnshang bèikè.
例句.en: The teacher prepares lessons every evening.

例句.zh: 她正在办公室备课。
例句.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài bàngōngshì bèikè.
例句.en: She is preparing lessons in the office.

例句.zh: 明天要上课，我得先备课。
例句.pinyin: Míngtiān yào shàngkè, wǒ děi xiān bèikè.
例句.en: I have to teach tomorrow, so I need to prepare my lesson first.

释义: the back / the reverse side / the wrong side

例句.zh: 照片背面写着日期。
例句.pinyin: Zhàopiàn bèimiàn xiězhe rìqī.

例句.zh: 今年，在这场选举中，她用手指触摸屏幕投下自己的选票，因为在美国生活了106年之后，经历了最好的时光和最黑暗的时刻之后，她知道美国如何能够发生变革。
例句.pinyin: jīn nián ， zài zhè chǎng xuǎn jǔ zhōng ， tā yòng shǒu zhǐ chù mō píng mù tóu xià zì jǐ de xuǎn piào ， yīn wèi zài měi guó shēng huó le 106 nián zhī hòu ， jīng lì le zuì hǎo de shí guāng hé zuì hēi àn de shí kè zhī hòu ， tā zhī dào měi guó rú hé néng gòu fā shēng biàn gé 。
例句.en: And this year, in this election, she touched her finger to a screen, and cast her vote; because after 106 years in America, through the best of times and the darkest of hours, she knows how America can change.

释义: to change / to alter / to modify

例句.zh: 会议时间已经变更。
例句.pinyin: Huìyì shíjiān yǐjīng biàngēng.
例句.en: The meeting time has been changed.

例句.zh: 如需变更地址，请提前通知我们。
例句.pinyin: Rú xū biàngēng dìzhǐ, qǐng tíqián tōngzhī wǒmen.
例句.en: If you need to change the address, please notify us in advance.

例句.zh: 公司变更了合同内容。
例句.pinyin: Gōngsī biàngēng le hétong nèiróng.
例句.en: The company changed the contents of the contract.

释义: an unforeseen event / accident / misfortune

例句.zh: 家里突然发生了变故。
例句.pinyin: Jiālǐ tūrán fāshēng le biàngù.
例句.en: Something unexpected suddenly happened in the family.

例句.zh: 这场变故打乱了我们的计划。
例句.pinyin: Zhè chǎng biàngù dǎluàn le wǒmen de jìhuà.
例句.en: This unforeseen event disrupted our plans.

例句.zh: 面对突如其来的变故，他依然很冷静。
例句.pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de biàngù, tā yīrán hěn lěngjìng.
例句.en: He remained calm in the face of the unexpected event.

释义: to speak in defense of / to argue in favor of / to defend / to plead

例句.zh: 我在给魔鬼当辩护士。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài gěi mó guǐ dāng biàn hù shì 。
例句.en: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.

释义: to transform / to convert / to vary / to alternate / a transformation

例句.zh: 舞台上的灯光不断变换颜色。
例句.pinyin: Wǔtái shàng de dēngguāng bùduàn biànhuàn yánsè.
例句.en: The stage lights constantly change colors.

例句.zh: 这朵云在风中变换着形状。
例句.pinyin: Zhè duǒ yún zài fēng zhōng biànhuàn zhe xíngzhuàng.
例句.en: This cloud changes shape in the wind.

例句.zh: 摄影师通过变换角度拍出了不同的效果。
例句.pinyin: Shèyǐngshī tōngguò biànhuàn jiǎodù pāi chū le bùtóng de xiàoguǒ.
例句.en: The photographer achieved different effects by changing angles.

释义: to change unpredictably / unpredictable / erratic / treacherous

例句.zh: 山里的天气变幻莫测。
例句.pinyin: Shānlǐ de tiānqì biànhuàn mòcè.
例句.en: The weather in the mountains changes unpredictably.

例句.zh: 市场行情变幻莫测。
例句.pinyin: Shìchǎng hángqíng biànhuàn mòcè.
例句.en: Market conditions are unpredictable.

例句.zh: 故事的情节变幻莫测。
例句.pinyin: Gùshi de qíngjié biànhuàn mòcè.
例句.en: The plot of the story is full of unpredictable twists.

释义: to explain / to justify / to defend (a point of view etc) / to provide an explanation / to try to defend oneself

例句.zh: 他试图为自己的错误辩解。
例句.pinyin: Tā shìtú wèi zìjǐ de cuòwù biànjiě.
例句.en: He tried to justify his mistake.

例句.zh: 别再辩解了，我只想听实话。
例句.pinyin: Bié zài biànjiě le, wǒ zhǐ xiǎng tīng shíhuà.
例句.en: Stop making excuses; I just want to hear the truth.

例句.zh: 面对指责，她没有辩解。
例句.pinyin: Miànduì zhǐzé, tā méiyǒu biànjiě.
例句.en: Faced with the accusation, she did not defend herself.

释义: debate / argument / to argue over / CL:場|场[chang3],次[ci4]

例句.zh: Tatoeba：这里的辩论比两只兔子在袜子里做爱还要激烈！
例句.pinyin: Tatoeba： zhè lǐ de biàn lùn bǐ liǎng zhǐ tù zi zài wà zi lǐ zuò ài hái yào jī liè ！
例句.en: Tatoeba: Where debates are hotter than two rabbits making babies in a sock!

例句.zh: 比尔擅长辩论。
例句.pinyin: bǐ ěr shàn cháng biàn lùn 。
例句.en: Bill is skillful in arguing and debating.

例句.zh: 我认为辩论该继续进行。
例句.pinyin: wǒ rèn wéi biàn lùn gāi jì xù jìn xíng 。
例句.en: I believe that the debate should be carried on.

释义: changes / vicissitudes

例句.zh: 人们很容易将能源和电力小组委员会的大多数成员描述为笨蛋。他们散布石油和煤炭公司炮制的虚假信息，以最大限度地减少全球气候变迁的重要性，被称为科学文盲。
例句.pinyin: rén men hěn róng yì jiāng néng yuán hé diàn lì xiǎo zǔ wěi yuán huì de dà duō shù chéng yuán miáo shù wèi bèn dàn 。 tā men sàn bù shí yóu hé méi tàn gōng sī páo zhì de xū jiǎ xìn xī ， yǐ zuì dà xiàn dù dì jiǎn shǎo quán qiú qì hòu biàn qiān de zhòng yào xìng ， bèi chēng wéi kē xué wén máng 。
例句.en: One can easily characterize a majority of the energy and power subcommittee members as nincompoops — scientific illiterates who spread misinformation crafted by oil and coal companies in order to minimize the significance of global climate change.

释义: to recognize / to identify

例句.zh: 我一眼就辨认出了他。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ yì yǎn jiù biànrèn chū le tā.
例句.en: I recognized him at a glance.

例句.zh: 天太黑了，我无法辨认方向。
例句.pinyin: Tiān tài hēi le, wǒ wúfǎ biànrèn fāngxiàng.
例句.en: It was too dark for me to tell the direction.

例句.zh: 你能辨认出照片里的人吗？
例句.pinyin: Nǐ néng biànrèn chū zhàopiàn lǐ de rén ma?
例句.en: Can you recognize the person in the photo?

释义: pragmatic / flexible / to act differently in different situations / to accommodate to circumstances

例句.zh: 规定是死的，遇到特殊情况要懂得变通。
例句.pinyin: Guīdìng shì sǐ de, yùdào tèshū qíngkuàng yào dǒngde biàntōng.
例句.en: Rules are rigid, so you need to be flexible in special situations.

例句.zh: 这个办法行不通，我们得变通一下。
例句.pinyin: Zhège bànfǎ xíngbutōng, wǒmen děi biàntōng yíxià.
例句.en: This approach won't work; we need to adapt it.

例句.zh: 他做事很有原则，但也知道变通。
例句.pinyin: Tā zuòshì hěn yǒu yuánzé, dàn yě zhīdào biàntōng.
例句.en: He is very principled, but he also knows when to be flexible.

释义: portable

例句.zh: 这款便携式音箱很轻。
例句.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn biànxiéshì yīnxiǎng hěn qīng.
例句.en: This portable speaker is very light.

例句.zh: 我买了一台便携式电脑。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le yì tái biànxiéshì diànnǎo.
例句.en: I bought a portable computer.

例句.zh: 这种便携式充电器适合旅行。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng biànxiéshì chōngdiànqì shìhé lǚxíng.
例句.en: This portable charger is suitable for travel.

释义: to become deformed; to change shape; to morph
短释义: to become deformed; to change shape; to morph

例句.zh: 橡皮不硬：它在压力下会变形。
例句.pinyin: xiàng pí bù yìng ： tā zài yā lì xià huì biàn xíng 。
例句.en: Rubber is not hard: it gives way to pressure.

例句.zh: 我们突然向下望去，只见一个杯状的洼地，上面点缀著矮小的橡树和被多年风暴肆虐扭曲变形的蕨类植物。两座高耸狭窄的塔楼耸立在树梢之上。车夫用鞭子指著前方。他说：「巴斯克维尔庄园。」
例句.pinyin: wǒ men tū rán xiàng xià wàng qù ， zhǐ jiàn yí gè bēi zhuàng de wā dì ， shàng miàn diǎn zhuì zhù ǎi xiǎo de xiàng shù hé bèi duō nián fēng bào sì nüè niǔ qū biàn xíng de jué lèi zhí wù 。 liǎng zuò gāo sǒng xiá zhǎi de tǎ lóu sǒng lì zài shù shāo zhī shàng 。 chē fū yòng biān zi zhǐ zhù qián fāng 。 tā shuō ：「 bā sī kè wéi ěr zhuāng yuán 。」
例句.en: Suddenly we looked down into a cup-like depression, patched with stunted oaks and furs which had been twisted and bent by the fury of years of storm. Two high, narrow towers rose over the trees. The driver pointed with his whip. “Baskerville Hall,” said he.

例句.zh: 这件毛衣整个撑变形了。
例句.pinyin: zhè jiàn máo yī zhěng gè chēng biàn xíng le 。
例句.en: This sweater is all stretched out of shape.

释义: variation

例句.zh: 病毒开始变异了。
例句.pinyin: bìng dú kāi shǐ biàn yì le 。
例句.en: The virus is starting to mutate.

释义: to investigate / dialectical

例句.zh: 这个说法还有待辩证。
例句.pinyin: Zhège shuōfǎ hái yǒudài biànzhèng.
例句.en: This claim still needs to be investigated.

例句.zh: 学者们反复辩证这段史料的真伪。
例句.pinyin: Xuézhěmen fǎnfù biànzhèng zhè duàn shǐliào de zhēnwěi.
例句.en: The scholars repeatedly investigated the authenticity of this historical material.

例句.zh: 他查阅古籍，辩证传闻的来源。
例句.pinyin: Tā cháyuè gǔjí, biànzhèng chuánwén de láiyuán.
例句.en: He consulted ancient texts to investigate the source of the rumor.

释义: plait / braid / pigtail / a mistake or shortcoming that may be exploited by an opponent / handle / CL:根[gen1],條|条[tiao2]

例句.zh: 她扎着辫子。
例句.pinyin: tā zhā zhe biàn zi 。
例句.en: She wore her hair in plaits.

例句.zh: 玛莉正在把头发编成辫子。
例句.pinyin: mǎ lì zhèng zài bǎ tóu fā biān chéng biàn zi 。
例句.en: Mary is plaiting her hair into a pigtail.

例句.zh: 她的辫子掉了。
例句.pinyin: tā de biàn zi diào le 。
例句.en: Her pigtail fell out.

释义: mark / sign / label / to mark with a symbol, label, lettering etc / to bear (a brand name, registration number etc) / prize / award / bid / target / quota / (old) the topmost branches of a tree / visible symptom / classifier for military units

例句.zh: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。
例句.pinyin: yǒu le jiān dìng de mù biāo ， nǐ huì zuò dé hěn hǎo 。
例句.en: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.

例句.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。
例句.pinyin: zì wǒ huái yí shì cōng míng de dì yī biāo zhì 。
例句.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.

例句.zh: 他终于完成了他的目标。
例句.pinyin: tā zhōng yú wán chéng le tā de mù biāo 。
例句.en: In the end he achieved his objective.

释义: to flaunt / to advertise / to parade / boost / excessive praise

例句.zh: 他总是标榜自己生活简朴。
例句.pinyin: Tā zǒng shì biāobǎng zìjǐ shēnghuó jiǎnpǔ.
例句.en: He always portrays himself as living a simple life.

例句.zh: 这家餐厅标榜只用有机食材。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng biāobǎng zhǐ yòng yǒujī shícái.
例句.en: This restaurant claims to use only organic ingredients.

例句.zh: 他喜欢标榜自己的社会地位。
例句.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan biāobǎng zìjǐ de shèhuì dìwèi.
例句.en: He likes to flaunt his social status.

释义: specimen; sample / the root cause and symptoms of a disease

例句.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了许多昆虫标本。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn shōucáng le xǔduō kūnchóng biāoběn.
例句.en: This museum has a collection of many insect specimens.

例句.zh: 医生把组织标本送去检验。
例句.pinyin: Yīshēng bǎ zǔzhī biāoběn sòng qù jiǎnyàn.
例句.en: The doctor sent the tissue specimen for testing.

例句.zh: 学生们正在观察植物标本。
例句.pinyin: Xuéshēngmen zhèngzài guānchá zhíwù biāoběn.
例句.en: The students are observing plant specimens.

释义: punctuation / a punctuation mark / to punctuate / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: "我们吃爷爷吧。" 和"我们吃了吧, 爷爷。" 这两个句子可以证明标点符号能让句子有很大的不同。
例句.pinyin: " wǒ men chī yé yé ba 。"  hé " wǒ men chī le ba ,  yé yé 。"  zhè liǎng gè jù zi kě yǐ zhèng míng biāo diǎn fú hào néng ràng jù zi yǒu hěn dà de bù tóng 。
例句.en: The sentences "Let's eat grandpa." and "Let's eat, grandpa." are only one proof that punctuation can change a lot.

例句.zh: 你得要更注意拼字和标点符号。
例句.pinyin: nǐ dé yào gèng zhù yì pīn zì hé biāo diǎn fú hào 。
例句.en: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.

例句.zh: 他们说的话，我连标点符号都不信。
例句.pinyin: tā men shuō de huà ， wǒ lián biāo diǎn fú hào dōu bù xìn 。
例句.en: I do not trust a single word that comes out of their mouths.

释义: sign / mark / symbol / to mark up / (computing) token

例句.zh: 请在地图上标记这个地点。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng zài dìtú shàng biāojì zhège dìdiǎn.
例句.en: Please mark this location on the map.

例句.zh: 门上的红色标记很醒目。
例句.pinyin: Mén shàng de hóngsè biāojì hěn xǐngmù.
例句.en: The red sign on the door is very noticeable.

例句.zh: 我用星号标记了重点。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ yòng xīnghào biāojì le zhòngdiǎn.
例句.en: I marked the key points with asterisks.

释义: label / tag / (computing) tab (GUI element)

例句.zh: 箱子的内容在标签上面写着。
例句.pinyin: xiāng zi de nèi róng zài biāo qiān shàng miàn xiě zhe 。
例句.en: The contents of the box are listed on the label.

例句.zh: 你可以删除「需要母语者确认」的标签。
例句.pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ shān chú 「 xū yào mǔ yǔ zhě què rèn 」 de biāo qiān 。
例句.en: You can remove the NNC.

例句.zh: 我在我的行李上附上了有我名字的标签, 但是它很快就剥落了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài wǒ de xíng lǐ shàng fù shàng le yǒu wǒ míng zì de biāo qiān ,  dàn shì tā hěn kuài jiù bō luò le 。
例句.en: I attached my name-tag to my baggage, but it soon came off.

释义: to rise rapidly / to soar

例句.zh: 位于乔治亚州瓦尔多斯塔的南乔治亚山核桃公司是世界上最大的山核桃生产商之一，公司副总裁杰夫沃恩指出，去年中国购买了约 3,100 万至 3,600 万公斤山核桃，占美国去年山核桃总产量的三分之一。他表示，这导致山核桃价格飙升。
例句.pinyin: wèi yú qiáo zhì yà zhōu wǎ ěr duō sī tǎ de nán qiáo zhì yà shān hé táo gōng sī shì shì jiè shàng zuì dà de shān hé táo shēng chǎn shāng zhī yī ， gōng sī fù zǒng cái jié fū wò ēn zhǐ chū ， qù nián zhōng guó gòu mǎi le yuē  3,100  wàn zhì  3,600  wàn gōng jīn shān hé táo ， zhàn měi guó qù nián shān hé táo zǒng chǎn liàng de sān fēn zhī yī 。 tā biǎo shì ， zhè dǎo zhì shān hé táo jià gé biāo shēng 。
例句.en: Jeff Worn, the Vice President of the South Georgia Pecan Company in Valdosta, Georgia, one of the largest pecan producers in the world, says the Chinese bought about 31 to 36 million kilograms last year, a third of the entire U.S. pecan crop last year. He says that has raised the price of pecans precipitously.

释义: identifying mark, sign, label etc / to mark or label for identification / variant of 標誌|标志[biao1 zhi4]

例句.zh: 这个标识表示禁止停车。
例句.pinyin: Zhège biāoshí biǎoshì jìnzhǐ tíngchē.
例句.en: This sign means no parking.

例句.zh: 请用红笔标识重点内容。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng yòng hóngbǐ biāoshí zhòngdiǎn nèiróng.
例句.en: Please mark the key content with a red pen.

例句.zh: 包装上有清晰的回收标识。
例句.pinyin: Bāozhuāng shàng yǒu qīngxī de huíshōu biāoshí.
例句.en: There is a clear recycling symbol on the packaging.

释义: to indicate

例句.zh: 厕所门上的标示显示「使用中」的时候，代表有人正在使用。
例句.pinyin: cè suǒ mén shàng de biāo shì xiǎn shì 「 shǐ yòng zhōng 」 de shí hòu ， dài biǎo yǒu rén zhèng zài shǐ yòng 。
例句.en: When the sign on the door of a rest room says OCCUPIED, it means someone is using it.

释义: written slogan / placard / CL:幅[fu2],張|张[zhang1],條|条[tiao2]

例句.zh: 如果一个人在成人前没有机会习得目标语言，他对该语言的认识达到母语者程度的机会是相当小的。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ yí gè rén zài chéng rén qián méi yǒu jī huì xí dé mù biāo yǔ yán ， tā duì gāi yǔ yán de rèn shí dá dào mǔ yǔ zhě chéng dù de jī huì shì xiāng dāng xiǎo de 。
例句.en: If a person has not had a chance to acquire his target language by the time he's an adult, he's unlikely to be able to reach native speaker level in that language.

释义: Peugeot (automobile brand) / (of a woman) beautiful; pretty

例句.zh: 他买了一辆标致汽车。
例句.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yí liàng Biāozhì qìchē.
例句.en: He bought a Peugeot car.

例句.zh: 这辆标致很省油。
例句.pinyin: Zhè liàng Biāozhì hěn shěngyóu.
例句.en: This Peugeot is very fuel-efficient.

例句.zh: 标致是法国汽车品牌。
例句.pinyin: Biāozhì shì Fǎguó qìchē pǐnpái.
例句.en: Peugeot is a French automobile brand.

释义: to explain oneself / to express / to reveal one's thoughts or feelings / declaration / confession

例句.zh: 他急忙向老师表白，自己并没有作弊。
例句.pinyin: Tā jímáng xiàng lǎoshī biǎobái, zìjǐ bìng méiyǒu zuòbì.
例句.en: He hurriedly explained to the teacher that he had not cheated.

例句.zh: 她再三表白自己是无辜的。
例句.pinyin: Tā zàisān biǎobái zìjǐ shì wúgū de.
例句.en: She repeatedly declared that she was innocent.

例句.zh: 无论他怎么表白，大家都不相信他。

释义: on the edge of / (fig.) on the verge of / close to

例句.zh: 这是一个濒临灭绝的物种。
例句.pinyin: zhè shì yí gè bīn lín miè jué de wù zhǒng 。
例句.en: It is an endangered species.

例句.zh: 这是一个濒临消失的物种。
例句.pinyin: zhè shì yí gè bīn lín xiāo shī de wù zhǒng 。
例句.en: It is an endangered species.

例句.zh: 当我们濒临死亡，我们应该独处。我们将摒离所有身外之物。世间的朋友们-跟我们的地位，财富和社会层次息息相关的朋友，都将离我们而去，只因我们即将步入黑暗的山谷。那些与陌生人紧紧相连的关系网-我们的亲属、我们的爱人、孩子、兄弟姐妹，还有那些不太亲却有共同朋友的人们，我们也必须要分开。现在，他们并没用离开我们。有一个比兄弟更亲的人-爱他自己也爱世间直到尽头。
例句.pinyin: dāng wǒ men bīn lín sǐ wáng ， wǒ men yīng gāi dú chǔ 。 wǒ men jiāng bǐng lí suǒ yǒu shēn wài zhī wù 。 shì jiān de péng yǒu men - gēn wǒ men de dì wèi ， cái fù hé shè huì céng cì xī xī xiāng guān de péng yǒu ， dōu jiāng lí wǒ men ér qù ， zhǐ yīn wǒ men jí jiāng bù rù hēi àn de shān gǔ 。 nà xiē yǔ mò shēng rén jǐn jǐn xiāng lián de guān xì wǎng - wǒ men de qīn shǔ 、 wǒ men de ài rén 、 hái zi 、 xiōng dì jiě mèi ， hái yǒu nà xiē bù tài qīn què yǒu gòng tóng péng yǒu de rén men ， wǒ men yě bì xū yào fēn kāi 。 xiàn zài ， tā men bìng méi yòng lí kāi wǒ men 。 yǒu yí gè bǐ xiōng dì gèng qīn de rén - ài tā zì jǐ yě ài shì jiān zhí dào jìn tóu 。
例句.en: When we come to die, we shall be alone. From all our worldly possessions we shall be about to part. Worldly friends — the friends drawn to us by our position, our wealth, or our social qualities, — will leave us as we enter the dark valley. From those bound to us by stronger ties — our kindred, our loved ones, children, brothers, sisters, and from those not less dear to us who have been made our friends because they and we are the friends of the same Saviour, — from them also we must part. Yet not all will leave us. There is One who "sticketh closer than a brother" — One who having loved His own which are in the world loves them to the end.

释义: really isn't

例句.pinyin: zhàn zhēng bìng fēi bù kě bì miǎn 。
例句.en: War is not inevitable.

例句.zh: 我从来不是最有可能获得这一职务的候选人。我们刚开始并没有太多资金，也没有得到许多人的支持。我们的竞选活动并非始自华盛顿的大厅里，而是始于得梅因、康科德、查尔斯顿这些地方的普通民众家中。那些辛勤工作的人们从自己微薄的储蓄中捐出5美元、10美元、20美元。
例句.pinyin: wǒ cóng lái bú shì zuì yǒu kě néng huò dé zhè yī zhí wù de hòu xuǎn rén 。 wǒ men gāng kāi shǐ bìng méi yǒu tài duō zī jīn ， yě méi yǒu dé dào xǔ duō rén de zhī chí 。 wǒ men de jìng xuǎn huó dòng bìng fēi shǐ zì huá shèng dùn de dà tīng lǐ ， ér shì shǐ yú dé méi yīn 、 kāng kē dé 、 chá ěr sī dùn zhè xiē dì fāng de pǔ tōng mín zhòng jiā zhōng 。 nà xiē xīn qín gōng zuò de rén men cóng zì jǐ wēi bó de chǔ xù zhōng juān chū 5 měi yuán 、10 měi yuán 、20 měi yuán 。
例句.en: I was never the likeliest candidate for this office. We didn't start with much money or many endorsements. Our campaign was not hatched in the halls of Washington. It began in the backyards of Des Moines, and the living rooms of Concord, and the front porches of Charleston. It was built by working men and women who dug into what little savings they had to give $5 and $10 and $20 to the cause.

例句.zh: 那些追求和平和安全的人们，我们支持你们。那些所有怀疑美国的灯塔能否能像以前一样明亮的人们，今天晚上我们再次证明，我们国家真正的力量并非来自我们武器的威力或财富的规模，而是来自我们理想的持久力量：民主、 自由、机会、不屈服的希望。

例句.en: To those who seek peace and security. We support you. And to all those who have wondered if America's beacon still burns as bright, tonight we proved once more that the true strength of our nation comes not from the might of our arms or the scale of our wealth, but from the enduring power of our ideals: democracy, liberty, opportunity and unyielding hope.

例句.pinyin: tā duì wǒ de tí yì bù xiè yī gù 。

短释义: lit. isn't that a joy? (quote from Confucius)

例句.pinyin: Yánjiū rényuán bǔhuò le yì zhī yěshēng húli.

例句.pinyin: Tiānxiàn bǔhuò dào le wēiruò de xìnhào.

例句.zh: 这艘货运飞船将为太空站工作人员运送超过四吨的补给品、水、备件和实验硬件，其中包括完成太空站电力系统全面升级所需的六块新的锂离子电池。
例句.pinyin: zhè sōu huò yùn fēi chuán jiāng wèi tài kōng zhàn gōng zuò rén yuán yùn sòng chāo guò sì dūn de bǔ jǐ pǐn 、 shuǐ 、 bèi jiàn hé shí yàn yìng jiàn ， qí zhōng bāo kuò wán chéng tài kōng zhàn diàn lì xì tǒng quán miàn shēng jí suǒ xū de liù kuài xīn de lǐ lí zi diàn chí 。
例句.en: The cargo craft will carry more than four tons of supplies, water, spare parts and experiment hardware for the station crew, including six new lithium-ion batteries needed to complete an overall update of the station’s electrical system.

例句.zh: 这种问题该有补救办法。

例句.pinyin: nǎi lào shì yóu mǔ niú 、 shān yáng 、 mián yáng huò qí tā bǔ rǔ dòng wù de nǎi jiā gōng zhì chéng de gù tǐ shí wù 。

例句.pinyin: xún yú de shòu mìng yǒu shí néng chāo guò 50 nián ， zhǎng dé dà dào shǎo shù de bǔ shí zhě cái huì qù liè 。

释义: to feed / (fig.) to nurture; to foster

例句.zh: 我命令希葛拉紧贴著婴孩卧下，以自己的乳汁哺育他，平息他的饥渴。我又令她将话语传遍整片森林，告诉所有爬虫与走兽：此子不可伤害。
例句.pinyin: wǒ mìng lìng xī gé lā jǐn tiē zhù yīng hái wò xià ， yǐ zì jǐ de rǔ zhī bǔ yù tā ， píng xī tā de jī kě 。 wǒ yòu lìng tā jiāng huà yǔ chuán biàn zhěng piàn sēn lín ， gào sù suǒ yǒu pá chóng yǔ zǒu shòu ： cǐ zi bù kě shāng hài 。
例句.en: I commanded Shiegra to lie close to the babe, and to give it her milk to quiet its hunger. And I told her to send word throughout the forest, to all beasts and reptiles, that the child should not be harmed.

例句.zh: 她每月能领到住房补助。

例句.en: She receives a housing subsidy every month.

释义: to catch; to seize; to capture
短释义: to catch; to seize; to capture

例句.zh: 他们利用陷阱捕捉狐狸。
例句.pinyin: tā men lì yòng xiàn jǐng bǔ zhuō hú lí 。
例句.en: Using a trap, they caught the fox.

例句.zh: 政府官员与业界人士也开始意识到「甲烷捕捉计划」的潜力。美国农业部正在密西西比州及其他数个州资助农场内的实验场址。部分大型禽肉加工业者正在成立再生能源部门，以供应饲料厂所需电力。此外，一家燃料公司正在评估是否可以用鸡只排放的甲烷取代天然气，并注入管线，用来为部分沿线发电机提供动力。
例句.pinyin: zhèng fǔ guān yuán yǔ yè jiè rén shì yě kāi shǐ yì shí dào 「 jiǎ wán bǔ zhuō jì huà 」 de qián lì 。 měi guó nóng yè bù zhèng zài mì xī xī bǐ zhōu jí qí tā shù gè zhōu zī zhù nóng chǎng nèi de shí yàn chǎng zhǐ 。 bù fèn dà xíng qín ròu jiā gōng yè zhě zhèng zài chéng lì zài shēng néng yuán bù mén ， yǐ gōng yìng sì liào chǎng suǒ xū diàn lì 。 cǐ wài ， yī jiā rán liào gōng sī zhèng zài píng gū shì fǒu kě yǐ yòng jī zhǐ pái fàng de jiǎ wán qǔ dài tiān rán qì ， bìng zhù rù guǎn xiàn ， yòng lái wèi bù fèn yán xiàn fā diàn jī tí gōng dòng lì 。
例句.en: Officials from government and industry are also starting to recognize the potential of the Methane Capture Project. The U.S. Department of Agriculture is funding experimental on-farm sites in Mississippi and several other states. Some large poultry processors are launching renewable energy divisions to power their feed mills. And a fuel company is investigating the possibility of pumping chicken-waste methane instead of natural gas through its pipeline, and to use it to power some of the generators along the way.

短释义: not paying attention; carelessly; by accident

释义: there is no lack of

例句.pinyin: Zhèlǐ bù fá yōuxiù réncái.

例句.zh: 支持者中不乏年轻人。
例句.pinyin: Zhīchízhě zhōng bù fá niánqīngrén.

例句.en: There is no lack of fine works in this category.

释义: pace / (measured) step / march

例句.zh: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。
例句.pinyin: tā mài zhe wěn jiàn de bù fá dēng shàng le shān qiū 。
例句.en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.

例句.zh: 所谓头脑好的人，就如同步伐轻快的云游者，他可以比别人捷足先登，到达人们尚未去过的地方，但是他可能会忽略掉路旁或岔道上的珍贵物品。
例句.pinyin: suǒ wèi tóu nǎo hǎo de rén ， jiù rú tóng bù fá qīng kuài de yún yóu zhě ， tā kě yǐ bǐ bié rén jié zú xiān dēng ， dào dá rén men shàng wèi qù guò de dì fāng ， dàn shì tā kě néng huì hū lüè diào lù páng huò chà dào shàng de zhēn guì wù pǐn 。
例句.en: A person with a sharp mind is like a nimble wanderer who can outpace others and reach places uncharted by the masses, yet they might overlook precious treasures along the way or at crossroads.

例句.zh: 我们应该走出什么样的步伐。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men yīng gāi zǒu chū shén me yàng de bù fá 。
例句.en: What steps should we take?

释义: lawless / illegal / unlawful

例句.zh: 警方逮捕了几名不法分子。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng dàibǔ le jǐ míng bùfǎ fènzǐ.
例句.en: The police arrested several lawbreakers.

例句.zh: 这些不法商人欺骗了消费者。
例句.pinyin: Zhèxiē bùfǎ shāngrén qīpiàn le xiāofèizhě.
例句.en: These dishonest merchants deceived consumers.

例句.zh: 我们必须打击不法行为。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen bìxū dǎjī bùfǎ xíngwéi.
例句.en: We must crack down on unlawful activities.

释义: there is no harm in; might as well
短释义: there is no harm in; might as well

例句.zh: 你不妨告诉我一切。
例句.pinyin: nǐ bù fáng gào sù wǒ yī qiè 。
例句.en: You may as well tell me all about it.

释义: not to accept sth / to want to have sth overruled or changed / to refuse to obey or comply / to refuse to accept as final / to remain unconvinced by / not to give in to

例句.zh: 他不服老。
例句.pinyin: tā bù fú lǎo 。

例句.zh: 如果汤姆不服用处方药，他的健康状况可能会恶化。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ tāng mǔ bù fú yòng chǔ fāng yào ， tā de jiàn kāng zhuàng kuàng kě néng huì è huà 。
例句.en: If Tom doesn't take the prescribed medicine, his state of health might deteriorate.

释义: lit. I dare not (accept the honor); fig. I don't deserve your praise / you flatter me
短释义: lit. I dare not (accept the honor); fig. I don't deserve your praise

例句.zh: 不敢当。
例句.pinyin: bù gǎn dāng 。
例句.en: I don't deserve it.

例句.zh: 不敢当。
例句.pinyin: bù gǎn dāng 。
例句.en: I don't deserve it.

释义: to fall short of / not as good as / too late

例句.zh: 我迫不及待地想要看到Tatoeba的新版本。
例句.pinyin: wǒ pò bù jí dài dì xiǎng yào kàn dào Tatoeba de xīn bǎn běn 。
例句.en: I'm very impatient to see the new version of Tatoeba.

例句.zh: 我向他道贺；也向裴林州长道贺，为他们所成就的一切。我迫不及待想和他们携手合作，在未来数月更新这个国家的许诺。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiàng tā dào hè ； yě xiàng péi lín zhōu zhǎng dào hè ， wèi tā men suǒ chéng jiù de yī qiè 。 wǒ pò bù jí dài xiǎng hé tā men xié shǒu hé zuò ， zài wèi lái shù yuè gēng xīn zhè ge guó jiā de xǔ nuò 。
例句.en: I congratulate him, I congratulate Governor Palin for all that they've achieved. And I look forward to working with them to renew this nation's promise in the months ahead.

例句.zh: 你虽然考试不及格，但也不必自卑。
例句.pinyin: nǐ suī rán kǎo shì bù jí gé ， dàn yě bù bì zì bēi 。
例句.en: You needn't be ashamed because you failed the exam.

释义: part; component

例句.zh: 这是个旧部件。
例句.pinyin: zhè shì gè jiù bù jiàn 。
例句.en: This is an old unit.

释义: (idiom) to act without taking time to think; to react instantly; to fire from the hip
短释义: (idiom) to act without taking time to think; to react instantly; to fire from the hip

例句.zh: 汤姆不假思索脱口而出。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ bù jiǎ sī suǒ tuō kǒu ér chū 。
例句.en: Tom speaks without thinking.

释义: to not understand / to be puzzled by / indissoluble
