例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ mí huò bù jiě 。
例句.en: Tom remained puzzled.

例句.zh: 这个无神论者困惑不解。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge wú shén lùn zhě kùn huò bù jiě 。
例句.en: The atheist is confused.

例句.zh: 多让人不解呀！
例句.pinyin: duō ràng rén bù jiě ya ！
例句.en: What a puzzle.

释义: slack / in a slump

例句.zh: 经济不景气失业率上升到了5％。
例句.pinyin: jīng jì bù jǐng qì shī yè lǜ shàng shēng dào le 5％。
例句.en: The unemployment rate went up to 5% because of the recession.

释义: arrangement / composition / layout / opening (chess jargon)

例句.zh: 我改了一下我的网站的布局。
例句.pinyin: wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ de wǎng zhàn de bù jú 。
例句.en: I've changed my website's layout.

例句.zh: 他家的布局非常温馨。
例句.pinyin: tā jiā de bù jú fēi cháng wēn xīn 。
例句.en: His home is furnished in a very cozy way.

释义: cannot bear / cannot stand / utterly / extremely

例句.zh: 在过去一个相当长的时期里，社会都是等级制度森严并且极度不公的，做为社会阶级中最大一部分的贫农常常被赋税，战争，饥荒压得喘不过气来，痛苦不堪。
例句.pinyin: zài guò qù yí gè xiāng dāng zhǎng de shí qī lǐ ， shè huì dōu shì děng jí zhì dù sēn yán bìng qiě jí dù bù gōng de ， zuò wèi shè huì jiē jí zhōng zuì dà yī bù fèn de pín nóng cháng cháng bèi fù shuì ， zhàn zhēng ， jī huāng yā dé chuǎn bù guò qì lái ， tòng kǔ bù kān 。
例句.en: For a long time, society was strongly hierarchical and unequal, primarily composed of peasants. The most backward, impoverished segment of the population, they were crushed by the weight of taxes, wars, and famines.

例句.zh: 我们还是脆弱不堪。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men hái shì cuì ruò bù kān 。
例句.en: We're still vulnerable.

例句.zh: 她的衣服破旧不堪。
例句.pinyin: tā de yī fú pò jiù bù kān 。
例句.en: Her clothes are worn out.

释义: necessary / must have

例句.zh: 空气是生命中不可或缺的。
例句.pinyin: kōng qì shì shēng mìng zhòng bù kě huò quē de 。
例句.en: Air is indispensable to life.

例句.zh: 在下雪很多的地方，煤油是不可或缺的东西。
例句.pinyin: zài xià xuě hěn duō de dì fāng ， méi yóu shì bù kě huò quē de dōng xī 。
例句.en: In places where it snows a lot, kerosene is an indispensable item.

例句.zh: 若是有人对公司来说是不可或缺的，那么这家公司组织得不好。
例句.pinyin: ruò shì yǒu rén duì gōng sī lái shuō shì bù kě huò quē de ， nà me zhè jiā gōng sī zǔ zhī dé bù hǎo 。
例句.en: If someone is indispensable to a company, then that company is not well-organized.

释义: (idiom) inconceivable; unimaginable; unfathomable

例句.zh: 你真是不可思议。
例句.pinyin: nǐ zhēn shì bù kě sī yì 。
例句.en: You are fantastic.

例句.zh: 这件事情真是太不可思议了。
例句.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì qíng zhēn shì tài bù kě sī yì le 。
例句.en: This situation is truly unimaginable.

释义: to settle a matter by leaving it unsettled / to end up with nothing definite
短释义: to settle a matter by leaving it unsettled

例句.zh: 这件事最后不了了之。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì zuìhòu bù liǎo liǎo zhī.
例句.en: The matter was eventually left unresolved.

例句.zh: 由于证据不足，调查只好不了了之。
例句.pinyin: Yóuyú zhèngjù bùzú, diàochá zhǐhǎo bù liǎo liǎo zhī.
例句.en: Because there was insufficient evidence, the investigation had to be dropped without resolution.

例句.zh: 双方争论了很久，这个问题却不了了之。
例句.pinyin: Shuāngfāng zhēnglùn le hěn jiǔ, zhège wèntí què bù liǎo liǎo zhī.
例句.en: The two sides argued for a long time, but the issue was left unresolved.

释义: inevitably

例句.zh: 他是个忠厚老实的人，不免上当。
例句.pinyin: tā shì gè zhōng hòu lǎo shí de rén ， bù miǎn shàng dàng 。
例句.en: He is an honest person, and he will always be lied to.

释义: uneven / injustice / unfairness / wrong / grievance / indignant / dissatisfied

例句.zh: 生活真正的艺术是在平凡中看到不平凡。
例句.pinyin: shēng huó zhēn zhèng de yì shù shì zài píng fán zhōng kàn dào bù píng fán 。
例句.en: True art of life is to see the extraordinary amongst the ordinary.

例句.zh: 地面高低不平，给部队前进带来了困难。
例句.pinyin: dì miàn gāo dī bù píng ， gěi bù duì qián jìn dài lái le kùn nán 。
例句.en: The rugged terrain made the troops' advance difficult.

例句.zh: 研究报告的作者指出，改变歧视性的性别规范和制度、解决经济和社会不平等问题、保障教育和安全工作的机会是有助于预防暴力的其他措施。
例句.pinyin: yán jiū bào gào de zuò zhě zhǐ chū ， gǎi biàn qí shì xìng de xìng bié guī fàn hé zhì dù 、 jiě jué jīng jì hé shè huì bù píng děng wèn tí 、 bǎo zhàng jiào yù hé ān quán gōng zuò de jī huì shì yǒu zhù yú yù fáng bào lì de qí tā cuò shī 。
例句.en: Authors of the study report that changing discriminatory gender norms and institutions, addressing economic and social inequalities, and ensuring access to education and safe work are other measures that can help prevent violence.

释义: must not / cannot / to not allow / cannot tolerate

例句.zh: 要掌握法语一点都不容易。
例句.pinyin: yào zhǎng wò fǎ yǔ yì diǎn dōu bù róng yì 。
例句.en: It's not easy to master French at all.

例句.zh: 区分善恶不容易。
例句.pinyin: qū fēn shàn è bù róng yì 。
例句.en: It is not easy to distinguish good from evil.

例句.zh: 他们好不容易才回答了他们老师的问题。
例句.pinyin: tā men hǎo bù róng yì cái huí dá le tā men lǎo shī de wèn tí 。
例句.en: They answered their teacher's question with difficulty.

释义: to step into; to enter

例句.zh: 当我们濒临死亡，我们应该独处。我们将摒离所有身外之物。世间的朋友们-跟我们的地位，财富和社会层次息息相关的朋友，都将离我们而去，只因我们即将步入黑暗的山谷。那些与陌生人紧紧相连的关系网-我们的亲属、我们的爱人、孩子、兄弟姐妹，还有那些不太亲却有共同朋友的人们，我们也必须要分开。现在，他们并没用离开我们。有一个比兄弟更亲的人-爱他自己也爱世间直到尽头。
例句.pinyin: dāng wǒ men bīn lín sǐ wáng ， wǒ men yīng gāi dú chǔ 。 wǒ men jiāng bǐng lí suǒ yǒu shēn wài zhī wù 。 shì jiān de péng yǒu men - gēn wǒ men de dì wèi ， cái fù hé shè huì céng cì xī xī xiāng guān de péng yǒu ， dōu jiāng lí wǒ men ér qù ， zhǐ yīn wǒ men jí jiāng bù rù hēi àn de shān gǔ 。 nà xiē yǔ mò shēng rén jǐn jǐn xiāng lián de guān xì wǎng - wǒ men de qīn shǔ 、 wǒ men de ài rén 、 hái zi 、 xiōng dì jiě mèi ， hái yǒu nà xiē bù tài qīn què yǒu gòng tóng péng yǒu de rén men ， wǒ men yě bì xū yào fēn kāi 。 xiàn zài ， tā men bìng méi yòng lí kāi wǒ men 。 yǒu yí gè bǐ xiōng dì gèng qīn de rén - ài tā zì jǐ yě ài shì jiān zhí dào jìn tóu 。
例句.en: When we come to die, we shall be alone. From all our worldly possessions we shall be about to part. Worldly friends — the friends drawn to us by our position, our wealth, or our social qualities, — will leave us as we enter the dark valley. From those bound to us by stronger ties — our kindred, our loved ones, children, brothers, sisters, and from those not less dear to us who have been made our friends because they and we are the friends of the same Saviour, — from them also we must part. Yet not all will leave us. There is One who "sticketh closer than a brother" — One who having loved His own which are in the world loves them to the end.

释义: radical of a Chinese character

例句.zh: “好”的部首是女。
例句.pinyin: “ hǎo ” de bù shǒu shì nǚ 。
例句.en: The radical in the Chinese character for "good" is the character for "woman".

例句.zh: 汉字的基本单位称作「部首」。
例句.pinyin: hàn zì de jī běn dān wèi chēng zuò 「 bù shǒu 」。
例句.en: The basic components of Chinese characters are called "radicals".

释义: to dispose / to deploy / deployment

例句.zh: 公司已经部署了新的安全系统。
例句.pinyin: Gōngsī yǐjīng bùshǔ le xīn de ānquán xìtǒng.
例句.en: The company has deployed a new security system.

例句.zh: 警方迅速部署警力，维护现场秩序。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng xùnsù bùshǔ jǐnglì, wéihù xiànchǎng zhìxù.
例句.en: The police quickly deployed officers to maintain order at the scene.

例句.zh: 领导正在部署明年的工作。
例句.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo zhèngzài bùshǔ míngnián de gōngzuò.
例句.en: The leadership is arranging the work for next year.

释义: not stint / not spare / not hesitate (to do sth) / not scruple (to do sth)

例句.zh: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men yīng gāi bù xī dài jià bì miǎn zhàn zhēng 。
例句.en: We must avoid war at all cost.

例句.zh: 演说家为了征服他的听众，不惜使用他在交流课上学到的修辞技巧。
例句.pinyin: yǎn shuō jiā wèi le zhēng fú tā de tīng zhòng ， bù xī shǐ yòng tā zài jiāo liú kè shàng xué dào de xiū cí jì qiǎo 。
例句.en: To win his audience, the speaker resorted to using rhetorical techniques he learned from his communication courses.

例句.zh: 战争必须不惜一切代价地去避免。
例句.pinyin: zhàn zhēng bì xū bù xī yí qiè dài jià dì qù bì miǎn 。
例句.en: War must be avoided at all costs.

释义: equally matched / about the same

例句.zh: 这两支球队实力不相上下。
例句.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhī qiúduì shílì bù xiāng shàng xià.
例句.en: The two teams are evenly matched in strength.

例句.zh: 我和他的中文水平不相上下。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ hé tā de Zhōngwén shuǐpíng bù xiāng shàng xià.
例句.en: His Chinese and mine are at about the same level.

例句.zh: 这两家餐厅的味道不相上下。
例句.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā cāntīng de wèidào bù xiāng shàng xià.
例句.en: The food at these two restaurants is equally good.

释义: (idiom) it goes without saying; it is self-evident
短释义: (idiom) it goes without saying; it is self-evident

例句.zh: 不言而喻。
例句.pinyin: bù yán ér yù 。
例句.en: That goes without saying.

释义: not to accept as correct (idiom); to object / to disapprove / to take exception to
短释义: not to accept as correct (idiom); to object

例句.zh: 他对这种说法不以为然。
例句.pinyin: Tā duì zhè zhǒng shuōfǎ bù yǐ wéi rán.
例句.en: He does not agree with this view.

例句.zh: 大家都很担心，她却不以为然。
例句.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu hěn dānxīn, tā què bù yǐ wéi rán.
例句.en: Everyone was worried, but she did not think it was a big deal.

例句.zh: 老师对他的解释不以为然。
例句.pinyin: Lǎoshī duì tā de jiěshì bù yǐ wéi rán.
例句.en: The teacher did not accept his explanation.

释义: can't help / cannot but

例句.zh: 不由得想起了故乡。
例句.pinyin: bù yóu de xiǎng qǐ le gù xiāng 。
例句.en: I can never forget my hometown.

释义: (idiom) can't help but; involuntarily

例句.zh: 总统不由自主地笑了起来。
例句.pinyin: zǒng tǒng bù yóu zì zhǔ dì xiào le qǐ lái 。

短释义: (idiom) (of two or more people) to take the same action without prior consultation; (usu. used adverbially) all (or both) of them, independently; as if by prior agreement

例句.zh: 听到这个好消息，大家不约而同地笑了起来。
例句.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège hǎo xiāoxi, dàjiā bùyuē’értóng de xiào le qǐlái.
例句.en: Upon hearing the good news, everyone smiled at the same time without prior agreement.

例句.zh: 我们不约而同地选择了同一件礼物。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen bùyuē’értóng de xuǎnzé le tóng yí jiàn lǐwù.
例句.en: We independently chose the same gift.

例句.zh: 下雨了，两个人不约而同地跑进了咖啡馆。
例句.pinyin: Xiàyǔ le, liǎng ge rén bùyuē’értóng de pǎo jìn le kāfēiguǎn.
例句.en: When it started raining, both of them ran into the café as if by prior agreement.

释义: a hundred percent / to the letter / out-and-out

例句.zh: 他是个不折不扣的足球迷。
例句.pinyin: Tā shì ge bù zhé bú kòu de zú qiú mí.
例句.en: He is a one-hundred-percent football fan.

例句.zh: 这是一场不折不扣的骗局。
例句.pinyin: Zhè shì yì chǎng bù zhé bú kòu de piàn jú.
例句.en: This is an outright scam.

例句.zh: 她是个不折不扣的乐观主义者。
例句.pinyin: Tā shì ge bù zhé bú kòu de lè guān zhǔ yì zhě.
例句.en: She is a thoroughgoing optimist.

释义: (idiom) unconsciously; unwittingly

例句.zh: 天不知不觉地暗了下来。

例句.zh: 现在是 2025 年 8 月 3 日，露露岛。晚餐后，阳光下嫩绿的无花果，昨天腌制的甜醋，还有重新加热的阿尔弗雷多义面，我坐在阳台上，望著那棵针叶树。楼下静谧无声，街道空无一车，一片悠闲。我的冰镇青柠水在阳光下闪闪发光。最近，我常和那位法丹混血的 UFO 研究专家麦可聊天。我们谈论内心深处的事情：智慧型装置的迷醉，以及思维的衰退。他说，咖啡馆已经不再是咖啡馆了。人们忘记如何观察、如何驻足停留。我跟他讲起在日本的亚瑟，他会像僧侣凝视虚空一样，对著空白的墙壁发呆。最近，我让机器像诗人一样说话，它们真的做到了。它们模仿伊莉莎白时代的诗歌，以及塔加洛语民谣中那古老而忧伤的韵律。我沿著通往蒂姆霍顿咖啡店的小路采摘黑莓。我像个孩子似的喊道：「莫拉！」我的朋友莫拉，她血液里流著安地斯山脉的薄雾，她会笑的。今天，我买了黄柠檬。我本来想买青柠，但黄柠檬也可以。/ 黑莓的清晨 / 指尖残留无花果的痕迹 / 街道依然沉睡
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì  2025  nián  8  yuè  3  rì ， lù lù dǎo 。 wǎn cān hòu ， yáng guāng xià nèn lǜ de wú huā guǒ ， zuó tiān yān zhì de tián cù ， hái yǒu chóng xīn jiā rè de ā ěr fú léi duō yì miàn ， wǒ zuò zài yáng tái shàng ， wàng zhù nà kē zhēn yè shù 。 lóu xià jìng mì wú shēng ， jiē dào kōng wú yī chē ， yī piàn yōu xián 。 wǒ de bīng zhèn qīng níng shuǐ zài yáng guāng xià shǎn shǎn fā guāng 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ cháng hé nà wèi fǎ dān hùn xuè de  UFO  yán jiū zhuān jiā mài kě liáo tiān 。 wǒ men tán lùn nèi xīn shēn chù de shì qíng ： zhì huì xíng zhuāng zhì de mí zuì ， yǐ jí sī wéi de shuāi tuì 。 tā shuō ， kā fēi guǎn yǐ jīng bù zài shì kā fēi guǎn le 。 rén men wàng jì rú hé guān chá 、 rú hé zhù zú tíng liú 。 wǒ gēn tā jiǎng qǐ zài rì běn de yà sè ， tā huì xiàng sēng lǚ níng shì xū kōng yī yàng ， duì zhù kòng bái de qiáng bì fā dāi 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ ràng jī qì xiàng shī rén yī yàng shuō huà ， tā men zhēn de zuò dào le 。 tā men mó fǎng yī lì shā bái shí dài de shī gē ， yǐ jí tǎ jiā luò yǔ mín yáo zhōng nà gǔ lǎo ér yōu shāng de yùn lǜ 。 wǒ yán zhù tōng wǎng dì mǔ huò dùn kā fēi diàn de xiǎo lù cǎi zhāi hēi méi 。 wǒ xiàng gè hái zi shì de hǎn dào ：「 mò lā ！」 wǒ de péng yǒu mò lā ， tā xuè yè lǐ liú zhù ān dì sī shān mài de bó wù ， tā huì xiào de 。 jīn tiān ， wǒ mǎi le huáng níng méng 。 wǒ běn lái xiǎng mǎi qīng níng ， dàn huáng níng méng yě kě yǐ 。/  hēi méi de qīng chén  /  zhǐ jiān cán liú wú huā guǒ de hén jì  /  jiē dào yī rán chén shuì
例句.en: It's Lulu Island, 3 August 2025. After supper—green figs tender with sunlight, sweet vinegar from yesterday’s pickled jar, and reheated Alfredo—I sat on the balcony and watched the conifer. Stillness below, a street without cars, without haste. My lime water, iced, caught the light. Michael, the Franco-Danish ufologist, has been in my conversations lately. We speak of inner things: the trance of smart devices, the mind’s eye dwindling. He says cafés aren’t cafés anymore. People forget how to look, how to linger. I tell him of Arthur in Japan—how he'd stare into blank walls like a monk gazing at emptiness. Lately I ask machines to speak like poets, and they do. They mimic Elizabethan verses and the old wistful lilt of Tagalog ballads. I pick blackberries along the path to Tim Hortons. "¡Moras!" I shout like a child. My friend Mora, whose blood flows with Andes mist, would smile. Today, I bought lemons. I meant limes, but lemons are all right. / blackberry morning— / a fig's ghost on my fingers / and the street still sleeps

例句.zh: 现在是 2025 年 8 月 3 日，露露岛。晚餐后，阳光下嫩绿的无花果，昨天腌制的甜醋，还有重新加热的阿尔弗雷多义面，我坐在阳台上，望著那棵针叶树。楼下静谧无声，街道空无一车，一片悠闲。我的冰镇青柠水在阳光下闪闪发光。最近，我常和那位法丹混血的 UFO 研究专家麦可聊天。我们谈论内心深处的事情：智慧型装置的迷醉，以及思维的衰退。他说，咖啡馆已经不再是咖啡馆了。人们忘记如何观察、如何驻足停留。我跟他讲起在日本的亚瑟，他会像僧侣凝视虚空一样，对著空白的墙壁发呆。最近，我让机器像诗人一样说话，它们真的做到了。它们模仿伊莉莎白时代的诗歌，以及塔加洛语民谣中那古老而忧伤的韵律。我沿著通往蒂姆霍顿咖啡店的小路采摘黑莓。我像个孩子似的喊道：「莫拉！」我的朋友莫拉，她血液里流著安地斯山脉的薄雾，她会笑的。今天，我买了黄柠檬。我本来想买青柠，但黄柠檬也可以。/ 黑莓的清晨 / 指尖残留无花果的痕迹 / 街道依然沉睡
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì  2025  nián  8  yuè  3  rì ， lù lù dǎo 。 wǎn cān hòu ， yáng guāng xià nèn lǜ de wú huā guǒ ， zuó tiān yān zhì de tián cù ， hái yǒu chóng xīn jiā rè de ā ěr fú léi duō yì miàn ， wǒ zuò zài yáng tái shàng ， wàng zhù nà kē zhēn yè shù 。 lóu xià jìng mì wú shēng ， jiē dào kōng wú yī chē ， yī piàn yōu xián 。 wǒ de bīng zhèn qīng níng shuǐ zài yáng guāng xià shǎn shǎn fā guāng 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ cháng hé nà wèi fǎ dān hùn xuè de  UFO  yán jiū zhuān jiā mài kě liáo tiān 。 wǒ men tán lùn nèi xīn shēn chù de shì qíng ： zhì huì xíng zhuāng zhì de mí zuì ， yǐ jí sī wéi de shuāi tuì 。 tā shuō ， kā fēi guǎn yǐ jīng bù zài shì kā fēi guǎn le 。 rén men wàng jì rú hé guān chá 、 rú hé zhù zú tíng liú 。 wǒ gēn tā jiǎng qǐ zài rì běn de yà sè ， tā huì xiàng sēng lǚ níng shì xū kōng yī yàng ， duì zhù kòng bái de qiáng bì fā dāi 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ ràng jī qì xiàng shī rén yī yàng shuō huà ， tā men zhēn de zuò dào le 。 tā men mó fǎng yī lì shā bái shí dài de shī gē ， yǐ jí tǎ jiā luò yǔ mín yáo zhōng nà gǔ lǎo ér yōu shāng de yùn lǜ 。 wǒ yán zhù tōng wǎng dì mǔ huò dùn kā fēi diàn de xiǎo lù cǎi zhāi hēi méi 。 wǒ xiàng gè hái zi shì de hǎn dào ：「 mò lā ！」 wǒ de péng yǒu mò lā ， tā xuè yè lǐ liú zhù ān dì sī shān mài de bó wù ， tā huì xiào de 。 jīn tiān ， wǒ mǎi le huáng níng méng 。 wǒ běn lái xiǎng mǎi qīng níng ， dàn huáng níng méng yě kě yǐ 。/  hēi méi de qīng chén  /  zhǐ jiān cán liú wú huā guǒ de hén jì  /  jiē dào yī rán chén shuì
例句.en: It's Lulu Island, 3 August 2025. After supper—green figs tender with sunlight, sweet vinegar from yesterday’s pickled jar, and reheated Alfredo—I sat on the balcony and watched the conifer. Stillness below, a street without cars, without haste. My lime water, iced, caught the light. Michael, the Franco-Danish ufologist, has been in my conversations lately. We speak of inner things: the trance of smart devices, the mind’s eye dwindling. He says cafés aren’t cafés anymore. People forget how to look, how to linger. I tell him of Arthur in Japan—how he'd stare into blank walls like a monk gazing at emptiness. Lately I ask machines to speak like poets, and they do. They mimic Elizabethan verses and the old wistful lilt of Tagalog ballads. I pick blackberries along the path to Tim Hortons. "¡Moras!" I shout like a child. My friend Mora, whose blood flows with Andes mist, would smile. Today, I bought lemons. I meant limes, but lemons are all right. / blackberry morning— / a fig's ghost on my fingers / and the street still sleeps

例句.zh: 于是那欢快的小男孩们四处游荡，/ 如此喜悦地穿越山丘与山谷，/ 蔷薇的芬芳穿过荆棘丛 / 将随温柔的夏风飘散：/ 每个清晨，大自然含笑赐予，/ 那贫苦卑微的农夫也得一份，/ 云雀从草丛中振翅而上，/ 将悠扬的音符送向天际。
例句.pinyin: yú shì nà huān kuài de xiǎo nán hái men sì chù yóu dàng ，/  rú cǐ xǐ yuè dì chuān yuè shān qiū yǔ shān gǔ ，/  qiáng wēi de fēn fāng chuān guò jīng jí cóng  /  jiāng suí wēn róu de xià fēng piāo sàn ：/  měi gè qīng chén ， dà zì rán hán xiào cì yǔ ，/  nà pín kǔ bēi wēi de nóng fū yě dé yī fèn ，/  yún què cóng cǎo cóng zhōng zhèn chì ér shàng ，/  jiāng yōu yáng de yīn fú sòng xiàng tiān jì 。
例句.en: Then the merry little boys they will ramble, / So gleesome, o’er mountain and dale, / Where the sweets of the rose through the bramble / Will be blown by the mild summer gale: / Then a share of Nature’s smiles each morning / To the poor humble peasant will be given. / While the lark from his covert he is soaring, / His musical notes to the heaven.

释义: lawn

例句.zh: 妈妈叫我修剪草坪。
例句.pinyin: mā mā jiào wǒ xiū jiǎn cǎo píng 。
例句.en: Mother told me to mow the lawn.

例句.zh: 离开草坪!
例句.pinyin: lí kāi cǎo píng !
例句.en: Get off the lawn!

例句.zh: 如果天气情况允许的话，我明天就去割草坪。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ tiān qì qíng kuàng yǔn xǔ de huà ， wǒ míng tiān jiù qù gē cǎo píng 。
例句.en: I'm going to mow the lawn tomorrow, weather permitting.

释义: careless / negligent / sloppy / not serious

例句.zh: 麻烦的开头是他草率的评论。
例句.pinyin: má fán de kāi tóu shì tā cǎo shuài de píng lùn 。
例句.en: The beginning of the trouble was his careless remark.

释义: herbal medicine

例句.zh: 这种草药可以缓解头痛。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng cǎoyào kěyǐ huǎnjiě tóutòng.
例句.en: This herbal medicine can relieve headaches.

例句.zh: 医生教我怎么煮草药。
例句.pinyin: Yīshēng jiāo wǒ zěnme zhǔ cǎoyào.
例句.en: The doctor taught me how to prepare the herbal medicine.

例句.zh: 这家店卖各种中国草药。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn mài gè zhǒng Zhōngguó cǎoyào.
例句.en: This shop sells various kinds of Chinese herbal medicine.

释义: to determine (by measuring or surveying)

例句.zh: 医生测定了患者的血糖水平。
例句.pinyin: Yīshēng cèdìng le huànzhě de xuètáng shuǐpíng.
例句.en: The doctor measured the patient's blood sugar level.

例句.zh: 实验人员正在测定水中的含盐量。
例句.pinyin: Shíyàn rényuán zhèngzài cèdìng shuǐ zhōng de hányánliàng.
例句.en: The laboratory staff are measuring the salt content of the water.

例句.zh: 科学家测定了这块岩石的年龄。
例句.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā cèdìng le zhè kuài yánshí de niánlíng.
例句.en: The scientists determined the age of this rock.

释义: lateral side / side / aspect / profile

例句.zh: 如果你在洋娃娃腹部的侧面上链的话，它就会扭动手臂，翻著筋斗向前前进。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ zài yáng wá wá fù bù de cè miàn shàng liàn de huà ， tā jiù huì niǔ dòng shǒu bì ， fān zhù jīn dǒu xiàng qián qián jìn 。
例句.en: If you wind up the doll with the key on the side of its torso it will swing its arms round and go forward doing somersaults.

释义: to take measurements and calculate

例句.zh: 工程师正在测算桥梁的承重能力。
例句.pinyin: Gōngchéngshī zhèngzài cèsuàn qiáoliáng de chéngzhòng nénglì.
例句.en: The engineer is measuring and calculating the bridge's load-bearing capacity.

例句.zh: 我们先测算一下房间的实际面积。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen xiān cèsuàn yíxià fángjiān de shíjì miànjī.
例句.en: Let's first measure and calculate the room's actual area.

例句.zh: 技术人员测算了这块土地的面积。
例句.pinyin: Jìshù rényuán cèsuàn le zhè kuài tǔdì de miànjī.
例句.en: The technicians measured and calculated the area of this plot of land.

释义: test / to test / CL:次[ci4],個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 我们明天有个测验。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men míng tiān yǒu gè cè yàn 。
例句.en: We have a test tomorrow.

例句.zh: 他这次测验不合格可不是开玩笑的。
例句.pinyin: tā zhè cì cè yàn bù hé gé kě bú shì kāi wán xiào de 。
例句.en: His failing the test is no laughing matter.

例句.zh: 她完全不担心测验的分数。
例句.pinyin: tā wán quán bù dān xīn cè yàn de fēn shù 。
例句.en: She is not in the least worried about her test scores.

释义: to place particular emphasis on

例句.zh: 这门课侧重口语训练。
例句.pinyin: Zhè mén kè cèzhòng kǒuyǔ xùnliàn.
例句.en: This course places particular emphasis on speaking practice.

例句.zh: 报告侧重分析市场变化。
例句.pinyin: Bàogào cèzhòng fēnxī shìchǎng biànhuà.
例句.en: The report focuses particularly on analyzing market changes.

例句.zh: 这本书侧重介绍中国历史。
例句.pinyin: Zhè běn shū cèzhòng jièshào Zhōngguó lìshǐ.
例句.en: This book places particular emphasis on introducing Chinese history.

释义: more and more emerge / innumerable succession / breeding like flies (idiom)

例句.zh: 新的科技产品层出不穷。
例句.pinyin: Xīn de kējì chǎnpǐn céngchū-bùqióng.
例句.en: New technology products keep emerging one after another.

例句.zh: 网络上的热门话题层出不穷。
例句.pinyin: Wǎngluò shàng de rèmén huàtí céngchū-bùqióng.
例句.en: Popular topics keep emerging online.

例句.zh: 市场上的新品牌层出不穷。
例句.pinyin: Shìchǎng shàng de xīn pǐnpái céngchū-bùqióng.
例句.en: New brands are constantly emerging in the market.

释义: to rub against / to walk slowly / (coll.) to freeload

例句.zh: 我去你那蹭饭吃。
例句.pinyin: wǒ qù nǐ nà cèng fàn chī 。
例句.en: I'm going to mooch a meal off you at your place.

例句.zh: 要不是他这么磨磨蹭蹭，现在早做完了。
例句.pinyin: yào bú shì tā zhè me mó mó cèng cèng ， xiàn zài zǎo zuò wán le 。
例句.en: If he hadn't wasted time, he'd be finished by now.

例句.zh: 你磨蹭什么呀，快点去吧。
例句.pinyin: nǐ mó cèng shén me ya ， kuài diǎn qù ba 。
例句.en: What are you lingering for? Hurry up and go.

释义: mistake; slip-up; fault; error / accident; mishap

例句.zh: 毕竟，即使是神也会偶尔出差错。
例句.pinyin: bì jìng ， jí shǐ shì shén yě huì ǒu ěr chū chā cuò 。
例句.en: After all, even the gods may err at times.

例句.zh: 我以一分之差错过了那趟火车。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yǐ yī fēn zhī chā cuò guò le nà tàng huǒ chē 。
例句.en: I missed the train by a hair's breadth.

例句.zh: 据我所知，他的计划没有出差错。
例句.pinyin: jù wǒ suǒ zhī ， tā de jì huà méi yǒu chū chā cuò 。
例句.en: As far as I know, there is nothing wrong with his plan.

释义: balance (financial) / discrepancy (in a sum or quota) / difference

例句.zh: 贸易支付差额是所有的钱从国外进入一个国家的所有的钱走出去的国家在同一时期。
例句.pinyin: mào yì zhī fù chā é shì suǒ yǒu de qián cóng guó wài jìn rù yí gè guó jiā de suǒ yǒu de qián zǒu chū qù de guó jiā zài tóng yī shí qī 。
例句.en: The balance of payments is the total of all the money coming into a country from abroad less all of the money going out of the country during the same period.

释义: music played during a movie, play etc / incidental music / music played in a theatrical interlude / (fig.) incident / episode
短释义: music played during a movie, play etc

例句.zh: 这部电影的插曲很好听。
例句.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de chāqǔ hěn hǎotīng.
例句.en: The music featured in this movie is beautiful.

例句.zh: 她演唱了电视剧中的一首插曲。
例句.pinyin: Tā yǎnchàng le diànshìjù zhōng de yì shǒu chāqǔ.
例句.en: She sang a song featured in the TV drama.

例句.zh: 这段插曲出现在电影的结尾。
例句.pinyin: Zhè duàn chāqǔ chūxiàn zài diànyǐng de jiéwěi.
例句.en: This piece of music is played at the end of the movie.

释义: to get involved in / to meddle / interference

例句.zh: 不要插手我的事。
例句.pinyin: bú yào chā shǒu wǒ de shì 。
例句.en: Don't interfere in my affairs.

例句.zh: 不要插手我的私生活。
例句.pinyin: bú yào chā shǒu wǒ de sī shēng huó 。
例句.en: Don't pry into my private life.

例句.zh: 你最好不要插手别人的事务。
例句.pinyin: nǐ zuì hǎo bù yào chā shǒu bié rén de shì wù 。
例句.en: It's best if you don't poke your nose into other people's business.

释义: illustration

例句.zh: 这本书有精美的插图。
例句.pinyin: zhè běn shū yǒu jīng měi de chā tú 。
例句.en: This book is beautifully illustrated.

例句.zh: 这本书有很多插图。
例句.pinyin: zhè běn shū yǒu hěn duō chā tú 。
例句.en: This book has a lot of illustrations.

例句.zh: 我们给这个故事配了插图。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men gěi zhè ge gù shì pèi le chā tú 。
例句.en: We have illustrated the story with pictures.

释义: to interrupt (sb talking) / to butt in / to cut into a conversation

例句.zh: 我说话的时候请你不要插嘴。
例句.pinyin: wǒ shuō huà de shí hòu qǐng nǐ bú yào chā zuǐ 。
例句.en: Please don't interrupt me while I'm talking.

例句.zh: 贝丝很喜欢在别人说话的时候插嘴。
例句.pinyin: bèi sī hěn xǐ huān zài bié rén shuō huà de shí hòu chā zuǐ 。
例句.en: Beth has a strong habit of interrupting people while they are talking.

释义: to investigate and handle (a criminal case)
短释义: to investigate and handle (a criminal case)

例句.zh: 警方正在查处这起诈骗案。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhèngzài cháchǔ zhè qǐ zhàpiàn àn.
例句.en: The police are investigating and handling this fraud case.

例句.zh: 有关部门将依法查处违法行为。
例句.pinyin: Yǒuguān bùmén jiāng yīfǎ cháchǔ wéifǎ xíngwéi.
例句.en: The relevant authorities will investigate and deal with illegal activities according to law.

例句.zh: 这名官员因受贿被查处。
例句.pinyin: Zhè míng guānyuán yīn shòuhuì bèi cháchǔ.
例句.en: This official was investigated and punished for accepting bribes.

释义: to track down and seize (a criminal suspect, contraband etc)
短释义: to track down and seize (a criminal suspect, contraband etc)

例句.zh: 警方在车内查获了一批毒品。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zài chē nèi cháhuò le yì pī dúpǐn.
例句.en: The police seized a quantity of drugs from the car.

例句.zh: 海关查获了三箱违禁品。
例句.pinyin: Hǎiguān cháhuò le sān xiāng wéijìnpǐn.
例句.en: Customs seized three boxes of prohibited goods.

例句.zh: 警方根据线索查获了两名在逃嫌疑人。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng gēnjù xiànsuǒ cháhuò le liǎng míng zàitáo xiányírén.
例句.en: Following the clues, the police tracked down and arrested two wanted suspects.

释义: to sense / to perceive / to become aware of / to detect

例句.zh: 某些失明者会产生一个弥补性的能力，这个能力让他们察觉到他们与离他们很近的物体的距离。
例句.pinyin: mǒu xiē shī míng zhě huì chǎn shēng yí gè mí bǔ xìng de néng lì ， zhè ge néng lì ràng tā men chá jué dào tā men yǔ lí tā men hěn jìn de wù tǐ de jù lí 。
例句.en: Blind people sometimes develop a compensatory ability to sense the proximity of objects around them.

例句.zh: 变化太小，察觉不出来。
例句.pinyin: biàn huà tài xiǎo ， chá jué bù chū lái 。
例句.en: The change is too small to be observed.

例句.zh: 当他的上司察觉他的谎言，麻烦来了。
例句.pinyin: dāng tā de shàng sī chá jué tā de huǎng yán ， má fán lái le 。
例句.en: The lie got him in trouble when his boss found out the truth.

释义: to watch / to look carefully at

例句.zh: 警察看来很清楚我们在哪里。
例句.pinyin: jǐng chá kàn lái hěn qīng chǔ wǒ men zài nǎ lǐ 。
例句.en: The police seem to know exactly where we are.

释义: to investigate and find out / to ascertain

例句.zh: 我们必须查明汤姆在哪里。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men bì xū chá míng tāng mǔ zài nǎ lǐ 。
例句.en: We have to find out where Tom is.

释义: fork in road / bifurcation / branch in road, river, mountain range etc / to branch off / to turn off / to diverge / to stray (from the path) / to change the subject / to interrupt / to stagger (times)

例句.zh: 所谓头脑好的人，就如同步伐轻快的云游者，他可以比别人捷足先登，到达人们尚未去过的地方，但是他可能会忽略掉路旁或岔道上的珍贵物品。
例句.pinyin: suǒ wèi tóu nǎo hǎo de rén ， jiù rú tóng bù fá qīng kuài de yún yóu zhě ， tā kě yǐ bǐ bié rén jié zú xiān dēng ， dào dá rén men shàng wèi qù guò de dì fāng ， dàn shì tā kě néng huì hū lüè diào lù páng huò chà dào shàng de zhēn guì wù pǐn 。
例句.en: A person with a sharp mind is like a nimble wanderer who can outpace others and reach places uncharted by the masses, yet they might overlook precious treasures along the way or at crossroads.

例句.zh: 别打岔!
例句.pinyin: bié dǎ chà !
例句.en: Don't interrupt!

例句.zh: 什么可以出岔子？
例句.pinyin: shén me kě yǐ chū chà zi ？
例句.en: What could go wrong?

释义: an instant (Sanskrit: ksana); split second; the twinkling of an eye
短释义: an instant (Sanskrit: ksana); split second; the twinkling of an eye

例句.zh: 就在那一刹那，灯突然灭了。
例句.pinyin: Jiù zài nà yí chà nà, dēng tū rán miè le.
例句.en: At that very instant, the light suddenly went out.

例句.zh: 刹那间，天空亮起了一道闪电。
例句.pinyin: Chà nà jiān, tiān kōng liàng qǐ le yí dào shǎn diàn.
例句.en: In a split second, a bolt of lightning lit up the sky.

例句.zh: 一刹那的犹豫让他错过了机会。
例句.pinyin: Yí chà nà de yóu yù ràng tā cuò guò le jī huì.
例句.en: A moment's hesitation caused him to miss the opportunity.

释义: flabbergasted / astonished

例句.zh: 听到这个消息，我感到很诧异。
例句.pinyin: Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi, wǒ gǎndào hěn chàyì.
例句.en: I was astonished to hear the news.

例句.zh: 他突然辞职，大家都很诧异。
例句.pinyin: Tā tūrán cízhí, dàjiā dōu hěn chàyì.
例句.en: Everyone was flabbergasted by his sudden resignation.

例句.zh: 她诧异地看着我，不明白我为什么笑。
例句.pinyin: Tā chàyì de kànzhe wǒ, bù míngbai wǒ wèishénme xiào.
例句.en: She looked at me in surprise, not understanding why I was laughing.

释义: to demolish a building and relocate the inhabitants
短释义: to demolish a building and relocate the inhabitants

例句.zh: 这片老城区明年开始拆迁。
例句.pinyin: Zhè piàn lǎo chéngqū míngnián kāishǐ chāiqiān.
例句.en: Demolition and relocation in this old urban area will begin next year.

例句.zh: 因为要修地铁，这几栋楼即将拆迁。
例句.pinyin: Yīnwèi yào xiū dìtiě, zhè jǐ dòng lóu jíjiāng chāiqiān.
例句.en: These buildings will soon be demolished for subway construction.

例句.zh: 拆迁后，居民搬进了新小区。
例句.pinyin: Chāiqiān hòu, jūmín bān jìn le xīn xiǎoqū.
例句.en: After the demolition and relocation, the residents moved into a new residential complex.

释义: diesel fuel

例句.zh: 这个取暖装置用柴油作为燃料。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge qǔ nuǎn zhuāng zhì yòng chái yóu zuò wéi rán liào 。
例句.en: This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.

释义: to mix; to blend; to dilute; to adulterate / to grasp
短释义: to mix; to blend; to dilute; to adulterate

例句.zh: 别掺和他的事。
例句.pinyin: bié chān huo tā de shì 。
例句.en: Don't meddle in his affairs.

例句.zh: 所有的社交，自然而然地，都会掺入一些虚伪的成分，我想这是有其必要的。
例句.pinyin: suǒ yǒu de shè jiāo ， zì rán ér rán dì ， dū huì càn rù yī xiē xū wěi de chéng fèn ， wǒ xiǎng zhè shì yǒu qí bì yào de 。
例句.en: All social interactions, naturally, will involve some degree of insincerity, which I believe is necessary.

例句.zh: 我现在还不想掺和进来，谢了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiàn zài hái bù xiǎng chān huo jìn lái ， xiè le 。
例句.en: I'd rather not get involved at the moment, thanks.

释义: to take by the arm and assist / variant of 摻|掺[chan1]
短释义: to take by the arm and assist

例句.zh: 我搀着奶奶慢慢下楼。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ chānzhe nǎinai mànmàn xià lóu.
例句.en: I helped Grandma slowly down the stairs by the arm.

例句.zh: 护士把病人搀了起来。
例句.pinyin: Hùshi bǎ bìngrén chān le qǐlái.
例句.en: The nurse helped the patient to his feet.

例句.zh: 他搀老人过马路。
例句.pinyin: Tā chān lǎorén guò mǎlù.
例句.en: He helped the elderly person cross the road by the arm.

释义: gluttonous / greedy / to have a craving

例句.zh: 你说得我馋死了！
例句.pinyin: nǐ shuō dé wǒ chán sǐ le ！
例句.en: The way you describe it makes me drool.

This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. 例句.zh: 越过松林，远处有一座小花园。那里青草长得又长又茂盛，铁杉花像洁白的星星一样闪耀，夜莺整夜唱歌。牠整夜歌唱，冰冷的月光俯瞰著牠，紫杉树张开巨大的枝干，庇护著沉睡的人们。

There the grass grows long and deep, there are the great white stars of the hemlock flower, there the nightingale sings all night long. 例句.zh: 如果人类的物质生活一年比一年富足，蛋糕的推出越来越精致，科技越来越便利，同时没有前人种树就不可能有后人乘凉，那么我便可以肯定“富有”的人生，肯定是由热爱吃苦的前辈，那群带有苦味的食客开创出来的。

例句.en: In reality, translation is akin to working for peanuts, since the corresponding meaning of something in one language is often hidden in some deep and impenetrable recesses of the other. As a result, the translator is forced to search all over... Never mind that the picky reader is very difficult to fool.

释义: late (with a task etc) / slow

例句.zh: 阳光明媚的地方，坐落著一座宜人的老农舍，紧邻一条深深的河流。从农舍一直到河边，长满了高大的牛蒡叶，最高的牛蒡叶下，可以让一个小孩站直身体。这地方如同茂密森林的中心，原始而静谧。一只鸭子栖息在这片幽静的角落，守候著雏鸟破壳而出。牠开始感到有些疲惫，因为小家伙们迟迟不肯破壳而出，而她也很少遇到来访者。
例句.pinyin: yáng guāng míng mèi de dì fāng ， zuò luò zhù yī zuò yí rén de lǎo nóng shè ， jǐn lín yī tiáo shēn shēn de hé liú 。 cóng nóng shè yì zhí dào hé biān ， zhǎng mǎn le gāo dà de niú bàng yè ， zuì gāo de niú bàng yè xià ， kě yǐ ràng yí gè xiǎo hái zhàn zhí shēn tǐ 。 zhè dì fāng rú tóng mào mì sēn lín de zhōng xīn ， yuán shǐ ér jìng mì 。 yī zhī yā zi qī xī zài zhè piàn yōu jìng de jiǎo luò ， shǒu hòu zhù chú niǎo pò ké ér chū 。 tā kāi shǐ gǎn dào yǒu xiē pí bèi ， yīn wèi xiǎo jiā huo men chí chí bù kěn pò ké ér chū ， ér tā yě hěn shǎo yù dào lái fǎng zhě 。
例句.en: In a sunny spot stood a pleasant old farm-house close by a deep river, and from the house down to the water side grew great burdock leaves, so high, that under the tallest of them a little child could stand upright. The spot was as wild as the centre of a thick wood. In this snug retreat sat a duck on her nest, watching for her young brood to hatch; she was beginning to get tired of her task, for the little ones were a long time coming out of their shells, and she seldom had any visitors.

释义: slow in one's reactions / sluggish (in movement or thought)

例句.zh: 他反应迟钝，没能及时回答问题。
例句.pinyin: Tā fǎnyìng chídùn, méi néng jíshí huídá wèntí.
例句.en: He was slow to react and failed to answer the question in time.

例句.zh: 熬夜后，我的思维变得很迟钝。
例句.pinyin: Áoyè hòu, wǒ de sīwéi biàn de hěn chídùn.
例句.en: After staying up late, my thinking became very sluggish.

例句.zh: 老人年纪大了，动作有些迟钝。
例句.pinyin: Lǎorén niánjì dà le, dòngzuò yǒuxiē chídùn.
例句.en: As the old man has aged, his movements have become somewhat slow.

释义: slow / sluggish

例句.zh: 行动迟缓的蓝色美洲狮从勤奋的猫身下滑过。
例句.pinyin: xíng dòng chí huǎn de lán sè měi zhōu shī cóng qín fèn de māo shēn xià huá guò 。
例句.en: The slow blue puma slides under the diligent cat.

释义: famous

例句.zh: 这座古城以美食驰名。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔchéng yǐ měishí chímíng.
例句.en: This ancient city is famous for its cuisine.

例句.zh: 这家茶馆驰名中外。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā cháguǎn chímíng zhōngwài.
例句.en: This teahouse is famous both in China and abroad.

例句.zh: 苏州园林驰名世界。
例句.pinyin: Sūzhōu yuánlín chímíng shìjiè.
例句.en: Suzhou's classical gardens are famous worldwide.

释义: to stay level (of exchange rate, market share etc) / fair / unbiased
短释义: to stay level (of exchange rate, market share etc)

例句.zh: 在结冰的街道上我们很难保持平衡。
例句.pinyin: zài jié bīng de jiē dào shàng wǒ men hěn nán bǎo chí píng héng 。
例句.en: It is hard to keep our balance on icy streets.

例句.zh: 我认为要保持平衡。
例句.pinyin: wǒ rèn wéi yào bǎo chí píng héng 。
例句.en: I think there's a balance to be had.

例句.zh: 人生就像骑单车一样，要保持平衡就得不停地前进。
例句.pinyin: rén shēng jiù xiàng qí dān chē yī yàng ， yào bǎo chí píng héng jiù dé bù tíng dì qián jìn 。
例句.en: Life is like riding a bicycle. To keep your balance you must keep moving.

释义: pool / pond

例句.zh: 我还是个小男孩时常去池塘游泳。
例句.pinyin: wǒ hái shì gè xiǎo nán hái shí cháng qù chí táng yóu yǒng 。
例句.en: As a boy, I used to swim in the pond.

例句.zh: 池塘的四周以前种满了大树。
例句.pinyin: chí táng de sì zhōu yǐ qián zhǒng mǎn le dà shù 。
例句.en: There used to be big trees around the pond.

例句.zh: 让孩子远离池塘。
例句.pinyin: ràng hái zi yuǎn lí chí táng 。
例句.en: Keep children away from the pond.

释义: to hesitate

例句.zh: 他迟疑了一下，还是答应了。
例句.pinyin: Tā chíyí le yí xià, háishì dāying le.
例句.en: He hesitated for a moment but agreed in the end.

例句.zh: 面对这个选择，她有些迟疑。
例句.pinyin: Miànduì zhège xuǎnzé, tā yǒuxiē chíyí.
例句.en: She was somewhat hesitant about this choice.

例句.zh: 别再迟疑了，快做决定吧。
例句.pinyin: Bié zài chíyí le, kuài zuò juédìng ba.
例句.en: Stop hesitating and make a decision.

释义: sooner or later

例句.zh: 他迟早会回来的。
例句.pinyin: tā chí zǎo huì huí lái de 。
例句.en: He will come back sooner or later.

例句.zh: 迟早他的运气会用完。
例句.pinyin: chí zǎo tā de yùn qì huì yòng wán 。
例句.en: Sooner or later his luck will run out.

例句.zh: 你迟早会学会怎么做。
例句.pinyin: nǐ chí zǎo huì xué huì zěn me zuò 。
例句.en: You'll learn how to do it sooner or later.

释义: to pursue unremittingly (idiom); to persevere

例句.zh: 我对汤姆要持之以恒地学习法语口语这件事很怀疑。
例句.pinyin: wǒ duì tāng mǔ yào chí zhī yǐ héng dì xué xí fǎ yǔ kǒu yǔ zhè jiàn shì hěn huái yí 。
例句.en: I doubt that Tom will ever learn how to speak French properly.

释义: scale / yardstick

例句.zh: 据说美国人把一个人的收入视为评判他能力的重要尺度。
例句.pinyin: jù shuō měi guó rén bǎ yí gè rén de shōu rù shì wèi píng pàn tā néng lì de zhòng yào chǐ dù 。
例句.en: Americans are said to regard the amount of money a man makes as a criterion of his ability.

例句.zh: 任何境遇都是宇宙给你的机会，假如你懂得利用、抓紧它。它将是你一生的财富。假如你遗漏、放弃或者没有做出积极的响应，宇宙会让这次机会在下一个时间、地点，和其他人重新来过。但在其中，你失去的是最宝贵的时间！知错就改，把握当下；在合适的尺度下，能跳就跳吧，能唱就唱吧，能疯就疯吧，能闹就闹吧。
例句.pinyin: rèn hé jìng yù dōu shì yǔ zhòu gěi nǐ de jī huì ， jiǎ rú nǐ dǒng de lì yòng 、 zhuā jǐn tā 。 tā jiāng shì nǐ yī shēng de cái fù 。 jiǎ rú nǐ yí lòu 、 fàng qì huò zhě méi yǒu zuò chū jī jí de xiǎng yìng ， yǔ zhòu huì ràng zhè cì jī huì zài xià yí gè shí jiān 、 dì diǎn ， hé qí tā rén chóng xīn lái guò 。 dàn zài qí zhōng ， nǐ shī qù de shì zuì bǎo guì de shí jiān ！ zhī cuò jiù gǎi ， bǎ wò dāng xià ； zài hé shì de chǐ dù xià ， néng tiào jiù tiào ba ， néng chàng jiù chàng ba ， néng fēng jiù fēng ba ， néng nào jiù nào ba 。
例句.en: Every situation is an opportunity given to you by the universe. If you know how to make the most out of that situation, do it. It will be a wealth that lasts you a lifetime. If you missed out, gave up, or didn't even attempt to take advantage of the opportunity, the universe will set this chance aside for the next person, in a different time and place. But what's most important is that you lost precious time. Understand what you did wrong, and control the present. Then with proper restraint, if you can dance, dance. If you can sing, sing. If you can be wild, be wild. If you can be lively, be lively.

释义: disgrace / shame / humiliation

例句.zh: 那是一个耻辱。
例句.pinyin: nà shì yí gè chǐ rǔ 。
例句.en: That's a shame.

释义: to sneer at sb / to ridicule

例句.zh: 不要因为别人犯错就耻笑他。
例句.pinyin: Bú yào yīn wèi bié rén fàn cuò jiù chǐ xiào tā.
例句.en: Don't sneer at someone just because they made a mistake.

例句.zh: 他小时候常被同学耻笑。
例句.pinyin: Tā xiǎo shí hou cháng bèi tóng xué chǐ xiào.
例句.en: He was often mocked by his classmates when he was young.

例句.zh: 真正的朋友不会耻笑你的梦想。
例句.pinyin: Zhēn zhèng de péng you bú huì chǐ xiào nǐ de mèng xiǎng.
例句.en: A true friend won't make fun of your dreams.

释义: equator (of the earth or a celestial body) / celestial equator
短释义: equator (of the earth or a celestial body)

例句.zh: 我去澳大利亚旅游的时候第一次穿越了赤道。
例句.pinyin: wǒ qù ào dà lì yà lǚ yóu de shí hòu dì yī cì chuān yuè le chì dào 。
例句.en: I crossed the equator for the first time on my trip to Australia.

例句.zh: 位处赤道附近一个狭窄区域的热带雨林，正在不断地遭受人类的破坏，预计在二零零零年之前，该区域将会有五分之四的热带雨林从地球上消失。
例句.pinyin: wèi chù chì dào fù jìn yí gè xiá zhǎi qū yù de rè dài yǔ lín ， zhèng zài bù duàn dì zāo shòu rén lèi de pò huài ， yù jì zài èr líng líng líng nián zhī qián ， gāi qū yù jiāng huì yǒu wǔ fēn zhī sì de rè dài yǔ lín cóng dì qiú shàng xiāo shī 。
例句.en: The tropical rainforests, located in a narrow region near the equator, are disappearing so fast that by the year 2000 eighty percent of them may be gone.

例句.zh: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。
例句.pinyin: chì dào bǎ dì qiú fēn wéi liǎng gè bàn qiú 。
例句.en: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.

释义: (financial) deficit / red letter

例句.zh: 我们去年遇到了赤字。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men qù nián yù dào le chì zì 。
例句.en: We went into the red last year.

例句.zh: 在这种困难的时候，任何寻常的努力都无法使我们的公司摆脱赤字。
例句.pinyin: zài zhè zhǒng kùn nán de shí hòu ， rèn hé xún cháng de nǔ lì dōu wú fǎ shǐ wǒ men de gōng sī bǎi tuō chì zì 。
例句.en: In hard times like this, no ordinary effort can get our company out of the red.

例句.zh: 这场生意正面临著赤字。
例句.pinyin: zhè chǎng shēng yì zhèng miàn lín zhù chì zì 。
例句.en: The business is in the red.

释义: sufficient; full / to fill / to serve as; to act as / to act falsely as; to pose as

例句.zh: 请把它充入我的账户。
例句.pinyin: qǐng bǎ tā chōng rù wǒ de zhàng hù 。
例句.en: Please add it to my account.

例句.zh: 今晚我们有充分的时间。
例句.pinyin: jīn wǎn wǒ men yǒu chōng fèn de shí jiān 。
例句.en: We have plenty of time tonight.

例句.zh: 他充满活力。
例句.pinyin: tā chōng mǎn huó lì 。
例句.en: He is full of energy.

释义: to be full of / to flood / to congest

例句.zh: 收音机广播充斥著有关最近爆炸的新闻。
例句.pinyin: shōu yīn jī guǎng bō chōng chì zhù yǒu guān zuì jìn bào zhà de xīn wén 。
例句.en: News of the recent blast is all over the radio.

例句.zh: 一篇大学论文描述了充斥在西方科幻作品中的「东方主义」。
例句.pinyin: yī piān dà xué lùn wén miáo shù le chōng chì zài xī fāng kē huàn zuò pǐn zhōng de 「 dōng fāng zhǔ yì 」。
例句.en: A university thesis describes the "Orientalism" that imbues sci-fi in the West.

例句.zh: 空气中充斥著海的气息。
例句.pinyin: kōng qì zhōng chōng chì zhù hǎi de qì xī 。
例句.en: The air was permeated by the smell of the sea.

释义: (sports) to sprint; to spurt; to dash / to put in a big effort to achieve a goal as the deadline approaches
短释义: (sports) to sprint; to spurt; to dash

例句.zh: 我刚百米冲刺，还累得不行呢。
例句.pinyin: wǒ gāng bǎi mǐ chōng cì ， hái lèi dé bù xíng ne 。
例句.en: I just did a 100-meter sprint and I'm so exhausted.

例句.zh: 齐里让我们冲刺跑 14 分钟。
例句.pinyin: qí lǐ ràng wǒ men chōng cì pǎo  14  fēn zhōng 。
例句.en: Ziri kept us sprinting for fourteen minutes.

释义: to serve as / to act as / to play the role of

例句.zh: 竞选活动的声势也来自那些已不再年轻的人们，他们冒着严寒酷暑，敲开陌生人的家门进行竞选宣传；竞选声势也源自数百万的美国民众，他们充当志愿者和组织者，他们证明了在两百多年以后，民有、民治、民享的政府并未从地球上消失。这是你们的胜利。
例句.pinyin: jìng xuǎn huó dòng de shēng shì yě lái zì nà xiē yǐ bù zài nián qīng de rén men ， tā men mào zhe yán hán kù shǔ ， qiāo kāi mò shēng rén de jiā mén jìn xíng jìng xuǎn xuān chuán ； jìng xuǎn shēng shì yě yuán zì shù bǎi wàn de měi guó mín zhòng ， tā men chōng dāng zhì yuàn zhě hé zǔ zhī zhě ， tā men zhèng míng liǎo zài liǎng bǎi duō nián yǐ hòu ， mín yǒu 、 mín zhì 、 mín xiǎng de zhèng fǔ bìng wèi cóng dì qiú shàng xiāo shī 。 zhè shì nǐ men de shèng lì 。
例句.en: It drew strength from the not-so-young people who braved the bitter cold and scorching heat to knock on doors of perfect strangers, and from the millions of Americans who volunteered and organized and proved that more than two centuries later a government of the people, by the people, and for the people has not perished from the Earth.

例句.zh: 我为你充当导游。
例句.pinyin: wǒ wèi nǐ chōng dāng dǎo yóu 。
例句.en: I'll act as a guide for you.

例句.zh: 在韩语中，形容词通常充当描述性动词，这意味著它们可以像动词一样变位以表达不同的时态和语气。
例句.pinyin: zài hán yǔ zhōng ， xíng róng cí tōng cháng chōng dāng miáo shù xìng dòng cí ， zhè yì wèi zhù tā men kě yǐ xiàng dòng cí yī yàng biàn wèi yǐ biǎo dá bù tóng de shí tài hé yǔ qì 。
例句.en: In Korean, adjectives often function as descriptive verbs, meaning they can be conjugated like verbs to express different tenses and moods.

释义: to long for; to look forward to
短释义: to long for; to look forward to

例句.zh: 我憧憬着未来的生活。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ chōngjǐng zhe wèilái de shēnghuó.
例句.en: I look forward to my future life.

例句.zh: 她一直憧憬着去巴黎生活。
例句.pinyin: Tā yìzhí chōngjǐng zhe qù Bālí shēnghuó.
例句.en: She has always dreamed of living in Paris.

例句.zh: 孩子们憧憬着美好的未来。
例句.pinyin: Háizimen chōngjǐng zhe měihǎo de wèilái.
例句.en: The children look forward to a bright future.

释义: to surf / surfing

例句.zh: 这个海滩是冲浪者的天堂。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge hǎi tān shì chōng làng zhě de tiān táng 。
例句.en: This beach is a paradise for surfers.

例句.zh: 你怎么一有空就上网，冲浪灌水打QQ，一个夜晚就扔给它了？
例句.pinyin: nǐ zěn me yī yǒu kòng jiù shàng wǎng ， chōng làng guàn shuǐ dǎ QQ， yí gè yè wǎn jiù rēng gěi tā le ？
例句.en: Why do you go online, surf, chat, and use QQ every time you have free time, wasting an entire night on it?

例句.zh: 她花实在太多的时间在网上冲浪。
例句.pinyin: tā huā shí zài tài duō de shí jiān zài wǎng shàng chōng làng 。
例句.en: She spends way too much time surfing the web.

释义: abundant; plentiful

例句.zh: 我小睡后就感到精力充沛。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎo shuì hòu jiù gǎn dào jīng lì chōng pèi 。
例句.en: A little nap and, just like that, I'm as fresh as a daisy.

例句.zh: 他不像从前那样精力充沛了。
例句.pinyin: tā bù xiàng cóng qián nà yàng jīng lì chōng pèi le 。
例句.en: He isn't as energetic as he once was.

释义: to rinse; to wash / (photography) to develop (film)

例句.zh: 用水冲洗灼伤的手指。
例句.pinyin: yòng shuǐ chōng xǐ zhuó shāng de shǒu zhǐ 。
例句.en: Cool the burned finger in running water.

释义: abundant / ample / plenty / abundance

例句.zh: 还有二十分钟，时间很充裕。
例句.pinyin: hái yǒu èr shí fēn zhōng ， shí jiān hěn chōng yù 。
例句.en: There is still 20 minutes left; that is plenty of time.

例句.zh: 我们有充裕的时间赶上火车。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men yǒu chōng yù de shí jiān gǎn shàng huǒ chē 。
例句.en: We have ample time to catch our train.

例句.zh: 如果时间充裕，我可以做得更好的。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ shí jiān chōng yù ， wǒ kě yǐ zuò dé gèng hǎo de 。
例句.en: I could have done better if I had had more time.

释义: to collide / jerking motion / to impinge / to offend / to provoke

例句.zh: 货车突然冲撞护栏。
例句.pinyin: Huòchē tūrán chōngzhuàng hùlán.
例句.en: The truck suddenly crashed into the guardrail.

例句.zh: 海浪不断冲撞着礁石。
例句.pinyin: Hǎilàng búduàn chōngzhuàng zhe jiāoshí.
例句.en: The waves kept crashing against the rocks.

例句.zh: 两艘小船在风浪中互相冲撞。
例句.pinyin: Liǎng sōu xiǎochuán zài fēnglàng zhōng hùxiāng chōngzhuàng.
例句.en: The two boats collided with each other in the wind and waves.

释义: layer upon layer / one after another / heavily / severely

例句.zh: 他用斧头重重的斩了一下，那棵树就倒了下来。
例句.pinyin: tā yòng fǔ tóu chóng chóng de zhǎn le yī xià ， nà kē shù jiù dào le xià lái 。
例句.en: The tree was felled with one hard blow of his ax.

例句.zh: 汤姆的头部受了重重的一击。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ de tóu bù shòu le chóng chóng de yī jī 。

例句.zh: 这是个由不分老少、贫富、民主党、共和党；黑人、白人、拉丁裔、亚裔、美洲原住民；同性恋、异性恋人；肢障与四体健全者，大家共同诉说的答案。美国民众向全世界发出讯息，我们绝非一盘散沙，也不是由红州、蓝州拼凑而成的集合体。

例句.en: It's the answer spoken by young and old, rich and poor, Democrat and Republican, black, white, Hispanic, Asian, Native American, gay, straight, disabled and not disabled. Americans who sent a message to the world that we have never been just a collection of individuals or a collection of red states and blue states. We are, and always will be, the United States of America.

例句.zh: 让我们记住，是伊利诺伊州的一名男子首次将共和党的旗帜扛到了白宫。共和党是建立在自立、个人自由以及国家团结的价值观之上的。这也是我们所有人共同的价值观。虽然民主党今天晚上赢得了巨大的胜利，但我们是以谦卑的态度和弥合阻碍我们进步的分歧的决心赢得这场胜利的
例句.pinyin: ràng wǒ men jì zhù ， shì yī lì nuò yī zhōu de yī míng nán zi shǒu cì jiāng gòng hé dǎng de qí zhì káng dào le bái gōng 。 gòng hé dǎng shì jiàn lì zài zì lì 、 gè rén zì yóu yǐ jí guó jiā tuán jié de jià zhí guān zhī shàng de 。 zhè yě shì wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén gòng tóng de jià zhí guān 。 suī rán mín zhǔ dǎng jīn tiān wǎn shàng yíng dé le jù dà de shèng lì ， dàn wǒ men shì yǐ qiān bēi de tài dù hé mí hé zǔ ài wǒ men jìn bù de fēn qí de jué xīn yíng dé zhè chǎng shèng lì de
例句.en: Let's remember that it was a man from this state who first carried the banner of the Republican Party to the White House, a party founded on the values of self-reliance and individual liberty and national unity. Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.

例句.zh: 在所有童话故事里出现的女巫中，没有一个比沙女巫更讨人喜欢、更善于交际了。这位女巫住在海边堆积如山的沙子下面，夏天的时候，人们会在那里用铲子挖沙。她和其他女巫完全不同。她从不骑扫帚，也从不钻烟囱。首先，海滩上根本没有扫帚和烟囱；其次，就算有，她也不知道怎么骑扫帚或钻烟囱。沙女巫只会做一件事：遇到害怕的东西就钻进沙里；遇到不认识的人，就从沙子里钻出来。现在你知道沙女巫是什么了吧。七岁的小詹克斯被晒得通红，如果他知道你所知道的一切，那么在七月一个炎热的早晨，当他突然遭遇这场突如其来的灾难时，他就能更好地应对了。
例句.pinyin: zài suǒ yǒu tóng huà gù shì lǐ chū xiàn de nǚ wū zhōng ， méi yǒu yí gè bǐ shā nǚ wū gèng tǎo rén xǐ huān 、 gèng shàn yú jiāo jì le 。 zhè wèi nǚ wū zhù zài hǎi biān duī jī rú shān de shā zi xià miàn ， xià tiān de shí hòu ， rén men huì zài nà lǐ yòng chǎn zi wā shā 。 tā hé qí tā nǚ wū wán quán bù tóng 。 tā cóng bù qí sào zhǒu ， yě cóng bù zuān yān cōng 。 shǒu xiān ， hǎi tān shàng gēn běn méi yǒu sào zhǒu hé yān cōng ； qí cì ， jiù suàn yǒu ， tā yě bù zhī dào zěn me qí sào zhǒu huò zuān yān cōng 。 shā nǚ wū zhǐ huì zuò yī jiàn shì ： yù dào hài pà de dōng xī jiù zuān jìn shā lǐ ； yù dào bù rèn shí de rén ， jiù cóng shā zi lǐ zuān chū lái 。 xiàn zài nǐ zhī dào shā nǚ wū shì shén me le ba 。 qī suì de xiǎo zhān kè sī bèi shài dé tōng hóng ， rú guǒ tā zhī dào nǐ suǒ zhī dào de yī qiè ， nà me zài qī yuè yí gè yán rè de zǎo chén ， dāng tā tū rán zāo yù zhè chǎng tū rú qí lái de zāi nàn shí ， tā jiù néng gèng hǎo dì yìng duì le 。
例句.en: Of all the witches that may be found in all the fairy tales ever told there is none more delightfully sociable than the Sand Witch. This Witch, who lives underneath the heaps of sand at the ocean's edge, where, in the summertime, you dig with your shovel, is not at all like other witches. She never rides on a broomstick, and she never goes down chimneys. In the first place there are no broomsticks or chimneys on the beach at the sea-shore, and in the second place she would not know how to ride on a broomstick or climb down a chimney, if there were. All the Sand Witch knows how to do is to sink into the sand when anything scares her, and to come up through the sand when she sees a chance to get acquainted with a person she never was acquainted with before. So now you know what a Sand Witch is. And if Junior Jenks, seven years old, and dreadfully sunburnt, had known what you know, he would have been much better prepared to face the one that came up right under his nose all of a sudden one hot July morning.

例句.zh: 今天是 2013 年 6 月 27 日。蓝色梦想不只有一种，而是有很多种。国际语并非唯一。几十年来，一直存在著其他拉丁语系的人工语言，分别属于不同的专案。未来，有些人寄望于其他语言。但世界语，这个绿色梦想，却成功传承了一个多世纪。几十年来，推行世界语的革命尝试都以失败告终，因为真正的世界语拥有一种无法篡改的艺术平衡。世界语依然历久不衰。在蓝色阵营中，我仍然选择国际语。应该有更多的人给它一个机会。世界语的重音赋予了这种语言一种魅力，或许正是这种魅力推动了它多年来的生存。但世界上也有其他替代方案。
例句.pinyin: jīn tiān shì  2013  nián  6  yuè  27  rì 。 lán sè mèng xiǎng bù zhǐ yǒu yī zhǒng ， ér shì yǒu hěn duō zhǒng 。 guó jì yǔ bìng fēi wéi yī 。 jǐ shí nián lái ， yì zhí cún zài zhù qí tā lā dīng yǔ xì de rén gōng yǔ yán ， fēn bié shǔ yú bù tóng de zhuān àn 。 wèi lái ， yǒu xiē rén jì wàng yú qí tā yǔ yán 。 dàn shì jiè yǔ ， zhè ge lǜ sè mèng xiǎng ， què chéng gōng chuán chéng le yí gè duō shì jì 。 jǐ shí nián lái ， tuī xíng shì jiè yǔ de gé mìng cháng shì dōu yǐ shī bài gào zhōng ， yīn wèi zhēn zhèng de shì jiè yǔ yōng yǒu yī zhǒng wú fǎ cuàn gǎi de yì shù píng héng 。 shì jiè yǔ yī rán lì jiǔ bù shuāi 。 zài lán sè zhèn yíng zhōng ， wǒ réng rán xuǎn zé guó jì yǔ 。 yīng gāi yǒu gèng duō de rén gěi tā yí gè jī huì 。 shì jiè yǔ de zhòng yīn fù yǔ le zhè zhǒng yǔ yán yī zhǒng mèi lì ， huò xǔ zhèng shì zhè zhǒng mèi lì tuī dòng le tā duō nián lái de shēng cún 。 dàn shì jiè shàng yě yǒu qí tā tì dài fāng àn 。
例句.en: It is the 27th of June of 2013. The Blue Dreams are plural. The Blue Dreams are many. Interlingua is not the only one. For decades now, there have existed other Latinate conlangs, different projects. And in the future, some hope for others. But it has been the Green Dream, Esperanto, that has succeeded for more than a century. Reforms attempted upon Esperanto have met with failure over the decades because genuine Esperanto has an artistic balance with which one cannot tamper. Esperanto remains enduring. Amongst the Blues, my vote is still Interlingua. More people should give it a chance. Esperanto's accents give a charm to the language that perhaps boosted its survival over the years. There are substitute systems.

例句.zh: 现在是 2025 年 8 月 3 日，露露岛。晚餐后，阳光下嫩绿的无花果，昨天腌制的甜醋，还有重新加热的阿尔弗雷多义面，我坐在阳台上，望著那棵针叶树。楼下静谧无声，街道空无一车，一片悠闲。我的冰镇青柠水在阳光下闪闪发光。最近，我常和那位法丹混血的 UFO 研究专家麦可聊天。我们谈论内心深处的事情：智慧型装置的迷醉，以及思维的衰退。他说，咖啡馆已经不再是咖啡馆了。人们忘记如何观察、如何驻足停留。我跟他讲起在日本的亚瑟，他会像僧侣凝视虚空一样，对著空白的墙壁发呆。最近，我让机器像诗人一样说话，它们真的做到了。它们模仿伊莉莎白时代的诗歌，以及塔加洛语民谣中那古老而忧伤的韵律。我沿著通往蒂姆霍顿咖啡店的小路采摘黑莓。我像个孩子似的喊道：「莫拉！」我的朋友莫拉，她血液里流著安地斯山脉的薄雾，她会笑的。今天，我买了黄柠檬。我本来想买青柠，但黄柠檬也可以。/ 黑莓的清晨 / 指尖残留无花果的痕迹 / 街道依然沉睡
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì  2025  nián  8  yuè  3  rì ， lù lù dǎo 。 wǎn cān hòu ， yáng guāng xià nèn lǜ de wú huā guǒ ， zuó tiān yān zhì de tián cù ， hái yǒu chóng xīn jiā rè de ā ěr fú léi duō yì miàn ， wǒ zuò zài yáng tái shàng ， wàng zhù nà kē zhēn yè shù 。 lóu xià jìng mì wú shēng ， jiē dào kōng wú yī chē ， yī piàn yōu xián 。 wǒ de bīng zhèn qīng níng shuǐ zài yáng guāng xià shǎn shǎn fā guāng 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ cháng hé nà wèi fǎ dān hùn xuè de  UFO  yán jiū zhuān jiā mài kě liáo tiān 。 wǒ men tán lùn nèi xīn shēn chù de shì qíng ： zhì huì xíng zhuāng zhì de mí zuì ， yǐ jí sī wéi de shuāi tuì 。 tā shuō ， kā fēi guǎn yǐ jīng bù zài shì kā fēi guǎn le 。 rén men wàng jì rú hé guān chá 、 rú hé zhù zú tíng liú 。 wǒ gēn tā jiǎng qǐ zài rì běn de yà sè ， tā huì xiàng sēng lǚ níng shì xū kōng yī yàng ， duì zhù kòng bái de qiáng bì fā dāi 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ ràng jī qì xiàng shī rén yī yàng shuō huà ， tā men zhēn de zuò dào le 。 tā men mó fǎng yī lì shā bái shí dài de shī gē ， yǐ jí tǎ jiā luò yǔ mín yáo zhōng nà gǔ lǎo ér yōu shāng de yùn lǜ 。 wǒ yán zhù tōng wǎng dì mǔ huò dùn kā fēi diàn de xiǎo lù cǎi zhāi hēi méi 。 wǒ xiàng gè hái zi shì de hǎn dào ：「 mò lā ！」 wǒ de péng yǒu mò lā ， tā xuè yè lǐ liú zhù ān dì sī shān mài de bó wù ， tā huì xiào de 。 jīn tiān ， wǒ mǎi le huáng níng méng 。 wǒ běn lái xiǎng mǎi qīng níng ， dàn huáng níng méng yě kě yǐ 。/  hēi méi de qīng chén  /  zhǐ jiān cán liú wú huā guǒ de hén jì  /  jiē dào yī rán chén shuì
例句.en: It's Lulu Island, 3 August 2025. After supper—green figs tender with sunlight, sweet vinegar from yesterday’s pickled jar, and reheated Alfredo—I sat on the balcony and watched the conifer. Stillness below, a street without cars, without haste. My lime water, iced, caught the light. Michael, the Franco-Danish ufologist, has been in my conversations lately. We speak of inner things: the trance of smart devices, the mind’s eye dwindling. He says cafés aren’t cafés anymore. People forget how to look, how to linger. I tell him of Arthur in Japan—how he'd stare into blank walls like a monk gazing at emptiness. Lately I ask machines to speak like poets, and they do. They mimic Elizabethan verses and the old wistful lilt of Tagalog ballads. I pick blackberries along the path to Tim Hortons. "¡Moras!" I shout like a child. My friend Mora, whose blood flows with Andes mist, would smile. Today, I bought lemons. I meant limes, but lemons are all right. / blackberry morning— / a fig's ghost on my fingers / and the street still sleeps

例句.zh: 我敢打赌，在Tom Waits发掘它当幕后支援前你从来没有听说过斯特罗小提琴！无论如何，1920年代末前它采用了一个大型金属喇叭谐振器来代替木制音箱，以便它可以更好地被录音设备收音。

释义: to develop / to make full use of

例句.zh: 21个月前在寒冬所开始的一切不应当在今天这个秋夜结束。今天的选举胜利并不是我们所寻求的改变--这只是我们进行改变的机会。如果我们仍然按照过去的方式行事，我们所寻求的改变将不会发生。没有你们，没有服务和牺牲的新精神，就不可能发生改变。因此，让我们发扬新的爱国和负责精神，所有的人都下定决心参与其中，更加努力地工作，不仅是为自己而是为彼此。
例句.pinyin: 21 gè yuè qián zài hán dōng suǒ kāi shǐ de yī qiè bù yīng dāng zài jīn tiān zhè ge qiū yè jié shù 。 jīn tiān de xuǎn jǔ shèng lì bìng bú shì wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn -- zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men jìn xíng gǎi biàn de jī huì 。 rú guǒ wǒ men réng rán àn zhào guò qù de fāng shì xíng shì ， wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn jiāng bú huì fā shēng 。 méi yǒu nǐ men ， méi yǒu fú wù hé xī shēng de xīn jīng shén ， jiù bù kě néng fā shēng gǎi biàn 。 yīn cǐ ， ràng wǒ men fā yáng xīn de ài guó hé fù zé jīng shén ， suǒ yǒu de rén dōu xià dìng jué xīn cān yù qí zhōng ， gèng jiā nǔ lì dì gōng zuò ， bù jǐn shì wèi zì jǐ ér shì wèi bǐ cǐ 。
例句.en: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.

例句.zh: 在香港北部石篱公共屋邨的一个社区中心里，一堆堆月饼盒正等著在隔天的中秋节当天分发出去。月饼盒里装的，是本地慈善机构「惜食堂」在佳节时分收集到的 76,000 个月饼的其中一部分，将被重新分配给低收入家庭和个人。
例句.pinyin: zài xiāng gǎng běi bù shí lí gōng gòng wū cūn de yí gè shè qū zhōng xīn lǐ ， yī duī duī yuè bǐng hé zhèng děng zhù zài gé tiān de zhōng qiū jié dàng tiān fēn fā chū qù 。 yuè bǐng hé lǐ zhuāng de ， shì běn dì cí shàn jī gòu 「 xī shí táng 」 zài jiā jié shí fēn shōu jí dào de  76,000  gè yuè bǐng de qí zhōng yī bù fèn ， jiāng bèi chóng xīn fēn pèi gěi dī shōu rù jiā tíng hé gè rén 。
例句.en: At a community center on Shek Lei public housing estate in northern Hong Kong, stacks of mooncake boxes are waiting to be distributed on Mid-Autumn Festival the following day. Inside they contain some of the 76,000 mooncakes that have been collected by Food Grace, a local charity, this holiday season to be redistributed to low-income families and individuals.

例句.zh: 玫瑰的芬芳弥漫了整个房间.
例句.pinyin: méi guī de fēn fāng mí màn le zhěng gè fáng jiān .
例句.en: The smell of roses filled the room.

例句.zh: 于是那欢快的小男孩们四处游荡，/ 如此喜悦地穿越山丘与山谷，/ 蔷薇的芬芳穿过荆棘丛 / 将随温柔的夏风飘散：/ 每个清晨，大自然含笑赐予，/ 那贫苦卑微的农夫也得一份，/ 云雀从草丛中振翅而上，/ 将悠扬的音符送向天际。
例句.pinyin: yú shì nà huān kuài de xiǎo nán hái men sì chù yóu dàng ，/  rú cǐ xǐ yuè dì chuān yuè shān qiū yǔ shān gǔ ，/  qiáng wēi de fēn fāng chuān guò jīng jí cóng  /  jiāng suí wēn róu de xià fēng piāo sàn ：/  měi gè qīng chén ， dà zì rán hán xiào cì yǔ ，/  nà pín kǔ bēi wēi de nóng fū yě dé yī fèn ，/  yún què cóng cǎo cóng zhōng zhèn chì ér shàng ，/  jiāng yōu yáng de yīn fú sòng xiàng tiān jì 。
例句.en: Then the merry little boys they will ramble, / So gleesome, o’er mountain and dale, / Where the sweets of the rose through the bramble / Will be blown by the mild summer gale: / Then a share of Nature’s smiles each morning / To the poor humble peasant will be given. / While the lark from his covert he is soaring, / His musical notes to the heaven.

例句.en: The king, convinced, told the tailors to prepare the outfit, but he also couldn't see this material.

例句.zh: 是在这点上我们的意见有分歧。
例句.pinyin: shì zài zhè diǎn shàng wǒ men de yì jiàn yǒu fēn qí 。

例句.zh: 让我们记住，是伊利诺伊州的一名男子首次将共和党的旗帜扛到了白宫。共和党是建立在自立、个人自由以及国家团结的价值观之上的。这也是我们所有人共同的价值观。虽然民主党今天晚上赢得了巨大的胜利，但我们是以谦卑的态度和弥合阻碍我们进步的分歧的决心赢得这场胜利的
例句.pinyin: ràng wǒ men jì zhù ， shì yī lì nuò yī zhōu de yī míng nán zi shǒu cì jiāng gòng hé dǎng de qí zhì káng dào le bái gōng 。 gòng hé dǎng shì jiàn lì zài zì lì 、 gè rén zì yóu yǐ jí guó jiā tuán jié de jià zhí guān zhī shàng de 。 zhè yě shì wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén gòng tóng de jià zhí guān 。 suī rán mín zhǔ dǎng jīn tiān wǎn shàng yíng dé le jù dà de shèng lì ， dàn wǒ men shì yǐ qiān bēi de tài dù hé mí hé zǔ ài wǒ men jìn bù de fēn qí de jué xīn yíng dé zhè chǎng shèng lì de
例句.en: Let's remember that it was a man from this state who first carried the banner of the Republican Party to the White House, a party founded on the values of self-reliance and individual liberty and national unity. Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.

例句.zh: 林肯在向远比我们眼下分歧更大的国家发表讲话时说，我们不是敌人，而是朋友……虽然激情可能会褪去，但这不会割断我们感情上的联系。
例句.pinyin: lín kěn zài xiàng yuǎn bǐ wǒ men yǎn xià fēn qí gèng dà de guó jiā fā biǎo jiǎng huà shí shuō ， wǒ men bú shì dí rén ， ér shì péng yǒu …… suī rán jī qíng kě néng huì tùn qù ， dàn zhè bú huì gē duàn wǒ men gǎn qíng shàng de lián xì 。
例句.en: As Lincoln said to a nation far more divided than ours, we are not enemies but friends. Though passion may have strained, it must not break our bonds of affection.

例句.zh: 哥伦布曾经在当地人偷了他的鹦鹉之后决定完全地烧毁整个村庄。因为他不能焚烧他们的水，所以他感到失望。于是他发明了氟。
例句.pinyin: gē lún bù céng jīng zài dāng dì rén tōu le tā de yīng wǔ zhī hòu jué dìng wán quán dì shāo huǐ zhěng gè cūn zhuāng 。 yīn wèi tā bù néng fén shāo tā men de shuǐ ， suǒ yǐ tā gǎn dào shī wàng 。 yú shì tā fā míng le fú 。
例句.en: Christopher Columbus once decided to burn absolutely everything in an entire village after one of the natives stole his parrot. He was disappointed that he couldn't burn their water. So he invented fluorine.

例句.en: Don't cast pearls before swine.

例句.zh: 2022 年 2 月 27 日早上，我正要离开卢卢岛的家，却碰见了邻居——红头发的俄罗斯门诺派血统的罗谢尔，以及来自蒙特利尔英语区、留著灰白小胡子的阿尔；阿尔好几代都是加拿大人。他说他住在蒙特娄的时候不懂法语。我在披萨店吃了一块香蒜起司披萨。小贩来自孟买。透过窗户，我看到一个棕金色头发的年轻男子，穿著深灰色连帽夹克和蓝色短裤，看起来像个「大男孩」。咖啡馆外面坐著十个不到 30 岁的人，其中一个看起来像个英俊的犹太人。里面有一桌五、六个 30 岁以上的人，其中一个穿著深绿色夹克和军绿色裤子，是个英俊的假小子。我喝著冰红茶。走出咖啡馆，我看到那个「大男孩」在树林茂密的公园抽烟。我绕了很长一段路回家，穿过散落著鹅粪的校园草坪，北边白雪皑皑的山脉被云雾笼罩，一派泛灵论佛教的景象，仿佛置身于另一个星球。我家附近，奥莉维亚和丹尼尔停放一辆卡车。奥莉维亚正在学习生物化学。卡车后座坐著一只全身黑色的德国牧羊犬。
例句.pinyin: 2022  nián  2  yuè  27  rì zǎo shàng ， wǒ zhèng yào lí kāi lú lú dǎo de jiā ， què pèng jiàn le lín jū —— hóng tóu fā de é luó sī mén nuò pài xuè tǒng de luó xiè ěr ， yǐ jí lái zì méng tè lì ěr yīng yǔ qū 、 liú zhù huī bái xiǎo hú zi de ā ěr ； ā ěr hǎo jǐ dài dōu shì jiā ná dà rén 。 tā shuō tā zhù zài méng tè lóu de shí hòu bù dǒng fǎ yǔ 。 wǒ zài pī sà diàn chī le yī kuài xiāng suàn qǐ sī pī sà 。 xiǎo fàn lái zì mèng mǎi 。 tòu guò chuāng hù ， wǒ kàn dào yí gè zōng jīn sè tóu fà de nián qīng nán zi ， chuān zhù shēn huī sè lián mào jiá kè hé lán sè duǎn kù ， kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè 「 dà nán hái 」。 kā fēi guǎn wài miàn zuò zhù shí gè bú dào  30  suì de rén ， qí zhōng yí gè kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè yīng jùn de yóu tài rén 。 lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhuō wǔ 、 liù gè  30  suì yǐ shàng de rén ， qí zhōng yí gè chuān zhù shēn lǜ sè jiá kè hé jūn lǜ sè kù zi ， shì gè yīng jùn de jiǎ xiǎo zi 。 wǒ hē zhù bīng hóng chá 。 zǒu chū kā fēi guǎn ， wǒ kàn dào nà ge 「 dà nán hái 」 zài shù lín mào mì de gōng yuán chōu yān 。 wǒ rào le hěn zhǎng yī duàn lù huí jiā ， chuān guò sàn luò zhù é fèn de xiào yuán cǎo píng ， běi biān bái xuě ái ái de shān mài bèi yún wù lǒng zhào ， yī pài fàn líng lùn fó jiào de jǐng xiàng ， fǎng fú zhì shēn yú lìng yí gè xīng qiú 。 wǒ jiā fù jìn ， ào lì wéi yà hé dān ní ěr tíng fàng yī liàng kǎ chē 。 ào lì wéi yà zhèng zài xué xí shēng wù huà xué 。 kǎ chē hòu zuò zuò zhù yī zhī quán shēn hēi sè de dé guó mù yáng quǎn 。
例句.en: In the morning of the 27th of February of 2022, on my way out of my Lulu Island house, I saw my neighbours the redhead Rochelle of Russian-Mennonite ancestry and the grey-haired moustached Al from the Anglophone section of Montreal; he was from many generations of Canadians. He said that he did not know French, when he lived in Montreal. I ate a slice of pesto cheese pizza at the pizzeria. The vendor was from Mumbai. Through the window, I could see a young brown-blond-haired man in a dark-grey hooded jacket and blue shorts, which made him look like a "big boy." At the cafe, there was an under-age-30 crowd of ten outside, of whom one looked like a handsome Jew. Inside was a table of five or six over-age-30 people, of whom one was a handsome tomboy in a dark-green jacket and army-green pants. I drank my iced black tea. Heading out of the cafe, I saw the "big boy" smoking in the wooded park. I took the long route home, through the grassy school field littered with goose poop, the northern snowcapped mountains obscured by clouds, an Animistic-Buddhistic view seemingly of a different planet. Near my house, parked in a truck were Olivia and Daniel. Olivia was studying Biochemistry. In the back seat of the truck was a fully black German Shepherd.

释义: excrement / feces / night soil

例句.zh: 请及时清理宠物的粪便。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng jíshí qīnglǐ chǒngwù de fènbiàn.
例句.en: Please clean up your pet's excrement promptly.

例句.zh: 医生需要检查病人的粪便。
例句.pinyin: Yīshēng xūyào jiǎnchá bìngrén de fènbiàn.
例句.en: The doctor needs to examine the patient's feces.

例句.zh: 粪便中可能含有细菌。
例句.pinyin: Fènbiàn zhōng kěnéng hányǒu xìjūn.
例句.en: Excrement may contain bacteria.

释义: share / portion

例句.zh: 这家公司占有很大的市场份额。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhànyǒu hěn dà de shìchǎng fèn'é.
例句.en: This company has a large market share.

例句.zh: 每个人都能得到相同的份额。
例句.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu néng dédào xiāngtóng de fèn'é.
例句.en: Everyone can receive an equal share.

例句.zh: 我们需要扩大产品的市场份额。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào kuòdà chǎnpǐn de shìchǎng fèn'é.
例句.en: We need to increase the product's market share.

释义: to do everything one can / to spare no effort / to strive

例句.zh: 奥运会最重要的不是胜利，而是参与；正如在生活中最重要的事情不是成功，而是奋斗；但最本质的事情并不是征服，而是奋力拼搏。
例句.pinyin: ào yùn huì zuì zhòng yào de bú shì shèng lì ， ér shì cān yù ； zhèng rú zài shēng huó zhōng zuì zhòng yào de shì qíng bú shì chéng gōng ， ér shì fèn dòu ； dàn zuì běn zhì dì shì qíng bìng bú shì zhēng fú ， ér shì fèn lì pīn bó 。
例句.en: The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not to win but to take part, just as the most important thing in life is not the triumph but the struggle. The essential thing is not to have conquered but to have fought well.

释义: (vector) component / (food) portion size / quantity; weight; measure / (fig.) weight (importance, prestige, authority etc); (of written material) density

例句.zh: 请计算速度在水平方向上的分量。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng jìsuàn sùdù zài shuǐpíng fāngxiàng shàng de fènliàng.
例句.en: Please calculate the horizontal component of the velocity.

例句.zh: 力的竖直分量抵消了重力。
例句.pinyin: Lì de shùzhí fènliàng dǐxiāo le zhònglì.
例句.en: The vertical component of the force counteracted gravity.

例句.zh: 这个向量可以分解成两个互相垂直的分量。
例句.pinyin: Zhège xiàngliàng kěyǐ fēnjiě chéng liǎng ge hùxiāng chuízhí de fènliàng.
例句.en: This vector can be resolved into two mutually perpendicular components.

释义: exceptionally / not one's responsibility or job

例句.zh: 先肯定后否定，一正一反，就分外有力量。
例句.pinyin: xiān kěn dìng hòu fǒu dìng ， yī zhèng yī fǎn ， jiù fèn wài yǒu lì liàng 。
例句.en: First acknowledge, then deny – one for and one against – and then you are in a powerful position.

释义: dauntless / to summon up courage and determination / using extreme force of will

例句.zh: 战士们奋勇向前。
例句.pinyin: Zhànshìmen fènyǒng xiàng qián.
例句.en: The soldiers advanced dauntlessly.

例句.zh: 他奋勇跳入水中救人。
例句.pinyin: Tā fènyǒng tiào rù shuǐ zhōng jiù rén.
例句.en: He bravely jumped into the water to save someone.

例句.zh: 队员们奋勇拼搏，赢得了比赛。
例句.pinyin: Duìyuánmen fènyǒng pīnbó, yíngdé le bǐsài.
例句.en: The team members fought courageously and won the match.

释义: insane / mad / wild

例句.zh: 大部份的人觉得我疯了。
例句.pinyin: dà bù fèn de rén jué de wǒ fēng le 。
例句.en: Most people think I'm crazy.

例句.zh: 世界就是一个疯子的囚笼。
例句.pinyin: shì jiè jiù shì yí gè fēng zi de qiú lóng 。
例句.en: The world is a den of crazies.

例句.zh: 快把我逼疯了
例句.pinyin: kuài bǎ wǒ bī fēng le
例句.en: It's driving me crazy.

释义: storm / violent commotion / fig. crisis (e.g. revolution, uprising, financial crisis etc)

例句.zh: 狂风暴雨造成她无法准时抵达。
例句.pinyin: kuáng fēng bào yǔ zào chéng tā wú fǎ zhǔn shí dǐ dá 。
例句.en: The storm prevented her from arriving on time.

例句.zh: 因为风暴，他们晚到了。
例句.pinyin: yīn wèi fēng bào ， tā men wǎn dào le 。
例句.en: Owing to the storm, they arrived late.

例句.zh: 一棵大树在风暴中倒下了。
例句.pinyin: yī kē dà shù zài fēng bào zhōng dǎo xià le 。
例句.en: A big tree has fallen in the storm.

释义: disturbance / crisis / disputes / restlessness / CL:場|场[chang2]

例句.zh: 这场风波很快平息了。
例句.pinyin: Zhè chǎng fēngbō hěn kuài píngxī le.
例句.en: The disturbance quickly died down.

例句.zh: 他不想卷入这场风波。
例句.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng juǎnrù zhè chǎng fēngbō.
例句.en: He doesn't want to get involved in this disturbance.

例句.zh: 公司因这次风波公开道歉。
例句.pinyin: Gōngsī yīn zhè cì fēngbō gōngkāi dàoqiàn.
例句.en: The company publicly apologized for the disturbance.

释义: svelte / elegant manner / graceful bearing

例句.zh: 她在舞台上展现出自信的风采。
例句.pinyin: Tā zài wǔtái shàng zhǎnxiàn chū zìxìn de fēngcǎi.
例句.en: She displayed a confident presence on stage.

例句.zh: 这位老教授依然风采不减。
例句.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎo jiàoshòu yīrán fēngcǎi bù jiǎn.
例句.en: The elderly professor remains as distinguished as ever.

例句.zh: 运动员们展现了青春的风采。
例句.pinyin: Yùndòngyuán men zhǎnxiàn le qīngchūn de fēngcǎi.
例句.en: The athletes displayed the vitality of youth.

释义: lit. to eat in the open air and sleep outdoors (idiom) / fig. to rough it
短释义: lit. to eat in the open air and sleep outdoors (idiom)

例句.zh: 地质队员常年风餐露宿，奔波在深山里。
例句.pinyin: Dìzhì duìyuán chángnián fēng cān lù sù, bēnbō zài shēnshān lǐ.
例句.en: The geological team members spend years eating and sleeping outdoors, traveling through the mountains.

例句.zh: 他一路风餐露宿，终于走到了西藏。
例句.pinyin: Tā yí lù fēng cān lù sù, zhōngyú zǒu dào le Xīzàng.
例句.en: He ate and slept outdoors along the way and finally reached Tibet.

例句.zh: 救援队员风餐露宿，连续搜寻了三天。
例句.pinyin: Jiùyuán duìyuán fēng cān lù sù, liánxù sōuxún le sān tiān.
例句.en: The rescuers ate and slept outdoors while searching for three days straight.

释义: lit. windswept and battered by rain / to undergo hardship (idiom)
短释义: lit. windswept and battered by rain

例句.zh: 这座古桥经历了百年的风吹雨打。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔqiáo jīnglì le bǎinián de fēng chuī yǔ dǎ.
例句.en: This ancient bridge has endured a hundred years of wind and rain.

例句.zh: 这个招牌经不起长期的风吹雨打。
例句.pinyin: Zhège zhāopái jīngbuqǐ chángqī de fēng chuī yǔ dǎ.
例句.en: This sign cannot withstand long-term exposure to wind and rain.

例句.zh: 虽经风吹雨打，那棵老树依然挺立。
例句.pinyin: Suī jīng fēng chuī yǔ dǎ, nà kē lǎoshù yīrán tǐnglì.
例句.en: Despite being battered by wind and rain, the old tree still stands tall.

释义: to put a roof (on a building) / to cap the roof (finishing a building project) / fig. to put a ceiling (on spending, prize, ambition etc) / to top off / fig. to reach the highest point (of growth, profit, interest rates) / to stop growing (of plant bud or branch)
短释义: to put a roof (on a building)

例句.zh: 这栋大楼下个月封顶。
例句.pinyin: Zhè dòng dàlóu xià ge yuè fēngdǐng.
例句.en: This building will be topped out next month.

例句.zh: 工人们正在给新房封顶。
例句.pinyin: Gōngrénmen zhèngzài gěi xīnfáng fēngdǐng.
例句.en: The workers are putting a roof on the new house.

例句.zh: 教学楼已经顺利封顶。
例句.pinyin: Jiàoxuélóu yǐjīng shùnlì fēngdǐng.
例句.en: The classroom building has been successfully topped out.

释义: elegance (for men) / elegant demeanor / grace / poise

例句.zh: 他举止从容，很有绅士风度。
例句.pinyin: Tā jǔzhǐ cóngróng, hěn yǒu shēnshì fēngdù.
例句.en: He carries himself calmly and has the elegance of a gentleman.

例句.zh: 即使输了比赛，他也保持了应有的风度。
例句.pinyin: Jíshǐ shū le bǐsài, tā yě bǎochí le yīngyǒu de fēngdù.
例句.en: Even though he lost the match, he maintained his dignity.

例句.zh: 那位男士谈吐得体，风度翩翩。
例句.pinyin: Nà wèi nánshì tántǔ détǐ, fēngdù piānpiān.
例句.en: That man speaks appropriately and has an elegant manner.

释义: air / manner / model / paragon / demeanor

例句.zh: 他举止从容，很有学者风范。
例句.pinyin: Tā jǔzhǐ cóngróng, hěn yǒu xuézhě fēngfàn.
例句.en: His calm manner gives him the air of a scholar.

例句.zh: 年轻的队长展现了领袖风范。
例句.pinyin: Niánqīng de duìzhǎng zhǎnxiàn le lǐngxiù fēngfàn.
例句.en: The young captain displayed the air of a leader.

例句.zh: 这位教授始终保持着谦逊的风范。
例句.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu shǐzhōng bǎochí zhe qiānxùn de fēngfàn.
例句.en: The professor always maintains a humble demeanor.

释义: moderate wind, beautiful sun (idiom); fine sunny weather, esp. in springtime
短释义: moderate wind, beautiful sun (idiom); fine sunny weather, esp. in springtime

例句.zh: 今天风和日丽，适合去公园散步。
例句.pinyin: Jīntiān fēng hé rì lì, shìhé qù gōngyuán sànbù.
例句.en: The weather is fine and sunny today, perfect for a walk in the park.

例句.zh: 春天的午后风和日丽，让人心情舒畅。
例句.pinyin: Chūntiān de wǔhòu fēng hé rì lì, ràng rén xīnqíng shūchàng.
例句.en: The fine, sunny spring afternoon puts everyone in a cheerful mood.

例句.zh: 婚礼当天风和日丽，一切都很顺利。
例句.pinyin: Hūnlǐ dāngtiān fēng hé rì lì, yíqiè dōu hěn shùnlì.
例句.en: The weather was fine and sunny on the wedding day, and everything went smoothly.

释义: generous; ample

例句.zh: 孔子说："像夏禹的为人，我找不到可以指责的漏洞。自己吃著菲薄的饮食，而却用丰厚祭品祭拜祖先与神明；自己平时穿粗劣的衣裳，而在祭祀时穿戴华服礼帽；自己住小房子，却尽力开通水道沟渠。像夏禹这样的人，我实在找不到可以指责的漏洞了。"
例句.pinyin: kǒng zi shuō ：" xiàng xià yǔ de wéi rén ， wǒ zhǎo bú dào kě yǐ zhǐ zé de lòu dòng 。 zì jǐ chī zhù fěi bó de yǐn shí ， ér què yòng fēng hòu jì pǐn jì bài zǔ xiān yǔ shén míng ； zì jǐ píng shí chuān cū liè de yī shang ， ér zài jì sì shí chuān dài huá fú lǐ mào ； zì jǐ zhù xiǎo fáng zi ， què jìn lì kāi tōng shuǐ dào gōu qú 。 xiàng xià yǔ zhè yàng de rén ， wǒ shí zài zhǎo bú dào kě yǐ zhǐ zé de lòu dòng le 。"
例句.en: Confucius said: " Yu the Great's conduct, I could not point out any flaws. He consumes meager amount of food, while offering boastful riches to the Gods and ancestors; He always don the crudest attire, but wears lavish garments when worshipping; He resides in a small house, yet forges water ways and ditches with all his might. Figures like Yu the Great, I honestly cannot point out any reprehensible flaws."

释义: summit meeting

例句.zh: 今年的峰会将在北京举行。
例句.pinyin: Jīnnián de fēnghuì jiāng zài Běijīng jǔxíng.
例句.en: This year's summit will be held in Beijing.

例句.zh: 各国领导人出席了这次峰会。
例句.pinyin: Gèguó lǐngdǎorén chūxí le zhè cì fēnghuì.
例句.en: Leaders from various countries attended the summit.

例句.zh: 峰会讨论了气候变化问题。
例句.pinyin: Fēnghuì tǎolùn le qìhòu biànhuà wèntí.
例句.en: The summit discussed climate change.

释义: the mountain road twists around each new peak (idiom) / (of a mountain road) twisting and turning / fig. an opportunity has come unexpectedly / things have taken a new turn
短释义: the mountain road twists around each new peak (idiom)

例句.zh: 就在大家准备放弃时，事情突然峰回路转。
例句.pinyin: Jiù zài dàjiā zhǔnbèi fàngqì shí, shìqing tūrán fēng huí lù zhuǎn.
例句.en: Just as everyone was about to give up, things suddenly took an unexpected turn.

例句.zh: 这场比赛峰回路转，直到最后才分出胜负。
例句.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bǐsài fēng huí lù zhuǎn, zhídào zuìhòu cái fēn chū shèngfù.
例句.en: The game was full of twists and turns, and the winner was not decided until the very end.

例句.zh: 山间小路峰回路转，景色越来越美。
例句.pinyin: Shānjiān xiǎolù fēng huí lù zhuǎn, jǐngsè yuè lái yuè měi.
例句.en: The mountain path winds around the peaks, and the scenery grows ever more beautiful.

释义: system of enfeoffment / feudalism / feudal / feudalistic

例句.zh: 众所周知，直到上个世纪中叶日本是一个封建国家。
例句.pinyin: zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī ， zhí dào shàng gè shì jì zhōng yè rì běn shì yí gè fēng jiàn guó jiā 。
例句.en: It is well known that up to the middle of the last century Japan was a feudal state.

释义: a strip of scenic beauty (coast, river, road etc) / (fig.) an eye-catching feature
短释义: a strip of scenic beauty (coast, river, road etc)

例句.zh: 这条滨海公路是一道美丽的风景线。
例句.pinyin: Zhè tiáo bīnhǎi gōnglù shì yí dào měilì de fēngjǐngxiàn.
例句.en: This coastal highway is a beautiful scenic route.

例句.zh: 沿江公园成了城市的新风景线。
例句.pinyin: Yánjiāng gōngyuán chéng le chéngshì de xīn fēngjǐngxiàn.

例句.zh: 惜秦皇汉武，略输文采；唐宗宋祖，稍逊风骚。一代天骄，成吉思汗，只识弯弓射大雕。俱往矣，数风流人物，还看今朝。

例句.en: Emperor Qin Shi Huang and Emperor Wu of Han, though remarkable in their achievements, somewhat lacked in literary grace; Emperor Taizong of Tang and Emperor Taizu of Song, though commendable in their elegance, still fall slightly short in their brilliance. The proud conqueror, Genghis Khan, knew only how to bend the bow and shoot great eagles. All of them are now bygone, and if you want to count the truly remarkable figures, look to the present age.

释义: general mood / atmosphere / common practice

例句.zh: 我从小到大都是个酷儿小孩，从学校、老师或大多数同学那里得不到任何支持，感到孤立无援，觉得自己从根本上就是有问题的。我很高兴现况已有所改变，但对于那股反对支持与肯定酷儿儿童之风气的反动势力感到厌恶。

例句.en: Growing up as a queer kid, I had no support whatsoever from school, from teachers, or from most other kids, and I felt isolated and fundamentally bad. I'm glad things have changed, but disgusted by the reactionary movement that has risen up against the practice of supporting and affirming queer kids.

例句.pinyin: tā jí shí fù yuē le 。
例句.en: He was in time for the appointment.

例句.zh: 我朋友邀我共赴晚餐。
例句.pinyin: wǒ péng yǒu yāo wǒ gòng fù wǎn cān 。
例句.en: My friends invited me to dinner.

例句.zh: 我们全力以赴来完成工作。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men quán lì yǐ fù lái wán chéng gōng zuò 。
例句.en: We went all out to get the job done.

例句.en: A man can live and be healthy without killing animals for food; therefore, if he eats meat, he participates in taking animal life merely for the sake of his appetite. And to act so is immoral.

例句.zh: 如果你在洋娃娃腹部的侧面上链的话，它就会扭动手臂，翻著筋斗向前前进。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ zài yáng wá wá fù bù de cè miàn shàng liàn de huà ， tā jiù huì niǔ dòng shǒu bì ， fān zhù jīn dǒu xiàng qián qián jìn 。
例句.en: If you wind up the doll with the key on the side of its torso it will swing its arms round and go forward doing somersaults.

释义: copy; duplicate; transcript / (gaming) dungeon; instance; private team mission

例句.zh: 请把合同副本交给我。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ hétóng fùběn jiāo gěi wǒ.
例句.en: Please give me a copy of the contract.

例句.zh: 我在电脑里保存了文件的副本。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ zài diànnǎo lǐ bǎocún le wénjiàn de fùběn.
例句.en: I saved a copy of the file on my computer.

例句.zh: 这份副本和原件完全一样。
例句.pinyin: Zhè fèn fùběn hé yuánjiàn wánquán yíyàng.
例句.en: This copy is exactly the same as the original.

例句.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì wǒ xià zhōu lái fùchá.
例句.en: The doctor advised me to come back for a follow-up examination next week.

例句.zh: 请复查一遍这些数据。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng fùchá yí biàn zhèxiē shùjù.
例句.en: Please check these data again.

例句.zh: 老师复查了学生的考试成绩。
例句.pinyin: Lǎoshī fùchá le xuéshēng de kǎoshì chéngjì.
例句.en: The teacher rechecked the students' exam results.

释义: supplementary / incidentally / in parentheses / by chance / in passing / additionally / secondary / subsidiary / to attach

例句.zh: 这份合同附带一项保密条款。
例句.pinyin: Zhè fèn hétóng fùdài yí xiàng bǎomì tiáokuǎn.
例句.en: This contract includes a confidentiality clause.

例句.zh: 他还附带说明了迟到的原因。
例句.pinyin: Tā hái fùdài shuōmíng le chídào de yuányīn.
例句.en: He also briefly explained why he was late.

例句.zh: 这项优惠有一个附带条件。
例句.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yōuhuì yǒu yí ge fùdài tiáojiàn.
例句.en: This special offer comes with one additional condition.

释义: to recur (of a disease) / to reappear / to relapse (into a former bad state)

例句.zh: 1955年她的癌症复发，她1956年去世，享年42岁。
例句.pinyin: 1955 nián tā de ái zhèng fù fā ， tā 1956 nián qù shì ， xiǎng nián 42 suì 。
例句.en: In 1955, the cancer returned and she died in 1956 at the age of 42.

释义: to contain in great quantities / rich in

例句.zh: 水果富含维生素和矿物质。
例句.pinyin: shuǐ guǒ fù hán wéi shēng sù hé kuàng wù zhì 。
例句.en: Fruits are rich in vitamins and minerals.

例句.pinyin: liǔ chéng fù hán wéi tā mìng  C。
例句.en: Oranges contain a lot of vitamin C.

例句.en: Pine is a resinous wood.

例句.pinyin: Nà wèi fùháo juān le yí dà bǐ qián.

例句.en: This tycoon owns several companies.

释义: (of people who were estranged) to be reconciled / (of a couple) to get back together / complex / compound / composite / hybrid / to compound / to combine

例句.zh: 你对复合碳水化合物有什么了解吗？
例句.pinyin: nǐ duì fù hé tàn shuǐ huà hé wù yǒu shén me liǎo jiě ma ？
例句.en: Do you know anything about complex carbohydrates?

例句.zh: 你知道什么是复合词吗？
例句.pinyin: nǐ zhī dào shén me shì fù hé cí ma ？
例句.en: Do you know what compound words are?

释义: to agree / to go along with / to echo (what sb says)

例句.zh: “我也那样觉得。”她附和道。
例句.pinyin: “ wǒ yě nà yàng jué de 。” tā fù hè dào 。
例句.en: "I think so, too," she chimed in.

例句.en: Jesus is said to have raised a man from the dead.

例句.zh: 死亡之后你便不会再复活。你不能死过之后又重回生命。如果你以为那会发生，你并非真正死去。
例句.pinyin: sǐ wáng zhī hòu nǐ biàn bú huì zài fù huó 。 nǐ bù néng sǐ guò zhī hòu yòu zhòng huí shēng mìng 。 rú guǒ nǐ yǐ wéi nà huì fā shēng ， nǐ bìng fēi zhēn zhèng sǐ qù 。
例句.en: Death is the point at which you can't be alive again. You can't die and then come back to life. If you think that happened, you weren't really dead.

例句.zh: 复活节快乐。
例句.pinyin: fù huó jié kuài lè 。
例句.en: Happy Easter!

例句.pinyin: yán jiū biǎo míng rén men yī yǒu zhù chù 、 shí wù zhè xiē jī běn de xū yào ， fù jiā de cái fù jiù bù néng dà liàng dì tí gāo tā men de kuài lè 。
例句.en: Studies show that once the basic needs of shelter and food are met, additional wealth adds very little to happiness.

例句.zh: 中国社会科学院信息化研究中心副主任刘满强说:“信息传递能够带来巨大的附加值，中国信息发展的一个重要目标是让更多的农民从信息业发展中受益。”
例句.pinyin: zhōng guó shè huì kē xué yuàn xìn xī huà yán jiū zhōng xīn fù zhǔ rèn liú mǎn qiáng shuō :“ xìn xī chuán dì néng gòu dài lái jù dà de fù jiā zhí ， zhōng guó xìn xī fā zhǎn de yí gè zhòng yào mù biāo shì ràng gèng duō de nóng mín cóng xìn xī yè fā zhǎn zhōng shòu yì 。”
例句.en: Liu Manqiang, deputy director of the Chinese Research Centre and College for Social Sciences and Information Technology, says "Information and communication technology has the potential for a huge increase in value; an important goal for the development of China's information technology is allowing more rural citizens to benefit from the information technology industry."

例句.zh: 有了这个附加元件，您的电脑就变成了游戏电脑。
例句.pinyin: yǒu le zhè ge fù jiā yuán jiàn ， nín de diàn nǎo jiù biàn chéng le yóu xì diàn nǎo 。
例句.en: With this add-on, your computer has been converted into a gaming PC.

释义: rich and powerful

例句.pinyin: wǒ men de guó jiā rì yì fù qiáng 。
例句.en: Our country grows stronger day by day.

例句.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng chūshòu yì jiā fùshǔ qǐyè.
例句.en: The company decided to sell a subsidiary.

例句.pinyin: jīng jì zài fù sū zhī zhōng 。
例句.en: The economy is picking up.

例句.zh: 我希望经济很快复苏起来。

例句.en: I hope the economy picks up soon.

例句.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi qù shàng yīng ér xīn fèi fù sū kè chéng 。

例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zuò yí gè bǎi wàn fù wēng 。
例句.en: I'd like to be a millionaire.

例句.pinyin: Wǒ chī le bù xīnxiān de shíwù hòu kāishǐ fùxiè.
例句.en: I began to have diarrhea after eating food that wasn't fresh.

例句.zh: 他腹泻了一整天，身体很虚弱。
例句.pinyin: Tā fùxiè le yì zhěng tiān, shēntǐ hěn xūruò.

例句.zh: 如果腹泻一直不好，就应该去看医生。
例句.pinyin: Rúguǒ fùxiè yìzhí bù hǎo, jiù yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
例句.en: If the diarrhea doesn't get better, you should see a doctor.

释义: to revive / to rejuvenate

例句.zh: 随著文艺复兴，学院派的想法被积极的想法取而代之了。
例句.pinyin: suí zhù wén yì fù xīng ， xué yuàn pài de xiǎng fǎ bèi jī jí de xiǎng fǎ qǔ ér dài zhī le 。

例句.pinyin: wǒ xiāng xìn nǐ hěn kuài jiù néng fù yuán 。
例句.en: I believe you'll get over it soon.

例句.zh: 爱和希望帮助她迅速复原。
例句.pinyin: ài hé xī wàng bāng zhù tā xùn sù fù yuán 。
例句.en: Love and hope helped her to recover quickly.

例句.en: Camels can carry heavy loads across the desert.

例句.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yālì hěn dà, tā réngrán fùzhòng qiánxíng.
例句.en: Despite the great pressure, he continued onward under the burden.
