例句.en: A long day has passed on.

例句.zh: 今晚稍早，我接到马侃参议员打来，态度非常恳切的电话。马侃参议员已打完一场漫长艰苦的选战。他为这个他所热爱的国家所打的仗更久，更艰苦。他为美国的奉献牺牲，是我们多数同胞难以想像的。因为有他这位勇敢无私的领袖的奉献，我们才能过比较好的日子。
例句.pinyin: jīn wǎn shāo zǎo ， wǒ jiē dào mǎ kǎn cān yì yuán dǎ lái ， tài dù fēi cháng kěn qiè de diàn huà 。 mǎ kǎn cān yì yuán yǐ dǎ wán yī cháng màn cháng jiān kǔ de xuǎn zhàn 。 tā wèi zhè ge tā suǒ rè ài de guó jiā suǒ dǎ dī zhàng gèng jiǔ ， gèng jiān kǔ 。 tā wèi měi guó de fèng xiàn xī shēng ， shì wǒ men duō shù tóng bāo nán yǐ xiǎng xiàng de 。 yīn wèi yǒu tā zhè wèi yǒng gǎn wú sī de lǐng xiù de fèng xiàn ， wǒ men cái néng guò bǐ jiào hǎo de rì zi 。
例句.en: A little bit earlier this evening, I received an extraordinarily gracious call from Senator McCain. Senator McCain fought long and hard in this campaign. And he's fought even longer and harder for the country that he loves. He has endured sacrifices for America that most of us cannot begin to imagine. We are better off for the service rendered by this brave and selfless leader.

例句.zh: 前方的道路将很漫长，我们攀登的脚步会很艰辛。我们可能无法在一年甚至一个任期内实现这些目标，但我从未像今晚这样满怀希望，我们将实现我们的目标。
例句.pinyin: qián fāng de dào lù jiāng hěn màn cháng ， wǒ men pān dēng de jiǎo bù huì hěn jiān xīn 。 wǒ men kě néng wú fǎ zài yī nián shèn zhì yí gè rèn qī nèi shí xiàn zhè xiē mù biāo ， dàn wǒ cóng wèi xiàng jīn wǎn zhè yàng mǎn huái xī wàng ， wǒ men jiāng shí xiàn wǒ men de mù biāo 。
例句.en: The road ahead will be long. Our climb will be steep. We may not get there in one year or even in one term. But, America, I have never been more hopeful than I am tonight that we WILL get there.

释义: slow and patient / chronic (disease) / slow to take effect (e.g. a slow poison)

例句.zh: 他是个慢性子。
例句.pinyin: tā shì gè màn xìng zi 。
例句.en: He is a slowcoach.

例句.zh: 鲍勃已无法忍受她老婆的慢性子。
例句.pinyin: bào bó yǐ wú fǎ rěn shòu tā lǎo pó de màn xìng zi 。
例句.en: Bob got impatient at his wife's delay.

释义: to spread; to extend

例句.zh: 火势以扇形迅速蔓延。
例句.pinyin: huǒ shì yǐ shàn xíng xùn sù màn yán 。
例句.en: The fire spread out in a fan-shape.

例句.zh: 这些措施可以预防疾病蔓延。
例句.pinyin: zhè xiē cuò shī kě yǐ yù fáng jí bìng màn yán 。
例句.en: These measures can prevent the disease from spreading.

例句.zh: 他穿过公园时，一阵寒意顺著脊背蔓延而下。
例句.pinyin: tā chuān guò gōng yuán shí ， yī zhèn hán yì shùn zhù jǐ bèi màn yán ér xià 。
例句.en: A chill ran down his spine as he crossed the park.

释义: to travel around / to roam / (mobile telephony) roaming

例句.zh: 他喜欢独自在欧洲漫游。
例句.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan dúzì zài Ōuzhōu mànyóu.
例句.en: He likes to travel around Europe alone.

例句.zh: 我们骑着自行车在乡间漫游。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen qízhe zìxíngchē zài xiāngjiān mànyóu.
例句.en: We rode bicycles around the countryside.

例句.zh: 她花了一年时间漫游世界。
例句.pinyin: Tā huā le yì nián shíjiān mànyóu shìjiè.
例句.en: She spent a year traveling around the world.

释义: to be really busy / pressing business

例句.zh: 我忙活了一上午，终于把房间收拾好了。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ mánghuo le yí shàngwǔ, zhōngyú bǎ fángjiān shōushi hǎo le.
例句.en: I was busy all morning and finally got the room cleaned up.

例句.zh: 为了这顿饭，妈妈忙活了半天。
例句.pinyin: Wèile zhè dùn fàn, māma mánghuo le bàntiān.
例句.en: Mom was busy for hours preparing this meal.

例句.zh: 大家忙活了一整天，总算把活动准备好了。
例句.pinyin: Dàjiā mánghuo le yì zhěng tiān, zǒngsuàn bǎ huódòng zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
例句.en: Everyone was busy all day and finally got the event ready.

释义: rushed and muddled

例句.zh: 婚礼开始前，后台一片忙乱。
例句.pinyin: Hūnlǐ kāishǐ qián, hòutái yí piàn mángluàn.
例句.en: Before the wedding began, backstage was in a flurry.

例句.zh: 他第一次值夜班，显得有些忙乱。
例句.pinyin: Tā dì-yī cì zhí yèbān, xiǎnde yǒuxiē mángluàn.
例句.en: He seemed a little rushed and muddled on his first night shift.

例句.zh: 搬家那天，我们忙乱得连午饭都忘了吃。
例句.pinyin: Bānjiā nà tiān, wǒmen mángluàn de lián wǔfàn dōu wàngle chī.
例句.en: On moving day, we were so rushed that we even forgot to eat lunch.

释义: boundless / vast and obscure

例句.zh: 突然，从茫茫大雾中出现了一艘船。
例句.pinyin: tū rán ， cóng máng máng dà wù zhōng chū xiàn le yì sōu chuán 。
例句.en: Suddenly, a ship appeared through the fog.

释义: (fig.) (of one's actions) blind; unthinking

例句.zh: 人们说爱情是盲目的。
例句.pinyin: rén men shuō ài qíng shì máng mù dì 。
例句.en: They say love is blind.

例句.zh: 爱是盲目的。
例句.pinyin: ài shì máng mù dì 。
例句.en: Love is blind.

例句.zh: Jane 又胖、又没礼貌、又烟不离手，可是 Ken 却觉得她可爱、动人，所谓「爱情是盲目的」，大概就是这个意思了吧。
例句.pinyin: Jane  yòu pàng 、 yòu méi lǐ mào 、 yòu yān bù lí shǒu ， kě shì  Ken  què jué de tā kě ài 、 dòng rén ， suǒ wèi 「 ài qíng shì máng mù dì 」， dà gài jiù shì zhè ge yì si le ba 。
例句.en: Jane is fat and rude, and smokes too much. However, Ken thinks she's lovely and charming. That's why they say love is blind.

释义: blankly / vacantly / at a loss

例句.zh: 他站在那里,一脸茫然。
例句.pinyin: tā zhàn zài nà lǐ , yī liǎn máng rán 。
例句.en: He was standing there with a vacant look.

例句.zh: 她感到茫然。
例句.pinyin: tā gǎn dào máng rán 。
例句.en: She felt dazed.

释义: spearhead / barb / an attack or criticism

例句.zh: 他把批评的矛头指向了管理层。
例句.pinyin: Tā bǎ pīpíng de máotóu zhǐxiàng le guǎnlǐcéng.
例句.en: He directed his criticism at the management.

例句.zh: 舆论的矛头突然转向了这家公司。
例句.pinyin: Yúlùn de máotóu tūrán zhuǎnxiàng le zhè jiā gōngsī.
例句.en: The focus of public criticism suddenly shifted to this company.

例句.zh: 不要把矛头对准无辜的人。
例句.pinyin: Bú yào bǎ máotóu duìzhǔn wúgū de rén.
例句.en: Don't target innocent people.

释义: to feign / to pretend to be / to pass oneself off as

例句.zh: 他冒充警察骗取信任。
例句.pinyin: Tā màochōng jǐngchá piànqǔ xìnrèn.
例句.en: He posed as a police officer to gain people's trust.

例句.zh: 别冒充专家发表意见。
例句.pinyin: Bié màochōng zhuānjiā fābiǎo yìjiàn.
例句.en: Don't pretend to be an expert and offer your opinion.

例句.zh: 有人冒充客服给我打电话。
例句.pinyin: Yǒurén màochōng kèfú gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
例句.en: Someone called me pretending to be a customer service representative.

释义: to offend

例句.zh: 我怕我冒犯了你。
例句.pinyin: wǒ pà wǒ mào fàn le nǐ 。
例句.en: I'm afraid I've offended you.

例句.zh: 他的行为冒犯了我。
例句.pinyin: tā de xíng wéi mào fàn le wǒ 。
例句.en: I was offended by his behavior.

例句.zh: 你的行为已经冒犯了他的尊严。
例句.pinyin: nǐ de xíng wéi yǐ jīng mào fàn le tā de zūn yán 。
例句.en: Your action has offended his dignity.

释义: bold / presumptuous / to take the liberty of

例句.zh: 恕我冒昧，我可以问你的年龄吗？
例句.pinyin: Shù wǒ màomèi, wǒ kěyǐ wèn nǐ de niánlíng ma?
例句.en: Forgive me for being so bold, but may I ask your age?

例句.zh: 我冒昧地给他提了一个建议。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ màomèi de gěi tā tí le yí ge jiànyì.
例句.en: I boldly offered him a suggestion.

例句.zh: 这样冒昧地打扰您，真不好意思。
例句.pinyin: Zhèyàng màomèi de dǎrǎo nín, zhēn bù hǎoyìsi.
例句.en: I’m sorry to disturb you so presumptuously.

释义: dense (of plant growth) / lush

例句.zh: 2022 年 2 月 27 日早上，我正要离开卢卢岛的家，却碰见了邻居——红头发的俄罗斯门诺派血统的罗谢尔，以及来自蒙特利尔英语区、留著灰白小胡子的阿尔；阿尔好几代都是加拿大人。他说他住在蒙特娄的时候不懂法语。我在披萨店吃了一块香蒜起司披萨。小贩来自孟买。透过窗户，我看到一个棕金色头发的年轻男子，穿著深灰色连帽夹克和蓝色短裤，看起来像个「大男孩」。咖啡馆外面坐著十个不到 30 岁的人，其中一个看起来像个英俊的犹太人。里面有一桌五、六个 30 岁以上的人，其中一个穿著深绿色夹克和军绿色裤子，是个英俊的假小子。我喝著冰红茶。走出咖啡馆，我看到那个「大男孩」在树林茂密的公园抽烟。我绕了很长一段路回家，穿过散落著鹅粪的校园草坪，北边白雪皑皑的山脉被云雾笼罩，一派泛灵论佛教的景象，仿佛置身于另一个星球。我家附近，奥莉维亚和丹尼尔停放一辆卡车。奥莉维亚正在学习生物化学。卡车后座坐著一只全身黑色的德国牧羊犬。
例句.pinyin: 2022  nián  2  yuè  27  rì zǎo shàng ， wǒ zhèng yào lí kāi lú lú dǎo de jiā ， què pèng jiàn le lín jū —— hóng tóu fā de é luó sī mén nuò pài xuè tǒng de luó xiè ěr ， yǐ jí lái zì méng tè lì ěr yīng yǔ qū 、 liú zhù huī bái xiǎo hú zi de ā ěr ； ā ěr hǎo jǐ dài dōu shì jiā ná dà rén 。 tā shuō tā zhù zài méng tè lóu de shí hòu bù dǒng fǎ yǔ 。 wǒ zài pī sà diàn chī le yī kuài xiāng suàn qǐ sī pī sà 。 xiǎo fàn lái zì mèng mǎi 。 tòu guò chuāng hù ， wǒ kàn dào yí gè zōng jīn sè tóu fà de nián qīng nán zi ， chuān zhù shēn huī sè lián mào jiá kè hé lán sè duǎn kù ， kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè 「 dà nán hái 」。 kā fēi guǎn wài miàn zuò zhù shí gè bú dào  30  suì de rén ， qí zhōng yí gè kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè yīng jùn de yóu tài rén 。 lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhuō wǔ 、 liù gè  30  suì yǐ shàng de rén ， qí zhōng yí gè chuān zhù shēn lǜ sè jiá kè hé jūn lǜ sè kù zi ， shì gè yīng jùn de jiǎ xiǎo zi 。 wǒ hē zhù bīng hóng chá 。 zǒu chū kā fēi guǎn ， wǒ kàn dào nà ge 「 dà nán hái 」 zài shù lín mào mì de gōng yuán chōu yān 。 wǒ rào le hěn zhǎng yī duàn lù huí jiā ， chuān guò sàn luò zhù é fèn de xiào yuán cǎo píng ， běi biān bái xuě ái ái de shān mài bèi yún wù lǒng zhào ， yī pài fàn líng lùn fó jiào de jǐng xiàng ， fǎng fú zhì shēn yú lìng yí gè xīng qiú 。 wǒ jiā fù jìn ， ào lì wéi yà hé dān ní ěr tíng fàng yī liàng kǎ chē 。 ào lì wéi yà zhèng zài xué xí shēng wù huà xué 。 kǎ chē hòu zuò zuò zhù yī zhī quán shēn hēi sè de dé guó mù yáng quǎn 。
例句.en: In the morning of the 27th of February of 2022, on my way out of my Lulu Island house, I saw my neighbours the redhead Rochelle of Russian-Mennonite ancestry and the grey-haired moustached Al from the Anglophone section of Montreal; he was from many generations of Canadians. He said that he did not know French, when he lived in Montreal. I ate a slice of pesto cheese pizza at the pizzeria. The vendor was from Mumbai. Through the window, I could see a young brown-blond-haired man in a dark-grey hooded jacket and blue shorts, which made him look like a "big boy." At the cafe, there was an under-age-30 crowd of ten outside, of whom one looked like a handsome Jew. Inside was a table of five or six over-age-30 people, of whom one was a handsome tomboy in a dark-green jacket and army-green pants. I drank my iced black tea. Heading out of the cafe, I saw the "big boy" smoking in the wooded park. I took the long route home, through the grassy school field littered with goose poop, the northern snowcapped mountains obscured by clouds, an Animistic-Buddhistic view seemingly of a different planet. Near my house, parked in a truck were Olivia and Daniel. Olivia was studying Biochemistry. In the back seat of the truck was a fully black German Shepherd.

例句.zh: 阳光明媚的地方，坐落著一座宜人的老农舍，紧邻一条深深的河流。从农舍一直到河边，长满了高大的牛蒡叶，最高的牛蒡叶下，可以让一个小孩站直身体。这地方如同茂密森林的中心，原始而静谧。一只鸭子栖息在这片幽静的角落，守候著雏鸟破壳而出。牠开始感到有些疲惫，因为小家伙们迟迟不肯破壳而出，而她也很少遇到来访者。
例句.pinyin: yáng guāng míng mèi de dì fāng ， zuò luò zhù yī zuò yí rén de lǎo nóng shè ， jǐn lín yī tiáo shēn shēn de hé liú 。 cóng nóng shè yì zhí dào hé biān ， zhǎng mǎn le gāo dà de niú bàng yè ， zuì gāo de niú bàng yè xià ， kě yǐ ràng yí gè xiǎo hái zhàn zhí shēn tǐ 。 zhè dì fāng rú tóng mào mì sēn lín de zhōng xīn ， yuán shǐ ér jìng mì 。 yī zhī yā zi qī xī zài zhè piàn yōu jìng de jiǎo luò ， shǒu hòu zhù chú niǎo pò ké ér chū 。 tā kāi shǐ gǎn dào yǒu xiē pí bèi ， yīn wèi xiǎo jiā huo men chí chí bù kěn pò ké ér chū ， ér tā yě hěn shǎo yù dào lái fǎng zhě 。
例句.en: In a sunny spot stood a pleasant old farm-house close by a deep river, and from the house down to the water side grew great burdock leaves, so high, that under the tallest of them a little child could stand upright. The spot was as wild as the centre of a thick wood. In this snug retreat sat a duck on her nest, watching for her young brood to hatch; she was beginning to get tired of her task, for the little ones were a long time coming out of their shells, and she seldom had any visitors.

例句.zh: 稀疏、低矮、枝叶稀疏的雪松被数量更多、颜色更深、更绿、更茂密的雪松所取代，这些雪松又被高大、枝繁叶茂、结满绿色浆果的树木所取代。
例句.pinyin: xī shū 、 dī ǎi 、 zhī yè xī shū de xuě sōng bèi shù liàng gèng duō 、 yán sè gēng shēn 、 gèng lǜ 、 gèng mào mì de xuě sōng suǒ qǔ dài ， zhè xiē xuě sōng yòu bèi gāo dà 、 zhī fán yè mào 、 jié mǎn lǜ sè jiāng guǒ de shù mù suǒ qǔ dài 。
例句.en: Scant, low, scraggy cedars gave place to more numerous, darker, greener, bushier ones, and these to high, full-foliaged, green-berried trees.

释义: lush

例句.zh: 它长得很茂盛。
例句.pinyin: tā zhǎng dé hěn mào shèng 。
例句.en: It grew luxuriantly.

例句.zh: 越过松林，远处有一座小花园。那里青草长得又长又茂盛，铁杉花像洁白的星星一样闪耀，夜莺整夜唱歌。牠整夜歌唱，冰冷的月光俯瞰著牠，紫杉树张开巨大的枝干，庇护著沉睡的人们。
例句.pinyin: yuè guò sōng lín ， yuǎn chù yǒu yī zuò xiǎo huā yuán 。 nà lǐ qīng cǎo zhǎng dé yòu zhǎng yòu mào shèng ， tiě shān huā xiàng jié bái de xīng xīng yī yàng shǎn yào ， yè yīng zhěng yè chàng gē 。 tā zhěng yè gē chàng ， bīng lěng de yuè guāng fǔ kàn zhù tā ， zǐ shān shù zhāng kāi jù dà de zhī gàn ， bì hù zhù chén shuì de rén men 。
例句.en: Far away beyond the pine-woods, there is a little garden. There the grass grows long and deep, there are the great white stars of the hemlock flower, there the nightingale sings all night long. All night long he sings, and the cold crystal moon looks down, and the yew-tree spreads out its giant arms over the sleepers.

释义: surname Mei / classifier for small objects: coins, badges, rings, carved seals, chess pieces, eggs, fingerprints etc (more formal than 個|个[ge4]) / classifier for bombs, missiles, satellites etc / (on product packaging) classifier for flat items (from Japanese 枚 "mai") / (old) stick used as a gag to prevent soldiers from talking while sneaking up on the enemy

例句.zh: 他把数枚硬币强行塞进了我的口袋中。
例句.pinyin: tā bǎ shù méi yìng bì qiáng xíng sāi jìn le wǒ de kǒu dài zhōng 。
例句.en: He thrust some coins into my pocket.

例句.zh: 我找到一个装有几枚古钱币的锅子。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zhǎo dào yí gè zhuāng yǒu jǐ méi gǔ qián bì de guō zi 。
例句.en: I found a pot in which there were several old coins.

例句.zh: 克里斯取得了七枚金币！
例句.pinyin: kè lǐ sī qǔ dé le qī méi jīn bì ！
例句.en: Chris gets 7 gold coins!

释义: intermediary / vehicle / vector / medium / media

例句.zh: 甚至在这些国家以外，英语也许比其他任何语言更广泛地被使用来当作国际交流的媒介。
例句.pinyin: shèn zhì zài zhè xiē guó jiā yǐ wài ， yīng yǔ yě xǔ bǐ qí tā rèn hé yǔ yán gèng guǎng fàn dì bèi shǐ yòng lái dàng zuò guó jì jiāo liú de méi jiè 。

例句.zh: 阳光明媚的地方，坐落著一座宜人的老农舍，紧邻一条深深的河流。从农舍一直到河边，长满了高大的牛蒡叶，最高的牛蒡叶下，可以让一个小孩站直身体。这地方如同茂密森林的中心，原始而静谧。一只鸭子栖息在这片幽静的角落，守候著雏鸟破壳而出。牠开始感到有些疲惫，因为小家伙们迟迟不肯破壳而出，而她也很少遇到来访者。
例句.pinyin: yáng guāng míng mèi de dì fāng ， zuò luò zhù yī zuò yí rén de lǎo nóng shè ， jǐn lín yī tiáo shēn shēn de hé liú 。 cóng nóng shè yì zhí dào hé biān ， zhǎng mǎn le gāo dà de niú bàng yè ， zuì gāo de niú bàng yè xià ， kě yǐ ràng yí gè xiǎo hái zhàn zhí shēn tǐ 。 zhè dì fāng rú tóng mào mì sēn lín de zhōng xīn ， yuán shǐ ér jìng mì 。 yī zhī yā zi qī xī zài zhè piàn yōu jìng de jiǎo luò ， shǒu hòu zhù chú niǎo pò ké ér chū 。 tā kāi shǐ gǎn dào yǒu xiē pí bèi ， yīn wèi xiǎo jiā huo men chí chí bù kěn pò ké ér chū ， ér tā yě hěn shǎo yù dào lái fǎng zhě 。
例句.en: In a sunny spot stood a pleasant old farm-house close by a deep river, and from the house down to the water side grew great burdock leaves, so high, that under the tallest of them a little child could stand upright. The spot was as wild as the centre of a thick wood. In this snug retreat sat a duck on her nest, watching for her young brood to hatch; she was beginning to get tired of her task, for the little ones were a long time coming out of their shells, and she seldom had any visitors.

例句.zh: 那是 2025 年 4 月 26 日。下午两点前，阳光明媚，万里无云。我来到我家附近的死胡同，静静地漫步。我欣赏著花园，这让我想起了道家思想：人如何影射天：樱花的簇簇花海，如同远处的星云。人其实不必走太远。我的白人邻居芭芭拉正站在她家车道上。她和丈夫肯恩正要出门去买鸡蛋。他们家很爱吃鸡蛋。
例句.pinyin: nà shì  2025  nián  4  yuè  26  rì 。 xià wǔ liǎng diǎn qián ， yáng guāng míng mèi ， wàn lǐ wú yún 。 wǒ lái dào wǒ jiā fù jìn de sǐ hú tòng ， jìng jìng dì màn bù 。 wǒ xīn shǎng zhù huā yuán ， zhè ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ le dào jiā sī xiǎng ： rén rú hé yǐng shè tiān ： yīng huā de cù cù huā hǎi ， rú tóng yuǎn chù de xīng yún 。 rén qí shí bù bì zǒu tài yuǎn 。 wǒ de bái rén lín jū bā bā lā zhèng zhàn zài tā jiā chē dào shàng 。 tā hé zhàng fū kěn ēn zhèng yào chū mén qù mǎi jī dàn 。 tā men jiā hěn ài chī jī dàn 。
例句.en: It's the 26th of April of 2025. Before 14:00, a sunny blue-sky afternoon, I went to my neighbourhood's cul-de-sac to meditatively walk around and around there. I admired the gardens. They reminded me of Daoism: how the microcosm reflects the macrocosm: The puffs of sakura would be a nebula afar. One need not really travel too far. Barb my white neighbour was at her driveway. She and her husband Ken would be going out to buy eggs. They eat many eggs.

例句.zh: 今天是 2025 年 7 月 3 日，阳光明媚。7 月 7日是日本的七夕。今天早上，在露露岛上，我两次去了提姆霍顿斯咖啡馆，先是点了燕麦奶冰咖啡，然后又点了草莓西瓜气泡饮配香肠卷。我还去了「蛤蜊寺」。路上，我瞥了一眼迷人的竹林。一位老人在竹林旁挖了几个坑，用吃剩的芒果和樱桃堆肥。在咖啡馆里，我和格雷格聊了起来。格雷格是个白人，他梦想著和他的日本妻子在北海道钏路开一家民宿。那里的特色是当地的阿伊努族人和沼泽地。今天，剃著光头的格雷格穿著米色 T 恤和米色短裤，也许带著一丝恰巴卡诺酒的韵味？
例句.pinyin: jīn tiān shì  2025  nián  7  yuè  3  rì ， yáng guāng míng mèi 。7  yuè  7 rì shì rì běn de qī xī 。 jīn tiān zǎo shàng ， zài lù lù dǎo shàng ， wǒ liǎng cì qù le tí mǔ huò dùn sī kā fēi guǎn ， xiān shì diǎn le yàn mài nǎi bīng kā fēi ， rán hòu yòu diǎn le cǎo méi xī guā qì pào yǐn pèi xiāng cháng juǎn 。 wǒ hái qù le 「 gé lí sì 」。 lù shàng ， wǒ piē le yī yǎn mí rén de zhú lín 。 yī wèi lǎo rén zài zhú lín páng wā le jǐ gè kēng ， yòng chī shèng de máng guǒ hé yīng táo duī féi 。 zài kā fēi guǎn lǐ ， wǒ hé gé léi gé liáo le qǐ lái 。 gé léi gé shì gè bái rén ， tā mèng xiǎng zhù hé tā de rì běn qī zǐ zài běi hǎi dào chuàn lù kāi yī jiā mín sù 。 nà lǐ de tè sè shì dāng dì de ā yī nǔ zú rén hé zhǎo zé dì 。 jīn tiān ， tì zhù guāng tóu de gé léi gé chuān zhù mǐ sè  T  xù hé mǐ sè duǎn kù ， yě xǔ dài zhù yī sī qià bā kǎ nuò jiǔ de yùn wèi ？
例句.en: It's a sunny 3rd of July of 2025. On the 7th will be the Star Festival—Tanabata—in Japan. This morning, here on Lulu Island, I strolled to Tim Hortons café twice—Iced Coffee with oat milk, then Strawberry Watermelon Sparkling Quencher with a Sausage Farmer's Wrap. I went to the "Clam Temple." On the way, I glanced at the charming bamboo grove. An old man had dug holes beside it to put compost—eaten mangoes and cherries. At the café, I spoke to Greg, the white man who eventually wants to own a B&B in Kushiro, Hokkaido, with his Japanese wife. The native Ainu and marshes are attractions there. Today, head-shaven Greg is wearing a beige T-shirt and beige shorts—maybe a hint of Chabacano?

释义: reputation

例句.zh: 请不要做任何有损松野家族名声的事！
例句.pinyin: qǐng bú yào zuò rèn hé yǒu sǔn sōng yě jiā zú míng shēng de shì ！
例句.en: Please don't do anything that would besmirch the Matsuno family name!

例句.zh: 他的名声很好。
例句.pinyin: tā de míng shēng hěn hǎo 。
例句.en: He has a good reputation.

例句.zh: 他名声很好。
例句.pinyin: tā míng shēng hěn hǎo 。
例句.en: He has a good reputation.

释义: saying / famous remark

例句.zh: 这句名言让我受益匪浅。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jù míngyán ràng wǒ shòuyì fěiqiǎn.
例句.en: This saying has benefited me greatly.

例句.zh: 老师在黑板上写了一句名言。
例句.pinyin: Lǎoshī zài hēibǎn shàng xiě le yí jù míngyán.
例句.en: The teacher wrote a saying on the blackboard.

例句.zh: 我把这句名言记在了笔记本上。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ zhè jù míngyán jì zài le bǐjìběn shàng.
例句.en: I wrote this saying down in my notebook.

释义: name / titular / nominal / in name / ostensible purpose

例句.zh: 汤姆名义上市公司的领导。他儿子做所有重大决策。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ míng yì shàng shì gōng sī de lǐng dǎo 。 tā ér zi zuò suǒ yǒu zhòng dà jué cè 。
例句.en: Tom is the head of the company in name only. His son makes all the important decisions.

例句.zh: 汤姆名义上是基督徒。他从来不去做礼拜。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ míng yì shàng shì jī dū tú 。 tā cóng lái bù qù zuò lǐ bài 。
例句.en: Tom is a Christian in name only. He never goes to church.

例句.zh: 他在利用集体的名义，为自己谋利。
例句.pinyin: tā zài lì yòng jí tǐ de míng yì ， wèi zì jǐ móu lì 。
例句.en: He is making use of the collective's name for his own profit.

释义: fame / reputation / honor / honorary / emeritus (of retired professor)

例句.zh: 我觉得我的名誉受到了威胁。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ de míng yù shòu dào le wēi xié 。
例句.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.

例句.zh: 尽管有金钱和名誉，他还是不幸福。
例句.pinyin: jǐn guǎn yǒu jīn qián hé míng yù ， tā hái shì bù xìng fú 。
例句.en: Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.

例句.zh: 媒体抹黑了他的名誉。
例句.pinyin: méi tǐ mǒ hēi le tā de míng yù 。
例句.en: The media stuck a shiv into his reputation.

释义: sensible / wise / judicious / sagacious

例句.zh: 他的忠告总是很明智。
例句.pinyin: tā de zhōng gào zǒng shì hěn míng zhì 。
例句.en: His advice is always very sensible.

例句.zh: 你应该更明智一点。
例句.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi gèng míng zhì yì diǎn 。
例句.en: You should be more reasonable.

例句.zh: 她去找他帮忙，实在不是一个明智之举。
例句.pinyin: tā qù zhǎo tā bāng máng ， shí zài bú shì yí gè míng zhì zhī jǔ 。
例句.en: It was foolish of her to ask him for help.

释义: masterpiece

例句.zh: 中国的四大名著是《西游记》《三国演义》《水浒传》和《红楼梦》。
例句.pinyin: zhōng guó de sì dà míng zhù shì 《 xī yóu jì 》《 sān guó yǎn yì 》《 shuǐ hǔ zhuàn 》 hé 《 hóng lóu mèng 》。
例句.en: The Four Great Classical Novels of China are Journey to the West (西遊記, Xī Yóu Jì), Romance of the Three Kingdoms (三國演義, Sānguó Yǎnyì), Water Margin (水滸傳, Shuǐhǔ Zhuàn), and Dream of the Red Chamber (紅樓夢, Hóng Lóu Mèng).

释义: life / fate / order or command / to assign a name, title etc

例句.zh: 睡眠是最大的小偷，它偷了我们一半的生命。
例句.pinyin: shuì mián shì zuì dà de xiǎo tōu ， tā tōu le wǒ men yí bàn de shēng mìng 。
例句.en: Sleep is the greatest thief, for it steals half one's life.

例句.zh: 他的医生命令他休息。
例句.pinyin: tā de yī shēng mìng lìng tā xiū xī 。
例句.en: His doctor ordered him to rest.

例句.zh: 100万人在战争中失去了生命。
例句.pinyin: 100 wàn rén zài zhàn zhēng zhōng shī qù le shēng mìng 。
例句.en: One million people lost their lives in the war.

释义: to feel about / to grope about / to fumble / to do things slowly

例句.zh: 他们不断地摸索。
例句.pinyin: tā men bù duàn dì mō suǒ 。
例句.en: They kept on feeling their way.

例句.zh: 她摸索著一张纸。
例句.pinyin: tā mō suǒ zhù yī zhāng zhǐ 。
例句.en: She fumbled with a piece of paper.

释义: membrane / film

例句.zh: 我五年前做了网膜剥离。
例句.pinyin: wǒ wǔ nián qián zuò le wǎng mó bō lí 。
例句.en: I had retinal detachment five years ago.

例句.zh: 我十四岁的时候，父亲死于蛛网膜下出血。
例句.pinyin: wǒ shí sì suì de shí hòu ， fù qīn sǐ yú zhū wǎng mó xià chū xiě 。
例句.en: I lost my father to a subarachnoid haemorrhage when I was fourteen.

例句.zh: 3D 眼镜的原理是视网膜视差。
例句.pinyin: 3D  yǎn jìng de yuán lǐ shì shì wǎng mó shì chà 。
例句.en: 3-D glasses make use of retinal disparity.

释义: to rub / to grind / to polish / to sharpen / to wear down / to die out / to waste time / to pester / to insist / grindstone / to grind / to turn round

例句.zh: 我在街上散步，消磨时间。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài jiē shàng sàn bù ， xiāo mó shí jiān 。
例句.en: I strolled along the streets to kill time.

例句.zh: 我试着消磨时间。
例句.pinyin: wǒ shì zhe xiāo mó shí jiān 。
例句.en: I was trying to kill time.

例句.zh: 两个老人打牌消磨著时间。
例句.pinyin: liǎng gè lǎo rén dǎ pái xiāo mó zhù shí jiān 。
例句.en: The two old men while away the time playing cards.

释义: friction / rubbing / chafing / fig. disharmony / conflict / also written 磨擦

例句.zh: 这两块木头摩擦时会产生热量。
例句.pinyin: Zhè liǎng kuài mùtou mócā shí huì chǎnshēng rèliàng.
例句.en: These two pieces of wood produce heat when they rub against each other.

例句.zh: 新鞋摩擦着我的脚后跟。
例句.pinyin: Xīn xié mócā zhe wǒ de jiǎohòugēn.
例句.en: The new shoes are rubbing against my heels.

例句.zh: 他们因为小事发生了摩擦。
例句.pinyin: Tāmen yīnwèi xiǎoshì fāshēng le mócā.
例句.en: They had a conflict over a trivial matter.

释义: enchantment / magic

例句.zh: 我要用魔法把他变成一只青蛙！
例句.pinyin: wǒ yào yòng mó fǎ bǎ tā biàn chéng yī zhī qīng wā ！
例句.en: I'll bewitch him into a frog!

例句.zh: 我想成为一个魔法师。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng chéng wéi yí gè mó fǎ shī 。
例句.en: I want to be a magician.

例句.zh: 我不是魔法师。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bú shì mó fǎ shī 。
例句.en: I'm not a magician.

释义: model / fine example

例句.zh: 他是大家学习的模范。
例句.pinyin: Tā shì dàjiā xuéxí de mófàn.
例句.en: He is a role model for everyone.

例句.zh: 这是一所模范学校。
例句.pinyin: Zhè shì yì suǒ mófàn xuéxiào.
例句.en: This is a model school.

例句.zh: 她被评为劳动模范。
例句.pinyin: Tā bèi píngwéi láodòng mófàn.
例句.en: She was named a model worker.

释义: mushroom / to pester / to dawdle

例句.zh: 在切尔诺贝利核电厂事故二十五年后，在乌克兰的某些地区，牛奶，蘑菇和浆果仍然受到了污染。
例句.pinyin: zài qiè ěr nuò bèi lì hé diàn chǎng shì gù èr shí wǔ nián hòu ， zài wū kè lán de mǒu xiē dì qū ， niú nǎi ， mó gū hé jiāng guǒ réng rán shòu dào le wū rǎn 。
例句.en: Twenty-five years after Chernobyl, milk, mushrooms and berries are still contaminated in some parts of Ukraine.

例句.zh: 他吃了毒蘑菇。
例句.pinyin: tā chī le dú mó gū 。
例句.en: He ate poisonous mushrooms.

例句.zh: 我特别喜欢蘑菇的味道。
例句.pinyin: wǒ tè bié xǐ huān mó gū de wèi dào 。
例句.en: I especially like the flavour of the mushroom.

释义: devil

例句.zh: 评论员对巫巫兹拉的声音作出了各种各样的描述：除了「烦人」、「像魔鬼一般」之外，还把它比作「一群嘈吵的大象」、「一群嗡嗡狂叫的蝗虫」、「一只准备给屠宰的山羊」、「一个装满发狂的蜜蜂的巨大蜂巢」、「一只吃了摇头丸的鸭子」等等。
例句.pinyin: píng lùn yuán duì wū wū zī lā de shēng yīn zuò chū le gè zhǒng gè yàng de miáo shù ： chú le 「 fán rén 」、「 xiàng mó guǐ yì bān 」 zhī wài ， hái bǎ tā bǐ zuò 「 yī qún cáo chǎo de dà xiàng 」、「 yī qún wēng wēng kuáng jiào de huáng chóng 」、「 yī zhī zhǔn bèi gěi tú zǎi de shān yáng 」、「 yí gè zhuāng mǎn fā kuáng de mì fēng de jù dà fēng cháo 」、「 yī zhī chī le yáo tóu wán de yā zi 」 děng děng 。
例句.en: Commentators have variously described the sound of vuvuzelas as "annoying" and "satanic" and compared it with "a stampede of noisy elephants", "a deafening swarm of locusts", "a goat on the way to slaughter", "a giant hive full of very angry bees", and "a duck on speed".

例句.zh: 忧愁就像魔鬼：谁不怕它，它就不能伤害谁。
例句.pinyin: yōu chóu jiù xiàng mó guǐ ： shuí bù pà tā ， tā jiù bù néng shāng hài shuí 。
例句.en: Worries are like ghosts - those who aren't afraid of them can't suffer at their hands.

例句.zh: 忧愁就像魔鬼一样，它伤害不了不害怕它的人。
例句.pinyin: yōu chóu jiù xiàng mó guǐ yī yàng ， tā shāng hài bù liǎo bù hài pà tā de rén 。
例句.en: Worries are like ghosts - those who aren't afraid of them can't suffer at their hands.

释义: to break in / to wear in

例句.zh: 新车需要一段时间来磨合。
例句.pinyin: Xīn chē xūyào yí duàn shíjiān lái móhé.
例句.en: A new car needs some time to be broken in.

例句.zh: 这台机器还在磨合。
例句.pinyin: Zhè tái jīqì hái zài móhé.
例句.en: This machine is still being broken in.

例句.zh: 我的脚还在和这双新鞋磨合。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ de jiǎo hái zài hé zhè shuāng xīn xié móhé.
例句.en: I'm still breaking in these new shoes.

释义: magic / magic power

例句.zh: 我父母说，YouTube 和串流平台让电影的魔力大打折扣。
例句.pinyin: wǒ fù mǔ shuō ，YouTube  hé chuàn liú píng tái ràng diàn yǐng de mó lì dà dǎ zhé kòu 。
例句.en: My parents say that YouTube and streaming services cheapen the magic of film.

释义: variant of 磨練|磨练[mo2 lian4]
短释义: variant of 磨練|磨练[mo2 lian4]

例句.zh: 艰苦的训练磨炼了他的意志。
例句.pinyin: Jiānkǔ de xùnliàn móliàn le tā de yìzhì.
例句.en: The rigorous training strengthened his willpower.

例句.zh: 年轻人需要在实践中磨炼自己。
例句.pinyin: Niánqīngrén xūyào zài shíjiàn zhōng móliàn zìjǐ.
例句.en: Young people need to develop themselves through practice.

例句.zh: 这段经历磨炼了她的耐心。
例句.pinyin: Zhè duàn jīnglì móliàn le tā de nàixīn.
例句.en: This experience cultivated her patience.

释义: a torment / a trial / tribulation / a cross (to bear) / well-tried

例句.zh: 经历了许多磨难，他依然乐观。
例句.pinyin: Jīnglì le xǔduō mónàn, tā yīrán lèguān.
例句.en: Despite enduring many hardships, he remains optimistic.

例句.zh: 这场磨难让她变得更加坚强。

例句.zh: 现在是 2025 年 8 月 3 日，露露岛。晚餐后，阳光下嫩绿的无花果，昨天腌制的甜醋，还有重新加热的阿尔弗雷多义面，我坐在阳台上，望著那棵针叶树。楼下静谧无声，街道空无一车，一片悠闲。我的冰镇青柠水在阳光下闪闪发光。最近，我常和那位法丹混血的 UFO 研究专家麦可聊天。我们谈论内心深处的事情：智慧型装置的迷醉，以及思维的衰退。他说，咖啡馆已经不再是咖啡馆了。人们忘记如何观察、如何驻足停留。我跟他讲起在日本的亚瑟，他会像僧侣凝视虚空一样，对著空白的墙壁发呆。最近，我让机器像诗人一样说话，它们真的做到了。它们模仿伊莉莎白时代的诗歌，以及塔加洛语民谣中那古老而忧伤的韵律。我沿著通往蒂姆霍顿咖啡店的小路采摘黑莓。我像个孩子似的喊道：「莫拉！」我的朋友莫拉，她血液里流著安地斯山脉的薄雾，她会笑的。今天，我买了黄柠檬。我本来想买青柠，但黄柠檬也可以。/ 黑莓的清晨 / 指尖残留无花果的痕迹 / 街道依然沉睡
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì  2025  nián  8  yuè  3  rì ， lù lù dǎo 。 wǎn cān hòu ， yáng guāng xià nèn lǜ de wú huā guǒ ， zuó tiān yān zhì de tián cù ， hái yǒu chóng xīn jiā rè de ā ěr fú léi duō yì miàn ， wǒ zuò zài yáng tái shàng ， wàng zhù nà kē zhēn yè shù 。 lóu xià jìng mì wú shēng ， jiē dào kōng wú yī chē ， yī piàn yōu xián 。 wǒ de bīng zhèn qīng níng shuǐ zài yáng guāng xià shǎn shǎn fā guāng 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ cháng hé nà wèi fǎ dān hùn xuè de  UFO  yán jiū zhuān jiā mài kě liáo tiān 。 wǒ men tán lùn nèi xīn shēn chù de shì qíng ： zhì huì xíng zhuāng zhì de mí zuì ， yǐ jí sī wéi de shuāi tuì 。 tā shuō ， kā fēi guǎn yǐ jīng bù zài shì kā fēi guǎn le 。 rén men wàng jì rú hé guān chá 、 rú hé zhù zú tíng liú 。 wǒ gēn tā jiǎng qǐ zài rì běn de yà sè ， tā huì xiàng sēng lǚ níng shì xū kōng yī yàng ， duì zhù kòng bái de qiáng bì fā dāi 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ ràng jī qì xiàng shī rén yī yàng shuō huà ， tā men zhēn de zuò dào le 。 tā men mó fǎng yī lì shā bái shí dài de shī gē ， yǐ jí tǎ jiā luò yǔ mín yáo zhōng nà gǔ lǎo ér yōu shāng de yùn lǜ 。 wǒ yán zhù tōng wǎng dì mǔ huò dùn kā fēi diàn de xiǎo lù cǎi zhāi hēi méi 。 wǒ xiàng gè hái zi shì de hǎn dào ：「 mò lā ！」 wǒ de péng yǒu mò lā ， tā xuè yè lǐ liú zhù ān dì sī shān mài de bó wù ， tā huì xiào de 。 jīn tiān ， wǒ mǎi le huáng níng méng 。 wǒ běn lái xiǎng mǎi qīng níng ， dàn huáng níng méng yě kě yǐ 。/  hēi méi de qīng chén  /  zhǐ jiān cán liú wú huā guǒ de hén jì  /  jiē dào yī rán chén shuì
例句.en: It's Lulu Island, 3 August 2025. After supper—green figs tender with sunlight, sweet vinegar from yesterday’s pickled jar, and reheated Alfredo—I sat on the balcony and watched the conifer. Stillness below, a street without cars, without haste. My lime water, iced, caught the light. Michael, the Franco-Danish ufologist, has been in my conversations lately. We speak of inner things: the trance of smart devices, the mind’s eye dwindling. He says cafés aren’t cafés anymore. People forget how to look, how to linger. I tell him of Arthur in Japan—how he'd stare into blank walls like a monk gazing at emptiness. Lately I ask machines to speak like poets, and they do. They mimic Elizabethan verses and the old wistful lilt of Tagalog ballads. I pick blackberries along the path to Tim Hortons. "¡Moras!" I shout like a child. My friend Mora, whose blood flows with Andes mist, would smile. Today, I bought lemons. I meant limes, but lemons are all right. / blackberry morning— / a fig's ghost on my fingers / and the street still sleeps

例句.zh: 伊朗的一座偏远沙漠城市、德国的冰河时期洞穴、巴西为非洲奴隶船入港所建造的石头码头，这三个新景点被联合国教科文组织列入世界遗产名录。

例句.en: A remote Iranian desert city, Ice Age-era caves in Germany and a stone wharf in Brazil built for arriving African slave ships are three new additions to UNESCO's list of World Heritage sites.

例句.zh: 我以前住在一个偏远的小镇。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yǐ qián zhù zài yí gè piān yuǎn de xiǎo zhèn 。

例句.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ jìde tánhuà zhōng de jǐ ge piànduàn.

例句.zh: 这部电影的开头片段很精彩。
例句.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de kāitóu piànduàn hěn jīngcǎi.

例句.zh: 老师播放了一段演讲片段。
例句.pinyin: Lǎoshī bōfàng le yí duàn yǎnjiǎng piànduàn.
例句.en: The teacher played an excerpt from a speech.

释义: (of a boat) to float; to drift; to lie at anchor / (fig.) to roam; to lead a wandering existence
短释义: (of a boat) to float; to drift; to lie at anchor

例句.zh: 小船在海上漂泊了三天。
例句.pinyin: Xiǎochuán zài hǎishàng piāobó le sān tiān.
例句.en: The boat drifted at sea for three days.

例句.zh: 那艘渔船仍在风浪中漂泊。
例句.pinyin: Nà sōu yúchuán réng zài fēnglàng zhōng piāobó.
例句.en: The fishing boat is still drifting in the wind and waves.

例句.zh: 一只木船独自在湖上漂泊。
例句.pinyin: Yì zhī mùchuán dúzì zài hú shàng piāobó.
例句.en: A wooden boat is drifting alone on the lake.

例句.pinyin: tā shì shì shàng dì yí gè zài tài kōng zhōng piāo fú de rén 。

释义: to float / to hover / to drift (also fig., to lead a wandering life) / to rove / showy / superficial

例句.zh: 池塘里漂浮着零星的几片落叶。
例句.pinyin: chí táng lǐ piāo fú zhe líng xīng de jǐ piàn luò yè 。
例句.en: A few fragments of dead leaves floated on the pond.

例句.zh: 木头会漂浮。
例句.pinyin: mù tou huì piāo fú 。
例句.en: Wood floats.

例句.pinyin: tā jué de hún shēn bù zì zài ， jǐn guǎn zhè ge qí guài hái zi de shēn tǐ kě néng zuò zài zhuō zi páng ， dàn tā de jīng shén què zài fēng chén yún wù zhōng yáo bù kě jí ， gāo gāo dì yú xiǎng xiàng lì de chì bǎng shàng piāo fú 。
例句.en: She had an uncomfortable feeling that while this odd child's body might be there at the table her spirit was far away in some remote airy cloudland, borne aloft on the wings of imagination.

释义: to float on the current / to drift along or about / rafting

例句.zh: 一片树叶顺着溪水漂流。
例句.pinyin: Yí piàn shùyè shùnzhe xīshuǐ piāoliú.
例句.en: A leaf floats along with the stream.

例句.zh: 木筏在江上缓缓漂流。
例句.pinyin: Mùfá zài jiāng shàng huǎnhuǎn piāoliú.
例句.en: The raft drifts slowly along the river.

例句.zh: 彩旗在风中飘扬。
例句.pinyin: Cǎiqí zài fēng zhōng piāoyáng.
例句.en: Colorful flags are waving in the wind.

例句.zh: 她的长发随风飘扬。
例句.pinyin: Tā de chángfà suí fēng piāoyáng.

例句.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de piàofáng hěn gāo.
例句.en: This movie did very well at the box office.

短释义: to do one's utmost; with all one's might; at all costs; (to work or fight) as if one's life depends on it

例句.zh: 我拼命地跑。
例句.pinyin: wǒ pīn mìng dì pǎo 。

例句.pinyin: Xuéxiào zhòngshì xuéshēng de pǐndé jiàoyù.

例句.pinyin: Yí ge rén de pǐndé bǐ cáifù gèng zhòngyào.
例句.en: A person's moral character is more important than wealth.

例句.pinyin: 「 nín de pǐn wèi zhēn gāo ！」 diàn yuán tàn dào 。「 bù guò wǒ men hái yǒu yī xiē jià qián bǐ jiào xiāng yí de kuǎn shì ， nín zhēn de bú yào xiān kàn yī xià ma ？」

例句.pinyin: tā shì yī wèi pǐn xíng duān zhèng de nǚ shì 。
例句.en: She is a very correct lady.

例句.zh: 汤姆想在发出录取通知前先确认申请人的品行证明。

例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ zhèng kǎo lǜ yìng pìn xīn chóu gèng gāo de gōng zuò 。

例句.pinyin: suī rán tā zhī dào nà jiā gōng sī bù dàn duì dāng dì guān yuán xíng huì ér qiě yě gěi tā de jiā rén dài liǎo liǎo jí dà de má fán ， kě tā hái shì yìng pìn le nà jiā gōng sī de yī fèn gōng zuò 。

释义: to appoint (to a position) / appointed

例句.pinyin: Xuéxiào pìnrèn tā wéi kèzuò jiàoshòu.
例句.en: The university appointed him as a visiting professor.

例句.zh: 公司决定聘任她为财务总监。
例句.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng pìnrèn tā wéi cáiwù zǒngjiān.
例句.en: The company decided to appoint her as finance director.

例句.zh: 他被聘任为新校长。
例句.pinyin: Tā bèi pìnrèn wéi xīn xiàozhǎng.
例句.en: He was appointed as the new principal.

释义: to employ / to hire

例句.zh: 我知道汤姆会成为一位优秀的篮球教练。这就是为什么我聘用了他。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào tāng mǔ huì chéng wéi yī wèi yōu xiù de lán qiú jiào liàn 。 zhè jiù shì wèi shén me wǒ pìn yòng le tā 。
例句.en: I knew Tom would be a good basketball coach. That's why I hired him.

释义: to screen / to block (sth or sb) / to shield / (protective) shield

例句.en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.

例句.pinyin: wǒ jué de wǒ de gōng zuò tài píng dàn wú qí le 。

Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.

例句.zh: 今天是 2025 年 7 月 3 日，阳光明媚。7 月 7日是日本的七夕。今天早上，在露露岛上，我两次去了提姆霍顿斯咖啡馆，先是点了燕麦奶冰咖啡，然后又点了草莓西瓜气泡饮配香肠卷。我还去了「蛤蜊寺」。路上，我瞥了一眼迷人的竹林。一位老人在竹林旁挖了几个坑，用吃剩的芒果和樱桃堆肥。在咖啡馆里，我和格雷格聊了起来。格雷格是个白人，他梦想著和他的日本妻子在北海道钏路开一家民宿。那里的特色是当地的阿伊努族人和沼泽地。今天，剃著光头的格雷格穿著米色 T 恤和米色短裤，也许带著一丝恰巴卡诺酒的韵味？
例句.pinyin: jīn tiān shì  2025  nián  7  yuè  3  rì ， yáng guāng míng mèi 。7  yuè  7 rì shì rì běn de qī xī 。 jīn tiān zǎo shàng ， zài lù lù dǎo shàng ， wǒ liǎng cì qù le tí mǔ huò dùn sī kā fēi guǎn ， xiān shì diǎn le yàn mài nǎi bīng kā fēi ， rán hòu yòu diǎn le cǎo méi xī guā qì pào yǐn pèi xiāng cháng juǎn 。 wǒ hái qù le 「 gé lí sì 」。 lù shàng ， wǒ piē le yī yǎn mí rén de zhú lín 。 yī wèi lǎo rén zài zhú lín páng wā le jǐ gè kēng ， yòng chī shèng de máng guǒ hé yīng táo duī féi 。 zài kā fēi guǎn lǐ ， wǒ hé gé léi gé liáo le qǐ lái 。 gé léi gé shì gè bái rén ， tā mèng xiǎng zhù hé tā de rì běn qī zǐ zài běi hǎi dào chuàn lù kāi yī jiā mín sù 。 nà lǐ de tè sè shì dāng dì de ā yī nǔ zú rén hé zhǎo zé dì 。 jīn tiān ， tì zhù guāng tóu de gé léi gé chuān zhù mǐ sè  T  xù hé mǐ sè duǎn kù ， yě xǔ dài zhù yī sī qià bā kǎ nuò jiǔ de yùn wèi ？
例句.en: It's a sunny 3rd of July of 2025. On the 7th will be the Star Festival—Tanabata—in Japan. This morning, here on Lulu Island, I strolled to Tim Hortons café twice—Iced Coffee with oat milk, then Strawberry Watermelon Sparkling Quencher with a Sausage Farmer's Wrap. I went to the "Clam Temple." On the way, I glanced at the charming bamboo grove. An old man had dug holes beside it to put compost—eaten mangoes and cherries. At the café, I spoke to Greg, the white man who eventually wants to own a B&B in Kushiro, Hokkaido, with his Japanese wife. The native Ainu and marshes are attractions there. Today, head-shaven Greg is wearing a beige T-shirt and beige shorts—maybe a hint of Chabacano?

例句.pinyin: 「 wǒ rèn wéi tí mǔ huò dùn sī kā fēi guǎn hé xīng bā kè kā fēi guǎn de cài dān shàng yīng gāi yǒu lán méi bīng chá 。」「 zhè zhǔ yì tài bàng le ！ lán méi bīng chá zhèng hǎo gǎn shàng le shuǐ guǒ chá de cháo liú 。 shuǐ guǒ chá tián wèi zhōng lüè dài suān wèi 。 tí mǔ huò dùn sī kě yǐ lì yòng yǐ yǒu de hún hòu bīng chá jī chǔ ， ér xīng bā kè kě yǐ hěn róng yì dì jiāng lán méi bīng chá róng rù tā men de yáo yún bīng chá hé qīng liáng yǐn liào xì liè zhōng 。」
例句.en: "I think that Tim Hortons café and Starbucks café should have blueberry iced tea on their menu." "That's a refreshing idea! A blueberry iced tea would fit perfectly with the trend of fruit-infused teas that balance sweetness with a bit of tartness. Tim Hortons already has a strong iced tea base they could use, while Starbucks could easily fold it into their lineup of shaken iced teas and refreshers."

例句.zh: 我想说的是，柴门霍夫不仅构建了一个语言学对象，而且在这之后还有一个理念——一个兄弟情谊的理念，一个和平主义的理念。这种理想的力量——世界语者甚至因此而受到纳粹主义和斯大林主义的迫害——至今仍为世界语者社区所保留。没有人能说这是失败的，但有一件事需要说明：任何语言之所以成功的原因总是难以定义的。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng shuō de shì ， chái mén huò fū bù jǐn gòu jiàn le yí gè yǔ yán xué duì xiàng ， ér qiě zài zhè zhī hòu hái yǒu yí gè lǐ niàn —— yí gè xiōng dì qíng yì de lǐ niàn ， yí gè hé píng zhǔ yì de lǐ niàn 。 zhè zhǒng lǐ xiǎng de lì liàng —— shì jiè yǔ zhě shèn zhì yīn cǐ ér shòu dào nà cuì zhǔ yì hé sī dà lín zhǔ yì de pò hài —— zhì jīn réng wèi shì jiè yǔ zhě shè qū suǒ bǎo liú 。 méi yǒu rén néng shuō zhè shì shī bài de ， dàn yǒu yī jiàn shì xū yào shuō míng ： rèn hé yǔ yán zhī suǒ yǐ chéng gōng de yuán yīn zǒng shì nán yǐ dìng yì de 。
例句.en: What I’m getting at is that Zamenhof not only built a linguistic object, but that behind that was an idea — an idea of brotherhood, a pacifist idea. That strength of an ideal — for which Esperantists were even persecuted under Nazism and Stalinism — is still conserved by the community of Esperantists. One cannot say that it has failed, but one thing needs to be said: the reason why any language is successful is always indefinable.

例句.zh: 国王下令把囚犯释放。
例句.pinyin: guó wáng xià lìng bǎ qiú fàn shì fàng 。
例句.en: The king ordered that the prisoner should be set free.

例句.zh: 这个囚犯被带到法官面前。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge qiú fàn bèi dài dào fǎ guān miàn qián 。
例句.en: The prisoner was brought before a judge.

例句.zh: 十名囚犯逃狱了。
例句.pinyin: shí míng qiú fàn táo yù le 。
例句.en: Ten prisoners broke out of jail.

释义: (idiom) to put aside differences and work together; to seek common ground and cooperate
短释义: (idiom) to put aside differences and work together; to seek common ground and cooperate

例句.zh: 双方应求同存异，通过对话解决分歧。
例句.pinyin: Shuāngfāng yīng qiú tóng cún yì, tōngguò duìhuà jiějué fēnqí.
例句.en: Both sides should seek common ground while setting aside differences and resolve disagreements through dialogue.

例句.zh: 我们虽然观点不同，但可以求同存异。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen suīrán guāndiǎn bùtóng, dàn kěyǐ qiú tóng cún yì.
例句.en: Although we have different views, we can seek common ground while respecting our differences.

例句.zh: 团队合作需要互相尊重、求同存异。
例句.pinyin: Tuánduì hézuò xūyào hùxiāng zūnzhòng, qiú tóng cún yì.
例句.en: Teamwork requires mutual respect and a willingness to put aside differences and work together.

释义: to pursue one's studies; to attend school / to seek knowledge
短释义: to pursue one's studies; to attend school

例句.zh: 汤姆不想在波士顿求学。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ bù xiǎng zài bō shì dùn qiú xué 。
例句.en: Tom doesn't want to study in Boston.

释义: to seek medical treatment; to see a doctor
短释义: to seek medical treatment; to see a doctor

例句.zh: 他病了很久，却一直不肯求医。
例句.pinyin: Tā bìng le hěn jiǔ, què yìzhí bù kěn qiúyī.
例句.en: He has been ill for a long time, but he refuses to seek medical treatment.

例句.zh: 病情恶化后，她才去外地求医。
例句.pinyin: Bìngqíng èhuà hòu, tā cái qù wàidì qiúyī.
例句.en: She sought medical treatment out of town only after her condition worsened.

例句.zh: 如果持续发烧，应及时求医。
例句.pinyin: Rúguǒ chíxù fāshāo, yīng jíshí qiúyī.
例句.en: If the fever persists, you should seek medical attention promptly.

释义: to seek proof / to seek confirmation

例句.zh: 这个消息还需要进一步求证。
例句.pinyin: Zhè ge xiāoxi hái xūyào jìnyí bù qiúzhèng.
例句.en: This information still needs further verification.

例句.zh: 他向专家求证了这个说法。
例句.pinyin: Tā xiàng zhuānjiā qiúzhèng le zhè ge shuōfǎ.
例句.en: He checked this claim with an expert.

例句.zh: 遇到可疑信息时，应先求证再转发。
例句.pinyin: Yùdào kěyí xìnxī shí, yīng xiān qiúzhèng zài zhuǎnfā.
例句.en: When you encounter suspicious information, verify it before sharing it.

释义: to drive / to propel / drive (vehicle wheel) / drive mechanism (tape or disk) / device driver (computing software)

例句.zh: 不是所有的临床研究都是假设驱动的。
例句.pinyin: bú shì suǒ yǒu de lín chuáng yán jiū dōu shì jiǎ shè qū dòng de 。
例句.en: Not all clinical studies are hypothesis-driven.

例句.zh: 这辆车靠天然气驱动。
例句.pinyin: zhè liàng chē kào tiān rán qì qū dòng 。
例句.en: This car runs on natural gas.

释义: to surrender / to succumb / to yield / (as a transitive verb) to defeat / to prevail over

例句.zh: 他向权力屈服。
例句.pinyin: tā xiàng quán lì qū fú 。
例句.en: He succumbed to authority.

例句.zh: 那些追求和平和安全的人们，我们支持你们。那些所有怀疑美国的灯塔能否能像以前一样明亮的人们，今天晚上我们再次证明，我们国家真正的力量并非来自我们武器的威力或财富的规模，而是来自我们理想的持久力量：民主、 自由、机会、不屈服的希望。
例句.pinyin: nà xiē zhuī qiú hé píng hé ān quán de rén men ， wǒ men zhī chí nǐ men 。 nà xiē suǒ yǒu huái yí měi guó de dēng tǎ néng fǒu néng xiàng yǐ qián yī yàng míng liàng de rén men ， jīn tiān wǎn shàng wǒ men zài cì zhèng míng ， wǒ men guó jiā zhēn zhèng de lì liàng bìng fēi lái zì wǒ men wǔ qì de wēi lì huò cái fù de guī mó ， ér shì lái zì wǒ men lǐ xiǎng de chí jiǔ lì liàng ： mín zhǔ 、  zì yóu 、 jī huì 、 bù qū fú de xī wàng 。
例句.en: To those who seek peace and security. We support you. And to all those who have wondered if America's beacon still burns as bright, tonight we proved once more that the true strength of our nation comes not from the might of our arms or the scale of our wealth, but from the enduring power of our ideals: democracy, liberty, opportunity and unyielding hope.

例句.zh: 我们决不会屈服于恐怖份子的要求之下。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men jué bù huì qū fú yú kǒng bù fèn zi de yāo qiú zhī xià 。
例句.en: We will never give in to terrorist demands.

释义: delimited area / defined section of a train or bus route / numerical range / (math.) interval

例句.zh: 这段区间正在施工。
例句.pinyin: Zhè duàn qūjiān zhèngzài shīgōng.
例句.en: This section is under construction.

例句.zh: 列车已经进入隧道区间。
例句.pinyin: Lièchē yǐjīng jìnrù suìdào qūjiān.
例句.en: The train has entered the tunnel section.

例句.zh: 请勿在施工区间内停车。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng wù zài shīgōng qūjiān nèi tíngchē.
例句.en: Do not park within the construction zone.

释义: insignificant / trifling / merely

例句.zh: 区区小事，不必放在心上。
例句.pinyin: Qūqū xiǎoshì, bù bì fàng zài xīn shàng.
例句.en: It's a trivial matter; don't take it to heart.

例句.zh: 他不愿为区区几百元争吵。
例句.pinyin: Tā bù yuàn wèi qūqū jǐ bǎi yuán zhēngchǎo.
例句.en: He doesn't want to argue over a mere few hundred yuan.

例句.zh: 区区小利，不值得你这样冒险。
例句.pinyin: Qūqū xiǎolì, bù zhíde nǐ zhèyàng màoxiǎn.
例句.en: Such a trifling gain isn't worth taking this kind of risk for.

释义: curve / curved line / indirect / in a roundabout way

例句.zh: 在图形上，正态分布是一种钟形曲线，越接近中心，取值越大，越远离中心，取值越小。
例句.pinyin: zài tú xíng shàng ， zhèng tài fēn bù shì yī zhǒng zhōng xíng qū xiàn ， yuè jiē jìn zhōng xīn ， qǔ zhí yuè dà ， yuè yuǎn lí zhōng xīn ， qǔ zhí yuè xiǎo 。
例句.en: In its graphical representation, the normal distribution is a bell-shaped curve, with the value growing as one moves closer to the middle and decreasing as one moves away.

释义: to tend towards

例句.zh: 高德温法则告诉我们对任何主题的所有无休止的讨论会趋于和纳粹主义的类比。
例句.pinyin: gāo dé wēn fǎ zé gào sù wǒ men duì rèn hé zhǔ tí de suǒ yǒu wú xiū zhǐ de tǎo lùn huì qū yú hé nà cuì zhǔ yì de lèi bǐ 。
例句.en: Godwin's law teaches us that any infinite discussion about an arbitrary subject converges to a Nazi comparison.

释义: winding / (fig.) complicated

例句.zh: 这条山路很曲折。
例句.pinyin: Zhè tiáo shānlù hěn qūzhé.
例句.en: This mountain road is very winding.

例句.zh: 小河沿着曲折的山谷流淌。
例句.pinyin: Xiǎohé yánzhe qūzhé de shāngǔ liútǎng.
例句.en: The stream flows through the winding valley.

例句.zh: 我们穿过一条曲折的小巷。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen chuānguò yì tiáo qūzhé de xiǎoxiàng.
例句.en: We walked through a winding alley.

释义: to expel / to deport / banishment

例句.zh: 许多犹太人被德国人驱逐。
例句.pinyin: xǔ duō yóu tài rén bèi dé guó rén qū zhú 。
例句.en: Many Jews were expelled by the Germans.

例句.zh: 一只赛勒诺栖于岩石之上，你看，/ 那阴郁的女先知就这样嘎声道出她的末日预言。/「还有战争，拉俄墨冬两度背信的后裔！/ 你们带来的是战争，还偷杀了我们的牛群？/ 而你们还要将无辜的哈尔庇厄驱逐，/ 赶出她们古老、世代相传的领地？」
例句.pinyin: yī zhī sài lēi nuò qī yú yán shí zhī shàng ， nǐ kàn ，/  nà yīn yù de nǚ xiān zhī jiù zhè yàng gā shēng dào chū tā de mò rì yù yán 。/「 hái yǒu zhàn zhēng ， lā é mò dōng liǎng dù bèi xìn de hòu yì ！/  nǐ men dài lái de shì zhàn zhēng ， hái tōu shā le wǒ men de niú qún ？/  ér nǐ men hái yào jiāng wú gū de hā ěr bì è qū zhú ，/  gǎn chū tā men gǔ lǎo 、 shì dài xiāng chuán de lǐng dì ？」
例句.en: One perched, Celaeno, on a rock, and lo, / thus croaked the dismal seer her prophecy of woe. / "War, too, Laomedon's twice-perjured race! / War do ye bring, our cattle stol'n and slain? / And unoffending Harpies would ye chase / forth from their old, hereditary reign?"

释义: (idiom) to replace; to supersede; to take its (or her etc) place
短释义: (idiom) to replace; to supersede; to take its (or her etc) place

例句.zh: 随著文艺复兴，学院派的想法被积极的想法取而代之了。
例句.pinyin: suí zhù wén yì fù xīng ， xué yuàn pài de xiǎng fǎ bèi jī jí de xiǎng fǎ qǔ ér dài zhī le 。
例句.en: With Renaissance, scholastic ideas gave place to positive ideas.

例句.zh: 共产主义失败了，而无产阶级专政现在也已经被淘汰了。虽然资本主义逐渐取而代之，但现在的资本主义对于人类还是一个威胁。
例句.pinyin: gòng chǎn zhǔ yì shī bài le ， ér wú chǎn jiē jí zhuān zhèng xiàn zài yě yǐ jīng bèi táo tài le 。 suī rán zī běn zhǔ yì zhú jiàn qǔ ér dài zhī ， dàn xiàn zài de zī běn zhǔ yì duì yú rén lèi hái shì yí gè wēi xié 。
例句.en: Since communism became obsolete and the dictatorship of the proletariat is out of date, capitalism proves to be the best so far, even though it itself is still a threat for humanity.

释义: to collect material

例句.zh: 记者正在为新节目取材。
例句.pinyin: Jìzhě zhèngzài wèi xīn jiémù qǔcái.
例句.en: The reporter is gathering material for a new program.

例句.zh: 他去农村取材，准备写一篇报道。
例句.pinyin: Tā qù nóngcūn qǔcái, zhǔnbèi xiě yì piān bàodào.
例句.en: He went to the countryside to gather material for an article.

例句.zh: 这部小说取材于真实故事。
例句.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō qǔcái yú zhēnshí gùshì.
例句.en: This novel is based on a true story.

释义: to suppress; to crack down on; to prohibit
短释义: to suppress; to crack down on; to prohibit

例句.zh: 政府依法取缔了这家非法机构。
例句.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ yīfǎ qǔdì le zhè jiā fēifǎ jīgòu.
例句.en: The government shut down this illegal organization in accordance with the law.

例句.zh: 警方取缔了多个地下赌场。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng qǔdì le duō gè dìxià dǔchǎng.
例句.en: The police shut down several underground casinos.

例句.zh: 无证经营的摊位将被取缔。
例句.pinyin: Wúzhèng jīngyíng de tānwèi jiāng bèi qǔdì.
例句.en: Unlicensed stalls will be shut down.

释义: to journey to India on a quest for the Buddhist scriptures / to learn by studying another's experience
短释义: to journey to India on a quest for the Buddhist scriptures

例句.zh: 玄奘不远万里前往印度取经。
例句.pinyin: Xuánzàng bù yuǎn wàn lǐ qiánwǎng Yìndù qǔjīng.
例句.en: Xuanzang traveled thousands of miles to India to obtain Buddhist scriptures.

例句.zh: 唐僧师徒历尽艰险，终于取经归来。
例句.pinyin: Táng Sēng shītú lìjìn jiānxiǎn, zhōngyú qǔjīng guīlái.
例句.en: The monk Tang and his disciples endured many hardships and finally returned with the Buddhist scriptures.

例句.zh: 这部小说讲述了唐僧西天取经的故事。
例句.pinyin: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō jiǎngshù le Táng Sēng Xītiān qǔjīng de gùshi.
例句.en: This novel tells the story of the monk Tang's journey to India in search of Buddhist scriptures.

释义: (usually followed by 於|于[yu2]) to hinge on / to be decided by / to depend on
短释义: (usually followed by 於|于[yu2]) to hinge on

例句.zh: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。
例句.pinyin: nǐ chéng gōng yǔ fǒu qǔ jué yú nǐ zì shēn de nǔ lì 。
例句.en: Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.

例句.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。
例句.pinyin: qián bì de jià zhí qǔ jué yú suǒ shǐ yòng de jīn shǔ de zhòng liàng 。
例句.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.

例句.zh: 取决于你
例句.pinyin: qǔ jué yú nǐ
例句.en: It's up to you.

释义: to warm oneself (by a fire, heater etc)
短释义: to warm oneself (by a fire, heater etc)

例句.zh: 这个取暖装置用柴油作为燃料。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge qǔ nuǎn zhuāng zhì yòng chái yóu zuò wéi rán liào 。
例句.en: This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.

例句.zh: 在村庄里，我们还是用木头给房子取暖。
例句.pinyin: zài cūn zhuāng lǐ ， wǒ men hái shì yòng mù tou gěi fáng zi qǔ nuǎn 。
例句.en: In the village we still heat our homes with wood.

释义: to score a victory / to prevail over one's opponents

例句.zh: 单凭力量不能保证取胜。
例句.pinyin: dān píng lì liàng bù néng bǎo zhèng qǔ shèng 。
例句.en: Relying on strength alone cannot guarantee victory.

例句.zh: 他现在这个年纪，就已经在国际比赛中取胜，前途实在无可限量。
例句.pinyin: tā xiàn zài zhè ge nián jì ， jiù yǐ jīng zài guó jì bǐ sài zhōng qǔ shèng ， qián tú shí zài wú kě xiàn liàng 。
例句.en: His victory at this age in an international competition is a good indication of a bright future.

例句.zh: 靠武力取胜，犹如落败，因为这样的胜利不会长久。
例句.pinyin: kào wǔ lì qǔ shèng ， yóu rú luò bài ， yīn wèi zhè yàng de shèng lì bú huì cháng jiǔ 。
例句.en: Victory attained by violence is tantamount to a defeat, for it is momentary.

释义: to tease; to make fun of
短释义: to tease; to make fun of

例句.zh: 我不想被取笑。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng bèi qǔ xiào 。
例句.en: I don't want to be laughed at.

例句.zh: 你现在这个年纪，穿成这个样子，会给人取笑的。
例句.pinyin: nǐ xiàn zài zhè ge nián jì ， chuān chéng zhè ge yàng zi ， huì gěi rén qǔ xiào de 。
例句.en: If you dress like that at your age, you'll make a fool of yourself.

例句.zh: 这个男孩取笑了这个女孩。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge nán hái qǔ xiào le zhè ge nǚ hái 。
例句.en: The boy made fun of the girl.

释义: folk musical theater

例句.zh: 爷爷很喜欢听传统曲艺。
例句.pinyin: Yéye hěn xǐhuan tīng chuántǒng qǔyì.
例句.en: Grandpa enjoys listening to traditional folk musical theater.

例句.zh: 这座城市每年都会举办曲艺节。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì měinián dōu huì jǔbàn qǔyì jié.
例句.en: This city holds a folk musical theater festival every year.

例句.zh: 她从小就学习曲艺。
例句.pinyin: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù xuéxí qǔyì.
例句.en: She has studied folk musical theater since childhood.

释义: to remove / to dislodge

例句.zh: 透过现今的生物科技，蕃薯烧酒已经变得十分容易入口了，因为那种难闻的蕃薯味道大部分已经被去除了。
例句.pinyin: tòu guò xiàn jīn de shēng wù kē jì ， fān shǔ shāo jiǔ yǐ jīng biàn dé shí fēn róng yì rù kǒu le ， yīn wèi nà zhǒng nán wén de fān shǔ wèi dào dà bù fèn yǐ jīng bèi qù chú le 。
例句.en: It's very easy to drink potato shochu now that the potato-like smell has been reduced to a low level through use of the latest biotechnology.

例句.zh: 随着北朝鲜在26号宣布了按照六方谈话上达成的共识所制定的核计划发展，美国将其从美国的恐怖主义捐助国的名单上去除。被绑架者的家属表达了不安，因为这有可能造成对绑架问题的放弃。
例句.pinyin: suí zhe běi cháo xiān zài 26 hào xuān bù le àn zhào liù fāng tán huà shàng dá chéng de gòng shí suǒ zhì dìng de hé jì huà fā zhǎn ， měi guó jiāng qí cóng měi guó de kǒng bù zhǔ yì juān zhù guó de míng dān shàng qù chú 。 bèi bǎng jià zhě de jiā shǔ biǎo dá le bù ān ， yīn wèi zhè yǒu kě néng zào chéng duì bǎng jià wèn tí de fàng qì 。
例句.en: With North Korea's announcement on the 26th of its nuclear development plan based upon the agreement stemming from the Six Party Talks, and the United States' commencement of procedures to remove North Korea from its designation on the list of State Sponsors of Terrorism, the families of abductees have expressed growing unease that it may constitute an abandonment of the abductee issue.

例句.zh: 请脱去除内裤和内衣外的所有衣物。
例句.pinyin: qǐng tuō qù chú nèi kù hé nèi yī wài de suǒ yǒu yī wù 。
例句.en: Please take off all your clothes except your underpants and bra.

释义: place / destination

例句.zh: 政府没有尽他们最大的努力去处理住房问题。
例句.pinyin: zhèng fǔ méi yǒu jǐn tā men zuì dà de nǔ lì qù chù lǐ zhù fáng wèn tí 。
例句.en: The government is not doing its best to solve the housing problem.

释义: direction in which sb or sth has gone; whereabouts
短释义: direction in which sb or sth has gone; whereabouts

例句.zh: 没人知道那笔钱的去向。
例句.pinyin: Méi rén zhīdào nà bǐ qián de qùxiàng.
例句.en: No one knows where that money went.

例句.zh: 警方正在调查失踪者的去向。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhèngzài diàochá shīzōngzhě de qùxiàng.
例句.en: The police are investigating the missing person's whereabouts.

例句.zh: 请告诉我你毕业后的去向。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ bìyè hòu de qùxiàng.
例句.en: Please tell me where you are going after graduation.

释义: trap; snare; trick

例句.pinyin: tā bèi rèn mìng wèi zhù yīng guó dà shǐ 。
例句.en: He was appointed ambassador to Britain.

例句.zh: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。
例句.pinyin: dǒng shì huì yí zhì jué dìng rèn mìng tā wèi zhí xíng zǒng cái 。
例句.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.

例句.zh: 他被任命为议长。
例句.pinyin: tā bèi rèn mìng wèi yì zhǎng 。
例句.en: He was appointed chairman.

释义: term of office / CL:屆|届[jie4] / tenure (entire period in office)

例句.zh: 前方的道路将很漫长，我们攀登的脚步会很艰辛。我们可能无法在一年甚至一个任期内实现这些目标，但我从未像今晚这样满怀希望，我们将实现我们的目标。
例句.pinyin: qián fāng de dào lù jiāng hěn màn cháng ， wǒ men pān dēng de jiǎo bù huì hěn jiān xīn 。 wǒ men kě néng wú fǎ zài yī nián shèn zhì yí gè rèn qī nèi shí xiàn zhè xiē mù biāo ， dàn wǒ cóng wèi xiàng jīn wǎn zhè yàng mǎn huái xī wàng ， wǒ men jiāng shí xiàn wǒ men de mù biāo 。
例句.en: The road ahead will be long. Our climb will be steep. We may not get there in one year or even in one term. But, America, I have never been more hopeful than I am tonight that we WILL get there.

释义: toughness

例句.zh: 我凭韧性克服了困难。
例句.pinyin: wǒ píng rèn xìng kè fú le kùn nán 。
例句.en: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.

释义: any / arbitrary / at will / at random

例句.zh: 我母亲宁愿选彩票机上的任意数字，也不选我的幸运数字。
例句.pinyin: wǒ mǔ qīn nìng yuàn xuǎn cǎi piào jī shàng de rèn yì shù zì ， yě bù xuǎn wǒ de xìng yùn shù zì 。
例句.en: My mother prefers the arbitrary selection of the lottery machines over my lucky numbers.

例句.zh: 贝尔被犯规了，球队获得了任意球。
例句.pinyin: bèi ěr bèi fàn guī le ， qiú duì huò dé le rèn yì qiú 。
例句.en: Bale was fouled, and his team was awarded a free kick.

例句.zh: 巴西最高法院大法官亚历山大德莫赖斯因涉嫌在针对雅伊尔博索纳罗的案件中侵犯人权 (例如审查和任意拘留)，而受到《全球马格尼茨基人权问责法》的制裁。这些制裁引发了美国和巴西之间的外交和经济紧张局势。
例句.pinyin: bā xī zuì gāo fǎ yuàn dà fǎ guān yà lì shān dà dé mò lài sī yīn shè xián zài zhēn duì yǎ yī ěr bó suǒ nà luó de àn jiàn zhōng qīn fàn rén quán  ( lì rú shěn chá hé rèn yì jū liú )， ér shòu dào 《 quán qiú mǎ gé ní cí jī rén quán wèn zé fǎ 》 de zhì cái 。 zhè xiē zhì cái yǐn fā le měi guó hé bā xī zhī jiān de wài jiāo hé jīng jì jǐn zhāng jú shì 。
例句.en: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes was sanctioned under the Global Magnitsky Act for alleged rights violations, such as censorship and arbitrary detention, in the case against Jair Bolsonaro. The sanctions have sparked diplomatic and economic tensions between the US and Brazil.

释义: to authenticate / to approve

例句.zh: 你有认证吗？
例句.pinyin: nǐ yǒu rèn zhèng ma ？
例句.en: Are you certified?

例句.zh: 汤姆有认证。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ yǒu rèn zhèng 。
例句.en: Tom is certified.

例句.zh: 梅纳德没有认证。
例句.pinyin: méi nà dé méi yǒu rèn zhèng 。
例句.en: Mennad isn't certified.

释义: to hold a post; to take office
短释义: to hold a post; to take office

例句.zh: 布拉赫有一个兄弟，长大后在政府任职。他还有一个姊妹，后来成为了科学家。
例句.pinyin: bù lā hè yǒu yí gè xiōng dì ， zhǎng dà hòu zài zhèng fǔ rèn zhí 。 tā hái yǒu yí gè zǐ mèi ， hòu lái chéng wéi le kē xué jiā 。
例句.en: Brahe had a brother who grew up to serve in the government. He also had a sister that became a scientist.

释义: a heavy load and a long road / fig. to bear heavy responsibilities through a long struggle (cf Confucian Analects, 8.7)
短释义: a heavy load and a long road

例句.zh: 教育改革任重道远，需要全社会共同努力。
例句.pinyin: Jiàoyù gǎigé rèn zhòng dào yuǎn, xūyào quán shèhuì gòngtóng nǔlì.
例句.en: Education reform is a long and arduous task that requires the joint efforts of the whole society.

例句.zh: 保护环境是一项任重道远的任务。
例句.pinyin: Bǎohù huánjìng shì yí xiàng rèn zhòng dào yuǎn de rènwu.
例句.en: Protecting the environment is a long and challenging task.

例句.zh: 实现这个目标任重道远，但我们不会放弃。
例句.pinyin: Shíxiàn zhè ge mùbiāo rèn zhòng dào yuǎn, dàn wǒmen bú huì fàngqì.
例句.en: Achieving this goal will be a long and difficult journey, but we will not give up.

释义: schedule / itinerary / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 因为日程安排的问题，我们必须取消明天的会议。
例句.pinyin: yīn wèi rì chéng ān pái de wèn tí ， wǒ men bì xū qǔ xiāo míng tiān de huì yì 。
例句.en: We had to nix tomorrow's meeting because of a scheduling problem.

例句.zh: 请让我看一下日程安排！
例句.pinyin: qǐng ràng wǒ kàn yī xià rì chéng ān pái ！
例句.en: Please show me the schedule.

例句.zh: 尽管事故使进度延迟了一个月，我们还是设法赶上了日程表。
例句.pinyin: jǐn guǎn shì gù shǐ jìn dù yán chí le yí gè yuè ， wǒ men hái shì shè fǎ gǎn shàng le rì chéng biǎo 。
例句.en: Although the accident has delayed progress by one month, we have managed to catch up with the schedule.

释义: day after day

例句.zh: 那只狗日复一日地等待著主人的归来。
例句.pinyin: nà zhǐ gǒu rì fù yí rì dì děng dài zhù zhǔ rén de guī lái 。
例句.en: The dog waited day after day for its master's return.

释义: (increasing) day by day / (more critical) with every passing day / gradually

例句.zh: 这项技术日趋成熟。
例句.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jìshù rìqū chéngshú.
例句.en: This technology is becoming increasingly mature.

例句.zh: 市场竞争日趋激烈。
例句.pinyin: Shìchǎng jìngzhēng rìqū jīliè.
例句.en: Market competition is growing fiercer day by day.

例句.zh: 人们的环保意识日趋增强。
例句.pinyin: Rénmen de huánbǎo yìshí rìqū zēngqiáng.
例句.en: People's environmental awareness is increasing day by day.

释义: daily renewal, monthly change (idiom) / every day sees new developments / rapid progress

例句.zh: 科技发展日新月异。
例句.pinyin: Kējì fāzhǎn rì xīn yuè yì.
例句.en: Technology is developing at a breathtaking pace.

例句.zh: 这座城市的面貌日新月异。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì de miànmào rì xīn yuè yì.
例句.en: The appearance of this city is changing with each passing day.

例句.zh: 互联网行业的变化日新月异。
例句.pinyin: Hùliánwǎng hángyè de biànhuà rì xīn yuè yì.
例句.en: The internet industry is undergoing rapid and constant change.

释义: to melt / to thaw / to blend / to merge / to be in harmony / old variant of 融[rong2]

例句.zh: 他和他所有的同学相处融洽。
例句.pinyin: tā hé tā suǒ yǒu de tóng xué xiāng chǔ róng qià 。
例句.en: He's getting along well with all of his classmates.

例句.zh: 他自称为金融专家。
例句.pinyin: tā zì chēng wèi jīn róng zhuān jiā 。
例句.en: He claimed to be an expert in finance.

例句.zh: 我知道你们的所做的一切并不只是为了赢得选举，我也知道你们做这一切并不是为了我。你们这样做是因为你们明白前面的任务有多么艰巨。即便我们今晚欢呼庆祝，我们也知道明天将面临我们一生之中最艰难的挑战——两场战争、一个面临危险的星球，一个世纪以来最严重的金融危机。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào nǐ men de suǒ zuò de yī qiè bìng bù zhǐ shì wèi le yíng dé xuǎn jǔ ， wǒ yě zhī dào nǐ men zuò zhè yī qiè bìng bú shì wèi le wǒ 。 nǐ men zhè yàng zuò shì yīn wèi nǐ men míng bái qián miàn de rèn wù yǒu duō me jiān jù 。 jí biàn wǒ men jīn wǎn huān hū qìng zhù ， wǒ men yě zhī dào míng tiān jiāng miàn lín wǒ men yī shēng zhī zhōng zuì jiān nán de tiǎo zhàn —— liǎng chǎng zhàn zhēng 、 yí gè miàn lín wēi xiǎn de xīng qiú ， yí gè shì jì yǐ lái zuì yán zhòng de jīn róng wēi jī 。
例句.en: And I know you didn't do this just to win an election. And I know you didn't do it for me. You did it because you understand the enormity of the task that lies ahead. For even as we celebrate tonight, we know the challenges that tomorrow will bring are the greatest of our lifetime: two wars, a planet in peril, the worst financial crisis in a century.

释义: face glowing (idiom); looking radiant / all smiles

例句.zh: 她今天看起来容光焕发。
例句.pinyin: Tā jīntiān kàn qǐlái róng guāng huàn fā.
例句.en: She looks radiant today.

例句.zh: 爷爷病愈后，显得容光焕发。
例句.pinyin: Yéye bìngyù hòu, xiǎnde róng guāng huàn fā.
例句.en: Grandpa looked radiant after recovering from his illness.

例句.zh: 新郎穿着西装，容光焕发。
例句.pinyin: Xīnláng chuānzhe xīzhuāng, róng guāng huàn fā.
例句.en: The groom looked radiant in his suit.

释义: be honored with

例句.zh: 她荣获了最佳女演员奖。
例句.pinyin: Tā rónghuò le zuìjiā nǚ yǎnyuán jiǎng.
例句.en: She was honored with the Best Actress Award.

例句.zh: 这位科学家荣获国家最高奖。
例句.pinyin: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā rónghuò guójiā zuìgāo jiǎng.
例句.en: The scientist was honored with the country's highest award.

例句.zh: 该作品荣获一等奖。
例句.pinyin: Gāi zuòpǐn rónghuò yī děng jiǎng.
例句.en: This work was honored with first prize.

释义: to dissolve

例句.zh: 盐很快溶解在水中。
例句.pinyin: Yán hěn kuài róngjiě zài shuǐ zhōng.
例句.en: Salt dissolves quickly in water.

例句.zh: 这种药片需要用温水溶解。
例句.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yàopiàn xūyào yòng wēnshuǐ róngjiě.
例句.en: This tablet needs to be dissolved in warm water.

例句.zh: 糖很难在冷水中完全溶解。
例句.pinyin: Táng hěn nán zài lěngshuǐ zhōng wánquán róngjiě.
例句.en: Sugar is difficult to dissolve completely in cold water.

释义: one's appearance / one's aspect / looks / features

例句.zh: 他的容貌改变了许多。
例句.pinyin: tā de róng mào gǎi biàn le xǔ duō 。
例句.en: He's changed a lot in his looks.

例句.zh: 早睡早起对你的健康和容貌都很有好处。
例句.pinyin: zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ duì nǐ de jiàn kāng hé róng mào dōu hěn yǒu hǎo chù 。
例句.en: Going to bed early and waking up early is very good both for your health and appearance.

例句.zh: 要说容貌，她不比她姊姊难看。
例句.pinyin: yào shuō róng mào ， tā bù bǐ tā zǐ zǐ nán kàn 。
例句.en: In terms of appearance, she's not any worse than her sister.

释义: to hold / to contain / to accommodate / to tolerate (different opinions)

例句.zh: 这家酒店可以容纳一千人。
例句.pinyin: zhè jiā jiǔ diàn kě yǐ róng nà yī qiān rén 。
例句.en: This hotel has accommodations for 1,000 guests.

例句.zh: 这房间太小了，容纳不下五十人。
例句.pinyin: zhè fáng jiān tài xiǎo le ， róng nà bù xià wǔ shí rén 。
例句.en: This room is too small to contain 50 men.

例句.zh: 这辆迷你巴士能容纳25个人。
例句.pinyin: zhè liàng mí nǐ bā shì néng róng nà 25 gè rén 。
例句.en: This minibus holds 25 persons.

释义: receptacle / vessel / (computing) container

例句.zh: 这些容器是密封的。
例句.pinyin: zhè xiē róng qì shì mì fēng de 。
例句.en: These containers are airtight.

释义: harmonious / friendly relations / on good terms with one another

例句.zh: 他和他所有的同学相处融洽。
例句.pinyin: tā hé tā suǒ yǒu de tóng xué xiāng chǔ róng qià 。
例句.en: He's getting along well with all of his classmates.

例句.zh: 我和婆婆相处得十分融洽。
例句.pinyin: wǒ hé pó po xiāng chǔ dé shí fēn róng qià 。
例句.en: I'm getting along with my mother-in-law very well.

例句.zh: 我与我的弟弟相处融洽。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yǔ wǒ de dì di xiāng chǔ róng qià 。
例句.en: I get along with my younger brother.

释义: to put up with / to tolerate

例句.zh: 我无法容忍她的行为。
例句.pinyin: wǒ wú fǎ róng rěn tā de xíng wéi 。
例句.en: I cannot put up with her behavior.

例句.zh: 我无法容忍他的行为。
例句.pinyin: wǒ wú fǎ róng rěn tā de xíng wéi 。
例句.en: I can't take his behaviour.

例句.zh: 我难以容忍他的行为。
例句.pinyin: wǒ nán yǐ róng rěn tā de xíng wéi 。
例句.en: I can hardly stand his behavior.

释义: honored (to have the privilege of ...)

例句.zh: 这是我们的荣幸。
例句.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ men de róng xìng 。
例句.en: It's our pleasure.

例句.zh: 我很荣幸能见到你。
例句.pinyin: wǒ hěn róng xìng néng jiàn dào nǐ 。
例句.en: I am honored to meet you.

例句.zh: 等待一位漂亮的姑娘是我的荣幸。
例句.pinyin: děng dài yī wèi piào liàng de gū niáng shì wǒ de róng xìng 。
例句.en: It is my pleasure to wait for a beautiful lady.

释义: to permit / to allow

例句.zh: 请容许我把故事讲完。
例句.pinyin: qǐng róng xǔ wǒ bǎ gù shì jiǎng wán 。
例句.en: Please bear with me until I finish the story.

例句.zh: 容许我向您介绍Mayuko。
例句.pinyin: róng xǔ wǒ xiàng nín jiè shào Mayuko。
例句.en: Allow me to introduce Mayuko to you.

释义: mien / complexion

例句.zh: 岁月改变了她的容颜。
例句.pinyin: Suìyuè gǎibiàn le tā de róngyán.
例句.en: Time has changed her appearance.

例句.zh: 她依然保持着年轻的容颜。
例句.pinyin: Tā yīrán bǎochí zhe niánqīng de róngyán.
例句.en: She still retains her youthful looks.

例句.zh: 他慈祥的容颜让人感到温暖。
例句.pinyin: Tā cíxiáng de róngyán ràng rén gǎndào wēnnuǎn.
例句.en: His kindly countenance makes people feel warm.

释义: honor; glory

例句.zh: 他以为他们渴望荣耀。
例句.pinyin: tā yǐ wéi tā men kě wàng róng yào 。
例句.en: He thinks that they are eager for glory.

例句.zh: 走向前去，为荣耀！
例句.pinyin: zǒu xiàng qián qù ， wèi róng yào ！
例句.en: Onwards, to glory!

例句.zh: 荣耀归于乌克兰！
例句.pinyin: róng yào guī yú wū kè lán ！
例句.en: Glory to Ukraine!

释义: financing

例句.zh: 公司正在为新项目融资。
例句.pinyin: Gōngsī zhèngzài wèi xīn xiàngmù róngzī.
例句.en: The company is raising funds for a new project.

例句.zh: 这家企业完成了新一轮融资。
例句.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè wánchéng le xīn yì lún róngzī.
例句.en: The company has completed a new round of financing.

例句.zh: 银行为小企业提供融资服务。
例句.pinyin: Yínháng wèi xiǎo qǐyè tígōng róngzī fúwù.
例句.en: Banks provide financing services to small businesses.

释义: long and tedious / redundant / superfluous / supernumerary / verbose (of writing)

例句.zh: 这位老教授的讲座冗长而沉闷。
例句.pinyin: zhè wèi lǎo jiào shòu de jiǎng zuò rǒng cháng ér chén mèn 。
例句.en: The old professor's lectures are long-winded and ponderous.

释义: to knead / to massage / to rub

例句.zh: 爱，就是一个人把另一个人的心揉碎的过程。
例句.pinyin: ài ， jiù shì yí gè rén bǎ lìng yí gè rén de xīn róu suì de guò chéng 。
例句.en: Love is the process of breaking and mending the heart of another.

例句.zh: 手脏的时候千万不要揉眼睛。
例句.pinyin: shǒu zàng de shí hòu qiān wàn bú yào róu yǎn jīng 。
例句.en: Never rub your eyes with dirty hands.

例句.zh: 她揉了揉她的眼睛。
例句.pinyin: tā róu le róu tā de yǎn jīng 。
例句.en: She rubbed her eyes.

释义: gentle / soft

例句.zh: 28 位专家来自新加坡、美国、法国、日本、瑞士和尼泊尔，他们在手术室里伴随著柔和的古典音乐，不慌不忙地工作。
例句.pinyin: 28  wèi zhuān jiā lái zì xīn jiā pō 、 měi guó 、 fǎ guó 、 rì běn 、 ruì shì hé ní pō ěr ， tā men zài shǒu shù shì lǐ bàn suí zhù róu hé de gǔ diǎn yīn yuè ， bù huāng bù máng dì gōng zuò 。
例句.en: The 28 specialists, including experts from Singapore, the United States, France, Japan, Switzerland and Nepal, are working at an unhurried pace to the soft strains of classical music in the operating theater.

释义: (idiom) enthralled; mesmerized; enraptured

例句.zh: 观众们听得如痴如醉。
例句.pinyin: Guānzhòng men tīng de rú chī rú zuì.
例句.en: The audience listened, completely enthralled.

例句.zh: 她如痴如醉地读着那本小说。
例句.pinyin: Tā rú chī rú zuì de dúzhe nà běn xiǎoshuō.
例句.en: She was completely absorbed in reading that novel.

例句.zh: 优美的琴声让他如痴如醉。
例句.pinyin: Yōuměi de qínshēng ràng tā rú chī rú zuì.
例句.en: The beautiful music left him mesmerized.

释义: as scheduled / on time / punctual

例句.zh: 就算下雨，足球比赛也会如期进行。

例句.zh: 2022 年 2 月 27 日早上，我正要离开卢卢岛的家，却碰见了邻居——红头发的俄罗斯门诺派血统的罗谢尔，以及来自蒙特利尔英语区、留著灰白小胡子的阿尔；阿尔好几代都是加拿大人。他说他住在蒙特娄的时候不懂法语。我在披萨店吃了一块香蒜起司披萨。小贩来自孟买。透过窗户，我看到一个棕金色头发的年轻男子，穿著深灰色连帽夹克和蓝色短裤，看起来像个「大男孩」。咖啡馆外面坐著十个不到 30 岁的人，其中一个看起来像个英俊的犹太人。里面有一桌五、六个 30 岁以上的人，其中一个穿著深绿色夹克和军绿色裤子，是个英俊的假小子。我喝著冰红茶。走出咖啡馆，我看到那个「大男孩」在树林茂密的公园抽烟。我绕了很长一段路回家，穿过散落著鹅粪的校园草坪，北边白雪皑皑的山脉被云雾笼罩，一派泛灵论佛教的景象，仿佛置身于另一个星球。我家附近，奥莉维亚和丹尼尔停放一辆卡车。奥莉维亚正在学习生物化学。卡车后座坐著一只全身黑色的德国牧羊犬。
例句.pinyin: 2022  nián  2  yuè  27  rì zǎo shàng ， wǒ zhèng yào lí kāi lú lú dǎo de jiā ， què pèng jiàn le lín jū —— hóng tóu fā de é luó sī mén nuò pài xuè tǒng de luó xiè ěr ， yǐ jí lái zì méng tè lì ěr yīng yǔ qū 、 liú zhù huī bái xiǎo hú zi de ā ěr ； ā ěr hǎo jǐ dài dōu shì jiā ná dà rén 。 tā shuō tā zhù zài méng tè lóu de shí hòu bù dǒng fǎ yǔ 。 wǒ zài pī sà diàn chī le yī kuài xiāng suàn qǐ sī pī sà 。 xiǎo fàn lái zì mèng mǎi 。 tòu guò chuāng hù ， wǒ kàn dào yí gè zōng jīn sè tóu fà de nián qīng nán zi ， chuān zhù shēn huī sè lián mào jiá kè hé lán sè duǎn kù ， kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè 「 dà nán hái 」。 kā fēi guǎn wài miàn zuò zhù shí gè bú dào  30  suì de rén ， qí zhōng yí gè kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè yīng jùn de yóu tài rén 。 lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhuō wǔ 、 liù gè  30  suì yǐ shàng de rén ， qí zhōng yí gè chuān zhù shēn lǜ sè jiá kè hé jūn lǜ sè kù zi ， shì gè yīng jùn de jiǎ xiǎo zi 。 wǒ hē zhù bīng hóng chá 。 zǒu chū kā fēi guǎn ， wǒ kàn dào nà ge 「 dà nán hái 」 zài shù lín mào mì de gōng yuán chōu yān 。 wǒ rào le hěn zhǎng yī duàn lù huí jiā ， chuān guò sàn luò zhù é fèn de xiào yuán cǎo píng ， běi biān bái xuě ái ái de shān mài bèi yún wù lǒng zhào ， yī pài fàn líng lùn fó jiào de jǐng xiàng ， fǎng fú zhì shēn yú lìng yí gè xīng qiú 。 wǒ jiā fù jìn ， ào lì wéi yà hé dān ní ěr tíng fàng yī liàng kǎ chē 。 ào lì wéi yà zhèng zài xué xí shēng wù huà xué 。 kǎ chē hòu zuò zuò zhù yī zhī quán shēn hēi sè de dé guó mù yáng quǎn 。
例句.en: In the morning of the 27th of February of 2022, on my way out of my Lulu Island house, I saw my neighbours the redhead Rochelle of Russian-Mennonite ancestry and the grey-haired moustached Al from the Anglophone section of Montreal; he was from many generations of Canadians. He said that he did not know French, when he lived in Montreal. I ate a slice of pesto cheese pizza at the pizzeria. The vendor was from Mumbai. Through the window, I could see a young brown-blond-haired man in a dark-grey hooded jacket and blue shorts, which made him look like a "big boy." At the cafe, there was an under-age-30 crowd of ten outside, of whom one looked like a handsome Jew. Inside was a table of five or six over-age-30 people, of whom one was a handsome tomboy in a dark-green jacket and army-green pants. I drank my iced black tea. Heading out of the cafe, I saw the "big boy" smoking in the wooded park. I took the long route home, through the grassy school field littered with goose poop, the northern snowcapped mountains obscured by clouds, an Animistic-Buddhistic view seemingly of a different planet. Near my house, parked in a truck were Olivia and Daniel. Olivia was studying Biochemistry. In the back seat of the truck was a fully black German Shepherd.

例句.zh: 在所有童话故事里出现的女巫中，没有一个比沙女巫更讨人喜欢、更善于交际了。这位女巫住在海边堆积如山的沙子下面，夏天的时候，人们会在那里用铲子挖沙。她和其他女巫完全不同。她从不骑扫帚，也从不钻烟囱。首先，海滩上根本没有扫帚和烟囱；其次，就算有，她也不知道怎么骑扫帚或钻烟囱。沙女巫只会做一件事：遇到害怕的东西就钻进沙里；遇到不认识的人，就从沙子里钻出来。现在你知道沙女巫是什么了吧。七岁的小詹克斯被晒得通红，如果他知道你所知道的一切，那么在七月一个炎热的早晨，当他突然遭遇这场突如其来的灾难时，他就能更好地应对了。
例句.pinyin: zài suǒ yǒu tóng huà gù shì lǐ chū xiàn de nǚ wū zhōng ， méi yǒu yí gè bǐ shā nǚ wū gèng tǎo rén xǐ huān 、 gèng shàn yú jiāo jì le 。 zhè wèi nǚ wū zhù zài hǎi biān duī jī rú shān de shā zi xià miàn ， xià tiān de shí hòu ， rén men huì zài nà lǐ yòng chǎn zi wā shā 。 tā hé qí tā nǚ wū wán quán bù tóng 。 tā cóng bù qí sào zhǒu ， yě cóng bù zuān yān cōng 。 shǒu xiān ， hǎi tān shàng gēn běn méi yǒu sào zhǒu hé yān cōng ； qí cì ， jiù suàn yǒu ， tā yě bù zhī dào zěn me qí sào zhǒu huò zuān yān cōng 。 shā nǚ wū zhǐ huì zuò yī jiàn shì ： yù dào hài pà de dōng xī jiù zuān jìn shā lǐ ； yù dào bù rèn shí de rén ， jiù cóng shā zi lǐ zuān chū lái 。 xiàn zài nǐ zhī dào shā nǚ wū shì shén me le ba 。 qī suì de xiǎo zhān kè sī bèi shài dé tōng hóng ， rú guǒ tā zhī dào nǐ suǒ zhī dào de yī qiè ， nà me zài qī yuè yí gè yán rè de zǎo chén ， dāng tā tū rán zāo yù zhè chǎng tū rú qí lái de zāi nàn shí ， tā jiù néng gèng hǎo dì yìng duì le 。
例句.en: Of all the witches that may be found in all the fairy tales ever told there is none more delightfully sociable than the Sand Witch. This Witch, who lives underneath the heaps of sand at the ocean's edge, where, in the summertime, you dig with your shovel, is not at all like other witches. She never rides on a broomstick, and she never goes down chimneys. In the first place there are no broomsticks or chimneys on the beach at the sea-shore, and in the second place she would not know how to ride on a broomstick or climb down a chimney, if there were. All the Sand Witch knows how to do is to sink into the sand when anything scares her, and to come up through the sand when she sees a chance to get acquainted with a person she never was acquainted with before. So now you know what a Sand Witch is. And if Junior Jenks, seven years old, and dreadfully sunburnt, had known what you know, he would have been much better prepared to face the one that came up right under his nose all of a sudden one hot July morning.

例句.pinyin: kuài shāi suī rán fāng biàn ， dàn réng yǒu wěi yáng xìng huò wěi yīn xìng de kě néng ， bù néng wán quán qǔ dài  PCR  jiǎn cè 。
例句.en: Rapid tests are convenient, but there is still a possibility of false positives or false negatives, and they cannot fully replace PCR testing.

例句.zh: 各医疗机构目前对乳房 X 光检查的建议各不相同。美国癌症协会建议女性从 45 岁到 54 岁每年进行一次乳房 X 光检查，之后每两年进行一次筛检。而美国放射学会建议从 40 岁开始每年进行一次乳房 X 光检查。
例句.pinyin: gè yī liáo jī gòu mù qián duì rǔ fáng  X  guāng jiǎn chá de jiàn yì gè bù xiāng tóng 。 měi guó ái zhèng xié huì jiàn yì nǚ xìng cóng  45  suì dào  54  suì měi nián jìn xíng yī cì rǔ fáng  X  guāng jiǎn chá ， zhī hòu měi liǎng nián jìn xíng yī cì shāi jiǎn 。 ér měi guó fàng shè xué huì jiàn yì cóng  40  suì kāi shǐ měi nián jìn xíng yī cì rǔ fáng  X  guāng jiǎn chá 。
例句.en: Medical groups currently offer differing advice on mammograms. The American Cancer Society recommends women get annual mammograms from age 45 to 54 followed by screenings every other year after that, while the American College of Radiology recommends annual mammograms beginning at age 40.

释义: valley / ravine

例句.zh: 小山后面有个美丽的山谷。
例句.pinyin: xiǎo shān hòu miàn yǒu gè měi lì de shān gǔ 。

例句.zh: 我们听见自己说话的回音从山谷的另一边传了回来。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men tīng jiàn zì jǐ shuō huà de huí yīn cóng shān gǔ de lìng yī biān chuán le huí lái 。
例句.en: We heard the echo of our voices from the other side of the valley.

例句.zh: 当我们濒临死亡，我们应该独处。我们将摒离所有身外之物。世间的朋友们-跟我们的地位，财富和社会层次息息相关的朋友，都将离我们而去，只因我们即将步入黑暗的山谷。那些与陌生人紧紧相连的关系网-我们的亲属、我们的爱人、孩子、兄弟姐妹，还有那些不太亲却有共同朋友的人们，我们也必须要分开。现在，他们并没用离开我们。有一个比兄弟更亲的人-爱他自己也爱世间直到尽头。
例句.pinyin: dāng wǒ men bīn lín sǐ wáng ， wǒ men yīng gāi dú chǔ 。 wǒ men jiāng bǐng lí suǒ yǒu shēn wài zhī wù 。 shì jiān de péng yǒu men - gēn wǒ men de dì wèi ， cái fù hé shè huì céng cì xī xī xiāng guān de péng yǒu ， dōu jiāng lí wǒ men ér qù ， zhǐ yīn wǒ men jí jiāng bù rù hēi àn de shān gǔ 。 nà xiē yǔ mò shēng rén jǐn jǐn xiāng lián de guān xì wǎng - wǒ men de qīn shǔ 、 wǒ men de ài rén 、 hái zi 、 xiōng dì jiě mèi ， hái yǒu nà xiē bù tài qīn què yǒu gòng tóng péng yǒu de rén men ， wǒ men yě bì xū yào fēn kāi 。 xiàn zài ， tā men bìng méi yòng lí kāi wǒ men 。 yǒu yí gè bǐ xiōng dì gèng qīn de rén - ài tā zì jǐ yě ài shì jiān zhí dào jìn tóu 。
例句.en: When we come to die, we shall be alone. From all our worldly possessions we shall be about to part. Worldly friends — the friends drawn to us by our position, our wealth, or our social qualities, — will leave us as we enter the dark valley. From those bound to us by stronger ties — our kindred, our loved ones, children, brothers, sisters, and from those not less dear to us who have been made our friends because they and we are the friends of the same Saviour, — from them also we must part. Yet not all will leave us. There is One who "sticketh closer than a brother" — One who having loved His own which are in the world loves them to the end.

例句.zh: 2022 年 2 月 27 日早上，我正要离开卢卢岛的家，却碰见了邻居——红头发的俄罗斯门诺派血统的罗谢尔，以及来自蒙特利尔英语区、留著灰白小胡子的阿尔；阿尔好几代都是加拿大人。他说他住在蒙特娄的时候不懂法语。我在披萨店吃了一块香蒜起司披萨。小贩来自孟买。透过窗户，我看到一个棕金色头发的年轻男子，穿著深灰色连帽夹克和蓝色短裤，看起来像个「大男孩」。咖啡馆外面坐著十个不到 30 岁的人，其中一个看起来像个英俊的犹太人。里面有一桌五、六个 30 岁以上的人，其中一个穿著深绿色夹克和军绿色裤子，是个英俊的假小子。我喝著冰红茶。走出咖啡馆，我看到那个「大男孩」在树林茂密的公园抽烟。我绕了很长一段路回家，穿过散落著鹅粪的校园草坪，北边白雪皑皑的山脉被云雾笼罩，一派泛灵论佛教的景象，仿佛置身于另一个星球。我家附近，奥莉维亚和丹尼尔停放一辆卡车。奥莉维亚正在学习生物化学。卡车后座坐著一只全身黑色的德国牧羊犬。
例句.pinyin: 2022  nián  2  yuè  27  rì zǎo shàng ， wǒ zhèng yào lí kāi lú lú dǎo de jiā ， què pèng jiàn le lín jū —— hóng tóu fā de é luó sī mén nuò pài xuè tǒng de luó xiè ěr ， yǐ jí lái zì méng tè lì ěr yīng yǔ qū 、 liú zhù huī bái xiǎo hú zi de ā ěr ； ā ěr hǎo jǐ dài dōu shì jiā ná dà rén 。 tā shuō tā zhù zài méng tè lóu de shí hòu bù dǒng fǎ yǔ 。 wǒ zài pī sà diàn chī le yī kuài xiāng suàn qǐ sī pī sà 。 xiǎo fàn lái zì mèng mǎi 。 tòu guò chuāng hù ， wǒ kàn dào yí gè zōng jīn sè tóu fà de nián qīng nán zi ， chuān zhù shēn huī sè lián mào jiá kè hé lán sè duǎn kù ， kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè 「 dà nán hái 」。 kā fēi guǎn wài miàn zuò zhù shí gè bú dào  30  suì de rén ， qí zhōng yí gè kàn qǐ lái xiàng gè yīng jùn de yóu tài rén 。 lǐ miàn yǒu yī zhuō wǔ 、 liù gè  30  suì yǐ shàng de rén ， qí zhōng yí gè chuān zhù shēn lǜ sè jiá kè hé jūn lǜ sè kù zi ， shì gè yīng jùn de jiǎ xiǎo zi 。 wǒ hē zhù bīng hóng chá 。 zǒu chū kā fēi guǎn ， wǒ kàn dào nà ge 「 dà nán hái 」 zài shù lín mào mì de gōng yuán chōu yān 。 wǒ rào le hěn zhǎng yī duàn lù huí jiā ， chuān guò sàn luò zhù é fèn de xiào yuán cǎo píng ， běi biān bái xuě ái ái de shān mài bèi yún wù lǒng zhào ， yī pài fàn líng lùn fó jiào de jǐng xiàng ， fǎng fú zhì shēn yú lìng yí gè xīng qiú 。 wǒ jiā fù jìn ， ào lì wéi yà hé dān ní ěr tíng fàng yī liàng kǎ chē 。 ào lì wéi yà zhèng zài xué xí shēng wù huà xué 。 kǎ chē hòu zuò zuò zhù yī zhī quán shēn hēi sè de dé guó mù yáng quǎn 。
例句.en: In the morning of the 27th of February of 2022, on my way out of my Lulu Island house, I saw my neighbours the redhead Rochelle of Russian-Mennonite ancestry and the grey-haired moustached Al from the Anglophone section of Montreal; he was from many generations of Canadians. He said that he did not know French, when he lived in Montreal. I ate a slice of pesto cheese pizza at the pizzeria. The vendor was from Mumbai. Through the window, I could see a young brown-blond-haired man in a dark-grey hooded jacket and blue shorts, which made him look like a "big boy." At the cafe, there was an under-age-30 crowd of ten outside, of whom one looked like a handsome Jew. Inside was a table of five or six over-age-30 people, of whom one was a handsome tomboy in a dark-green jacket and army-green pants. I drank my iced black tea. Heading out of the cafe, I saw the "big boy" smoking in the wooded park. I took the long route home, through the grassy school field littered with goose poop, the northern snowcapped mountains obscured by clouds, an Animistic-Buddhistic view seemingly of a different planet. Near my house, parked in a truck were Olivia and Daniel. Olivia was studying Biochemistry. In the back seat of the truck was a fully black German Shepherd.

例句.en: I can't calculate the final cost without first discussing it with our contractors.

例句.pinyin: ōu zhōu hé měi guó de yī fèn zì yóu mào yì xié dìng zhèng zài shāng yì zhōng 。
例句.en: A free-trade agreement between Europe and the United States is currently under negotiation.

例句.pinyin: Zhè shì yì kuǎn shāngyòng ruǎnjiàn.
例句.en: This is a commercial software package.

例句.zh: 商用车辆禁止入内。
例句.pinyin: Shāngyòng chēliàng jìnzhǐ rùnèi.
例句.en: Commercial vehicles are prohibited from entering.

例句.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào shēnqǐng shāngyòng xǔkě.
例句.en: We need to apply for a commercial license.

例句.pinyin: wǒ zhōng yú gǎn dào bèi shǎng shí le 。

释义: surname Shang / still / yet / to value / to esteem

例句.zh: 现在是我们回答这个问题的机会。这是我们的时刻这是我们的时代--让我们的人民重新就业，为我们的后代敞开机会之门，恢复繁荣，推进和平，重新确立“美国梦”，再次证明这样一个基本的真理：我们是一家人；只要一息尚存，我们就有希望；当我们遇到嘲讽和怀疑，当有人说我们办不到的时候，我们要以这个永恒的信条来回应他们。是的，我们能做到
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì wǒ men huí dá zhè ge wèn tí de jī huì 。 zhè shì wǒ men de shí kè zhè shì wǒ men de shí dài -- ràng wǒ men de rén mín chóng xīn jiù yè ， wèi wǒ men de hòu dài chǎng kāi jī huì zhī mén ， huī fù fán róng ， tuī jìn hé píng ， chóng xīn què lì “ měi guó mèng ”， zài cì zhèng míng zhè yàng yí gè jī běn de zhēn lǐ ： wǒ men shì yī jiā rén ； zhǐ yào yī xī shàng cún ， wǒ men jiù yǒu xī wàng ； dāng wǒ men yù dào cháo fěng hé huái yí ， dāng yǒu rén shuō wǒ men bàn bú dào de shí hòu ， wǒ men yào yǐ zhè ge yǒng héng de xìn tiáo lái huí yìng tā men 。 shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào
例句.en: This is our chance to answer that call. This is our moment. This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. And where we are met with cynicism and doubt and those who tell us that we can't, we will respond with that timeless creed that sums up the spirit of a people: Yes, we can.

例句.zh: 他在工作中经验尚浅。
例句.pinyin: tā zài gōng zuò zhōng jīng yàn shàng qiǎn 。
例句.en: He is still green at the job.

例句.zh: 今天我同学看到你们在欧尚买东西。
例句.pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ tóng xué kàn dào nǐ men zài ōu shàng mǎi dōng xī 。
例句.en: Today, my classmate saw you guys shopping at Auchan.

短释义: first half of a game or contest

例句.pinyin: huáng jiā mǎ dé lǐ zài shàng bàn chǎng chǔ yú lǐng xiān ， dàn qiè ěr xī zuì zhōng yíng dé le bǐ sài 。
例句.en: At the end of the first half Real Madrid were in the lead, but Chelsea won in the end.

释义: to report to one's superiors / to appear in the news / to reply to a letter

例句.pinyin: zuì zhòng yào de shì mǎ shàng bào jǐng 。
例句.en: The important thing is to call the police at once.

例句.en: When a team makes its entrance, the captain leads the way.

例句.zh: 当亚历克斯·弗格森看到自己的球员劳累时，他总是叫替补上场。
例句.pinyin: dāng yà lì kè sī · fú gé sēn kàn dào zì jǐ de qiú yuán láo lèi shí ， tā zǒng shì jiào tì bǔ shàng chǎng 。
例句.en: When Sir Alex Ferguson saw that his players were getting tired, he always substituted them.

释义: to take up one's post; to go on duty / to take up a job
短释义: to take up one's post; to go on duty

例句.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng xià zhōu zhèngshì shànggǎng.

例句.pinyin: Tā měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn shànggǎng.
例句.en: He goes on duty at eight every morning.

释义: to get angry / to suffer from excessive internal heat (TCM)

例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ dào le xiàn zài hái méi lái ， shuō bù dìng shì méi gǎn shàng huǒ chē 。
例句.en: Tom may have missed the train. He hasn't come yet.

例句.zh: 快一点，你就能赶上火车了。
例句.pinyin: kuài yì diǎn ， nǐ jiù néng gǎn shàng huǒ chē le 。
例句.en: Hurry, and you will catch the train.

释义: the skies above a certain place; (aviation) airspace / (Tw) topless
短释义: the skies above a certain place; (aviation) airspace

例句.zh: 一片一片的白云在上空飘过。

例句.en: Fluffy white clouds drift across the sky one by one.

例句.pinyin: Tā shàngqiě bù zhīdào, wǒ zěnme huì zhīdào?
