例句.pinyin: wǒ méi fā xiàn rèn hé wǒ gāi dào qiàn de lǐ yóu 。
例句.en: I don't see any reason why I have to apologize.

例句.zh: 警方没有发现任何线索。
例句.pinyin: jǐng fāng méi yǒu fā xiàn rèn hé xiàn suǒ 。
例句.en: The police didn't find any clues.

例句.zh: 发现任何错误或在BMI计算器以后的版本中希望加入的缺失功能，请用邮件通知我。
例句.pinyin: fā xiàn rèn hé cuò wù huò zài BMI jì suàn qì yǐ hòu de bǎn běn zhōng xī wàng jiā rù de quē shī gōng néng ， qǐng yòng yóu jiàn tōng zhī wǒ 。
例句.en: Please notify me by e-mail about any bugs found or missing functions that you want to be included in future versions of the BMI calculator.

释义: line (in drawing, calligraphy etc) / the lines or contours of a three-dimensional object (hairstyle, clothing, car etc)

例句.zh: 他有明显的肌肉线条。
例句.pinyin: tā yǒu míng xiǎn de jī ròu xiàn tiáo 。
例句.en: He's ripped.

例句.zh: 线条艺术强调形式和轮廓，而不是颜色、阴影和纹理。
例句.pinyin: xiàn tiáo yì shù qiáng diào xíng shì hé lún kuò ， ér bú shì yán sè 、 yīn yǐng hé wén lǐ 。
例句.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.

释义: to be in effect / in force / current

例句.zh: 我希望所有那些想要修订现行著作权法的人一个从容不迫的夜晚，但实际上所有其他的人也一样。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xī wàng suǒ yǒu nà xiē xiǎng yào xiū dìng xiàn xíng zhù zuò quán fǎ de rén yí gè cóng róng bù pò de yè wǎn ， dàn shí jì shàng suǒ yǒu qí tā de rén yě yī yàng 。
例句.en: I wish all those an unhurried night who want a revision of the existing copyright laws, but actually all the others too.

例句.zh: 他无视现行法律。
例句.pinyin: tā wú shì xiàn xíng fǎ lǜ 。
例句.en: He ignored the existing laws.

例句.zh: 对于那些想要修订现行著作权法的人，我希望他们这一晚是轻松的一晚，但实际上我希望其他人的夜晚也是轻松的。
例句.pinyin: duì yú nà xiē xiǎng yào xiū dìng xiàn xíng zhù zuò quán fǎ de rén ， wǒ xī wàng tā men zhè yī wǎn shì qīng sōng de yī wǎn ， dàn shí jì shàng wǒ xī wàng qí tā rén de yè wǎn yě shì qīng sōng de 。
例句.en: I wish all those an unhurried night who want a revision of the existing copyright laws, but actually all the others too.

释义: to inlay / to embed / ridge / border

例句.zh: 钻石被镶在一个金戒指上。
例句.pinyin: zuàn shí bèi xiāng zài yí gè jīn jiè zhǐ shàng 。
例句.en: The diamond was set in a gold ring.

例句.zh: 宝石师傅在胸针上镶了一枚大珍珠。
例句.pinyin: bǎo shí shī fù zài xiōng zhēn shàng xiāng le yī méi dà zhēn zhū 。
例句.en: The jeweler mounted a big pearl in the brooch.

例句.zh: 这两个男孩，一个14岁、一个16岁，都穿着军队制服，衣袖上佩戴着镶金色蕾丝边的中士袖章。
例句.pinyin: zhè liǎng gè nán hái ， yí gè 14 suì 、 yí gè 16 suì ， dōu chuān zhe jūn duì zhì fú ， yī xiù shàng pèi dài zhe xiāng jīn sè lěi sī biān de zhōng shì xiù zhāng 。
例句.en: The two boys, aged respectively fourteen and sixteen, were dressed in the army uniform, and wore gold-lace sergeant's chevrons upon their sleeves.

释义: to accompany sb / to accompany each other

例句.zh: 感谢你一路相伴。
例句.pinyin: Gǎnxiè nǐ yí lù xiāngbàn.
例句.en: Thank you for accompanying me all the way.

例句.zh: 她与音乐相伴多年。
例句.pinyin: Tā yǔ yīnyuè xiāngbàn duō nián.
例句.en: She has been accompanied by music for many years.

例句.zh: 愿快乐永远与你相伴。
例句.pinyin: Yuàn kuàilè yǒngyuǎn yǔ nǐ xiāngbàn.
例句.en: May happiness always be with you.

释义: (idiom) to complement one another

例句.zh: 理论与实践相辅相成。
例句.pinyin: Lǐlùn yǔ shíjiàn xiāngfǔ-xiāngchéng.
例句.en: Theory and practice complement each other.

例句.zh: 工作和休息相辅相成，缺一不可。
例句.pinyin: Gōngzuò hé xiūxi xiāngfǔ-xiāngchéng, quē yī bù kě.
例句.en: Work and rest complement each other, and neither can be neglected.

例句.zh: 传统与创新可以相辅相成。
例句.pinyin: Chuántǒng yǔ chuàngxīn kěyǐ xiāngfǔ-xiāngchéng.
例句.en: Tradition and innovation can complement each other.

释义: in succession / following closely

例句.zh: 会议结束后，代表们相继离场。
例句.pinyin: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, dàibiǎo men xiāngjì líchǎng.
例句.en: After the meeting, the delegates left one after another.

例句.zh: 春天来了，公园里的花相继开放。
例句.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, gōngyuán lǐ de huā xiāngjì kāifàng.
例句.en: Spring arrived, and the flowers in the park bloomed one after another.

例句.zh: 几家公司相继推出了新产品。
例句.pinyin: Jǐ jiā gōngsī xiāngjì tuīchū le xīn chǎnpǐn.
例句.en: Several companies launched new products in succession.

释义: close / similar to

例句.zh: 我们的想法很相近。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen de xiǎngfǎ hěn xiāngjìn.
例句.en: Our ideas are very similar.

例句.zh: 这两种颜色很相近。
例句.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zhǒng yánsè hěn xiāngjìn.
例句.en: These two colors are very similar.

例句.zh: 我家和学校的位置相近。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ jiā hé xuéxiào de wèizhì xiāngjìn.
例句.en: My home and the school are close to each other.

释义: spice / flavoring / condiment / perfume

例句.zh: 不含香料、防腐剂及人造色素。
例句.pinyin: bù hán xiāng liào 、 fáng fǔ jì jí rén zào sè sù 。
例句.en: No artificial colours, preservatives or flavours.

例句.zh: 这家商店有各种香料。
例句.pinyin: zhè jiā shāng diàn yǒu gè zhǒng xiāng liào 。
例句.en: This store has a variety of spices.

例句.zh: 燕大侠发现自己被骗了他飞到了江枫的旁边，他抱走江枫的儿子。燕大侠誓言报复，他把男孩给了一个香料商人。
例句.pinyin: yàn dà xiá fā xiàn zì jǐ bèi piàn le tā fēi dào le jiāng fēng de páng biān ， tā bào zǒu jiāng fēng de ér zi 。 yàn dà xiá shì yán bào fù ， tā bǎ nán hái gěi le yí gè xiāng liào shāng rén 。
例句.en: Yan Daxia realised he had been lied to and flew to Jiang Feng's side. He took Jiang Feng's son and left. Yan Daxia vowed revenge and left the boy with a spice merchant.

释义: to inlay / to embed / to set (e.g. a jewel in a ring) / tiling / tesselation

例句.zh: 王冠上镶嵌著数十颗光彩夺目的宝石。
例句.pinyin: wáng guān shàng xiāng qiàn zhù shù shí kē guāng cǎi duó mù dì bǎo shí 。
例句.en: The crown is adorned with dozens of divinely lustrous gemstones.

释义: person from one's hometown or home region / local people; folks
短释义: person from one's hometown or home region

例句.zh: 乡亲们帮他修好了房子。
例句.pinyin: Xiāngqīnmen bāng tā xiū hǎo le fángzi.
例句.en: The villagers helped him repair his house.

例句.zh: 离开家乡多年，他一直惦记着乡亲们。
例句.pinyin: Líkāi jiāxiāng duō nián, tā yìzhí diànjìzhe xiāngqīnmen.
例句.en: After years away from home, he still misses the people there.

例句.zh: 在异乡遇到乡亲，他格外高兴。
例句.pinyin: Zài yìxiāng yùdào xiāngqīn, tā géwài gāoxìng.
例句.en: He was especially happy to meet someone from his home region while away from home.

释义: to get to know each other / acquaintance
短释义: to get to know each other

例句.zh: Smith 先生和我是老相识。
例句.pinyin: Smith  xiān shēng hé wǒ shì lǎo xiāng shí 。
例句.en: Mr Smith and I have been acquainted with each other for a long time.

例句.zh: 史密斯先生是她的一个相识。
例句.pinyin: shǐ mì sī xiān shēng shì tā de yí gè xiāng shí 。
例句.en: Mr Smith is an acquaintance of hers.

例句.zh: 在你面前有一百万美金。你可以自己留下或帮一个你不认识的快全身瘫痪的人做手术。他不认识你，你也不认识他。当然，无论你慷慨地把所有的钱都捐给了一个素不相识的人去做手术，还是卑鄙地拿走这笔钱，让那个人今生都只能卧床不起，都不会有人知道。你会怎么做呢？这笔钱不可割分。
例句.pinyin: zài nǐ miàn qián yǒu yì bǎi wàn měi jīn 。 nǐ kě yǐ zì jǐ liú xià huò bāng yí gè nǐ bù rèn shí de kuài quán shēn tān huàn de rén zuò shǒu shù 。 tā bù rèn shí nǐ ， nǐ yě bù rèn shí tā 。 dāng rán ， wú lùn nǐ kāng kǎi dì bǎ suǒ yǒu de qián dōu juān gěi le yí gè sù bù xiāng shí de rén qù zuò shǒu shù ， hái shì bēi bǐ dì ná zǒu zhè bǐ qián ， ràng nà ge rén jīn shēng dōu zhǐ néng wò chuáng bù qǐ ， dōu bú huì yǒu rén zhī dào 。 nǐ huì zěn me zuò ne ？ zhè bǐ qián bù kě gē fēn 。
例句.en: You've got a million dollars in front of you. You can either spend it for yourself or spend it on a surgery for someone you don't know who is in danger of quadriplegia. You don't know each other. And no one will ever know what a noble deed you've done sacrificing all the money for the surgery for a person you don't know, or how mean you were to take the money confining that person to a wheelchair for the rest of their life. So what would you do? You can't share the money.

释义: to discuss two disparate things together (idiom); to mention on equal terms / to place on a par with / (often with negatives: impossible to mention X in the same breath as Y)
短释义: to discuss two disparate things together (idiom); to mention on equal terms

例句.zh: 管理一间公司和拥有一间公司是不能相提并论的两回事。
例句.pinyin: guǎn lǐ yī jiān gōng sī hé yōng yǒu yī jiān gōng sī shì bù néng xiāng tí bìng lùn de liǎng huí shì 。
例句.en: Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.

释义: interlinked / connected / communicating / in communication / accommodating

例句.zh: 网络是一个相通的渠道，而不是物质或具体的活动。
例句.pinyin: wǎng luò shì yí gè xiāng tōng de qú dào ， ér bú shì wù zhì huò jù tǐ de huó dòng 。
例句.en: It’s a communication medium, not a substance or specific activity.

释义: countryside / rural area / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 汤姆回乡下了。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ huí xiāng xià le 。
例句.en: Tom went back to his hometown.

例句.zh: 当我住在乡下的时候，我几乎没有访客。
例句.pinyin: dāng wǒ zhù zài xiāng xià de shí hòu ， wǒ jī hū méi yǒu fǎng kè 。
例句.en: Living in the country, I have few visitors.

例句.zh: 他住在乡下地区。
例句.pinyin: tā zhù zài xiāng xià dì qū 。
例句.en: He dwells in the country.

释义: sesame oil / perfumed oil

例句.zh: 凉菜里放一点香油更好吃。
例句.pinyin: Liángcài lǐ fàng yìdiǎn xiāngyóu gèng hǎochī.
例句.en: Cold dishes taste better with a little sesame oil.

例句.zh: 妈妈在汤里加了几滴香油。
例句.pinyin: Māma zài tāng lǐ jiā le jǐ dī xiāngyóu.
例句.en: Mom added a few drops of sesame oil to the soup.

例句.zh: 这瓶香油闻起来很香。
例句.pinyin: Zhè píng xiāngyóu wén qǐlai hěn xiāng.
例句.en: This bottle of sesame oil smells very fragrant.

释义: to meet / to encounter / to come across

例句.zh: 他们的相遇是必然的。
例句.pinyin: tā men de xiāng yù shì bì rán de 。
例句.en: Their meeting was inevitable.

例句.zh: 与她的相遇丰富了他的精神生活。
例句.pinyin: yǔ tā de xiāng yù fēng fù le tā de jīng shén shēng huó 。
例句.en: His encounter with her is enriching his inner life.

例句.zh: 我们在2008年相遇。一年后，我们结婚了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men zài 2008 nián xiāng yù 。 yī nián hòu ， wǒ men jié hūn le 。
例句.en: We met in 2008. A year later, we got married.

释义: to agree (on a meeting place, date etc) / to reach agreement / to make an appointment
短释义: to agree (on a meeting place, date etc)

例句.zh: 我们相约周六在公园见面。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen xiāngyuē zhōuliù zài gōngyuán jiànmiàn.
例句.en: We agreed to meet at the park on Saturday.

例句.zh: 他们相约下班后一起吃饭。
例句.pinyin: Tāmen xiāngyuē xiàbān hòu yìqǐ chīfàn.
例句.en: They agreed to have dinner together after work.

例句.zh: 我和朋友相约明早去爬山。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyou xiāngyuē míngzǎo qù páshān.
例句.en: My friend and I agreed to go hiking tomorrow morning.

释义: auspicious and peaceful

例句.zh: 小村庄显得宁静祥和。
例句.pinyin: Xiǎo cūn zhuāng xiǎn de níng jìng xiáng hé.
例句.en: The small village looks quiet and peaceful.

例句.zh: 春节期间，街上洋溢着欢乐祥和的气氛。
例句.pinyin: Chūn Jié qī jiān, jiē shàng yáng yì zhe huān lè xiáng hé de qì fēn.
例句.en: During the Spring Festival, the streets are filled with a joyful and peaceful atmosphere.

例句.zh: 一家人围坐在一起，画面十分祥和。
例句.pinyin: Yì jiā rén wéi zuò zài yì qǐ, huà miàn shí fēn xiáng hé.
例句.en: The whole family sits together, creating a very peaceful scene.

释义: thorough and detailed / exhaustive / the tedious details in full

例句.zh: 报告者详尽地说明了他的研究方法。
例句.pinyin: bào gào zhě xiáng jìn dì shuō míng le tā de yán jiū fāng fǎ 。
例句.en: The reporter elaborated on the method of his investigation.

释义: to enjoy / to benefit / to have the use of / old variant of 享[xiang3]

例句.zh: 他喜欢每天都享受一下一个人的时间。
例句.pinyin: tā xǐ huān měi tiān dōu xiǎng shòu yī xià yí gè rén de shí jiān 。
例句.en: He likes to spend some time in solitude every day.

例句.zh: 竞选活动的声势也来自那些已不再年轻的人们，他们冒着严寒酷暑，敲开陌生人的家门进行竞选宣传；竞选声势也源自数百万的美国民众，他们充当志愿者和组织者，他们证明了在两百多年以后，民有、民治、民享的政府并未从地球上消失。这是你们的胜利。
例句.pinyin: jìng xuǎn huó dòng de shēng shì yě lái zì nà xiē yǐ bù zài nián qīng de rén men ， tā men mào zhe yán hán kù shǔ ， qiāo kāi mò shēng rén de jiā mén jìn xíng jìng xuǎn xuān chuán ； jìng xuǎn shēng shì yě yuán zì shù bǎi wàn de měi guó mín zhòng ， tā men chōng dāng zhì yuàn zhě hé zǔ zhī zhě ， tā men zhèng míng liǎo zài liǎng bǎi duō nián yǐ hòu ， mín yǒu 、 mín zhì 、 mín xiǎng de zhèng fǔ bìng wèi cóng dì qiú shàng xiāo shī 。 zhè shì nǐ men de shèng lì 。
例句.en: It drew strength from the not-so-young people who braved the bitter cold and scorching heat to knock on doors of perfect strangers, and from the millions of Americans who volunteered and organized and proved that more than two centuries later a government of the people, by the people, and for the people has not perished from the Earth.

例句.zh: 能够的时候就好好享受人生吧。
例句.pinyin: néng gòu de shí hòu jiù hǎo hǎo xiǎng shòu rén shēng ba 。
例句.en: Enjoy your life while you are able to.

释义: to think up every possible method (idiom); to devise ways and means / to try this, that and the other
短释义: to think up every possible method (idiom); to devise ways and means

例句.zh: 她想方设法以一己之力完成了工作。
例句.pinyin: tā xiǎng fāng shè fǎ yǐ yī jǐ zhī lì wán chéng le gōng zuò 。
例句.en: She managed to finish the work on her own.

释义: loud and clear; resounding

例句.zh: 行动比语言更响亮。
例句.pinyin: xíng dòng bǐ yǔ yán gèng xiǎng liàng 。
例句.en: Actions speak louder than words.

例句.zh: 蝉破土而出后，会蜕皮，等待身体干燥变硬，然后飞到树顶觅食和寻找配偶，牠们通过发出响亮的蝉鸣来寻找配偶。
例句.pinyin: chán pò tǔ ér chū hòu ， huì tuì pí ， děng dài shēn tǐ gān zào biàn yìng ， rán hòu fēi dào shù dǐng mì shí hé xún zhǎo pèi ǒu ， tā men tōng guò fā chū xiǎng liàng de chán míng lái xún zhǎo pèi ǒu 。
例句.en: Once out of the ground, the cicadas molt and wait for their bodies to dry and harden, then they fly to the tops of trees where they feed and look for a mate, which they do by making a loud buzz.

释义: to respond to / answer / CL:個|个[ge4]

例句.zh: 在浏览器端，耗时很长的操作都应该异步执行，避免浏览器失去响应，最好的例子就是 Ajax 操作。
例句.pinyin: zài liú lǎn qì duān ， hào shí hěn zhǎng de cāo zuò dōu yīng gāi yì bù zhí xíng ， bì miǎn liú lǎn qì shī qù xiǎng yìng ， zuì hǎo de lì zi jiù shì  Ajax  cāo zuò 。
例句.en: On the client side, very time-consuming operations should run asynchronously so as to avoid freezing the browser. The best example is the operation of Ajax.

例句.zh: 任何境遇都是宇宙给你的机会，假如你懂得利用、抓紧它。它将是你一生的财富。假如你遗漏、放弃或者没有做出积极的响应，宇宙会让这次机会在下一个时间、地点，和其他人重新来过。但在其中，你失去的是最宝贵的时间！知错就改，把握当下；在合适的尺度下，能跳就跳吧，能唱就唱吧，能疯就疯吧，能闹就闹吧。
例句.pinyin: rèn hé jìng yù dōu shì yǔ zhòu gěi nǐ de jī huì ， jiǎ rú nǐ dǒng de lì yòng 、 zhuā jǐn tā 。 tā jiāng shì nǐ yī shēng de cái fù 。 jiǎ rú nǐ yí lòu 、 fàng qì huò zhě méi yǒu zuò chū jī jí de xiǎng yìng ， yǔ zhòu huì ràng zhè cì jī huì zài xià yí gè shí jiān 、 dì diǎn ， hé qí tā rén chóng xīn lái guò 。 dàn zài qí zhōng ， nǐ shī qù de shì zuì bǎo guì de shí jiān ！ zhī cuò jiù gǎi ， bǎ wò dāng xià ； zài hé shì de chǐ dù xià ， néng tiào jiù tiào ba ， néng chàng jiù chàng ba ， néng fēng jiù fēng ba ， néng nào jiù nào ba 。
例句.en: Every situation is an opportunity given to you by the universe. If you know how to make the most out of that situation, do it. It will be a wealth that lasts you a lifetime. If you missed out, gave up, or didn't even attempt to take advantage of the opportunity, the universe will set this chance aside for the next person, in a different time and place. But what's most important is that you lost precious time. Understand what you did wrong, and control the present. Then with proper restraint, if you can dance, dance. If you can sing, sing. If you can be wild, be wild. If you can be lively, be lively.

释义: to enjoy (i.e. have the use or benefit of)
短释义: to enjoy (i.e. have the use or benefit of)

例句.zh: 请享用！
例句.pinyin: qǐng xiǎng yòng ！
例句.en: Enjoy!

例句.zh: 2025 年 5 月 14 日，天空多云，间或有蓝色空间。我两次走到圣奥尔本斯路上的罗马天主教堂，一次在早上，一次在下午，这是我今年春天第 12 次和第 13 次。早上，穿著制服的小男孩和小女孩们在宽敞的礼拜堂里忏悔。他们来自不同的种族。神父在告解室和一个学生交谈。在崇拜小堂，我注意到左前方有一盆漂亮的兰花。下午，宽敞的礼拜堂几乎空无一人，我通常更喜欢这种状态。路边有个穿著白色背心的英俊肌肉男在慢跑。那棵开著紫色花朵的大树看起来像一棵皇后树，一棵泡桐，因为它有著大大的心形叶子。它让我想起开著紫色花朵的蓝花楹，让我对南美洲充满了怀念。在提姆霍顿斯咖啡馆，我早上享用了香肠马铃薯炒蛋和一杯燕麦奶伯爵茶，下午又喝了一杯经典冰柠檬水。这一天我都在散步。在家，我学习了一些逻辑语和世界语。我有很多世界语书籍。我的融合主义倾向是万物有灵论和佛教。
例句.pinyin: 2025  nián  5  yuè  14  rì ， tiān kōng duō yún ， jiàn huò yǒu lán sè kōng jiān 。 wǒ liǎng cì zǒu dào shèng ào ěr běn sī lù shàng de luó mǎ tiān zhǔ jiào táng ， yī cì zài zǎo shàng ， yī cì zài xià wǔ ， zhè shì wǒ jīn nián chūn tiān dì  12  cì hé dì  13  cì 。 zǎo shàng ， chuān zhù zhì fú de xiǎo nán hái hé xiǎo nǚ hái men zài kuān chǎng de lǐ bài táng lǐ chàn huǐ 。 tā men lái zì bù tóng de zhǒng zú 。 shén fù zài gào jiě shì hé yí gè xué shēng jiāo tán 。 zài chóng bài xiǎo táng ， wǒ zhù yì dào zuǒ qián fāng yǒu yī pén piào liàng de lán huā 。 xià wǔ ， kuān chǎng de lǐ bài táng jī hū kōng wú yì rén ， wǒ tōng cháng gèng xǐ huān zhè zhǒng zhuàng tài 。 lù biān yǒu gè chuān zhù bái sè bèi xīn de yīng jùn jī ròu nán zài màn pǎo 。 nà kē kāi zhù zǐ sè huā duǒ de dà shù kàn qǐ lái xiàng yī kē huáng hòu shù ， yī kē pāo tóng ， yīn wèi tā yǒu zhù dà dà de xīn xíng yè zi 。 tā ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ kāi zhù zǐ sè huā duǒ de lán huā yíng ， ràng wǒ duì nán měi zhōu chōng mǎn le huái niàn 。 zài tí mǔ huò dùn sī kā fēi guǎn ， wǒ zǎo shàng xiǎng yòng le xiāng cháng mǎ líng shǔ chǎo dàn hé yī bēi yàn mài nǎi bó jué chá ， xià wǔ yòu hē le yī bēi jīng diǎn bīng níng méng shuǐ 。 zhè yī tiān wǒ dōu zài sàn bù 。 zài jiā ， wǒ xué xí le yī xiē luó jí yǔ hé shì jiè yǔ 。 wǒ yǒu hěn duō shì jiè yǔ shū jí 。 wǒ de róng hé zhǔ yì qīng xiàng shì wàn wù yǒu líng lùn hé fó jiào 。
例句.en: This 14th of May of 2025 is cloudy skies interspersed with blue spaces. I walked to the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road twice, once in the morning and again in the afternoon, my 12th and 13th times this spring. In the morning was confession for the little boys and girls in uniform. They were of different races, in the big worship hall. The priest was in the confession booth talking to a student. At the Adoration Chapel, I noticed a nice pot of orchids on the front left. In the afternoon, the big worship hall was mostly empty, a condition which I usually prefer. At the road was a handsome muscle man in white tank top jogging. The big purple-bloom tree seems like an Empress Tree, a Paulownia, because of the big heart-shaped leaves. Reminiscent of Jacaranda with its purple blooming, it's saudade for me about South America. At Tim Hortons café, I enjoyed Scrambled Eggs with Sausage and Potatoes and an Earl Grey Tea with oat milk in the morning, and an Iced Classic Lemonade in the afternoon. The day was full of walking. At home, I study bits of Lojban and Esperanto. I have many books in Esperanto. I tend towards Animism-Buddhism in my Syncretism.

例句.zh: 于是，他们心满意足地享用了美酒和野味，/ 恢复了体力。
例句.pinyin: yú shì ， tā men xīn mǎn yì zú dì xiǎng yòng le měi jiǔ hé yě wèi ，/  huī fù le tǐ lì 。
例句.en: So wine and venison, to their hearts' desire, / refreshed their strength.

例句.zh: 每一个孩子都应该享有平等的学习机会。
例句.pinyin: měi yí gè hái zi dōu yīng gāi xiǎng yǒu píng děng de xué xí jī huì 。
例句.en: It is essential that every child have the same educational opportunities.

例句.pinyin: tā xiǎng yǒu sī rén jiào xué de tè quán 。
例句.en: He had the privilege of a private education.

例句.zh: 请勿由享有版权的来源添加句子。
例句.pinyin: qǐng wù yóu xiǎng yǒu bǎn quán de lái yuán tiān jiā jù zi 。
例句.en: Don't add sentences from copyrighted sources.

释义: lane / alley

例句.zh: 幸好，在狄马睡觉的小巷外面，刚好有一家阿玛尼。
例句.pinyin: xìng hǎo ， zài dí mǎ shuì jiào de xiǎo xiàng wài miàn ， gāng hǎo yǒu yī jiā ā mǎ ní 。
例句.en: Thankfully, there was an Armani store just outside the alley where Dima had slept.

例句.zh: 我在小巷子里转向了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài xiǎo xiàng zi lǐ zhuǎn xiàng le 。
例句.en: I turned into a small alleyway.

例句.zh: 我在黑暗的巷子中绊倒，膝盖砸在柏油路上。一块木板盖著巷弄的房屋之间的电线。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼镜从眼睛上掉了下来。幸好有一位带著手电筒的广东工人帮忙。我的膝盖只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝盖摔伤是在菲律宾奎松市的唐荷西高地。那里有一大片火星般的红土地，遍地长满了「塔拉希布」草。有时工人会故意纵火烧草。我和哥哥当时还在外面玩。那时我们还未到青春期。在燃烧的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝盖著地。我的贝贝姥姥愤怒不已。家里的女佣在车库后面的大磁砖水槽里帮我清洗了双腿。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zài hēi àn de xiàng zi zhōng bàn dǎo ， xī gài zá zài bǎi yóu lù shàng 。 yī kuài mù bǎn gài zhù xiàng nòng de fáng wū zhī jiān de diàn xiàn 。 shēn yè de xiàng nòng fēi cháng zhī àn 。 wǒ de yǎn jìng cóng yǎn jīng shàng diào le xià lái 。 xìng hǎo yǒu yī wèi dài zhù shǒu diàn tǒng de guǎng dōng gōng rén bāng máng 。 wǒ de xī gài zhǐ shì cā pò le pí 。 wǒ xiǎng qǐ lìng yī cì xī gài shuāi shāng shì zài fēi lǜ bīn kuí sōng shì de táng hé xī gāo dì 。 nà lǐ yǒu yī dà piàn huǒ xīng bān de hóng tǔ dì ， biàn dì zhǎng mǎn le 「 tǎ lā xī bù 」 cǎo 。 yǒu shí gōng rén huì gù yì zòng huǒ shāo cǎo 。 wǒ hé gē gē dāng shí hái zài wài miàn wán 。 nà shí wǒ men hái wèi dào qīng chūn qī 。 zài rán shāo de yě cǎo páng ， wǒ shuāi dǎo le ， xī gài zhù dì 。 wǒ de bèi bèi lǎo lao fèn nù bù yǐ 。 jiā lǐ de nǚ yōng zài chē kù hòu miàn de dà cí zhuān shuǐ cáo lǐ bāng wǒ qīng xǐ le shuāng tuǐ 。
例句.en: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

例句.en: These gloves are made of rubber.

例句.pinyin: Xiàngjiāo hěn yǒu tánxìng.

例句.zh: 他的人缘向来很好，因此一旦遭遇急难，朋友都乐意帮忙。

例句.en: He is always popular among his friends. So whenever he comes across troubles or emergencies, they are happy to offer help.

例句.pinyin: nǐ yí xiàng lái dōu hěn hǎo 。

释义: facial features; looks

例句.zh: 2015 年 4 月 14 日，我步行前往列治文公共市场，先是爬上了外面的阶梯。市场内部宽敞的中庭式建筑，让我感觉仿佛置身于丛林之中。我当时已经有点饿了，便小跑到小吃摊「瓦船长」那里，点了一份面和一杯热茶。面里有鱿鱼、鱼和豆腐。我吃著吃著，一位穿著紫色 T 恤的英俊原住民男子从我身边走过。接著，一位身材魁梧、相貌英俊的犹太人也走了过来。几分钟后，我开始觉得口渴，于是在「QQ 珍珠奶茶与咖啡」买了一杯冰镇薄荷珍珠绿茶。我坐在阶梯旁慢慢品尝。附近坐著一家三口吃东西，男人是黑人，女人是东亚人，小孩是混血儿。我喝珍珠奶茶上瘾，于是在「花生家」又买了一杯。这次是冰镇青苹果珍珠绿茶，味道好极了。我搭扶梯下楼。去洗手间的路上，我注意到一个大水族箱，里面养著大概是体型巨大的阿拉斯加红帝王蟹，蟹腿上长满了藤壶。不知怎的，牠们让我想起了外星生物。在书店里，我买了一本图文并茂的绿色植物学书籍，上面用的是汉字。一个月前我把它放在一个箱子上，现在还在那里。这本书 14 块钱。我搭扶梯上楼。我对珍珠奶茶还是有瘾，于是用剩下的零钱买了一杯冰荔枝珍珠绿茶。味道好极了，里面甚至还有白色的荔枝果肉。
例句.pinyin: 2015  nián  4  yuè  14  rì ， wǒ bù xíng qián wǎng liè zhì wén gōng gòng shì chǎng ， xiān shì pá shàng le wài miàn de jiē tī 。 shì chǎng nèi bù kuān chǎng de zhōng tíng shì jiàn zhù ， ràng wǒ gǎn jué fǎng fú zhì shēn yú cóng lín zhī zhōng 。 wǒ dāng shí yǐ jīng yǒu diǎn è le ， biàn xiǎo pǎo dào xiǎo chī tān 「 wǎ chuán zhǎng 」 nà lǐ ， diǎn le yī fèn miàn hé yī bēi rè chá 。 miàn lǐ yǒu yóu yú 、 yú hé dòu fǔ 。 wǒ chī zhù chī zhù ， yī wèi chuān zhù zǐ sè  T  xù de yīng jùn yuán zhù mín nán zi cóng wǒ shēn biān zǒu guò 。 jiē zhù ， yī wèi shēn cái kuí wú 、 xiàng mào yīng jùn de yóu tài rén yě zǒu le guò lái 。 jǐ fēn zhōng hòu ， wǒ kāi shǐ jué de kǒu kě ， yú shì zài 「QQ  zhēn zhū nǎi chá yǔ kā fēi 」 mǎi le yī bēi bīng zhèn bò hé zhēn zhū lǜ chá 。 wǒ zuò zài jiē tī páng màn màn pǐn cháng 。 fù jìn zuò zhù yī jiā sān kǒu chī dōng xī ， nán rén shì hēi rén ， nǚ rén shì dōng yà rén ， xiǎo hái shì hùn xuè ér 。 wǒ hē zhēn zhū nǎi chá shàng yǐn ， yú shì zài 「 huā shēng jiā 」 yòu mǎi le yī bēi 。 zhè cì shì bīng zhèn qīng píng guǒ zhēn zhū lǜ chá ， wèi dào hǎo jí le 。 wǒ dā fú tī xià lóu 。 qù xǐ shǒu jiān de lù shàng ， wǒ zhù yì dào yí gè dà shuǐ zú xiāng ， lǐ miàn yǎng zhù dà gài shì tǐ xíng jù dà de ā lā sī jiā hóng dì wáng xiè ， xiè tuǐ shàng zhǎng mǎn le téng hú 。 bù zhī zěn de ， tā men ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ le wài xīng shēng wù 。 zài shū diàn lǐ ， wǒ mǎi le yī běn tú wén bìng mào de lǜ sè zhí wù xué shū jí ， shàng miàn yòng de shì hàn zì 。 yí gè yuè qián wǒ bǎ tā fàng zài yí gè xiāng zi shàng ， xiàn zài hái zài nà lǐ 。 zhè běn shū  14  kuài qián 。 wǒ dā fú tī shàng lóu 。 wǒ duì zhēn zhū nǎi chá hái shì yǒu yǐn ， yú shì yòng shèng xià de líng qián mǎi le yī bēi bīng lì zhī zhēn zhū lǜ chá 。 wèi dào hǎo jí le ， lǐ miàn shèn zhì hái yǒu bái sè de lì zhī guǒ ròu 。
例句.en: On the 14th of April of 2015, I walk to the Richmond Public Market, I first climbing the stairs outside. Inside, the wide atrium-like building is like a garden in a jungle surrounding, I imagine. Already quite hungry, I trot to Captain Wa, the food vendor, to get noodles with squid, fish, and tofu, as well as hot tea. As I eat, a handsome First Nations man in a purple T-shirt walks by. Then a handsome, stocky Jewish fellow walks by. A few minutes later, I begin to thirst, so I get a cold Mint Bubble Green Tea at the vendor QQ Bubble Tea and Coffee. I sit by the stairs to sip. A threesome family sits eating nearby, the man being black, the woman being Oriental, and the child being a hybrid. Addicted to Bubble Tea, I get another one, this time at Peanut's. It is a cold Green Apple Bubble Green Tea. It is delicious. I take the escalator down. On my way to the washroom, I notice a big aquarium full of probably giant red Alaskan king crabs with barnacles on their legs. They remind me of extraterrestrials, somehow. At the bookstore, I buy a heavily illustrated green botany book in sinograms. I left it on top of a box a month ago and it is still there. It is $14. I take the escalator up. Addicted to Bubble Tea, I spend my remaining coins on a cold Lychee Bubble Green Tea. It is delicious with even bits of white lychee flesh.

释义: presentable / decent / up to par

例句.zh: 汤姆穿得还挺像样的，对吧？
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ chuān dé hái tǐng xiàng yàng de ， duì ba ？
例句.en: Tom is presentable, isn't he?

例句.zh: 然而这也算不上什么像样的东西。
例句.pinyin: rán ér zhè yě suàn bù shàng shén me xiàng yàng de dōng xī 。
例句.en: But it isn't even worth calling stuff.

例句.en: She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.

例句.zh: 听到她成功的消息，他很高兴。

例句.en: He was happy at the news of her success.

例句.pinyin: wǒ tīng dào zhè ge xiāo xī hěn chī jīng 。
例句.en: I was surprised at the news.

例句.zh: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。

例句.en: It worried me that she looked pale.

例句.zh: 她病了很久，现在还很虚弱，无法随意走动。
例句.pinyin: tā bìng le hěn jiǔ ， xiàn zài hái hěn xū ruò ， wú fǎ suí yì zǒu dòng 。
例句.en: She has been ill for a long time and she is still too weak to get about.

释义: false / hypocritical / artificial / sham

例句.zh: 虽然虚伪、苦痛还有破碎的梦伴随着我，但这仍然是一个美丽的世界。
例句.pinyin: suī rán xū wěi 、 kǔ tòng hái yǒu pò suì de mèng bàn suí zhe wǒ ， dàn zhè réng rán shì yí gè měi lì de shì jiè 。
例句.en: With all its sham, drudgery and broken dreams; it is still a beautiful world.

例句.zh: 所有的社交，自然而然地，都会掺入一些虚伪的成分，我想这是有其必要的。
例句.pinyin: suǒ yǒu de shè jiāo ， zì rán ér rán dì ， dū huì càn rù yī xiē xū wěi de chéng fèn ， wǒ xiǎng zhè shì yǒu qí bì yào de 。
例句.en: All social interactions, naturally, will involve some degree of insincerity, which I believe is necessary.

例句.zh: 这真是彻底的虚伪！
例句.pinyin: zhè zhēn shì chè dǐ de xū wěi ！
例句.en: This is pure hypocrisy!

释义: key information / instructions / it must be borne in mind

例句.zh: 我们必须知道事情的真相。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men bì xū zhī dào shì qíng de zhēn xiàng 。
例句.en: We have to get at the truth of the matter.

例句.zh: 我必须知道。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bì xū zhī dào 。
例句.en: I have to know.

释义: slowly / gently

例句.zh: 太阳徐徐升起。
例句.pinyin: Tàiyáng xúxú shēng qǐ.
例句.en: The sun slowly rises.

例句.zh: 微风徐徐吹来。
例句.pinyin: Wēifēng xúxú chuī lái.
例句.en: A gentle breeze slowly blows in.

例句.zh: 列车徐徐驶出车站。
例句.pinyin: Lièchē xúxú shǐ chū chēzhàn.
例句.en: The train slowly pulls out of the station.

释义: surname Xu / to allow / to permit / to promise / to praise / somewhat / perhaps

例句.zh: 也许我会马上放弃然后去打盹。
例句.pinyin: yě xǔ wǒ huì mǎ shàng fàng qì rán hòu qù dǎ dǔn 。
例句.en: I may give up soon and just nap instead.

例句.zh: 十年后，我们的城市将改变许多。
例句.pinyin: shí nián hòu ， wǒ men de chéng shì jiāng gǎi biàn xǔ duō 。
例句.en: In ten years our town will change a lot.

例句.zh: 他告诉了我们许多经验教训。
例句.pinyin: tā gào sù le wǒ men xǔ duō jīng yàn jiào xùn 。
例句.en: He told us many lessons.

释义: to make a wish / to make a vow / to promise a reward

例句.zh: 她闭上眼睛许愿。
例句.pinyin: Tā bì shàng yǎnjing xǔyuàn.
例句.en: She closed her eyes and made a wish.

例句.zh: 我对着流星许愿。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ duìzhe liúxīng xǔyuàn.
例句.en: I made a wish upon a shooting star.

例句.zh: 吹蜡烛前先许愿吧。
例句.pinyin: Chuī làzhú qián xiān xǔyuàn ba.
例句.en: Make a wish before blowing out the candles.

释义: (bound form) order; sequence / (bound form) introductory; initial / preface

例句.zh: 英国人很尊重法序和秩序。
例句.pinyin: yīng guó rén hěn zūn zhòng fǎ xù hé zhì xù 。
例句.en: The British have a lot of respect for law and order.

例句.zh: 我编译这个程序有些困难。
例句.pinyin: wǒ biān yì zhè ge chéng xù yǒu xiē kùn nán 。
例句.en: I'm having some problems compiling this software.

例句.zh: 大部分程序员讨厌调试，设置故障比纠正它们有意思多了。
例句.pinyin: dà bù fèn chéng xù yuán tǎo yàn tiáo shì ， shè zhì gù zhàng bǐ jiū zhèng tā men yǒu yì si duō le 。
例句.en: Most developers hate debugging; it's more fun to create bugs than to correct them.

释义: to continue / to replenish

例句.zh: 不管我跟她说了多少次，她还是继续犯同样的错误。
例句.pinyin: bù guǎn wǒ gēn tā shuō le duō shǎo cì ， tā hái shì jì xù fàn tóng yàng de cuò wù 。
例句.en: No matter how often I tell her, she keeps making the same mistake.

例句.zh: 她母亲将继续工作。
例句.pinyin: tā mǔ qīn jiāng jì xù gōng zuò 。
例句.en: Her mother will continue to work.

例句.zh: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。
例句.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ bù àn zhào ān quán shǒu xù lái de huà ， nǐ kě néng huì shòu shāng de 。
例句.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.

释义: long-winded / garrulous / to talk endlessly without getting to the point

例句.zh: 奶奶一见我就絮叨个不停。
例句.pinyin: Nǎinai yí jiàn wǒ jiù xùdao ge bù tíng.
例句.en: As soon as Grandma sees me, she starts nagging nonstop.

例句.zh: 他有点儿絮叨，但都是为你好。
例句.pinyin: Tā yǒudiǎnr xùdao, dàn dōu shì wèi nǐ hǎo.
例句.en: He is a bit long-winded, but he only wants what is best for you.

例句.zh: 别再絮叨这件事了。
例句.pinyin: Bié zài xùdao zhè jiàn shì le.
例句.en: Stop going on about this.

释义: (of an airplane, ship, vehicle etc) to continue a journey without refueling / (of an electronic device, battery etc) to run before needing to be recharged
短释义: (of an airplane, ship, vehicle etc) to continue a journey without refueling

例句.zh: 目前正在审查的规则要求，到 2025 年，汽车制造商所制造的所有汽车，平均续航须达到每加仑 54.5 英里 (每公升 23 公里)。
例句.pinyin: mù qián zhèng zài shěn chá de guī zé yāo qiú ， dào  2025  nián ， qì chē zhì zào shāng suǒ zhì zào de suǒ yǒu qì chē ， píng jūn xù háng xū dá dào měi jiā lún  54.5  yīng lǐ  ( měi gōng shēng  23  gōng lǐ )。
例句.en: The rules now under review require an average of 54.5 miles per gallon (23 kilometers per liter) from an automaker's entire fleet by 2025.

例句.zh: 电池续航力对我来说很重要。
例句.pinyin: diàn chí xù háng lì duì wǒ lái shuō hěn zhòng yào 。
例句.en: Battery life is really important to me.

释义: heavy drinking / to get drunk / to drink to excess

例句.zh: 严禁卖淫嫖娼，赌博，吸毒，酗酒滋事等违法犯罪活动！
例句.pinyin: yán jìn mài yín piáo chāng ， dǔ bó ， xī dú ， xù jiǔ zī shì děng wéi fǎ fàn zuì huó dòng ！
例句.en: Prostitution, gambling, the use of narcotic substances, drunkenness, disorder, and all other illegal activities are STRICTLY FORBIDDEN.

例句.zh: 酗酒是导致阳痿的一个因素。
例句.pinyin: xù jiǔ shì dǎo zhì yáng wěi de yí gè yīn sù 。
例句.en: Excessive drinking is one of the causes of impotence.

释义: sequence

例句.zh: 请按序列输入这些数字。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng àn xùliè shūrù zhèxiē shùzì.
例句.en: Please enter these numbers in sequence.

例句.zh: 这个序列包含十个元素。
例句.pinyin: Zhège xùliè bāohán shí ge yuánsù.
例句.en: This sequence contains ten elements.

例句.zh: 我们发现了一个有规律的序列。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen fāxiàn le yí ge yǒu guīlǜ de xùliè.
例句.en: We found a regular sequence.

释义: to raise animals

例句.zh: 他家世代以畜牧为生。
例句.pinyin: Tā jiā shìdài yǐ xùmù wéi shēng.
例句.en: His family has raised livestock for a living for generations.

例句.zh: 这里水草丰富，适合畜牧。
例句.pinyin: Zhèlǐ shuǐcǎo fēngfù, shìhé xùmù.
例句.en: The abundant water and grass here make it suitable for raising livestock.

例句.zh: 畜牧是当地经济的重要支柱。
例句.pinyin: Xùmù shì dāngdì jīngjì de zhòngyào zhīzhù.
例句.en: Animal husbandry is an important pillar of the local economy.

释义: prologue

例句.zh: 音乐会在悠扬的琴声中拉开序幕。
例句.pinyin: Yīnyuèhuì zài yōuyáng de qínshēng zhōng lā kāi xùmù.
例句.en: The concert opened with the melodious sound of the piano.

例句.zh: 这次会议只是双方合作的序幕。
例句.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì zhǐshì shuāngfāng hézuò de xùmù.
例句.en: This meeting is only the prologue to cooperation between the two sides.

例句.zh: 序幕结束后，主角终于登场了。
例句.pinyin: Xùmù jiéshù hòu, zhǔjué zhōngyú dēngchǎng le.
例句.en: After the prologue ended, the main character finally appeared on stage.

释义: the rising sun

例句.zh: 旭日从东方缓缓升起。
例句.pinyin: Xùrì cóng dōngfāng huǎnhuǎn shēngqǐ.
例句.en: The rising sun slowly emerges in the east.

例句.zh: 我们迎着旭日出发了。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen yíngzhe xùrì chūfā le.
例句.en: We set out facing the rising sun.

例句.zh: 旭日给大地带来了温暖。
例句.pinyin: Xùrì gěi dàdì dàilái le wēnnuǎn.
例句.en: The rising sun brought warmth to the earth.

释义: preface; introductory remarks; preamble; prelude

例句.zh: 这本书的序言介绍了作者的写作目的。
例句.pinyin: Zhè běn shū de xùyán jièshào le zuòzhě de xiězuò mùdì.
例句.en: The preface of this book introduces the author's purpose in writing.

例句.zh: 我读完序言后，对这部小说有了初步了解。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ dú wán xùyán hòu, duì zhè bù xiǎoshuō yǒu le chūbù liǎojiě.
例句.en: After reading the preface, I gained a basic understanding of the novel.

例句.zh: 他请一位著名学者为新书写序言。
例句.pinyin: Tā qǐng yí wèi zhùmíng xuézhě wèi xīn shū xiě xùyán.
例句.en: He asked a renowned scholar to write the preface for his new book.

释义: to assert / to claim

例句.zh: 当两个女生都跟约翰宣称她们对他有感觉时，他不知道该跟哪个谈恋爱了。
例句.pinyin: dāng liǎng gè nǚ shēng dōu gēn yuē hàn xuān chēng tā men duì tā yǒu gǎn jué shí ， tā bù zhī dào gāi gēn nǎ ge tán liàn ài le 。
例句.en: When both girls told John they had feelings for him, he was in a quandary as to which girl he should be with.

释义: to read out loud to an audience / a prepared speech (e.g. to a party conference)
短释义: to read out loud to an audience

例句.zh: 校长在毕业典礼上宣读了获奖名单。
例句.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng zài bìyè diǎnlǐ shàng xuāndú le huòjiǎng míngdān.
例句.en: The principal read out the list of award winners at the graduation ceremony.

例句.zh: 法官当庭宣读了判决结果。
例句.pinyin: Fǎguān dāngtíng xuāndú le pànjué jiéguǒ.
例句.en: The judge read the verdict aloud in court.

例句.zh: 请你向大家宣读这份通知。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ xiàng dàjiā xuāndú zhè fèn tōngzhī.
例句.en: Please read this notice aloud to everyone.

释义: to declare / to proclaim

例句.zh: 被突袭后宣告战争是可以预想的，但用炸弹屠杀万人以上的平民却是前所未闻的。
例句.pinyin: bèi tū xí hòu xuān gào zhàn zhēng shì kě yǐ yù xiǎng de ， dàn yòng zhà dàn tú shā wàn rén yǐ shàng de píng mín què shì qián suǒ wèi wén de 。
例句.en: Declaring war after a surprise attack is to be expected, but killing over ten thousand non-combatants with a bomb is something unheard of.

例句.zh: 他被宣告破产。
例句.pinyin: tā bèi xuān gào pò chǎn 。
例句.en: He was declared bankrupt.

释义: hubbub / clamor / to make a racket

例句.zh: 请勿在图书馆内大声喧哗。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng wù zài túshūguǎn nèi dàshēng xuānhuá.
例句.en: Please do not make loud noise in the library.

例句.zh: 教室里一片喧哗。
例句.pinyin: Jiàoshì lǐ yí piàn xuānhuá.
例句.en: The classroom was filled with hubbub.

例句.zh: 人群突然喧哗起来。
例句.pinyin: Rénqún tūrán xuānhuá qǐlái.
例句.en: The crowd suddenly became noisy.

释义: to make a noise / noisy

例句.zh: 街上的人群十分喧闹。
例句.pinyin: Jiē shàng de rénqún shífēn xuānnào.
例句.en: The crowd in the street is very noisy.

例句.zh: 孩子们在教室里喧闹起来。
例句.pinyin: Háizimen zài jiàoshì lǐ xuānnào qǐlái.
例句.en: The children started making noise in the classroom.

例句.zh: 请不要在医院里大声喧闹。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào zài yīyuàn lǐ dàshēng xuānnào.
例句.en: Please don't make loud noises in the hospital.

释义: to swear an oath (of office) / to make a vow

例句.zh: 骑士宣誓效忠于国王。
例句.pinyin: qí shì xuān shì xiào zhōng yú guó wáng 。
例句.en: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.

例句.zh: 下个月是他们的五十周年纪念，他们打算重新宣誓。
例句.pinyin: xià gè yuè shì tā men de wǔ shí zhōu nián jì niàn ， tā men dǎ suàn chóng xīn xuān shì 。
例句.en: Next month is their 50th anniversary, and they're planning on renewing their vows.

例句.zh: 我向国旗宣誓效忠。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiàng guó qí xuān shì xiào zhōng 。
例句.en: I pledge allegiance to the flag.

释义: to drain (by leading off water) / to unburden oneself / to divulge / to leak a secret

例句.zh: 为了宣泄洪水，他们挖了一条新河道。
例句.pinyin: Wèile xuānxiè hóngshuǐ, tāmen wā le yì tiáo xīn hédào.
例句.en: To drain off the floodwater, they dug a new channel.

例句.zh: 水库开闸宣泄洪水。
例句.pinyin: Shuǐkù kāizhá xuānxiè hóngshuǐ.
例句.en: The reservoir opened its gates to release the floodwater.

例句.zh: 这条沟渠能迅速宣泄田里的积水。
例句.pinyin: Zhè tiáo gōuqú néng xùnsù xuānxiè tián lǐ de jīshuǐ.
例句.en: This ditch can quickly drain the standing water from the fields.

释义: declaration / manifesto

例句.zh: 为了详述它们的价值观，公司常常在它们的册子里，在网站上或者在办公室里挂着有五到十个“目标宣言”的单子，作为一种对雇员、顾客和民众的交流。
例句.pinyin: wèi le xiáng shù tā men de jià zhí guān ， gōng sī cháng cháng zài tā men de cè zi lǐ ， zài wǎng zhàn shàng huò zhě zài bàn gōng shì lǐ guà zhe yǒu wǔ dào shí gè “ mù biāo xuān yán ” de dān zi ， zuò wéi yī zhǒng duì gù yuán 、 gù kè hé mín zhòng de jiāo liú 。
例句.en: Businesses often have a list of 5-10 'mission statements' featured in their brochures, on their websites or hanging in their office detailing the values they hold as a form of communication to their employees, their clients and the public.

释义: to publicize; to advertise; to spread far and wide
短释义: to publicize; to advertise; to spread far and wide

例句.zh: Garvey毫无保留地宣扬种族主义。
例句.pinyin: Garvey háo wú bǎo liú dì xuān yáng zhǒng zú zhǔ yì 。
例句.en: Garvey speaks up for racial pride.

释义: black / mysterious

例句.zh: 他身穿玄色长袍。
例句.pinyin: Tā shēn chuān xuánsè chángpáo.
例句.en: He is wearing a long black robe.

例句.zh: 她选了一件玄色汉服。
例句.pinyin: Tā xuǎn le yí jiàn xuánsè Hànfú.
例句.en: She chose a black Hanfu outfit.

例句.zh: 画中的将军披着玄色铠甲。
例句.pinyin: Huà zhōng de jiāngjūn pīzhe xuánsè kǎijiǎ.
例句.en: The general in the painting is wearing black armor.

释义: to hang or suspend / to worry / public announcement / unresolved / baseless / without foundation

例句.zh: 他们一直爬到悬崖顶上。
例句.pinyin: tā men yì zhí pá dào xuán yá dǐng shàng 。
例句.en: They climbed to the top of a cliff.

例句.zh: 地球只不过是悬浮在太空中的一个球体。
例句.pinyin: dì qiú zhǐ bù guò shì xuán fú zài tài kōng zhōng de yí gè qiú tǐ 。
例句.en: The earth is just a sphere suspended in space.

例句.zh: 我不喜欢让事情悬而未决。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bù xǐ huān ràng shì qíng xuán ér wèi jué 。
例句.en: I don't like to leave things up in the air.

释义: to suspend / to hang / (vehicle) suspension

例句.zh: 人们普遍认为悬挂式滑翔运动是危险的。
例句.pinyin: rén men pǔ biàn rèn wéi xuán guà shì huá xiáng yùn dòng shì wēi xiǎn de 。
例句.en: There is a tendency for people to think that hang gliding is dangerous.

例句.zh: 他的画被悬挂在墙上。
例句.pinyin: tā de huà bèi xuán guà zài qiáng shàng 。
例句.en: His pictures were hung on the wall.

例句.zh: 美国自然历史博物馆的「光之生物」展览展出了发绿色光的水母、额头上提著灯笼的琵琶鱼，以及在洞穴顶棚上悬挂粘液状细丝，用来诱捕猎物的萤火虫。
例句.pinyin: měi guó zì rán lì shǐ bó wù guǎn de 「 guāng zhī shēng wù 」 zhǎn lǎn zhǎn chū le fā lǜ sè guāng de shuǐ mǔ 、 é tóu shàng tí zhù dēng lóng de pí pá yú ， yǐ jí zài dòng xué dǐng péng shàng xuán guà nián yè zhuàng xì sī ， yòng lái yòu bǔ liè wù de yíng huǒ chóng 。
例句.en: The American Museum of Natural History’s “Creatures of Light” exhibit features jellyfish that glow green, anglerfish whose lantern-like bulbs dangle from their foreheads and luminous glowworms that hang mucus-like strands from cave ceilings to attract and ensnare their prey.

释义: profound theory (in Daoism and Buddhism) / mysterious principles

例句.zh: 道长向弟子讲解道教的玄机。
例句.pinyin: Dàozhǎng xiàng dìzǐ jiǎngjiě Dàojiào de xuánjī.
例句.en: The Daoist priest explained the profound teachings of Daoism to his disciples.

例句.zh: 这部经书蕴含着佛法的玄机。
例句.pinyin: Zhè bù jīngshū yùnhánzhe Fófǎ de xuánjī.
例句.en: This scripture contains the profound truths of Buddhism.

例句.zh: 他参悟多年，终于领会了其中的玄机。

释义: to elect / election / CL:次[ci4],個|个[ge4]

例句.pinyin: měi guó fù nǚ méi yǒu xuǎn jǔ quán 。
例句.en: American women didn't have the right to vote.

例句.zh: 已经过去了很长时间，但是今晚，由于我们今天在这场选举所采取的行动，在这个决定性的时候，变革来到了美国。
例句.pinyin: yǐ jīng guò qù le hěn zhǎng shí jiān ， dàn shì jīn wǎn ， yóu yú wǒ men jīn tiān zài zhè chǎng xuǎn jǔ suǒ cǎi qǔ de xíng dòng ， zài zhè ge jué dìng xìng de shí hòu ， biàn gé lái dào le měi guó 。
例句.en: It's been a long time coming; but tonight, because of what we did on this day, in this election, at this defining moment, change has come to America.

例句.zh: 我要感谢我的选举搭档，这位先生全心全意竞选，为与他在史克兰顿街头一起长大的男男女女代言，并和我一起乘火车回德拉瓦州，他就是副总统当选人，拜登先生。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yào gǎn xiè wǒ de xuǎn jǔ dā dàng ， zhè wèi xiān shēng quán xīn quán yì jìng xuǎn ， wèi yǔ tā zài shǐ kè lán dùn jiē tóu yì qǐ zhǎng dà de nán nán nǚ nǚ dài yán ， bìng hé wǒ yì qǐ chéng huǒ chē huí dé lā wǎ zhōu ， tā jiù shì fù zǒng tǒng dāng xuǎn rén ， bài dēng xiān shēng 。
例句.en: I want to thank my partner in this journey, a man who campaigned from his heart, and spoke for the men and women he grew up with on the streets of Scranton, and rode with on the train home to Delaware, the vice president-elect of the United States, Joe Biden.

释义: voter / constituency / electorate

例句.zh: 这次大选创造了多项第一，也诞生了很多将世代流传的故事。但是今天晚上令我难忘的却是在亚特兰大投票的一名妇女：安-尼克松-库波尔。她和其他数百万排队等待投票的选民没有什么差别，除了一点：她已是106岁的高龄。
例句.pinyin: zhè cì dà xuǎn chuàng zào le duō xiàng dì yī ， yě dàn shēng le hěn duō jiāng shì dài liú chuán de gù shì 。 dàn shì jīn tiān wǎn shàng lìng wǒ nán wàng de què shì zài yà tè lán dà tóu piào de yī míng fù nǚ ： ān - ní kè sōng - kù bō ěr 。 tā hé qí tā shù bǎi wàn pái duì děng dài tóu piào de xuǎn mín méi yǒu shén me chā bié ， chú le yì diǎn ： tā yǐ shì 106 suì de gāo líng 。
例句.en: This election had many firsts and many stories that will be told for generations. But one that's on my mind tonight is about a woman who cast her ballot in Atlanta. She's a lot like the millions of others who stood in line to make their voice heard in this election, except for one thing: Ann Nixon Cooper is 106 years old.

The U.S. Department of Agriculture is funding experimental on-farm sites in Mississippi and several other states. Some large poultry processors are launching renewable energy divisions to power their feed mills. 例句.zh: 21个月前在寒冬所开始的一切不应当在今天这个秋夜结束。今天的选举胜利并不是我们所寻求的改变--这只是我们进行改变的机会。如果我们仍然按照过去的方式行事，我们所寻求的改变将不会发生。没有你们，没有服务和牺牲的新精神，就不可能发生改变。因此，让我们发扬新的爱国和负责精神，所有的人都下定决心参与其中，更加努力地工作，不仅是为自己而是为彼此。
例句.pinyin: 21 gè yuè qián zài hán dōng suǒ kāi shǐ de yī qiè bù yīng dāng zài jīn tiān zhè ge qiū yè jié shù 。 jīn tiān de xuǎn jǔ shèng lì bìng bú shì wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn -- zhè zhǐ shì wǒ men jìn xíng gǎi biàn de jī huì 。 rú guǒ wǒ men réng rán àn zhào guò qù de fāng shì xíng shì ， wǒ men suǒ xún qiú de gǎi biàn jiāng bú huì fā shēng 。 méi yǒu nǐ men ， méi yǒu fú wù hé xī shēng de xīn jīng shén ， jiù bù kě néng fā shēng gǎi biàn 。 yīn cǐ ， ràng wǒ men fā yáng xīn de ài guó hé fù zé jīng shén ， suǒ yǒu de rén dōu xià dìng jué xīn cān yù qí zhōng ， gèng jiā nǔ lì dì gōng zuò ， bù jǐn shì wèi zì jǐ ér shì wèi bǐ cǐ 。
例句.en: What began 21 months ago in the depths of winter cannot end on this autumn night. This victory alone is not the change we seek. It is only the chance for us to make that change. And that cannot happen if we go back to the way things were. It can't happen without you, without a new spirit of service, a new spirit of sacrifice. So let us summon a new spirit of patriotism, of responsibility, where each of us resolves to pitch in and work harder and look after not only ourselves but each other.

释义: (coll.) clothes

例句.zh: 孔子说："像夏禹的为人，我找不到可以指责的漏洞。自己吃著菲薄的饮食，而却用丰厚祭品祭拜祖先与神明；自己平时穿粗劣的衣裳，而在祭祀时穿戴华服礼帽；自己住小房子，却尽力开通水道沟渠。像夏禹这样的人，我实在找不到可以指责的漏洞了。"
例句.pinyin: kǒng zi shuō ：" xiàng xià yǔ de wéi rén ， wǒ zhǎo bú dào kě yǐ zhǐ zé de lòu dòng 。 zì jǐ chī zhù fěi bó de yǐn shí ， ér què yòng fēng hòu jì pǐn jì bài zǔ xiān yǔ shén míng ； zì jǐ píng shí chuān cū liè de yī shang ， ér zài jì sì shí chuān dài huá fú lǐ mào ； zì jǐ zhù xiǎo fáng zi ， què jìn lì kāi tōng shuǐ dào gōu qú 。 xiàng xià yǔ zhè yàng de rén ， wǒ shí zài zhǎo bú dào kě yǐ zhǐ zé de lòu dòng le 。"
例句.en: Confucius said: " Yu the Great's conduct, I could not point out any flaws. He consumes meager amount of food, while offering boastful riches to the Gods and ancestors; He always don the crudest attire, but wears lavish garments when worshipping; He resides in a small house, yet forges water ways and ditches with all his might. Figures like Yu the Great, I honestly cannot point out any reprehensible flaws."

例句.zh: 若老师要筹划一趟假期旅行或类似需要比价、核算费用的事，他便会借助学生的本领。有时，妻子想要一个新果盘，或丈夫想要一把新裁纸刀；许多人有儿子需要听睡前短故事，或有女儿的洋娃娃必须穿上最时髦的衣裳；凡此种种，老师一律让学生替他代劳。
例句.pinyin: ruò lǎo shī yào chóu huà yī tàng jià qī lǚ xíng huò lèi sì xū yào bǐ jià 、 hé suàn fèi yòng de shì ， tā biàn huì jiè zhù xué shēng de běn lǐng 。 yǒu shí ， qī zǐ xiǎng yào yí gè xīn guǒ pán ， huò zhàng fū xiǎng yào yī bǎ xīn cái zhǐ dāo ； xǔ duō rén yǒu ér zi xū yào tīng shuì qián duǎn gù shì ， huò yǒu nǚ ér de yáng wá wá bì xū chuān shàng zuì shí máo de yī shang ； fán cǐ zhǒng zhǒng ， lǎo shī yī lǜ ràng xué shēng tì tā dài láo 。
例句.en: If the teacher is to plan out a vacation or something similar requiring one to compare prices and figure out what it would cost, it is the pupils' skills he would exploit. Sometimes, the wife may be wishing for a new fruit bowl, or perhaps the husband is looking for a new letter opener. Many have sons that require a short bedside story or daughters with dolls that must be clad in clothing of utmost fashionability; all this, the teacher makes the pupils make for him.

例句.zh: 我觉得您说的很有道理，但是依照您出的条件处理的话，我们也很为难。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jué de nín shuō de hěn yǒu dào lǐ ， dàn shì yī zhào nín chū de tiáo jiàn chǔ lǐ de huà ， wǒ men yě hěn wéi nán 。
例句.en: I think what you said makes sense, but I would rather not just follow your conditions.

释义: appearance / bearing / meter (i.e. measuring instrument)

例句.zh: 汤姆把他的太阳镜留在我的车的仪表板上了。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ bǎ tā de tài yáng jìng liú zài wǒ de chē de yí biǎo bǎn shàng le 。
例句.en: Tom left his sunglasses on the dashboard of my car.

释义: variant of 一併|一并[yi1 bing4] / to lump together; to treat along with all the others
短释义: variant of 一併|一并[yi1 bing4]

例句.zh: 请把身份证和复印件一并提交。
例句.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ shēnfènzhèng hé fùyìnjiàn yíbìng tíjiāo.
例句.en: Please submit your ID card and the photocopy together.

例句.zh: 会议时间和地点将一并通知大家。
例句.pinyin: Huìyì shíjiān hé dìdiǎn jiāng yíbìng tōngzhī dàjiā.
例句.en: Everyone will be informed of the meeting time and location together.

例句.zh: 他把旧书和杂志一并捐给了图书馆。
例句.pinyin: Tā bǎ jiùshū hé zázhì yíbìng juāngěi le túshūguǎn.
例句.en: He donated the old books and magazines to the library together.

释义: a doubtful point

例句.zh: 警方正在调查案件中的疑点。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zhèngzài diàochá ànjiàn zhōng de yídiǎn.
例句.en: The police are investigating the doubtful points in the case.

例句.zh: 他的解释并没有消除所有疑点。
例句.pinyin: Tā de jiěshì bìng méiyǒu xiāochú suǒyǒu yídiǎn.
例句.en: His explanation did not clear up all the doubts.

例句.zh: 这个细节是整件事最大的疑点。
例句.pinyin: Zhège xìjié shì zhěng jiàn shì zuì dà de yídiǎn.
例句.en: This detail is the biggest doubtful point in the whole matter.

释义: motionless

例句.zh: 她有时会一动不动的坐上好几个小时。
例句.pinyin: tā yǒu shí huì yī dòng bù dòng de zuò shàng hǎo jǐ gè xiǎo shí 。
例句.en: She will sometimes sit still for hours.

释义: for a time / at one time / one time / once

例句.zh: 在美国，由于投资者纷纷涌向包括黄金和美国国债在内的安全港，因此主要的股票价格指数在星期一一度下跌了3个百分点。
例句.pinyin: zài měi guó ， yóu yú tóu zī zhě fēn fēn yǒng xiàng bāo kuò huáng jīn hé měi guó guó zhài zài nèi de ān quán gǎng ， yīn cǐ zhǔ yào de gǔ piào jià gé zhǐ shù zài xīng qī yī yí dù xià diē le 3 gè bǎi fēn diǎn 。
例句.en: In the United States, the major stock market indices at one point were down three percentage points on Monday, as investors rushed to safe havens, including gold and U.S. Treasury bonds.

例句.zh: 在美国，由于投资者纷纷涌向包括黄金和美国国债在内的安全港，因此主要的股票市场指数在星期一一度下跌了3个百分点。
例句.pinyin: zài měi guó ， yóu yú tóu zī zhě fēn fēn yǒng xiàng bāo kuò huáng jīn hé měi guó guó zhài zài nèi de ān quán gǎng ， yīn cǐ zhǔ yào de gǔ piào shì chǎng zhǐ shù zài xīng qī yī yí dù xià diē le 3 gè bǎi fēn diǎn 。
例句.en: In the United States, the major stock market indices at one point were down three percentage points on Monday, as investors rushed to safe havens, including gold and U.S. Treasury bonds.

释义: all / without any exceptions / categorically

例句.zh: 「只有傻子才会相信这种一概而论的说法。」「你这句话其实也是一种一概而论的说法。」「唉，我知道啦。」
例句.pinyin: 「 zhǐ yǒu shǎ zi cái huì xiāng xìn zhè zhǒng yī gài ér lùn de shuō fǎ 。」「 nǐ zhè jù huà qí shí yě shì yī zhǒng yī gài ér lùn de shuō fǎ 。」「 āi ， wǒ zhī dào la 。」
例句.en: "Only a moron truly believes in blanket statements like this." "That's actually a blanket statement too." "Ha, I know."

释义: to lump different matters together (idiom)

例句.zh: 「只有傻子才会相信这种一概而论的说法。」「你这句话其实也是一种一概而论的说法。」「唉，我知道啦。」
例句.pinyin: 「 zhǐ yǒu shǎ zi cái huì xiāng xìn zhè zhǒng yī gài ér lùn de shuō fǎ 。」「 nǐ zhè jù huà qí shí yě shì yī zhǒng yī gài ér lùn de shuō fǎ 。」「 āi ， wǒ zhī dào la 。」
例句.en: "Only a moron truly believes in blanket statements like this." "That's actually a blanket statement too." "Ha, I know."

释义: (of passing time) in an instant / (of a sight) in a flash

例句.zh: 一晃，三年过去了。
例句.pinyin: Yí huàng, sān nián guò qù le.
例句.en: In the blink of an eye, three years passed.

例句.zh: 一晃，孩子们都长大了。
例句.pinyin: Yí huàng, hái zi men dōu zhǎng dà le.
例句.en: In an instant, the children were all grown up.

例句.zh: 一晃，假期就结束了。
例句.pinyin: Yí huàng, jià qī jiù jié shù le.
例句.en: In the blink of an eye, the vacation was over.

释义: to transfer / to hand over

例句.zh: 我们将移交至岛上的机场。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men jiāng yí jiāo zhì dǎo shàng de jī chǎng 。
例句.en: We will deliver up to the airport of the island.

释义: proficiency in a particular field (idiom) / skill in a specialized area (idiom)

例句.zh: 每个人都应该有一技之长。
例句.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yīnggāi yǒu yí jì zhī cháng.
例句.en: Everyone should have a particular skill.

例句.zh: 有一技之长，找工作会更容易。
例句.pinyin: Yǒu yí jì zhī cháng, zhǎo gōngzuò huì gèng róngyì.
例句.en: Having a particular skill makes it easier to find a job.

例句.zh: 他凭着一技之长开了自己的店。
例句.pinyin: Tā píngzhe yí jì zhī cháng kāi le zìjǐ de diàn.
例句.en: He used his particular skill to open his own shop.

释义: livable

例句.zh: 这是一座宜居的城市。
例句.pinyin: Zhè shì yí zuò yíjū de chéngshì.
例句.en: This is a livable city.

例句.zh: 这里环境优美，非常宜居。
例句.pinyin: Zhèlǐ huánjìng yōuměi, fēicháng yíjū.
例句.en: The environment here is beautiful, making it very livable.

例句.zh: 良好的公共交通让这座城市更宜居。
例句.pinyin: Liánghǎo de gōnggòng jiāotōng ràng zhè zuò chéngshì gèng yíjū.
例句.en: Good public transportation makes this city more livable.

释义: to leave behind / to hand down

例句.zh: 我一定是把它遗留在巴士上了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yí dìng shì bǎ tā yí liú zài bā shì shàng le 。
例句.en: I must have left it on the bus.

例句.zh: 据估计只有几百只遗留的熊猫，其中的少数圈养在中国和国外的动物园。
例句.pinyin: jù gū jì zhǐ yǒu jǐ bǎi zhǐ yí liú de xióng māo ， qí zhōng de shǎo shù quān yǎng zài zhōng guó hé guó wài de dòng wù yuán 。
例句.en: It is estimated that only a few hundred pandas remain, with a small number of them being raised in zoos in China and abroad.

释义: to overlook / to miss / to omit

例句.zh: 用法语，很少会遗漏主语。
例句.pinyin: yòng fǎ yǔ ， hěn shǎo huì yí lòu zhǔ yǔ 。
例句.en: In French, you can rarely omit the subject.

例句.zh: 任何境遇都是宇宙给你的机会，假如你懂得利用、抓紧它。它将是你一生的财富。假如你遗漏、放弃或者没有做出积极的响应，宇宙会让这次机会在下一个时间、地点，和其他人重新来过。但在其中，你失去的是最宝贵的时间！知错就改，把握当下；在合适的尺度下，能跳就跳吧，能唱就唱吧，能疯就疯吧，能闹就闹吧。
例句.pinyin: rèn hé jìng yù dōu shì yǔ zhòu gěi nǐ de jī huì ， jiǎ rú nǐ dǒng de lì yòng 、 zhuā jǐn tā 。 tā jiāng shì nǐ yī shēng de cái fù 。 jiǎ rú nǐ yí lòu 、 fàng qì huò zhě méi yǒu zuò chū jī jí de xiǎng yìng ， yǔ zhòu huì ràng zhè cì jī huì zài xià yí gè shí jiān 、 dì diǎn ， hé qí tā rén chóng xīn lái guò 。 dàn zài qí zhōng ， nǐ shī qù de shì zuì bǎo guì de shí jiān ！ zhī cuò jiù gǎi ， bǎ wò dāng xià ； zài hé shì de chǐ dù xià ， néng tiào jiù tiào ba ， néng chàng jiù chàng ba ， néng fēng jiù fēng ba ， néng nào jiù nào ba 。
例句.en: Every situation is an opportunity given to you by the universe. If you know how to make the most out of that situation, do it. It will be a wealth that lasts you a lifetime. If you missed out, gave up, or didn't even attempt to take advantage of the opportunity, the universe will set this chance aside for the next person, in a different time and place. But what's most important is that you lost precious time. Understand what you did wrong, and control the present. Then with proper restraint, if you can dance, dance. If you can sing, sing. If you can be wild, be wild. If you can be lively, be lively.

释义: hesitation / misgivings / doubt

例句.zh: 我对这个计划仍有疑虑。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhège jìhuà réng yǒu yílǜ.
例句.en: I still have concerns about this plan.

例句.zh: 如果你有任何疑虑，请告诉我。
例句.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu rènhé yílǜ, qǐng gàosu wǒ.
例句.en: If you have any concerns, please let me know.

例句.zh: 他的解释消除了我的疑虑。
例句.pinyin: Tā de jiěshì xiāochú le wǒ de yílǜ.
例句.en: His explanation cleared up my doubts.

释义: one side / one aspect / simultaneously... (and...) / one's whole face

例句.zh: 硬币的一面叫做"公"，另一面叫做"字"。
例句.pinyin: yìng bì de yí miàn jiào zuò " gōng "， lìng yí miàn jiào zuò " zì "。
例句.en: One side of a coin is called 'heads' and the other side is called 'tails'.

例句.zh: 他一面开车一面听收音机的音乐。
例句.pinyin: tā yí miàn kāi chē yí miàn tīng shōu yīn jī de yīn yuè 。
例句.en: He drove the car, listening to music on the radio.

例句.zh: 我们每个人就像是月亮: 我们从来没有让别人看到我们黑暗的一面。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men měi gè rén jiù xiàng shì yuè liàng :  wǒ men cóng lái méi yǒu ràng bié rén kàn dào wǒ men hēi àn de yí miàn 。
例句.en: Each of us is like the moon: there is a dark side of us that we do not let others see.

释义: obvious at a glance (idiom) / obvious at a glance (idiom)

例句.zh: 男人老不老,自己心中有数;女人老不老,别人一目了然.
例句.pinyin: nán rén lǎo bù lǎo , zì jǐ xīn zhōng yǒu shù ; nǚ rén lǎo bù lǎo , bié rén yī mù liǎo rán .
例句.en: A man is as old as he feels and a woman as old as she looks.

释义: to leave / to abandon

例句.zh: 他觉得被社会遗弃了。
例句.pinyin: tā jué de bèi shè huì yí qì le 。
例句.en: He felt alienated from society.

例句.zh: 那幢房子看起来被遗弃了。
例句.pinyin: nà chuáng fáng zi kàn qǐ lái bèi yí qì le 。
例句.en: That house appears deserted.

例句.zh: 一个牧羊人把他一身白雪的山羊赶进被遗弃的山洞躲避暴风雪。
例句.pinyin: yí gè mù yáng rén bǎ tā yī shēn bái xuě de shān yáng gǎn jìn bèi yí qì de shān dòng duǒ bì bào fēng xuě 。
例句.en: A goatherd drove his goats, all white with snow, into a deserted cave for shelter.

释义: happy and content (idiom)

例句.zh: 爷爷坐在院子里喝茶，一副怡然自得的样子。
例句.pinyin: Yéye zuò zài yuànzi lǐ hē chá, yí fù yí rán zì dé de yàngzi.
例句.en: Grandpa sat drinking tea in the courtyard, looking happy and content.

例句.zh: 她躺在草地上晒太阳，显得怡然自得。
例句.pinyin: Tā tǎng zài cǎodì shàng shài tàiyáng, xiǎnde yí rán zì dé.
例句.en: She lay on the grass in the sun, looking happy and content.

例句.zh: 小猫在窗边怡然自得地睡着。
例句.pinyin: Xiǎomāo zài chuāngbiān yí rán zì dé de shuìzhe.
例句.en: The kitten is sleeping contentedly by the window.

释义: nice; pleasant; charming; hospitable to people
短释义: nice; pleasant; charming; hospitable to people

例句.zh: 阳光明媚的地方，坐落著一座宜人的老农舍，紧邻一条深深的河流。从农舍一直到河边，长满了高大的牛蒡叶，最高的牛蒡叶下，可以让一个小孩站直身体。这地方如同茂密森林的中心，原始而静谧。一只鸭子栖息在这片幽静的角落，守候著雏鸟破壳而出。牠开始感到有些疲惫，因为小家伙们迟迟不肯破壳而出，而她也很少遇到来访者。
例句.pinyin: yáng guāng míng mèi de dì fāng ， zuò luò zhù yī zuò yí rén de lǎo nóng shè ， jǐn lín yī tiáo shēn shēn de hé liú 。 cóng nóng shè yì zhí dào hé biān ， zhǎng mǎn le gāo dà de niú bàng yè ， zuì gāo de niú bàng yè xià ， kě yǐ ràng yí gè xiǎo hái zhàn zhí shēn tǐ 。 zhè dì fāng rú tóng mào mì sēn lín de zhōng xīn ， yuán shǐ ér jìng mì 。 yī zhī yā zi qī xī zài zhè piàn yōu jìng de jiǎo luò ， shǒu hòu zhù chú niǎo pò ké ér chū 。 tā kāi shǐ gǎn dào yǒu xiē pí bèi ， yīn wèi xiǎo jiā huo men chí chí bù kěn pò ké ér chū ， ér tā yě hěn shǎo yù dào lái fǎng zhě 。
例句.en: In a sunny spot stood a pleasant old farm-house close by a deep river, and from the house down to the water side grew great burdock leaves, so high, that under the tallest of them a little child could stand upright. The spot was as wild as the centre of a thick wood. In this snug retreat sat a duck on her nest, watching for her young brood to hatch; she was beginning to get tired of her task, for the little ones were a long time coming out of their shells, and she seldom had any visitors.

释义: to lose; to leave behind (inadvertently)

例句.zh: 我的雨伞遗失在公园里某个地方。我必须再买一把。
例句.pinyin: wǒ de yǔ sǎn yí shī zài gōng yuán lǐ mǒu gè dì fāng 。 wǒ bì xū zài mǎi yī bǎ 。
例句.en: I have lost my umbrella somewhere in the park. I have to buy one.

例句.zh: 凡能将他遗失的钱寻回者可得到酬金。
例句.pinyin: fán néng jiāng tā yí shī de qián xún huí zhě kě dé dào chóu jīn 。
例句.en: A reward will be paid to anyone who brings back the money that he lost.

例句.zh: 汤姆遗失了他的钥匙。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ yí shī le tā de yào shi 。
例句.en: Tom has lost his keys.

释义: (idiom) to have achieved nothing; to be a total failure; to get nowhere
短释义: (idiom) to have achieved nothing; to be a total failure; to get nowhere

例句.zh: 他忙了半天，最后还是一事无成。
例句.pinyin: Tā máng le bàntiān, zuìhòu háishi yí shì wú chéng.
例句.en: He worked for ages but ended up achieving nothing.

例句.zh: 没有明确的目标，很容易一事无成。
例句.pinyin: Méiyǒu míngquè de mùbiāo, hěn róngyì yí shì wú chéng.
例句.en: Without clear goals, it is easy to get nowhere.

例句.zh: 他不想一辈子一事无成。
例句.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng yí bèizi yí shì wú chéng.
例句.en: He doesn't want to go through life without achieving anything.

释义: remains (of a dead person)

例句.zh: 警方在河边发现了一具遗体。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng zài hébiān fāxiàn le yí jù yítǐ.
例句.en: The police found a body by the river.

例句.zh: 家属已将遗体送往殡仪馆。
例句.pinyin: Jiāshǔ yǐ jiāng yítǐ sòng wǎng bìnyíguǎn.
例句.en: The family has sent the remains to the funeral home.

例句.zh: 他的遗体被安葬在家乡。
例句.pinyin: Tā de yítǐ bèi ānzàng zài jiāxiāng.
例句.en: His remains were buried in his hometown.

释义: to forget; to cease to think about (sb or sth) anymore
短释义: to forget; to cease to think about (sb or sth) anymore

例句.zh: 对于那些彻夜关注美国大选的海外人士，从国会到皇宫，以及在被遗忘的角落里挤在收音机旁的人们，我们的经历虽然各有不同，但是我们的命运是一样的，新的美国领导层已产生了。
例句.pinyin: duì yú nà xiē chè yè guān zhù měi guó dà xuǎn de hǎi wài rén shì ， cóng guó huì dào huáng gōng ， yǐ jí zài bèi yí wàng de jiǎo luò lǐ jǐ zài shōu yīn jī páng de rén men ， wǒ men de jīng lì suī rán gè yǒu bù tóng ， dàn shì wǒ men de mìng yùn shì yī yàng de ， xīn de měi guó lǐng dǎo céng yǐ chǎn shēng le 。
例句.en: And all those watching tonight from beyond our shores, from parliaments and palaces, to those who are huddled around radios in the forgotten corners of the world, our stories are singular, but our destiny is shared, and a new dawn of American leadership is at hand.

例句.zh: 在时间的洗礼下，这事件已经被人们遗忘。
例句.pinyin: zài shí jiān de xǐ lǐ xià ， zhè shì jiàn yǐ jīng bèi rén men yí wàng 。
例句.en: By the shower of time, people have forgotten this event.

例句.zh: 失败的革命很快就被遗忘了。
例句.pinyin: shī bài de gé mìng hěn kuài jiù bèi yí wàng le 。
例句.en: Defeated revolutions are forgotten quickly.

释义: persistently; stubbornly; blindly

例句.zh: 遇到问题不能一味逃避。
例句.pinyin: Yùdào wèntí bù néng yíwèi táobì.
例句.en: You shouldn't blindly avoid problems.

例句.zh: 他一味追求速度，忽视了质量。
例句.pinyin: Tā yíwèi zhuīqiú sùdù, hūshì le zhìliàng.
例句.en: He persistently pursued speed while neglecting quality.

例句.zh: 父母不该一味满足孩子的要求。
例句.pinyin: Fùmǔ bù gāi yíwèi mǎnzú háizi de yāoqiú.
例句.en: Parents shouldn't blindly satisfy their children's demands.

释义: personal effects (of the deceased); artifacts; relics; (biological) remains
短释义: personal effects (of the deceased); artifacts; relics; (biological) remains

例句.pinyin: zǒng yǒu yī xiē dōng xī wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù néng xué huì ， wǒ de shēng mìng bú shì yǒng héng de ！

例句.zh: 现在是我们回答这个问题的机会。这是我们的时刻这是我们的时代--让我们的人民重新就业，为我们的后代敞开机会之门，恢复繁荣，推进和平，重新确立“美国梦”，再次证明这样一个基本的真理：我们是一家人；只要一息尚存，我们就有希望；当我们遇到嘲讽和怀疑，当有人说我们办不到的时候，我们要以这个永恒的信条来回应他们。是的，我们能做到
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì wǒ men huí dá zhè ge wèn tí de jī huì 。 zhè shì wǒ men de shí kè zhè shì wǒ men de shí dài -- ràng wǒ men de rén mín chóng xīn jiù yè ， wèi wǒ men de hòu dài chǎng kāi jī huì zhī mén ， huī fù fán róng ， tuī jìn hé píng ， chóng xīn què lì “ měi guó mèng ”， zài cì zhèng míng zhè yàng yí gè jī běn de zhēn lǐ ： wǒ men shì yī jiā rén ； zhǐ yào yī xī shàng cún ， wǒ men jiù yǒu xī wàng ； dāng wǒ men yù dào cháo fěng hé huái yí ， dāng yǒu rén shuō wǒ men bàn bú dào de shí hòu ， wǒ men yào yǐ zhè ge yǒng héng de xìn tiáo lái huí yìng tā men 。 shì de ， wǒ men néng zuò dào
例句.en: This is our chance to answer that call. This is our moment. This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. And where we are met with cynicism and doubt and those who tell us that we can't, we will respond with that timeless creed that sums up the spirit of a people: Yes, we can.

释义: fortunately

例句.zh: 美国，我们已经走过了一条漫漫长路。我们已经历了很多。但是我们仍有很多事情要做。因此今夜，请让我们自问--如果我们的孩子能够活到下个世纪；如果我的女儿有幸活得和安一样长，她们将会看到怎样的改变？我们将会取得什么样的进步。

例句.en: America, we have come so far. We have seen so much. But there is so much more to do. So tonight, let us ask ourselves, if our children should live to see the next century, if my daughters should be so lucky to live as long as Ann Nixon Cooper, what change will they see? What progress will we have made?

例句.pinyin: Zhè wèi yuànshì chángqī cóngshì réngōng zhìnéng yánjiū.

例句.en: A Story on Another Planet: On a faraway planet, there are two suns in the blue sky, Strong and Beauteous. A child asketh the mother, "Dearest mother, why are there two suns in the sky?" Saith the mother, "Oh, what kind of question is that? How many eyes hast thou? 'Tis two. How many hands hast thou? 'Tis two." The child respondeth, "But, mother, I have but one nose..."

This morning, here on Lulu Island, I strolled to Tim Hortons café twice—Iced Coffee with oat milk, then Strawberry Watermelon Sparkling Quencher with a Sausage Farmer's Wrap. I went to the "Clam Temple." On the way, I glanced at the charming bamboo grove. An old man had dug holes beside it to put compost—eaten mangoes and cherries. Today, head-shaven Greg is wearing a beige T-shirt and beige shorts—maybe a hint of Chabacano?

This is our time, to put our people back to work and open doors of opportunity for our kids; to restore prosperity and promote the cause of peace; to reclaim the American dream and reaffirm that fundamental truth, that out of many, we are one; that while we breathe, we hope. 例句.zh: 今天是 2013 年 6 月 27 日。蓝色梦想不只有一种，而是有很多种。国际语并非唯一。几十年来，一直存在著其他拉丁语系的人工语言，分别属于不同的专案。未来，有些人寄望于其他语言。但世界语，这个绿色梦想，却成功传承了一个多世纪。几十年来，推行世界语的革命尝试都以失败告终，因为真正的世界语拥有一种无法篡改的艺术平衡。世界语依然历久不衰。在蓝色阵营中，我仍然选择国际语。应该有更多的人给它一个机会。世界语的重音赋予了这种语言一种魅力，或许正是这种魅力推动了它多年来的生存。但世界上也有其他替代方案。
例句.pinyin: jīn tiān shì  2013  nián  6  yuè  27  rì 。 lán sè mèng xiǎng bù zhǐ yǒu yī zhǒng ， ér shì yǒu hěn duō zhǒng 。 guó jì yǔ bìng fēi wéi yī 。 jǐ shí nián lái ， yì zhí cún zài zhù qí tā lā dīng yǔ xì de rén gōng yǔ yán ， fēn bié shǔ yú bù tóng de zhuān àn 。 wèi lái ， yǒu xiē rén jì wàng yú qí tā yǔ yán 。 dàn shì jiè yǔ ， zhè ge lǜ sè mèng xiǎng ， què chéng gōng chuán chéng le yí gè duō shì jì 。 jǐ shí nián lái ， tuī xíng shì jiè yǔ de gé mìng cháng shì dōu yǐ shī bài gào zhōng ， yīn wèi zhēn zhèng de shì jiè yǔ yōng yǒu yī zhǒng wú fǎ cuàn gǎi de yì shù píng héng 。 shì jiè yǔ yī rán lì jiǔ bù shuāi 。 zài lán sè zhèn yíng zhōng ， wǒ réng rán xuǎn zé guó jì yǔ 。 yīng gāi yǒu gèng duō de rén gěi tā yí gè jī huì 。 shì jiè yǔ de zhòng yīn fù yǔ le zhè zhǒng yǔ yán yī zhǒng mèi lì ， huò xǔ zhèng shì zhè zhǒng mèi lì tuī dòng le tā duō nián lái de shēng cún 。 dàn shì jiè shàng yě yǒu qí tā tì dài fāng àn 。
例句.en: It is the 27th of June of 2013. The Blue Dreams are plural. The Blue Dreams are many. Interlingua is not the only one. For decades now, there have existed other Latinate conlangs, different projects. And in the future, some hope for others. But it has been the Green Dream, Esperanto, that has succeeded for more than a century. Reforms attempted upon Esperanto have met with failure over the decades because genuine Esperanto has an artistic balance with which one cannot tamper. Esperanto remains enduring. Amongst the Blues, my vote is still Interlingua. More people should give it a chance. Esperanto's accents give a charm to the language that perhaps boosted its survival over the years. There are substitute systems.

例句.zh: ​我们​来​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，说​不​同​的​语言。可是，我们​十分​团结，大家​都​有​同样​的​目标。最​重要​的​是，我们​都​渴望​尊荣​耶和华，耶和华​就是​圣经​所​说​的​上帝，他​是​万物​的​创造主。我们​尽力​效法​耶稣基督，以​身​为​基督徒​为​荣。我们​每​个​人​都​常常​花​时间​帮助​别人​认识​圣经​和​上帝​的​王国。由于​我们​为​耶和华​上帝​和​他​的​王国​作​见证，也​就是​向​别人​传讲​上帝​和​他​王国​的​真理，所以​我们​称​为​耶和华见证人。
例句.pinyin: ​ wǒ men ​ lái ​ zì ​ shì jiè ​ gè ​ dì ， yǒu ​ bù ​ tóng ​ de ​ wén huà ​ bèi jǐng ， shuō ​ bù ​ tóng ​ de ​ yǔ yán 。 kě shì ， wǒ men ​ shí fēn ​ tuán jié ， dà jiā ​ dōu ​ yǒu ​ tóng yàng ​ de ​ mù biāo 。 zuì ​ zhòng yào ​ de ​ shì ， wǒ men ​ dōu ​ kě wàng ​ zūn róng ​ yē hé huá ， yē hé huá ​ jiù shì ​ shèng jīng ​ suǒ ​ shuō ​ de ​ shàng dì ， tā ​ shì ​ wàn wù ​ de ​ chuàng zào zhǔ 。 wǒ men ​ jìn lì ​ xiào fǎ ​ yē sū jī dū ， yǐ ​ shēn ​ wèi ​ jī dū tú ​ wèi ​ róng 。 wǒ men ​ měi ​ gè ​ rén ​ dōu ​ cháng cháng ​ huā ​ shí jiān ​ bāng zhù ​ bié rén ​ rèn shí ​ shèng jīng ​ hé ​ shàng dì ​ de ​ wáng guó 。 yóu yú ​ wǒ men ​ wèi ​ yē hé huá ​ shàng dì ​ hé ​ tā ​ de ​ wáng guó ​ zuò ​ jiàn zhèng ， yě ​ jiù shì ​ xiàng ​ bié rén ​ chuán jiǎng ​ shàng dì ​ hé ​ tā ​ wáng guó ​ de ​ zhēn lǐ ， suǒ yǐ ​ wǒ men ​ chēng ​ wèi ​ yē hé huá jiàn zhèng rén 。
例句.en: We come from hundreds of ethnic and language backgrounds, yet we are united by common goals. Above all, we want to honor Jehovah, the God of the Bible and the Creator of all things. We do our best to imitate Jesus Christ and are proud to be called Christians. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and God’s Kingdom. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

释义: (production) target; quota / index; indicator / sign; signpost / (computing) pointer

例句.pinyin: Zhège yuè de shēngchǎn zhǐbiāo yǐjīng wánchéng le.
例句.en: This month's production target has already been met.

例句.zh: 公司给每个销售员定了明确的指标。
例句.pinyin: Gōngsī gěi měi ge xiāoshòuyuán dìng le míngquè de zhǐbiāo.
例句.en: The company set a clear target for each salesperson.

例句.zh: 我们必须按时完成出口指标。

例句.en: We must meet the export quota on time.

例句.zh: 看到警示牌后，游客们立即止步。
例句.pinyin: Kàndào jǐngshìpái hòu, yóukèmen lìjí zhǐbù.
例句.en: The tourists stopped immediately after seeing the warning sign.

例句.zh: 我们不能止步于眼前的成绩。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng zhǐbù yú yǎnqián de chéngjì.
例句.en: We must not stop at our current achievements.

释义: to point out / to indicate / to give directions / to show how (to do sth) / to censure / to pick at

例句.en: Can you show me the way please?

例句.en: It is bad manners to point at people.

例句.en: Whatever words you have, just say them.

例句.pinyin: wǒ de zhǐ jiǎ duàn le 。

例句.zh: 不要再咬指甲了。
例句.pinyin: bú yào zài yǎo zhǐ jiǎ le 。
例句.en: Stop biting your nails.

释义: to offer advice, guidance, or feedback
短释义: to offer advice, guidance, or feedback

例句.zh: 谢谢您的指教。
例句.pinyin: xiè xiè nín de zhǐ jiào 。
例句.en: Thanks for your advice.

释义: accusation / a (criminal) charge / to accuse

例句.zh: 他被指控偷钱。
例句.pinyin: tā bèi zhǐ kòng tōu qián 。
例句.en: He was accused of stealing money.

例句.zh: 警方指控他谋杀。
例句.pinyin: jǐng fāng zhǐ kòng tā móu shā 。
例句.en: The police accused him of murder.

例句.zh: 他被指控犯有好几起侵犯财产罪。
例句.pinyin: tā bèi zhǐ kòng fàn yǒu hǎo jǐ qǐ qīn fàn cái chǎn zuì 。
例句.en: He is charged with multiple property crimes.

例句.pinyin: zú qiú jiào liàn zhàn zài biān xiàn shàng duì zì jǐ de duì wǔ hǎn chū zhǐ lìng 。
例句.en: The manager and coach stood on the touchline shouting out instructions to their team.

释义: to guide / guidebook

例句.zh: 这家酒店在旅行指南上有四星级的评分，但是却完全没有四星级的水准。
例句.pinyin: zhè jiā jiǔ diàn zài lǚ xíng zhǐ nán shàng yǒu sì xīng jí de píng fēn ， dàn shì què wán quán méi yǒu sì xīng jí de shuǐ zhǔn 。
例句.en: This hotel is far from deserving the four stars the guidebook gives it.

例句.zh: 根据指南，这是这附近最好的餐馆。
例句.pinyin: gēn jù zhǐ nán ， zhè shì zhè fù jìn zuì hǎo de cān guǎn 。
例句.en: According to the guidebook, this is the best restaurant around here.

释义: lit. military tactics on paper (idiom) / fig. theoretical discussion that is worse than useless in practice / armchair strategist / idle theorizing / cf Zhao Kuo 趙括|赵括[Zhao4 Kuo4] leading an army of 400,000 to total annihilation at battle of Changping 長平之戰|长平之战[Chang2 ping2 zhi1 Zhan4] in 260 BC

例句.zh: 计划再好，不执行也只是纸上谈兵。
例句.pinyin: Jìhuà zài hǎo, bù zhíxíng yě zhǐshì zhǐshàng-tánbīng.
例句.en: No matter how good a plan is, it is just empty talk if it is not carried out.

例句.zh: 我们需要采取行动，而不是纸上谈兵。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào cǎiqǔ xíngdòng, ér bú shì zhǐshàng-tánbīng.
例句.en: We need to take action instead of merely discussing things on paper.

例句.zh: 没有实际经验，再多的理论也可能是纸上谈兵。
例句.pinyin: Méiyǒu shíjì jīngyàn, zài duō de lǐlùn yě kěnéng shì zhǐshàng-tánbīng.
例句.en: Without practical experience, even extensive theoretical knowledge may amount to nothing more than armchair strategy.

释义: to gesticulate while talking (idiom) / to explain by waving one's hands / to criticize or give orders summarily

例句.zh: 不要让她对你指手画脚。
例句.pinyin: bú yào ràng tā duì nǐ zhǐ shǒu huà jiǎo 。
例句.en: Don't let yourself be bossed around by her.

释义: (numerical, statistical) index / (math.) exponent / (attributive) exponential

例句.zh: 嗨，先生，黑板上的不是指数函数，而是三角函数。
例句.pinyin: hāi ， xiān shēng ， hēi bǎn shàng de bú shì zhǐ shù hán shù ， ér shì sān jiǎo hán shù 。
例句.en: Hey, sir, the function on the blackboard is not exponential, but trigonometric.

例句.zh: 这项应用程序能让你快速计算身高体重指数（BMI）。
例句.pinyin: zhè xiàng yìng yòng chéng xù néng ràng nǐ kuài sù jì suàn shēn gāo tǐ zhòng zhǐ shù （BMI）。
例句.en: The application allows you to quickly calculate the ratio of body mass index - BMI.

例句.zh: 总读数表的身高体重指数分类（体重过轻、超重或肥胖）不适用于运动员、儿童、老人和体弱者。
例句.pinyin: zǒng dú shù biǎo de shēn gāo tǐ zhòng zhǐ shù fēn lèi （ tǐ zhòng guò qīng 、 chāo zhòng huò féi pàng ） bù shì yòng yú yùn dòng yuán 、 ér tóng 、 lǎo rén hé tǐ ruò zhě 。
例句.en: BMI categories (underweight, overweight or obese) from general reading table are inappropriate for athletes, children, the elderly, and the infirm.

释义: to count on; to hope for / prospect; hope
短释义: to count on; to hope for

例句.zh: 你不能指望我一直考虑周到！
例句.pinyin: nǐ bù néng zhǐ wàng wǒ yì zhí kǎo lǜ zhōu dào ！
例句.en: You can't expect me to always think of everything!

例句.zh: 别指望别人来为你考虑！
例句.pinyin: bié zhǐ wàng bié rén lái wèi nǐ kǎo lǜ ！
例句.en: Don't expect others to think for you!

例句.zh: 我就指望你了。
例句.pinyin: wǒ jiù zhǐ wàng nǐ le 。
例句.en: I'm counting on you.

例句.zh: 汤姆小心翼翼地把刀子上的指纹擦掉。
例句.pinyin: tāng mǔ xiǎo xīn yì yì dì bǎ dāo zi shàng de zhǐ wén cā diào 。
例句.en: Tom carefully wiped his fingerprints off the knife.

例句.zh: 你的指纹怎么会在这个玻璃杯上?
例句.pinyin: nǐ de zhǐ wén zěn me huì zài zhè ge bō lí bēi shàng ?
例句.en: How come your fingerprints are on this glass?

例句.zh: 那差不多就是完美犯罪：我们到达现场，打开行李箱，杀了那人并消除指纹，但我们忘了藏尸体。
例句.pinyin: nà chà bu duō jiù shì wán měi fàn zuì ： wǒ men dào dá xiàn chǎng ， dǎ kāi xíng lǐ xiāng ， shā le nà rén bìng xiāo chú zhǐ wén ， dàn wǒ men wàng le cáng shī tǐ 。
例句.en: It was almost the perfect crime: we arrived at the scene, opened the trunk, killed the man and cleaned up the prints, but we forgot to hide the body.

释义: to point towards / aimed at / facing / the direction indicated

例句.zh: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
例句.pinyin: wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒu qiāng zhǐ xiàng le mù biāo 。
例句.en: I aimed my gun at the target.

例句.zh: 温度计指向十度。
例句.pinyin: wēn dù jì zhǐ xiàng shí dù 。
例句.en: The thermometer reads 10 degrees.

例句.zh: 指南针指向北边。
例句.pinyin: zhǐ nán zhēn zhǐ xiàng běi biān 。
例句.en: The compass points to the north.

释义: to guide / to show / to point (the way) / directions / guidance / guidelines

例句.zh: 营辅员应负责为学生提供指引和辅导。
例句.pinyin: yíng fǔ yuán yīng fù zé wèi xué shēng tí gōng zhǐ yǐn hé fǔ dǎo 。
例句.en: The camp counselors are supposed to provide guidance and mentorship to the students.

释义: to have as its purpose / to be intended to / to aim to (do sth)

例句.zh: 自由旨在能够做所有不伤害其他人的事。
例句.pinyin: zì yóu zhǐ zài néng gòu zuò suǒ yǒu bù shāng hài qí tā rén de shì 。
例句.en: Liberty consists of being able to make everything as harmless as possible.

例句.zh: 市政府举行了一次大型公会，旨在促进跨部门合作。
例句.pinyin: shì zhèng fǔ jǔ xíng le yī cì dà xíng gōng huì ， zhǐ zài cù jìn kuà bù mén hé zuò 。
例句.en: The city government held a large conference aimed at promoting cross-departmental cooperation.

例句.zh: 1916 年，橙子过剩催生了「喝一颗橙子」的广告语，旨在让人们相信，将一颗橙子 (或数颗橙子) 榨汁是开始新一天的健康方式。
例句.pinyin: 1916  nián ， chéng zi guò shèng cuī shēng le 「 hē yī kē chéng zi 」 de guǎng gào yǔ ， zhǐ zài ràng rén men xiāng xìn ， jiāng yī kē chéng zi  ( huò shù kē chéng zi )  zhà zhī shì kāi shǐ xīn yī tiān de jiàn kāng fāng shì 。
例句.en: In 1916, a surplus of oranges gave birth to the advertising slogan, “Drink an orange,” which aimed to convince people that juicing an orange (or a few oranges) was a healthy way to start the day.

释义: (bound form) fine; delicate; exquisite / (literary) to send; to transmit; to convey / (bound form) to cause; to lead to; consequently

例句.zh: 道路结冰导致了很多起事故。
例句.pinyin: dào lù jié bīng dǎo zhì le hěn duō qǐ shì gù 。
例句.en: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.

例句.zh: 工厂的废料导致了严重的环境污染。
例句.pinyin: gōng chǎng de fèi liào dǎo zhì le yán zhòng de huán jìng wū rǎn 。
例句.en: The factory waste gave rise to serious environmental pollution.

例句.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
例句.pinyin: yǒu shí hòu kǒu wù duì zhèng zhì jiā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de 。
例句.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.

释义: to install / to place / to put / to buy

例句.zh: 老师给我们布置了家庭作业。
例句.pinyin: lǎo shī gěi wǒ men bù zhì le jiā tíng zuò yè 。
例句.en: The teacher gave us homework.

例句.zh: 这个装置是用开关启动的。
例句.pinyin: zhè ge zhuāng zhì shì yòng kāi guān qǐ dòng de 。
例句.en: This device is actuated by a switch.

例句.zh: 地图帮助我们知道所在的位置。
例句.pinyin: dì tú bāng zhù wǒ men zhī dào suǒ zài de wèi zhì 。
例句.en: A map helps us to know where we are.

释义: law and order / public security

例句.zh: 这个小区的治安很好。
例句.pinyin: Zhè ge xiǎoqū de zhì’ān hěn hǎo.
例句.en: Law and order in this neighborhood is very good.

例句.zh: 警方加强了夜间治安巡逻。
例句.pinyin: Jǐngfāng jiāqiáng le yèjiān zhì’ān xúnluó.
例句.en: The police have increased nighttime patrols to maintain law and order.

例句.zh: 良好的治安让居民更安心。
例句.pinyin: Liánghǎo de zhì’ān ràng jūmín gèng ānxīn.
例句.en: Good law and order makes residents feel safer.

释义: to punish / punishment / sanctions (incl. economic)

例句.zh: 巴西最高法院大法官亚历山大德莫赖斯因涉嫌在针对雅伊尔博索纳罗的案件中侵犯人权 (例如审查和任意拘留)，而受到《全球马格尼茨基人权问责法》的制裁。这些制裁引发了美国和巴西之间的外交和经济紧张局势。
例句.pinyin: bā xī zuì gāo fǎ yuàn dà fǎ guān yà lì shān dà dé mò lài sī yīn shè xián zài zhēn duì yǎ yī ěr bó suǒ nà luó de àn jiàn zhōng qīn fàn rén quán  ( lì rú shěn chá hé rèn yì jū liú )， ér shòu dào 《 quán qiú mǎ gé ní cí jī rén quán wèn zé fǎ 》 de zhì cái 。 zhè xiē zhì cái yǐn fā le měi guó hé bā xī zhī jiān de wài jiāo hé jīng jì jǐn zhāng jú shì 。
例句.en: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes was sanctioned under the Global Magnitsky Act for alleged rights violations, such as censorship and arbitrary detention, in the case against Jair Bolsonaro. The sanctions have sparked diplomatic and economic tensions between the US and Brazil.

释义: to express in words or writing / to make a speech (esp. short introduction, vote of thanks, afterword, funeral homily etc) / to address (an audience) / same as 致詞|致词
短释义: to express in words or writing

例句.zh: 校长在毕业典礼上致辞。
例句.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng zài bìyè diǎnlǐ shàng zhìcí.
例句.en: The principal delivered a speech at the graduation ceremony.

例句.zh: 市长将为开幕式致辞。
例句.pinyin: Shìzhǎng jiāng wèi kāimùshì zhìcí.
例句.en: The mayor will deliver a speech at the opening ceremony.

例句.zh: 她代表全体员工致辞。
例句.pinyin: Tā dàibiǎo quántǐ yuángōng zhìcí.
例句.en: She delivered a speech on behalf of all the employees.

释义: up until now / so far

例句.zh: 事已至此。
例句.pinyin: shì yǐ zhì cǐ 。
例句.en: What's done is done.

例句.zh: 我至此只见过他一次。
例句.pinyin: wǒ zhì cǐ zhǐ jiàn guò tā yī cì 。
例句.en: I've met him only once so far.

释义: texture / background (texture) / grain / quality / character / disposition

例句.pinyin: Zhè jiàn máoyī de zhìdì hěn róuruǎn.
例句.en: The texture of this sweater is very soft.

例句.zh: 这种木材质地坚硬。

例句.en: This kind of wood has a hard texture.

例句.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan zhè kuài bù de zhìdì.
例句.en: I like the texture of this fabric.

释义: to become rich

例句.zh: 你想致富吗？
例句.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng zhì fù ma ？
例句.en: Do you want to be rich?

释义: to lag behind

例句.zh: 我有一星期没用Anki了，现在我有五百张卡片滞后。
例句.pinyin: wǒ yǒu yī xīng qī méi yòng Anki le ， xiàn zài wǒ yǒu wǔ bǎi zhāng kǎ piàn zhì hòu 。
例句.en: I haven't used Anki for a week, and now I'm behind by 500 cards.

释义: to salute / to pay one's respects to / to pay tribute to / to pay homage to

例句.zh: 我们向英雄致敬。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàng yīngxióng zhìjìng.
例句.en: We salute the heroes.

例句.zh: 这部电影向经典致敬。
例句.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng xiàng jīngdiǎn zhìjìng.
例句.en: This film pays tribute to the classics.

例句.zh: 全场起立，向老兵致敬。
例句.pinyin: Quánchǎng qǐlì, xiàng lǎobīng zhìjìng.
例句.en: Everyone stood up to salute the veterans.

短释义: (of a person) to remain in (a place) (due to circumstances that prevent one leaving); to be stranded

例句.zh: 大雪导致许多旅客滞留在机场。
例句.pinyin: Dàxuě dǎozhì xǔduō lǚkè zhìliú zài jīchǎng.

例句.zh: 因签证问题，他被迫滞留国外。
例句.pinyin: Yīn qiānzhèng wèntí, tā bèipò zhìliú guówài.

例句.zh: 现在是 2025 年 8 月 3 日，露露岛。晚餐后，阳光下嫩绿的无花果，昨天腌制的甜醋，还有重新加热的阿尔弗雷多义面，我坐在阳台上，望著那棵针叶树。楼下静谧无声，街道空无一车，一片悠闲。我的冰镇青柠水在阳光下闪闪发光。最近，我常和那位法丹混血的 UFO 研究专家麦可聊天。我们谈论内心深处的事情：智慧型装置的迷醉，以及思维的衰退。他说，咖啡馆已经不再是咖啡馆了。人们忘记如何观察、如何驻足停留。我跟他讲起在日本的亚瑟，他会像僧侣凝视虚空一样，对著空白的墙壁发呆。最近，我让机器像诗人一样说话，它们真的做到了。它们模仿伊莉莎白时代的诗歌，以及塔加洛语民谣中那古老而忧伤的韵律。我沿著通往蒂姆霍顿咖啡店的小路采摘黑莓。我像个孩子似的喊道：「莫拉！」我的朋友莫拉，她血液里流著安地斯山脉的薄雾，她会笑的。今天，我买了黄柠檬。我本来想买青柠，但黄柠檬也可以。/ 黑莓的清晨 / 指尖残留无花果的痕迹 / 街道依然沉睡
例句.pinyin: xiàn zài shì  2025  nián  8  yuè  3  rì ， lù lù dǎo 。 wǎn cān hòu ， yáng guāng xià nèn lǜ de wú huā guǒ ， zuó tiān yān zhì de tián cù ， hái yǒu chóng xīn jiā rè de ā ěr fú léi duō yì miàn ， wǒ zuò zài yáng tái shàng ， wàng zhù nà kē zhēn yè shù 。 lóu xià jìng mì wú shēng ， jiē dào kōng wú yī chē ， yī piàn yōu xián 。 wǒ de bīng zhèn qīng níng shuǐ zài yáng guāng xià shǎn shǎn fā guāng 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ cháng hé nà wèi fǎ dān hùn xuè de  UFO  yán jiū zhuān jiā mài kě liáo tiān 。 wǒ men tán lùn nèi xīn shēn chù de shì qíng ： zhì huì xíng zhuāng zhì de mí zuì ， yǐ jí sī wéi de shuāi tuì 。 tā shuō ， kā fēi guǎn yǐ jīng bù zài shì kā fēi guǎn le 。 rén men wàng jì rú hé guān chá 、 rú hé zhù zú tíng liú 。 wǒ gēn tā jiǎng qǐ zài rì běn de yà sè ， tā huì xiàng sēng lǚ níng shì xū kōng yī yàng ， duì zhù kòng bái de qiáng bì fā dāi 。 zuì jìn ， wǒ ràng jī qì xiàng shī rén yī yàng shuō huà ， tā men zhēn de zuò dào le 。 tā men mó fǎng yī lì shā bái shí dài de shī gē ， yǐ jí tǎ jiā luò yǔ mín yáo zhōng nà gǔ lǎo ér yōu shāng de yùn lǜ 。 wǒ yán zhù tōng wǎng dì mǔ huò dùn kā fēi diàn de xiǎo lù cǎi zhāi hēi méi 。 wǒ xiàng gè hái zi shì de hǎn dào ：「 mò lā ！」 wǒ de péng yǒu mò lā ， tā xuè yè lǐ liú zhù ān dì sī shān mài de bó wù ， tā huì xiào de 。 jīn tiān ， wǒ mǎi le huáng níng méng 。 wǒ běn lái xiǎng mǎi qīng níng ， dàn huáng níng méng yě kě yǐ 。/  hēi méi de qīng chén  /  zhǐ jiān cán liú wú huā guǒ de hén jì  /  jiē dào yī rán chén shuì
例句.en: It's Lulu Island, 3 August 2025. After supper—green figs tender with sunlight, sweet vinegar from yesterday’s pickled jar, and reheated Alfredo—I sat on the balcony and watched the conifer. Stillness below, a street without cars, without haste. My lime water, iced, caught the light. Michael, the Franco-Danish ufologist, has been in my conversations lately. We speak of inner things: the trance of smart devices, the mind’s eye dwindling. He says cafés aren’t cafés anymore. People forget how to look, how to linger. I tell him of Arthur in Japan—how he'd stare into blank walls like a monk gazing at emptiness. Lately I ask machines to speak like poets, and they do. They mimic Elizabethan verses and the old wistful lilt of Tagalog ballads. I pick blackberries along the path to Tim Hortons. "¡Moras!" I shout like a child. My friend Mora, whose blood flows with Andes mist, would smile. Today, I bought lemons. I meant limes, but lemons are all right. / blackberry morning— / a fig's ghost on my fingers / and the street still sleeps

例句.zh: 过度自负会让人忽视自己的不足。

释义: independent / self-reliant / self-sustaining / to stand on one's own feet / to support oneself

例句.zh: 让我们记住，是伊利诺伊州的一名男子首次将共和党的旗帜扛到了白宫。共和党是建立在自立、个人自由以及国家团结的价值观之上的。这也是我们所有人共同的价值观。虽然民主党今天晚上赢得了巨大的胜利，但我们是以谦卑的态度和弥合阻碍我们进步的分歧的决心赢得这场胜利的
例句.pinyin: ràng wǒ men jì zhù ， shì yī lì nuò yī zhōu de yī míng nán zi shǒu cì jiāng gòng hé dǎng de qí zhì káng dào le bái gōng 。 gòng hé dǎng shì jiàn lì zài zì lì 、 gè rén zì yóu yǐ jí guó jiā tuán jié de jià zhí guān zhī shàng de 。 zhè yě shì wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén gòng tóng de jià zhí guān 。 suī rán mín zhǔ dǎng jīn tiān wǎn shàng yíng dé le jù dà de shèng lì ， dàn wǒ men shì yǐ qiān bēi de tài dù hé mí hé zǔ ài wǒ men jìn bù de fēn qí de jué xīn yíng dé zhè chǎng shèng lì de
例句.en: Let's remember that it was a man from this state who first carried the banner of the Republican Party to the White House, a party founded on the values of self-reliance and individual liberty and national unity. Those are values that we all share. And while the Democratic Party has won a great victory tonight, we do so with a measure of humility and determination to heal the divides that have held back our progress.

例句.zh: 我想更加自立。
例句.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gèng jiā zì lì 。

例句.zh: 十二生肖是由十一种源于自然界的动物即鼠、牛、虎、兔、蛇、马、羊、猴、鸡、狗、猪以及传说中的龙组成的，用于纪年。

例句.pinyin: nóng zuò wù xū yào yǔ shuǐ 。
例句.en: The crops need rain.

例句.zh: 我们种植各种的作物。
例句.pinyin: wǒ men zhòng zhí gè zhǒng de zuò wù 。
例句.en: We grow a variety of crops.

例句.zh: 通过遗传修饰，我们可以改良农作物。
例句.pinyin: tōng guò yí chuán xiū shì ， wǒ men kě yǐ gǎi liáng nóng zuò wù 。
例句.en: Through genetic modification, we can improve crops.

释义: to work and rest

例句.zh: 我们每天按固定时间作息。
例句.pinyin: Wǒmen měitiān àn gùdìng shíjiān zuòxī.
例句.en: We follow a fixed work-and-rest schedule every day.

例句.zh: 为了身体健康，我们应该规律作息。
例句.pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ jiànkāng, wǒmen yīnggāi guīlǜ zuòxī.
例句.en: For our health, we should keep regular hours.

例句.zh: 农民们通常随季节变化作息。
例句.pinyin: Nóngmínmen tōngcháng suí jìjié biànhuà zuòxī.
例句.en: Farmers usually adjust their work and rest according to the seasons.

释义: motto / maxim

例句.zh: “永不放弃”是我的座右铭。
例句.pinyin: “Yǒng bù fàngqì” shì wǒ de zuòyòumíng.
例句.en: “Never give up” is my motto.

例句.zh: 她把这句话当作自己的座右铭。
例句.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhè jù huà dàngzuò zìjǐ de zuòyòumíng.
例句.en: She takes this saying as her motto.

例句.zh: 你的座右铭是什么？
例句.pinyin: Nǐ de zuòyòumíng shì shénme?
例句.en: What is your motto?

释义: combat / to fight

例句.zh: 士兵作战时毫无畏缩，但到了最后还是不得不投降。
例句.pinyin: shì bīng zuò zhàn shí háo wú wèi suō ， dàn dào le zuì hòu hái shì bù dé bù tóu xiáng 。
例句.en: The soldiers fought valiantly, but finally they had to give in.

例句.zh: 民兵雕像是为了纪念独立战争中英勇作战的士兵。
例句.pinyin: mín bīng diāo xiàng shì wèi le jì niàn dú lì zhàn zhēng zhōng yīng yǒng zuò zhàn dī shì bīng 。
例句.en: The statue of the Minute Man commemorates the valiant soldiers who fought in the Revolutionary War.

例句.zh: 约阿夫行动是以色列独立战争中的一次作战行动。
例句.pinyin: yuē ā fū xíng dòng shì yǐ sè liè dú lì zhàn zhēng zhōng de yī cì zuò zhàn xíng dòng 。
例句.en: Operation Yoav was a military operation carried out by Israel in its war for independence.

释义: variant of 作證|作证[zuo4 zheng4]
短释义: variant of 作證|作证[zuo4 zheng4]

例句.zh: 我可以为你做证。
例句.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ wèi nǐ zuòzhèng.
例句.en: I can testify for you.

例句.zh: 她愿意出庭做证。
例句.pinyin: Tā yuànyì chūtíng zuòzhèng.
例句.en: She is willing to testify in court.

例句.zh: 当时有两个人能做证。
例句.pinyin: Dāngshí yǒu liǎng ge rén néng zuòzhèng.
例句.en: There were two people who could testify at the time.

释义: variant of 作主[zuo4 zhu3]

例句.zh: 这次校庆时，他将第一次做主角。
例句.pinyin: zhè cì xiào qìng shí ， tā jiāng dì yī cì zuò zhǔ jué 。
例句.en: He will play the leading role for the first time in the next school festival.
